abstract.text: CONTEXT: In response to concerns about the quality of care in US hospitals, the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services began measuring hospital performance and reporting this performance on their Web site, Hospital Compare. It is unknown whether these process performance measures are related to hospital-level outcomes. OBJECTIVE: To determine whether quality measured with the process measures used in Hospital Compare are correlated with and predictive of hospitals' risk-adjusted mortality rates. DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: Cross-sectional study of hospital care between January 1 and December 31, 2004, for acute myocardial infarction, heart failure, and pneumonia at acute care hospitals in the United States included on the Hospital Compare Web site. Ten process performance measures included in Hospital Compare were compared with hospital risk-adjusted mortality rates, which were measured using Medicare Part A claims data. MAIN OUTCOME MEASURES: Condition-specific inpatient, 30-day, and 1-year risk-adjusted mortality rates. RESULTS: A total of 3657 acute care hospitals were included in the study based on their performance as reported in Hospital Compare. Across all acute myocardial infarction performance measures, the absolute reduction in risk-adjusted mortality rates between hospitals performing in the 25th percentile vs those performing in the 75th percentile was 0.005 for inpatient mortality, 0.006 for 30-day mortality, and 0.012 for 1-year mortality (P<.001 for each comparison). For the heart failure performance measures, the absolute mortality reduction was smaller, ranging from 0.001 for inpatient mortality (P = .03) to 0.002 for 1-year mortality (P = .08). For the pneumonia performance measures, the absolute reduction in mortality ranged from 0.001 for 30-day mortality (P = .05) to 0.005 for inpatient mortality (P<.001). Differences in mortality rates for hospitals performing in the 75th percentile on all measures within a condition vs those performing lower than the 25th percentile on all reported measures for acute myocardial infarction ranged between 0.008 (P = .06) and 0.018 (P = .008). For pneumonia, the effects ranged between 0.003 (P = .09) and 0.014 (P<.001); for heart failure, the effects ranged between -0.013 (P = .06) and -0.038 (P = .45). CONCLUSIONS: Hospital performance measures predict small differences in hospital risk-adjusted mortality rates. Efforts should be made to develop performance measures that are tightly linked to patient outcomes.

10.1001/jama.296.22.2694.abstractZh: 背景：为了回应人们对美国医院护理质量的担忧，医疗保险与医疗补助服务中心开始衡量医院的表现，并在其网站Hospital Compare上公布这些表现数据。目前尚不清楚这些过程表现指标是否与医院层面的结果相关。目的：确定Hospital Compare中使用的过程表现指标所衡量出的质量是否与医院的风险调整死亡率相关，并能否预测这些死亡率。设计、背景与参与者：本研究为横断面研究，时间范围为2004年1月1日至12月31日，针对美国急性护理医院中患有急性心肌梗死、心力衰竭和肺炎的患者，这些医院的信息被收录在Hospital Compare网站上。研究比较了Hospital Compare中包含的10个过程表现指标与医院的风险调整死亡率，后者是通过Medicare Part A索赔数据来测量的。主要结果指标：特定疾病的住院患者30天和1年的风险调整死亡率。结果：根据Hospital Compare上的表现数据，共有3657家急性护理医院被纳入研究。在所有急性心肌梗死的表现指标中，表现位于第25百分位的医院与表现位于第75百分位的医院之间，住院死亡率的风险调整死亡率降低了0.005，30天死亡率降低了0.006，1年死亡率降低了0.012（每项比较的P值均小于0.001）。对于心力衰竭的表现指标，死亡率的降低幅度较小，从住院死亡率的0.001（P=0.03）到1年死亡率的0.002（P=0.08）不等。对于肺炎的绩效指标，死亡率的绝对降低幅度从30天死亡率的0.001（P=0.05）到住院死亡率的0.005（P<0.001）不等。对于急性心肌梗塞，在所有指标上处于第75百分位的医院与那些在所有指标上低于第25百分位的医院之间的死亡率差异在0.008（P=0.06）到0.018（P=0.008）之间。对于肺炎，这些差异在0.003（P=0.09）到0.014（P<0.001）之间；对于心力衰竭，这些差异在-0.013（P=0.06）到-0.038（P=0.45）之间。结论：医院绩效指标可以预测医院风险调整后的死亡率的微小差异。应努力开发与患者结果紧密相关的绩效指标。

abstract.text: The aim of this paper is to empirically analyse the responses by general practitioners to promotional activities for ethical drugs by pharmaceutical companies. Promotion can be beneficial as a means of providing information, but it can also be harmful in the sense that it lowers price sensitivity of doctors and it merely is a means of maintaining market share, even when cheaper, therapeutically equivalent drugs are available. A model is estimated that includes interactions of promotion expenditures and prices and that explicitly exploits the panel structure of the data, allowing for drug specific effects and dynamic adjustments, or habit persistence. The data used are aggregate monthly GP prescriptions per drug together with monthly outlays on drug promotion for the period 1994-1999 for 11 therapeutic markets, covering more than half of the total prescription drug market in the Netherlands. Identification of price effects is aided by the introduction of the Pharmaceutical Prices Act, which established that Dutch drugs prices became a weighted average of the prices in surrounding countries after June 1996. We conclude that GP drug price sensitivity is small, but adversely affected by promotion. Ltd.

10.1002/hec.1007.abstractZh: 本文旨在实证分析全科医生对制药公司推广道德药物的反应的状况。推广作为一种提供信息的手段可能是有益的，但也可能带来负面影响，因为它会降低医生的价格敏感度，并且仅仅是一种维持市场份额的手段，即使有价格更低、疗效相同的药物可用。本文建立了一个模型，该模型考虑了推广支出与价格之间的相互作用，并明确利用了数据的面板结构，从而能够分析特定药物的影响以及动态调整或习惯持续性。所使用的数据是1994年至1999年间11个治疗市场每月的全科医生处方情况以及每月用于药物推广的支出，这些数据涵盖了荷兰超过一半的处方药市场。通过引入《药品价格法》，可以辅助识别价格效应，该法律规定，自1996年6月起，荷兰药品价格成为周边国家价格的加权平均值。我们得出结论，全科医生对药物价格的敏感度较低，但会受到推广的负面影响。有限公司

abstract.text: Do Primary Care Physicians (PCPs) react strategically to financial incentives and if so how? To address this question, we follow a quasi-natural experiment in Quebec, using a panel system technique. In so doing, we both correct for underestimation biases in earlier time series findings and generate new results on the issue of complementarity/substitution between consultations with varying levels of technicality. Under both techniques, we show that PCPs are sensitive to the enforcement and subsequent temporary removals of expenditure caps and more generally, to changes in consultations' relative prices over time. These results support the existence of a discretionary power over the choice of consultation, PCPs increasing strategically the number of the more technical (and therefore more lucrative) consultations when pressed to defend their income. This finding for primary care parallels the now well-established DRG creep in hospitals. The panel system approach offers a better account of the complexity surrounding PCPs' decision-making process. In particular, it successfully addresses issues of physician heterogeneity, jointness between consultations and temporal breaks and generates robust estimates of PCPs volume and quality reactions to regulatory changes.

10.1002/hec.1012.abstractZh: 初级保健医生是否会针对经济激励采取策略性反应？如果会，又是如何反应的呢？为了探讨这个问题，我们在魁北克进行了一项准自然实验，采用了面板系统技术。通过这种方法，我们既纠正了早期时间序列研究中的低估偏差，又得出了关于不同技术程度下的咨询之间互补性或替代性的新结果。在两种技术下，我们发现初级保健医生对支出上限的强制执行及随后的临时取消非常敏感，同时也对咨询相对价格随时间的变化变化非常敏感。这些结果支持了初级保健医生在选择咨询方式方面拥有一定的自由裁量权，当面临收入压力时，初级保健医生会战略性地增加技术含量较高的咨询数量，因为这些咨询往往更有利可图。这一发现与医院中已广泛认可的DRG膨胀现象类似。面板系统方法更好地解释了初级保健医生决策过程的复杂性。特别是，它成功解决了医生异质性、咨询之间的关联性以及时间中断等问题，并得出了关于初级保健医生对监管变化反应的数量和质量的稳健估计。

abstract.text: The decision to undertake a screening test is conditional upon awareness of screening. From an econometric perspective there is a potential selection problem, if no distinction is made between aware and unaware non-screeners. This paper explores this problem through analysis of the determinants of cervical screening in Australia. Cervical cancer is one of the most preventable and curable forms of cancer. Since 1991 there has been a concerted effort in Australia to recommend and encourage women to have Pap smears every two years. The success of this program can be partly gauged by exploring the determinants of screening for cervical cancer. Using unit record data from the 1995 National Health Survey, an econometric model is developed for whether women have ever screened or not. A proportion of women in the sample contend that they have never heard of a Pap test. The analysis characterizes this group of women and accounts for their presence in the modelling. The paper demonstrates failing to model awareness can result in inconsistent parameter estimates even when the degree of censoring in the sample is relatively small.

10.1002/hec.1013.abstractZh: 进行筛查测试的决定取决于对筛查的认识程度。从计量经济学的角度来看，如果不对有意识和无意识的未筛查者进行区分，就存在潜在的选择问题。本文通过分析澳大利亚宫颈癌筛查的决定因素来探讨这一问题。宫颈癌是最容易预防和治愈的一种癌症。自1991年以来，澳大利亚一直在努力推荐并鼓励女性每两年进行一次巴氏涂片检查。这一计划的成功程度可以通过分析宫颈癌筛查的决定因素来衡量。利用1995年全国健康调查的单位记录数据，建立了一个计量经济模型，以判断女性是否曾经进行过筛查。样本中有部分女性声称从未听说过巴氏涂片检查。分析描述了这一群体的特征，并解释了她们在模型中的存在情况。本文表明，如果未能对意识程度进行建模，即使样本中的审查程度相对较小，也可能导致参数估计的不一致。

abstract.text: This paper uses two methods to compare the impact of health care payments under insurance and user fees. Concentration indices for insured and uninsured groups are computed following the indirect standardisation method to evaluate horizontal inequity in utilisation of basic health care services. The minimum standard approach analyses the extent to which out-of-pocket health spending contributed to increased poverty. The analysis uses cross-sectional household survey data collected in Rwanda in 2000 in the context of the introduction of community-based health insurance. Results indicate that health spending had a small impact on the socio-economic situation of uninsured and insured households; however, this is at the expense of horizontal inequity in utilisation of care for user-fee paying individuals who reported significantly lower visit rates than the insured.

10.1002/hec.1014.abstractZh: 本文采用两种方法比较了保险和用户付费制度下医疗支付的影响。通过间接标准化方法计算被保险人群和未被保险人群的浓度指数，以评估基本医疗服务的利用水平是否存在不平等现象。最小标准法分析了自付医疗费用在多大程度上导致了贫困的加剧。分析使用了2000年在卢旺达进行的横断面家庭调查数据，这些数据是在社区基础医疗保险制度引入的背景下收集的。结果表明，医疗支出对未被保险人群和被保险人群的社会经济状况的影响较小；然而，这种影响是以牺牲用户付费人群的医疗利用水平为代价的，这些人群的报告显示就诊率明显低于被保险人。

abstract.text: In most national surveys, health is measured as a categorical variable. However, in order to be able to calculate socio-economic inequalities in health, a continuous variable is needed. The recently developed interval regression approach was shown to outperform to other approaches like ordered probit. In this research we investigate the impact of using different sets of external data to estimate health inequalities: the EQ-index and the Canadian HUI. We found that the concentration index differs, but the income-related health mobility index and its decomposition are highly similar.

10.1002/hec.1015.abstractZh: 在大多数国家调查中，健康被作为分类变量来测量。然而，为了能够计算健康方面的社会经济不平等，需要一种连续变量来表示。最近开发的区间回归方法被证明比其他方法（如有序Probit模型）更为有效。在这项研究中，我们探讨了使用不同的外部数据集合来估计健康不平等的影响：EQ指数和加拿大HUI指数。我们发现，虽然浓度指数有所不同，但与收入相关的健康流动性指数及其分解结果却非常相似。

abstract.text: Although researchers agree that more educated people typically engage in healthier behaviors, they have not uncovered the reason why. This paper considers several explanations, including future opportunity costs. Future opportunity costs represent any utility-improving future outcome that is affected by currently engaging in health-related behavior. This paper also examines whether there are degree effects in the health behaviors of binge drinking and smoking. Results suggest that future opportunity costs may affect smoking, although other interpretations cannot be ruled out. The results also find degree effects with regard to binge drinking.

10.1002/hec.1019.abstractZh: 尽管研究人员一致认为，受教育程度较高的人通常会采取更健康的行为，但他们尚未找到其中的原因。本文提出了几种解释，包括未来的机会成本。未来的机会成本指的是由于当前采取健康相关行为而可能带来的任何提升效用的未来结果。本文还探讨了酗酒和吸烟等健康行为是否存在程度效应。研究结果表明，未来的机会成本可能会影响吸烟行为，尽管其他解释也不能被排除。研究结果还发现，酗酒行为也存在程度效应。

abstract.text: Objective This paper explores why traffic fatalities increase with GDP per capita in lower income countries and decrease with GDP per capita in wealthy countries. Methods Data from 41 countries for the period 1992-1996 were obtained on road transport crashes, injuries, and fatalities as well as numbers of vehicles, kilometers of roadway, oil consumption, population, and GDP. Fixed effects regression was used to control for unobservable heterogeneity among countries. Results A 10% increase in GDP in a lower income country (GDP/Capita <1600) is expected to raise the number of crashes by 7.9%, the number of traffic injuries by 4.7%, and the number of deaths by 3.1% through a mechanism that is independent of population size, vehicle counts, oil use, and roadway availability. Increases in GDP in richer countries appear to reduce the number of traffic deaths, but do not reduce the number of crashes or injuries, all else equal. Greater petrol use and alcohol use are related to more traffic fatalities in rich countries, all else equal. Conclusion In lower income countries a rise in traffic-related crashes, injuries, and deaths accompanies economic growth. At a threshold of around 1,500 dollars-8,000 dollars per capita economic growth no longer leads to additional traffic deaths, although crashes and traffic injuries continue to increase with growth. The negative association between GDP and traffic deaths in rich countries may be mediated by lower injury severity and post-injury ambulance transport and medical care.

10.1002/hec.1020.abstractZh: 目的 本文旨在探讨为何低收入国家的交通死亡人数随人均GDP的增加而增加，而富裕国家则随人均GDP的增加而减少。方法 研究采用了1992-1996年间41个国家的道路交通事故、受伤人数、死亡人数以及车辆数量、道路里程、石油消耗、人口和GDP的数据。采用固定效应回归模型来控制各国之间的不可观测异质性。结果 在低收入国家，人均GDP增加10%预计会导致交通事故数量增加7.9%，交通受伤人数增加4.7%，死亡人数增加3.1%。这种影响与人口规模、车辆数量、石油使用量和道路可用性无关。在富裕国家，GDP的增加似乎减少了交通死亡人数，但并未减少交通事故和受伤人数。在其他条件相同的情况下，石油使用和酒精使用量的增加与富裕国家的交通死亡人数增加有关。结论 在低收入国家，交通相关事故、受伤和死亡人数的增加伴随着经济增长。在人均GDP达到约1,500美元至8,000美元时，经济增长不再导致额外的交通死亡人数，尽管交通事故和交通受伤人数仍会随经济增长而增加。富裕国家GDP与交通死亡人数之间的负相关关系可能由较低的受伤严重程度以及受伤后的救护车运输和医疗护理所缓解。

abstract.text: The objective of this study is to determine the allocation of resources within a multi-site needle exchange program (NEP) that achieves the largest possible reduction in new HIV infections at minimum cost. We present a model that relates the number of injection drug user (IDU) clients and the number of syringes exchanged per client to both the costs of the NEP and the expected reduction in HIV infections per unit time. We show that cost-effective allocation within a multi-site NEP requires that sites be located where the density of IDUs is highest, and that the number of syringes exchanged per client be equal across sites. We apply these optimal allocation rules to a specific multi-site needle exchange program, Prevention Point Philadelphia (PPP). This NEP, we find, needs to add 2 or 3 new sites in neighborhoods with the highest density of IDU AIDS cases, and to increase its total IDU client base by about 28%, from approximately 6400 to 8200 IDU clients. The case-study NEP also needs to increase its hours of operation at two existing sites, where the number of needles distributed per client is currently sub-optimal, by 50%. At the optimal allocation, the estimated cost per case of HIV averted would be dollar 2800 (range dollar 2300-dollar 4200). Such a favorable cost-effectiveness ratio derives primarily from PPP's low marginal costs per distributed needle.

10.1002/hec.1021.abstractZh: 本研究的目标是确定在一个多站点针头交换计划中，如何以最低的成本实现最大程度的新HIV感染减少。我们提出了一个模型，该模型将注射药物使用者的数量以及每位使用者交换的注射针数量与针头交换计划的成本以及单位时间内预期的HIV感染减少量联系起来。研究表明，在多站点针头交换计划中，要实现成本效益最大化，需要将这些站点设置在注射药物使用者密度最高的地区，并且每位使用者的交换针数量在各个站点之间保持一致。我们将这些最优分配规则应用于一个具体的多站点针头交换计划——费城预防点。研究发现，该计划需要在注射药物使用者密度最高的社区增加2到3个新站点，并将总注射药物使用者数量增加约28%，从大约6400人增加到8200人。此外，该计划还需要在现有两个站点将操作时间延长50%，因为目前在这些站点中，每位使用者分配的针数量并不理想。在最优分配下，每避免一例HIV感染的估计成本将为2800美元（范围在2300到4200美元之间）。如此高的成本效益主要得益于费城预防点每分配一支针的较低边际成本。

abstract.text: An individual assessing a risky job can be understood as a public good. He and each of his valued relationships place a demand for the preservation of his life and health for which he accepts a responsibility to preserve. Additional demands generally do not deplete his capacity for beneficial relationships, hence, they are nonrival. It follows that the more extensive are his relationships the greater is his social capital. Although a common metric to compare and aggregate such relationships is not practical, the paper demonstrates that the common social capital indicators can yield qualitative predictions on changes in risky behaviors in the context of conventional value of life models familiar within health economics. The individual will change his behavior toward risk upon experiencing an exogenous change in his social capital: when he marries, has children, acquires friends, or experiences a more socially active community. The empirical sections of the paper show this prediction to conform well to prior studies of micro data as well as to original empirical analysis of aggregate data.

10.1002/hec.1022.abstractZh: 可以将评估风险工作的个体视为一种公共物品。他以及他珍视的每一段关系都要求维护他的生命和健康，为此他必须承担维护责任的义务。额外的需求通常不会削弱他建立有益关系的能力，因此这些需求是非竞争性的。由此可见，他的关系越广泛，他的社会资本就越大。虽然比较和汇总这些关系的常见指标并不实用，但本文表明，常见的社会资本指标可以基于健康经济学中熟悉的常规生命价值模型，对风险行为的变化做出定性预测。当个体的社会资本发生外部变化时，他的行为会发生变化：当他结婚、有孩子、结识朋友或生活在更加活跃的社会环境中时。本文的实证部分表明，这一预测与先前对微观数据的研究以及针对汇总数据的原始实证分析结果非常一致。

abstract.text: Many states in the US have passed laws mandating insurance companies to provide or offer some form of mental health benefits. These laws presumably lower the price of obtaining mental health services for many adults, and as a result, might improve health outcomes. This paper analyzes the effectiveness of mental health insurance mandates by examining the influence of mandates on adult suicides, which are strongly correlated with mental illness. Data on completed suicides in each state for the period 1981-2000 are analyzed. Ordinary least squares and two-stage least squares results show that mental health mandates are not effective in reducing suicide rates.

10.1002/hec.1023.abstractZh: 美国的许多州已经通过法律，要求保险公司提供或提供某种形式的心理健康福利。这些法律预计会降低许多成年人获得心理健康服务的成本，从而可能改善健康结果。本文通过分析心理健康保险强制规定的效果，探讨了这些规定对成年人自杀行为的影响，因为自杀行为与精神疾病之间存在密切关联。文章分析了1981年至2000年间各州完成的自杀案例数据。普通最小二乘法和两阶段最小二乘分析结果显示，心理健康强制规定在降低自杀率方面并不有效。

abstract.text: Using data from a survey of 800 managers in 12 industries, we find empirical support for the hypothesis that the cost associated with missed work varies across jobs according to the ease with which a manager can find a perfect replacement for the absent worker, the extent to which the worker functions as part of a team, and the time sensitivity of the worker's output. We then estimate wage 'multipliers' for 35 different jobs, where the multiplier is defined as the cost to the firm of an absence as a proportion (often greater than one) of the absent worker's daily wage. The median multiplier is 1.28, which supports the view that the cost to the firm of missed work is often greater than the wage.

10.1002/hec.1052.abstractZh: 通过对12个行业中的800名经理进行调查，我们发现这一假设得到了实证支持：因缺勤而产生的成本在不同岗位上存在差异，这种差异取决于经理找到替代人员所需的难易程度、员工在团队中的角色以及员工工作成果的时效性。随后，我们对35种不同岗位的工资“乘数”进行了估算，其中乘数定义为企业因缺勤而产生的成本与缺勤员工日工资的比例（通常大于1）。中位数乘数为1.28，这支持了企业因缺勤而产生的成本往往高于员工工资的观点。

abstract.text: This paper examines the effect of health on labour force participation using the Household, Income and Labour Dynamics in Australia (HILDA) Survey. The potential endogeneity of health, especially self-assessed health, in the labour force participation equation is addressed by estimating the health equation and the labour force participation equation simultaneously. Taking into account the correlation between the error terms in the two equations, the estimation is conducted separately for males aged 15-49, males aged 50-64, females aged 15-49 and females aged 50-60. The results indicate that better health increases the probability of labour force participation for all four groups. However, the effect is larger for the older groups and for women. As for the feedback effect, it is found that labour force participation has a significant positive impact on older females' health, and a significant negative effect on younger males' health. For younger females and older males, the impact of labour force participation on health is not significant. The null-hypothesis of exogeneity of health to labour force participation is rejected for all groups.

10.1002/hec.1053.abstractZh: 本文通过澳大利亚家庭、收入和劳动力动态调查（HILDA）的数据，探讨了健康状况对劳动力参与率的影响。为了研究健康状况的潜在内生性，尤其是自我评估的健康状况对劳动力参与率的影响，本文同时估计了健康状况方程和劳动力参与率方程。考虑到两个方程中误差项之间的相关性，分别对15-49岁男性、50-64岁男性、15-49岁女性以及50-60岁女性进行了单独估计。研究结果表明，更好的健康状况增加了所有群体的劳动力参与率。不过，这种影响在年龄较大的群体和女性中更为显著。关于反馈效应，研究发现劳动力参与率对年长女性的健康状况有显著的正面影响，而对年轻男性的健康状况则有显著的负面影响。对于年轻女性和年长男性而言，劳动力参与率对健康状况的影响并不显著。因此，所有群体的健康状况与劳动力参与率之间的内生性假设均被拒绝。

abstract.text: This paper describes an experiment to test the construct validity of contingent valuation, by eliciting women's valuations for the NHS cervical cancer screening programme. It is known that, owing to low levels of knowledge of cancer and screening in the general population, women both over-estimate the risk of disease and the efficacy of screening. The study is constructed as a randomised experiment, in which one group is provided with accurate information about cervical cancer screening, whilst the other is not. The first hypothesis supporting construct validity, that controls who perceive greater benefits from screening will offer higher valuations, is substantiated. Both groups are then provided with objective information on an improvement to the screening programme, and are asked to value the improvement as an increment to their original valuations. The second hypothesis supporting construct validity, that controls who perceive the benefits of the programme to be high already will offer lower incremental valuations, is also substantiated.

10.1002/hec.1054.abstractZh: 本文描述了一项实验，旨在测试条件估值法的结构效度，通过收集女性对英国国家医疗服务体系宫颈癌筛查项目的评估。已知由于普通人群中对于癌症和筛查知识的匮乏，女性既高估了疾病的风险，也高估了筛查的效果。该研究采用随机实验设计，其中一组获得了关于宫颈癌筛查的准确信息，而另一组则没有。支持结构效度的第一个假设得到了验证：认为从筛查中获益更多的人会给出更高评估的女性群体确实如此。随后，两组都获得了关于改进筛查项目的客观信息，并被要求将其作为对原有评估的增量进行估值。支持结构效度的第二个假设也得到了验证：认为已经认为该计划带来的好处较高的群体，其增量评估会更低。

abstract.text: A general population sample of 314 Australian respondents were randomly allocated to complete a contingent valuation survey administered by face-to-face or telephone ('phone-mail-phone') interview. Although the telephone interview was quicker to complete, no significant difference was found in values obtained through either method. Within each sub-sample, respondents were also randomly allocated to the three different versions of the payment card (PC) questionnaire format: values listed from high-to-low, values listed from low-to-high and values randomly shuffled. The high-to-low version resulted in significantly higher values than the other versions. Further analyses indicate that the randomly shuffled PC version may produce the most 'valid' values.

10.1002/hec.1055.abstractZh: 共有314名澳大利亚受访者被随机分配完成一项条件价值评估调查，调查方式包括面对面访谈或电话访谈（电话-邮件-电话结合方式）。尽管电话访谈的完成速度更快，但两种方法获得的评估值并无显著差异。在每个子样本中，受访者还被随机分配到三种不同版本的支付卡问卷格式：从高到低排列的评估值、从低到高排列的评估值以及随机打乱的评估值。其中，从高到低排列的版本得出的评估值显著高于其他版本。进一步分析表明，随机打乱的支付卡问卷版本可能能够得出最“有效”的评估值。

abstract.text: Cost-effectiveness analysis (CEA) compares the costs and outcomes of two or more technologies. However, there is no consensus about which measure of effectiveness should be used in each analysis. Clinical researchers have to select an appropriate outcome for their purpose, and this choice can have dramatic consequences on the conclusions of their analysis. In this paper we present a Bayesian cost-effectiveness framework to carry out CEA when more than one measure is considered. In particular, we analyse the case in which two measures of effectiveness, one binary and the other continuous, are considered. Decision-making measures, such as the incremental cost-effectiveness ratio, incremental net-benefit and cost-effectiveness acceptability curves, are used to compare costs and one measure of outcome. We propose an extension of cost-acceptability curves, namely the cost-effectiveness acceptability plane, as a suitable measure for decision taking. The models were validated using data from two clinical trials. In the first one, we compared four highly active antiretroviral treatments applied to asymptomatic HIV patients. As measures of effectiveness, we considered the percentage of patients with undetectable levels of viral load, and changes in quality of life, measured according to EuroQol. In the second clinical trial we compared three methadone maintenance programmes for opioid-addicted patients. In this case, the measures of effectiveness considered were quality of life, according to the Nottingham Health Profile, and adherence to the treatment, measured as the percentage of patients who participated in the whole treatment programme.

10.1002/hec.1056.abstractZh: 成本效益分析（CEA）用于比较两种或多种技术的成本和效果。然而，关于在每项分析中应使用哪种效果衡量标准，目前尚无共识。临床研究人员需要为其研究目的选择合适的效果指标，这一选择可能会对分析结论产生重大影响。本文提出了一种贝叶斯成本效益框架，用于在考虑多个衡量标准时进行CEA分析。我们特别分析了两种效果衡量标准的情况，一种是二值型，另一种是连续型。决策指标如增量成本效益比、增量净效益以及成本效益可接受性曲线，被用来比较成本和一种效果指标。我们提出了成本可接受性曲线的扩展形式——成本效益可接受性平面，作为决策的理想衡量标准。这些模型通过两项临床试验的数据进行了验证。在第一项试验中，我们比较了四种针对无症状HIV患者的高效抗逆转录病毒疗法。作为效果衡量标准，我们考虑了病毒载量检测不到的患者比例，以及根据EuroQol标准测量的生活质量变化。在第二项临床试验中，我们比较了三种针对阿片类药物成瘾患者的美沙酮维持治疗方案。在这种情况下，效果衡量标准包括根据Nottingham健康状况量表测量的生活质量，以及根据参与整个治疗计划的患者比例来衡量的治疗依从性。

abstract.text: Understanding health care utilization is important to design efficient and effective health systems. Toward this end, we develop a relatively simple and intuitively appealing microeconometric framework to analyse health care utilization and illustrate its use with recent Canadian microdata. We find that health care utilization consists of distinct stochastic processes requiring the use of two stochastic regression models. In particular, the latent class modelling framework is the superior statistical framework if the data permit modelling unobserved heterogeneity and overdispersion. In many instances, results differ for the classes of high and low users of health care services.

10.1002/hec.1057.abstractZh: 理解医疗服务的利用对于设计高效且有效的医疗系统至关重要。为此，我们开发了一个相对简单且直观的微观计量经济学框架来分析医疗服务的利用情况，并通过加拿大最新的微观数据验证了该框架的有效性。我们发现，医疗服务的利用由不同的随机过程构成，需要使用两种随机回归模型来进行分析。特别是，如果数据允许对未观察到的异质性和过度离散性进行建模，那么潜在类别建模框架就是更优的统计框架。在许多情况下，医疗服务的高使用者和低使用者类别的结果存在差异。

abstract.text: In recent years, a large body of empirical work has focused on measuring and explaining socio-economic inequalities in health outcomes and health service use. In any effort to address these questions, analysts must confront the issue of how to measure socioeconomic status. In developing countries, socioeconomic status has typically been measured by per capita consumption or an asset index. Currently, there is only limited information on how the choice of welfare indicators affect the analysis of health inequalities and the incidence of public spending. The purpose of this paper is to illustrate the potential sensitivity of the analysis of health related inequalities to how socioeconomic status is measured. Using data from Mozambique, the paper focuses on five key health service indicators, and tests whether measured inequality (concentration index) in health service utilization differs depending on the choice of welfare indicator. The paper shows that, at least in some contexts, the choice of welfare indicator can have a large and significant impact on measured inequality in utilization of health services. In consequence, we can reach very different conclusions about the 'same' issue depending on how we define socioeconomic status. The paper also provides some tentative conclusions about why and in what contexts health inequalities can be sensitive to the choice of living standards measure. The results call for more clarity and care in the analysis of health related inequalities, and for explicit recognition of the potential sensitivity of findings to the choice of welfare measure. The results also point at the need for more careful research on how different dimensions of SES are related, and on the pathways by which the respective different dimensions impact on health related variables.

10.1002/hec.1058.abstractZh: 近年来，大量实证研究聚焦于衡量和解释健康结果及医疗服务使用中的社会经济不平等问题。在解决这些问题的过程中，分析人员必须面对如何衡量社会经济地位的问题。在发展中国家，社会经济地位通常通过人均消费或资产指数来衡量。目前，关于福利指标的选择如何影响健康不平等分析及公共支出分配的信息非常有限。本文旨在说明，对健康相关不平等的分析对衡量社会经济地位的方式非常敏感。本文以莫桑比克的数据为基础，重点研究了五个关键的医疗服务指标，并测试了在不同福利指标选择下，医疗服务利用中的不平等程度是否存在差异。研究表明，至少在某些情境下，福利指标的选择会对医疗服务利用中的不平等程度产生较大且显著的影响。因此，关于“同一问题”的结论会因社会经济地位的界定方式而有所不同。本文还提出了一些关于为何以及在何种情境下健康不平等会对生活水平衡量方式的选择产生敏感性的初步结论。研究结果呼吁在健康相关不平等的分析中更加明确和谨慎，并明确认识到研究结果对福利衡量方式选择的潜在敏感性。研究结果还指出了需要更仔细地研究不同社会经济地位维度之间的关系，以及这些维度如何影响与健康相关的变量。

abstract.text: Our main hypothesis in this paper was that, once controlled for age and gender, the use of primary health care services of people in each of the groups defined by their degree of obesity (i.e. normal weight, overweight and obese) did not correspond to the need for care implied by the level of risk of the group he/she belonged to. This fact could reflect some inequity in the utilisation of such services. Using a survey of the general population from the Girona Health Region, Spain, carried out during the fourth quarter of 2002, we have found that: first, the probability of primary health care use decreased with income for GPs (until 1200 Euro) and increased for specialists (from 1500 Euro). Second, we could conclude by confirming our hypothesis, i.e. there was more probability of obese individuals using general practice care, public in particular, and less probability of them using specialists, private in particular, than the rest of individuals. Third, we conclude that the use of multilevel (also hierarchical or mixed) models could explain most of our original findings in this paper.

10.1002/hec.1059.abstractZh: 本文的主要假设是，在控制了年龄和性别因素后，不同肥胖程度群体（即正常体重、超重和肥胖）对初级卫生保健服务的使用并不与其所属群体的风险水平所暗示的需求相对应。这一事实可能反映了这些服务利用上的某些不平等现象。通过对西班牙吉罗纳健康地区普通人群在2002年第四季度进行的调查，我们发现：首先，对于全科医生而言，收入在1200欧元以下的人群使用初级卫生保健服务的概率较低，而收入在1500欧元以上的人群则具有较高的使用概率。其次，我们的假设得到了验证：肥胖人群使用全科医疗服务的概率高于使用专科医疗服务的概率，而使用专科医疗服务的概率则低于其他人群。最后，我们认为使用多层次模型（包括层次模型或混合模型）可以解释本文大部分的原始发现。

abstract.text: This paper estimates frontier cost functions for US Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) hospitals in FY2000 that are consistent with economic theory and explicitly account for cost differences across patients' risk, level of access to care, quality of care, and hospital-specific characteristics. Results indicate that on average VA hospitals in FY2000 operate at efficiency levels of 94%, as compared to previous studies on US private sector hospitals that average closer to 90% efficient. Using these cost frontiers, management systems potentially could be implemented to enhance the equitable allocation of the VA medical care global budget and systematically distribute funds across hospitals and networks. The paper also provides recommendations to improve the efficiency of delivering health care services applicable to public sector organizations.

10.1002/hec.1060.abstractZh: 本文估算了2000财年美国退伍军人事务部医院的前沿成本函数，这些函数符合经济理论，并明确考虑了患者风险、就医机会、医疗质量以及医院特定特征等因素导致的成本差异。研究结果表明，2000财年退伍军人事务部医院的平均运营效率为94%，这一数值高于之前关于美国私营部门医院的研究结果，后者的平均运营效率约为90%。利用这些成本前沿数据，可以实施相应的管理系统，以更有效地分配退伍军人事务部医疗服务的预算，并系统地将资金分配到各个医院和网络中。本文还提出了一些建议，旨在提高公共部门组织提供医疗服务效率。

abstract.text: In a recent issue of Health Economics Letters, Whynes et al. report an observation not previously reported in the willingness-to-pay (WTP) literature; that when people are asked to provide an estimate using payment scales they tend to disproportionately select prominent values (that is, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, etc.). However, it remains an open question just how common this prominence effect actually is. Here we present data from several additional contingent valuation (CV) studies, which suggest that although prominence occurs, it does not reach statistical significance, as found by Whynes et al. A number of reasons are outlined to explain this.

10.1002/hec.1062.abstractZh: 在《健康经济学快报》最近的一期中，Whynes等人报告了一项在支付意愿文献中未曾提及的观察结果：当人们被要求使用支付量表进行估算时，他们倾向于选择较为突出的数值（即1、2、5、10、20、50、100等）。然而，这种突出效应究竟有多普遍，仍然是一个未解之谜。本文进一步提供了来自其他几项条件价值评估研究的资料，这些资料表明，尽管存在这种突出效应，但其统计学意义并不如Whynes等人所发现的那样显著。文中还提出了多种可能解释这一现象的原因。

abstract.text: Decisions in health care must be made, despite uncertainty about benefits, risks, and costs. Value of information analysis is a theoretically sound method to estimate the expected value of future quantitative research pertaining to an uncertain decision. If the expected value of future research does not exceed the cost of research, additional research is not justified, and decisions should be based on current evidence, despite the uncertainty. To assess the importance of individual parameters relevant to a decision, different value of information methods have been suggested. The generally recommended method assumes that the expected value of perfect knowledge concerning a parameter is estimated as the reduction in expected opportunity loss. This method, however, results in biased expected values and incorrect importance ranking of parameters. The objective of this paper is to set out the correct methods to estimate the partial expected value of perfect information and to demonstrate why the generally recommended method is incorrect conceptually and mathematically.

10.1002/hec.1064.abstractZh: 在医疗保健领域，尽管存在关于收益、风险和成本的不确定性，仍需做出决策。信息分析的价值是一种理论上合理的方法，可用于估算与不确定决策相关的未来定量研究的预期价值。如果未来研究的预期价值不超过研究成本，那么进行额外研究就没有必要，决策应基于当前的证据，即使存在不确定性。为了评估与决策相关的各个参数的重要性，提出了不同的信息价值评估方法。通常推荐的方法假设关于某个参数的完全信息的预期价值等于预期机会损失的减少量。然而，这种方法会导致预期的偏差以及参数重要性排序的错误。本文旨在提出正确的方法来计算完全信息的部分预期价值，并说明为什么通常推荐的方法在概念上和数学上都是不正确的。

abstract.text: Over the last decade or so, there have been many developments in methods to handle uncertainty in cost-effectiveness studies. In decision modelling, it is widely accepted that there needs to be an assessment of how sensitive the decision is to uncertainty in parameter values. The rationale for probabilistic sensitivity analysis (PSA) is primarily based on a consideration of the needs of decision makers in assessing the consequences of decision uncertainty. In this paper, we highlight some further compelling reasons for adopting probabilistic methods for decision modelling and sensitivity analysis, and specifically for adopting simulation from a Bayesian posterior distribution. Our reasoning is as follows. Firstly, cost-effectiveness analyses need to be based on all the available evidence, not a selected subset, and the uncertainties in the data need to be propagated through the model in order to provide a correct analysis of the uncertainties in the decision. In many--perhaps most--cases the evidence structure requires a statistical analysis that inevitably induces correlations between parameters. Deterministic sensitivity analysis requires that models are run with parameters fixed at 'extreme' values, but where parameter correlation exists it is not possible to identify sets of parameter values that can be considered 'extreme' in a meaningful sense. However, a correct probabilistic analysis can be readily achieved by Monte Carlo sampling from the joint posterior distribution of parameters. In this paper, we review some evidence structures commonly occurring in decision models, where analyses that correctly reflect the uncertainty in the data induce correlations between parameters. Frequently, this is because the evidence base includes information on functions of several parameters. It follows that, if health technology assessments are to be based on a correct analysis of all available data, then probabilistic methods must be used both for sensitivity analysis and for estimation of expected costs and benefits.

10.1002/hec.1068.abstractZh: 在过去的十年左右时间里，处理成本效益研究中的不确定性方法取得了许多进展。在决策建模中，人们普遍认为需要评估决策对参数值不确定性的敏感性。概率敏感性分析的主要依据是对决策者评估决策不确定性后果的需求的考虑。在本文中，我们进一步强调了采用概率方法进行决策建模和敏感性分析的一些重要理由，特别是采用来自贝叶斯后验分布的模拟方法。我们的推理如下：首先，成本效益分析需要基于所有可用的证据，而不是仅选取一部分证据，并且数据中的不确定性需要被传递到模型中，以便正确分析决策中的不确定性。在许多——或许是最多的情况下——证据结构需要一种统计分析，这不可避免地会导致参数之间的相关性。确定性敏感性分析要求模型在参数固定为“极端”值时运行，但在存在参数相关性的情况下，无法识别出在有意义意义上可以被认为是“极端”的参数值集合。然而，通过蒙特卡洛抽样从参数的联合后验分布中可以获得正确的概率分析。在本文中，我们回顾了一些在决策模型中常见的证据结构，这些结构中的分析能够正确地反映数据中的不确定性，并导致参数之间的相关性。这种情况通常是因为证据基础包含了关于多个参数函数的信息。因此，如果健康技术评估要基于对所有可用数据的正确分析，那么在进行敏感性分析以及估算预期成本和收益时，必须使用概率方法。

abstract.text: The conventional time trade off (TTO) method relies on fundamentally different procedures to assess states better than and worse than dead. Arbitrary transformation mechanisms are then applied to worse than dead scores in order to achieve symmetry with those rated as better than dead. We use a 'life profile' approach along with a ranking procedure in order to show how states rated worse than dead may be assessed in exactly the same manner as better than dead scores. We then explore a common issue associated with states worse than dead that has received some attention recently: maximal endurable time. Our results showed that, although the severe health state was commonly rated as worse than dead, there were relatively few respondents that exhibited MET preferences. We discuss the implications of our findings for the use of the TTO method in deriving values for states that are worse than dead.

10.1002/hec.1069.abstractZh: 传统的权衡方法依赖于截然不同的程序来评估状态，以更好地判断状态是否优于或劣于“死亡”状态。随后，通过任意的转换机制对劣于“死亡”状态的评分进行调整，以实现与评为优于“死亡”状态的评分的对称性。我们采用“生命剖面”方法以及排名程序，展示了如何以与评为优于“死亡”状态的评分完全相同的方式来评估劣于“死亡”状态的评分。接着，我们探讨了与劣于“死亡”状态相关的一个常见问题，即“最大可忍受时间”。我们的结果显示，尽管严重健康状态通常被评定为劣于“死亡”状态，但表现出MET偏好的受访者相对较少。我们讨论了这些发现对于使用权衡方法推导劣于“死亡”状态的值的启示意义。

abstract.text: Socio-economic status (SES) indices are increasingly being used to characterise (in)equity, with the assumption that SES indices are reliable. However, the accuracy of such SES indices is questionable if they are unreliable. We examined the inter-rater and test-retest reliability of a range of indicators commonly used to generate SES indices as well as the composite SES indices. Results from research in southeast Nigeria showed considerable variation, with some indicators having only low to moderate reliability (reliability coefficients 0.25-0.77). Inter-rater and test-retest reliability of SES indices was 0.63 in both cases. Many households were misclassified because of the unreliable SES indices. Analyses of the distribution of resources based on such indicators could lead to inaccuracies in benefit incidence estimates and policy decisions based on low to moderately reliable SES indicators could worsen equity in access to and use of resources. Greater rigour is needed in conceptualising as well as undertaking SES measurements.

10.1002/hec.1071.abstractZh: 社会经济地位指数被越来越多地用于描述不平等现象，前提是这些指数被认为是可靠的。然而，如果这些指数不可靠，那么其准确性就值得质疑。我们研究了用于生成社会经济地位指数的各种指标的评分者间信度和重测信度，以及综合社会经济地位指数。在尼日利亚东南部进行的研究显示，这些指标存在相当大的差异，有些指标的信度仅为低到中等水平（信度系数在0.25到0.77之间）。两种情况下，社会经济地位指数的评分者间信度和重测信度均为0.63。由于不可靠的社会经济地位指数，许多家庭被错误分类。基于这些指标对资源分配的分析可能导致收益分配估计的不准确性，而基于信度较低或中等的指标做出的政策决策可能会进一步加剧资源获取和使用方面的不平等。在概念化和实施社会经济地位测量时，需要更加严谨的方法。

abstract.text: Switzerland (7.2 million inhabitants) is a federal state composed of 26 cantons. The autonomy of cantons and a particular health insurance system create strong heterogeneity in terms of regulation and organisation of health care services. In this study we use a single-equation approach to model the per capita cantonal expenditures on health care services and postulate that per capita health expenditures depend on some economic, demographic and structural factors. The empirical analysis demonstrates that a larger share of old people tends to increase health costs and that physicians paid on a fee-for-service basis swell expenditures, thus highlighting a possible phenomenon of supply-induced demand.

10.1002/hec.1072.abstractZh: 瑞士拥有720万居民，是一个由26个州组成的联邦国家。各州的自治权以及独特的健康保险制度导致在医疗服务的管理和组织方面存在显著的差异。本研究采用单方程模型来模拟各州在医疗服务上的人均支出，并假设人均健康支出取决于一些经济、人口和结构因素。实证分析表明，老年人口比例的增加往往会提高健康成本，而以劳务收费方式支付的医生费用也会增加支出，这凸显了供给引发需求的潜在现象。

abstract.text: We study the willingness to pay for reductions in health risks when people do not evaluate probabilities linearly, as is commonly assumed in elicitations of willingness to pay, but weight probabilities, as is commonly observed in empirical studies of decision under risk. We show that for the levels of baseline risk typically considered, probability weighting strongly affects willingness to pay estimates and may lead to unstable monetary valuations of health.

10.1002/hec.1073.abstractZh: 我们研究了当人们不采用线性方式评估概率时，对于降低健康风险的支付意愿。这种假设在支付意愿的评估中较为常见，而概率加权则更符合风险决策实证研究的常见做法。研究表明，对于通常考虑的基线风险水平，概率加权对支付意愿的估计有显著影响，并可能导致对健康的不稳定货币价值评估。

abstract.text: The quality-adjusted life year (QALY) assumes that the value of a health state is linearly related to the time spent in it, which implies that the value of a health state is independent of the states which precede or follow it. Irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) is a suitable condition to test this assumption since it is subject to considerable fluctuations over time. Forty-nine IBS patients were asked to rate their own health using generic measures of health and a condition specific classification. They were then asked to value five IBS states and four profiles using a self-completed version of the standard gamble technique. The implied value of each profile was estimated using the QALY assumption of linearity over time and compared with the direct profile valuations. The directly elicited profile values suggest that reductions in the duration of IBS symptoms has less of an impact on the value of quality of life than would be implied by the QALY assumption of linearity over time, though the differences were small. There are a number of competing explanations for this finding, including possible sequence effects, quantity effects or time preference, or it might be due to gestalt effects resulting in a neglect of time spent in symptomatic states of health.

10.1002/hec.1074.abstractZh: 质量调整生命年（QALY）假设一种健康状态的价值与在该状态下度过的时间呈线性关系，这意味着一种健康状态的价值与其之前或之后的状态无关。肠易激综合症（IBS）是一种适合测试这一假设的情况，因为其状况随时间会发生显著波动。49名IBS患者被要求使用通用的健康指标和特定状况的分类来评价自己的健康状况。随后，他们使用标准赌博技术的一个自填式版本，对五种IBS状态和四种状况进行价值评估。每种状况的隐含价值是根据QALY的线性时间假设进行估算的，并与直接评估的结果进行了比较。直接评估得出的状况价值表明，减少IBS症状的持续时间对生活质量的影响小于QALY线性时间假设所暗示的影响，尽管这种差异很小。这一发现有多种可能的解释，包括可能的序列效应、数量效应或时间偏好，或者可能是由于整体效应导致忽视了在症状性健康状态下所度过的时间。

abstract.text: The incorporation of informal care into economic evaluations of health care is troublesome. The debate focuses on the valuation of time spent on informal caregiving, while time measurement, a related and may be even a more important issue, tends to be neglected. Valid time measurement is a necessary condition for the valuation of informal care. In this paper, two methods of time measurement are compared and evaluated: the diary, which is considered the gold standard, and the recall method, which is applied more often. The main objective of this comparison is to explore the validity of the measurement of time spent on providing informal care. In addition, this paper gives empirical evidence regarding the measurement of joint production and the separation between 'normal' housework and additional housework due to the care demands of the care recipients. Finally, the test-retest stability for the recall method is assessed. A total of 199 persons giving informal care to a heterogeneous population of care recipients completed the diary and the recall questionnaire. Corrected for joint production, informal caregivers spent almost 5.8 h a day on providing informal care. If one assumes that respondents take into account joint production when completing the recall questionnaire, the recall method is a valid instrument to measure time spent on providing informal care compared to the diary. Otherwise, the recall method is likely to overestimate the time spent on providing informal care. Moreover, the recall method proves to be unstable over time. This could be due to learning effects from completing a diary.

10.1002/hec.1075.abstractZh: 将非正式护理纳入医疗保健的经济评估是一个棘手的问题。争论的焦点在于对非正式护理所花费时间的评估，而时间测量这一相关且可能更为重要的问题却往往被忽视。有效的时间测量是评估非正式护理的基础条件。本文比较并评估了两种时间测量方法：被视为金标准的日记法，以及更为常用的回忆法。此次比较的主要目的是探讨时间测量的有效性。此外，本文还提供了关于共同生产量测量以及“正常”家务劳动与因照顾需求而产生的额外家务劳动之间区别的实证证据。最后，评估了回忆法的重测稳定性。共有199名非正式护理人员完成日记和回忆问卷。经过共同生产量的校正后，非正式护理人员每天花费约5.8小时进行非正式护理。如果假设受访者在填写回忆问卷时考虑了共同生产量，那么回忆法是一种有效的测量工具，可以比日记法更准确地反映非正式护理所花费的时间。否则，回忆法可能会高估非正式护理所花费的时间。此外，回忆法在时间上的稳定性较差，这可能是由于完成日记过程中产生的学习效应所致。

abstract.text: We examine the relationship between Visual Analogue Scale (VAS) and Standard Gamble (SG) assumed in the development of the multiplicative multi-attribute utility functions (M-MAUFs) for the Health Utilities Index (HUI) Mark 2 and Mark 3, using data from a UK valuation study of the HUI2. A range of functional forms are considered, and are compared on the basis of their explanatory power and predictive ability.A restricted cubic function fits the data better than a power curve with a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.025 and root mean square error (RMSE) of 0.029 compared to a MAE of 0.135 and RMSE of 0.135 for the power curve. The use of a cubic mapping function instead of a power function leads to different predicted health state values. We question the reliance on the assumption of a power curve relationship between VAS and SG data, in the Health Utilities Index valuation framework. Our results demonstrate that further work is required to examine the appropriateness of the published M-MAUFs for the Health Utilities Indices.

10.1002/hec.1076.abstractZh: 我们研究了视觉类比量表（VAS）与标准赌博（SG）之间的关系，这些关系被用于开发用于健康效用指数（HUI）Mark 2和Mark 3的乘法多属性效用函数（M-MAUFs）。研究使用了来自英国HUI2评估研究的数据。我们考虑了多种函数形式，并基于它们的解释能力和预测能力进行了比较。限制性立方函数比幂曲线更适合数据，其平均绝对误差为0.025，均方根误差为0.029，而幂曲线的平均绝对误差为0.135，均方根误差为0.135。使用立方映射函数而非幂函数会导致不同的健康状态预测值。我们质疑在健康效用指数评估框架中，对VAS与SG数据之间幂曲线关系的假设是否合适。我们的研究结果表明，需要进一步的工作来检验已发布的M-MAUFs对于健康效用指数的适用性。

abstract.text: Aims To assess the cost-effectiveness of two primary care interventions, a letter and a flag, aimed at improving attendance for breast screening among (i) all women invited for breast screening and (ii) non-attenders. Methods A probabilistic decision analytic model was developed using Markov chain Monte Carlo simulation implemented in WinBUGS. The model was populated using economic and effectiveness data collected alongside two randomised controlled trials. Results For all women invited, the incremental cost-effectiveness ratio (ICER) for the letter compared with no intervention is 27 pounds per additional attendance, and the ICER for the combined letter and flag intervention compared to the letter alone is 171 pounds. The corresponding ICERs for non-attenders are 41 pounds and 90 pounds. The flag intervention is an inefficient option in both settings. A large proportion of the costs fall on the practices (25-67%), depending on the intervention and target population. The total costs incurred do not, however, seem prohibitive. Expected value of perfect information suggests that there is greater value in carrying out further research on the intervention implemented among all women invited for breast screening rather than on non-attenders. Conclusions The flag intervention alone does not appear to be an efficient option. The choice between the letter and both interventions combined is subjective, depending on the willingness to pay for an additional screening attendance.

10.1002/hec.1077.abstractZh: 目的：评估两种初级保健干预措施的成本效益，即使用信件和旗帜，旨在提高（i）所有受邀进行乳腺筛查的女性以及（ii）未参与筛查的女性的筛查参与率。方法：使用WinBUGS软件中的马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗模拟方法，开发了一个概率决策分析模型。该模型基于收集到的经济数据和效果数据，并结合两项随机对照试验的数据进行构建。结果：对于所有受邀女性，使用信件与无干预措施相比，每增加一次筛查的增量成本效益比为27英镑；而同时使用信件和旗帜与仅使用信件相比，增量成本效益比为171英镑。对于未参与筛查的女性，相应的增量成本效益比分别为41英镑和90英镑。在两种情况下，使用旗帜作为干预措施都是低效的选择。大部分成本由医疗机构承担，比例在25%到67%之间，具体取决于干预措施和目标人群。然而，总体成本似乎并不高。完全信息的期望值表明，对受邀进行乳腺筛查的女性实施进一步的干预措施，比对未参与筛查的女性实施干预措施具有更大的价值。结论：单独使用旗帜作为干预措施似乎不是一种有效的选择。选择使用信件还是同时使用两种干预措施取决于人们愿意为额外的筛查参与支付多少费用。

abstract.text: This study examines the relationship between health outcomes and cost inefficiency in Florida hospitals over the period 1999-2001, with health outcomes measured by risk-adjusted in-hospital mortality rates. Previous research has come to conflicting conclusions regarding the relationship between costs and health outcomes. We hypothesize that these seemingly conflicting findings are due to the fact that total cost has two components--cost that reflects the best use of resources under current circumstances and cost associated with waste or inefficiency. By isolating costs due to inefficiency, we can examine directly their relationship, if any, to hospital mortality rates, and begin to assess whether policies that create incentives for hospitals to increase efficiency have adverse effects on health outcomes. We regress an in-hospital mortality index for each hospital on a measure of the hospital's cost inefficiency, obtained from a stochastic cost frontier estimation, as well as on predicted mortality and a set of variables linked to mortality performance. Our results indicate a positive and significant relationship between a hospital's mortality performance and its inefficiency: on average, a one percentage point reduction in cost inefficiency would be associated with one fewer in-hospital death per 10,000 discharges, holding patient risk and other factors constant.

10.1002/hec.1078.abstractZh: 本研究考察了1999年至2001年间佛罗里达州医院的健康结果与成本效率低下之间的关系，健康结果通过风险调整后的院内死亡率来衡量。先前的研究对于成本与健康结果之间的关系得出了相互矛盾的结论。我们假设这些看似矛盾的结果是由于总成本包含两个部分——一部分反映了在当前情况下对资源的最佳利用，另一部分则与浪费或效率低下相关。通过分离出因效率低下而产生的成本，我们可以直接考察它们与院内死亡率之间的关系，以及制定激励医院提高效率的政策是否会对健康结果产生不利影响。我们基于随机成本前沿估计得出的医院成本效率低下指标，以及预测的死亡率和一系列与死亡率表现相关的变量，对每家医院的院内死亡率指数进行了回归分析。我们的研究结果表明，医院的死亡率表现与其效率低下之间存在正相关关系：平均而言，成本效率低下降低一个百分点，每10,000例出院病例中就会减少一例院内死亡。

abstract.text: The estimation of economic benefits of health effects through direct methods, such as contingent valuation, presents the problem of preference imprecision. This paper deals with this problem by proposing an elicitation method that allows the subject to state an interval for willingness to pay, without inducing any specific amount as a response. The paper also analyzes the effects of the context where changes in health occur on the associated imprecision level and the estimates, by comparing a situation without context with another in which effects are due to atmospheric pollution. The econometric modelling develops a Bayesian estimation method for censored intervals, which models the existing uncertainty between the lower and upper limits derived from the elicitation process. Results prove that data dispersion is significantly higher for the non-contextual scenario, and increases for the most severe symptoms.

10.1002/hec.1079.abstractZh: 通过直接方法，如条件估值法，来估算健康效应的经济效益时，会出现偏好不精确的问题。本文提出了一种 elicitation 方法，该方法允许受试者给出一个支付意愿的区间，而不需要给出具体的金额作为回应。文章还分析了健康状况变化所处的环境对相关不精确程度及估算结果的影响，通过将无环境情境的情况与因大气污染导致变化的情况进行比较。计量经济建模开发了一种贝叶斯估算方法，用于处理被截断的区间，该方法能够模拟从 elicitation 过程中得出的上下限之间存在的现有不确定性。结果表明，无环境情境下的数据离散度明显更高，且最严重的症状所导致的离散度更大。

abstract.text: Many low-income countries are implementing non-profit medical insurance to increase access to health services, especially among low-income households, and to raise additional revenue for financing public health services. This paper estimates the effect of insurance on out-of-pocket health expenditures using the Vietnam Living Standards Surveys for 1993 and 1998 and appropriate models for panel data. Our findings suggest that health insurance reduces health expenditure when unobserved heterogeneity is accounted for. Failure to capture unobserved heterogeneity produces contrary results that are consistent with previous cross-sectional studies in the literature. Health insurance is found to reduce out-of-pocket expenditure between 16 and 18% and the reduction in expenditure is more pronounced for individuals with lower incomes. At mean income, the effect of health insurance is to reduce health expenditures between 28 and 35%.

10.1002/hec.1080.abstractZh: 许多低收入国家正在实施非营利性医疗保险，以增加低收入家庭获得医疗服务的机会，并为公共医疗服务提供额外资金。本文利用1993年和1998年的越南生活水平调查数据，以及适合面板数据的模型，估算了保险对自付医疗费用的影响。研究结果表明，在考虑未观测异质性后，医疗保险能够降低医疗费用。未能捕捉到未观测异质性会导致与文献中先前横断面研究一致的结果。研究发现，医疗保险可将自付支出减少16%至18%，且低收入个体的支出减少幅度更为明显。在平均收入水平下，医疗保险可将医疗费用减少28%至35%。

abstract.text: Brouwer and colleagues [1] argue that the reasons for specifying an equal discount rate for health outcomes and costs in the recent guidance on methods of technology appraisal issued by the National Institute for Clinical Excellence (NICE) [2] is both opaque and wrong. They argue that a lower rate should apply to health outcomes like QALYs. It is also claimed that the guidance on discounting represents a step backwards, that is both inconsistent with current theoretical insights and will prejudice the outcome of cost-effectiveness studies of preventive interventions.The reasoning behind the use of equal discount rates for costs and health outcomes is indeed not well developed in the published guidance. Nor does it reflect the debate that underpinned the guidance. We therefore welcome the opportunity to explain more completely the rationale in the minds of the principal authors of the current guidance.

10.1002/hec.1081.abstractZh: Brouwer及其同事[1]认为，国家临床卓越研究所(NICE)[2]在最近发布的关于技术评估方法的指南中，为健康结果和成本指定相同的折现率，这一做法既不明确也不正确。他们认为，对于像QALYs这样的健康结果，应该采用较低的折现率。此外，该指南中的折现方法被认为是一种倒退，既不符合当前的理论见解，也会对预防干预措施的成本效益研究的结果产生不利影响。在已发布的指南中，对于成本和健康结果使用相同折现率的原因并没有得到充分阐述，也没有反映出制定该指南时所进行的讨论。因此，我们非常欢迎有机会更全面地解释当前指南主要作者们的思考逻辑。

abstract.text: Background The SF-12 is a widely used generic measure of subjective health. As the scoring algorithms of the SF-12 do not include preference values, different approaches to assign a preference-based index are available that should be tested regarding their feasibility and validity. Objectives To develop a concept for a preference-based index for the SF-12 on the basis of multi-attribute decision analysis and to perform initial tests of its feasibility and validity in an empirical study. Methods A multi-attribute preference function for the SF-12 was developed, estimated and tested for validity. Two mail surveys (n = 100, 200) and an interview (n = 72) were conducted with women who had an operation for breast cancer. Visual analogue scale (VAS) and standard gamble (SG) measures elicited preference-based valuations. Results Eight attributes were identified in the SF-12. Validity tests showed an average difference of 8 VAS score points between directly measured and predicted values for given health states. Conclusion The initial results show that this approach might allow the direct assignment of a preference-based valuation to the SF-12. The quality of the psychometric features of the multi-attribute value function is encouraging. Future studies should test this concept more extensively, especially by determining parameters for a representative sample of the general population and by comparing performance with other approaches to value the SF-12.

10.1002/hec.1082.abstractZh:
背景  
SF-12是一种广泛使用的主观健康综合指标。由于SF-12的评分算法并未包含偏好值，因此存在多种基于偏好的指标分配方法，这些方法需要就其可行性和有效性进行测试。  

目的  
基于多属性决策分析，为SF-12开发一个基于偏好的指标，并在实证研究中对其可行性和有效性进行初步测试。  

方法  
为SF-12开发了一个多属性偏好函数，并对其有效性和可靠性进行了估计与测试。对100名和200名接受过乳腺癌手术的女性进行了两次邮件调查，并进行了72次访谈。通过视觉模拟量表和标准赌博法来收集偏好值。  

结果  
在SF-12中识别出八个属性。有效性测试显示，对于给定的健康状况，直接测量值与预测值之间的平均差异为8个视觉模拟量表评分点。  

结论  
初步结果表明，这种方法可能允许直接为SF-12分配基于偏好的价值。多属性价值函数的心理测量特征令人鼓舞。未来的研究应更广泛地测试这一概念，特别是通过确定普通人群代表性样本的参数，并与其他价值评估方法进行比较。

abstract.text: Conventional cost-effectiveness decision rules rely on the assumptions that all health care programmes are divisible and exhibit constant returns to scale for a homogeneous population; hence, the path between adjacent programmes on a cost-effectiveness frontier must be linear. In this paper we build a framework to analyse non-linear 'expansion' paths. We model the impact of two key sources of non-linearity: economies of scale or scope in the production of health care; and prioritisation of patients who are most likely to benefit from more expensive and more effective treatments. We conclude that the expansion path might be linear, convex or concave, depending on the situation. The path might also exhibit vertical discontinuity due to fixed costs or horizontal discontinuity due to indivisibility. The efficiency of resource allocation might be improved by empirical estimation of expansion paths. We discuss the advantages and disadvantages of this approach compared with a standard stratified analysis.

10.1002/hec.1083.abstractZh: 传统的成本效益决策规则基于这样的假设：所有医疗保健项目都是可分割的，并且对于同质人群来说具有恒定的规模收益；因此，成本效益前沿上相邻项目之间的路径必须是线性的。在本文中，我们构建了一个框架来分析非线性的“扩展”路径。我们模拟了两种导致非线性的关键因素：医疗保健生产的规模经济或范围效应；以及优先选择那些最有可能从更昂贵且更有效的治疗中获益的患者。我们得出结论，扩展路径可能是线性的、凸形的或凹形的，这取决于具体情况。该路径还可能因固定成本而表现出垂直不连续性，或因不可分割性而表现出水平不连续性。通过对扩展路径进行实证估计，可以提高资源分配的效率。我们讨论了这种方法与标准分层分析相比的优势和劣势。

abstract.text: A sizable proportion of women remain married well into late life and an increasing proportion of them participate in the labor force. Since women tend to marry men older than themselves and men tend to experience serious illnesses at younger ages than women, women frequently witness declining health in their husbands. This is likely to affect a wife's labor-leisure trade-off in offsetting ways. Prior studies have not sought to disentangle the effect of a husband's poor health on his wife's reservation wage from the income effect of his ill health. We argue that, if we control for husband's earnings, the coefficient of husband's health in models of his wife's labor force participation (and hours of work) will reflect, in part, her preference over whether to decrease her labor supply to provide health care for her husband or whether to instead increase it to purchase this care in the market. However, husband's earnings are likely to be endogenous in these models due to unobserved characteristics common to husbands and wives. We find that the estimated effect of husband's health depends on whether we instrument for husband's earnings and on the health measure used. This is indicative of the importance of using a variety of health measures and controlling for husband's earnings, and their endogeneity, in future research on the effect of husband's health on wife's labor supply.

10.1002/hec.1084.abstractZh: 相当数量的女性在晚年仍然保持婚姻状态，而且越来越多的女性参与劳动力市场。由于女性往往与年龄较大的男性结婚，而男性在较年轻时就可能遭遇严重疾病，因此女性经常目睹丈夫健康状况的恶化。这可能会以不同的方式影响妻子的劳动-休闲权衡。先前的研究并未试图区分丈夫健康状况不佳对其妻子保留工资的影响，以及其健康状况不佳所带来的收入影响。我们认为，如果我们控制了丈夫的收入，那么模型中丈夫健康状况的系数将部分反映妻子的偏好：她是选择减少劳动供应以照顾丈夫的健康需求，还是选择增加劳动供应以便在市场上购买这种护理服务。然而，由于丈夫和妻子共有的未观测特征，丈夫的收入在这些模型中可能是内生变量。我们发现，丈夫健康状况的估计效应取决于我们是否对丈夫的收入进行了工具变量处理，以及所使用的健康衡量标准。这表明，在未来的研究中，使用多种健康衡量标准并控制丈夫的收入及其内生性，对于研究丈夫健康状况对妻子劳动供应影响具有重要意义。

abstract.text: This paper uses data from the National Education Longitudinal Study to estimate the association between illicit drug use during high school and the number of years of schooling completed. The analysis accounts for the possibility that drug use is endogenous using two methods: (1) by controlling for individual-level characteristics measured before high school entrance; and (2) by using an instrumental variables method, with state drug policies and 8th grade school characteristics as identifying variables. Findings suggest that marijuana use and cocaine use in high school are associated with reductions in the number of years of schooling completed.

10.1002/hec.1085.abstractZh: 本文利用全国教育纵向研究的数据，估计了高中时期非法药物使用与完成的教育年限之间的关联。分析考虑了药物使用可能具有内生性的可能性，采用了两种方法：(1)通过控制高中入学前个体特征来进行分析；(2)使用工具变量方法，以州级药物政策和第8年级学校特征作为识别变量。研究结果表明，高中时期的大麻使用和可卡因使用与完成的教育年限减少有关。

abstract.text: This paper critically reviews theoretical and empirical propositions regarding visual analogue scale (VAS) valuations of health states and their use in cost-utility analysis (CUA). A widely repeated assertion in the economic evaluation literature is the inferiority, on theoretical grounds, of VAS valuations. Five common criticisms are: VAS lacks a theoretical foundation; VAS values are not 'choice based'; VAS values are not consistent with utility-under-uncertainty requirements; context and range effects observed in VAS valuation data mean that they cannot even be considered to represent measurable value functions; and when completing a VAS, people are not trying to express values. We address each of these points: the VAS does have a theoretical basis, being entirely consistent with the non-welfarist foundations of QALYs and CUA; the 'choiceless' nature of the VAS is incorrectly judged by stated preference criteria relevant to monetary rather than health state valuations, and VAS valuations do in any case involve an element of choice; because valuations are intended for use in social decision-making, it may be advantageous that VAS values are elicited under conditions of certainty; although there are measurement problems with the VAS, means such as better design and transformations of data can deal with these; and with any method of eliciting values, it is unrealistic to expect people consciously to think in terms of social science constructs such as utilities.Moreover, there are problems, both theoretical and empirical, with alternative methods. Selection of the appropriate valuation method should be based on empirical performance, and in this the VAS has important advantages. We conclude that there are strong grounds for disputing the consensus view against the VAS and challenge those who hold it to deploy more convincing arguments and evidence in favour of alternative methods. However, we identify areas where further research is required to establish and consolidate the potential of the VAS as a valuation method.

10.1002/hec.1086.abstractZh: 本文对关于视觉模拟量表（VAS）对健康状态的评估及其在成本效用分析中的应用的理论和实证观点进行了批判性的回顾。在经济学评估文献中，一个广泛重复的观点是，从理论上讲，VAS的评估方法存在不足。常见的五种批评包括：VAS缺乏理论基础；VAS的评估值并非基于选择；VAS的评估值与效用不确定性要求不一致；VAS评估数据中观察到的情境和范围效应意味着它们甚至不能被视为可测量的价值函数；以及在完成VAS时，人们并非试图表达价值。我们对这些观点逐一进行了分析：VAS确实具有理论基础，与QALYs和CUA的非福利主义基础完全一致；VAS的“无选择”特性被与货币价值评估相关的陈述偏好标准错误地判断了，而VAS的评估值实际上涉及了选择元素；由于评估值用于社会决策，在确定性条件下进行VAS评估可能更为有利；尽管VAS存在测量问题，但改进设计和数据转换等方法可以解决这些问题；对于任何价值评估方法，期望人们有意识地用社会科学构建如效用这样的概念是不现实的。此外，其他替代方法在理论和实证方面都存在问题。选择适当的评估方法应基于实证表现，在这方面，VAS具有显著优势。我们得出结论，有充分的理由对反对虚拟资产系统的一致观点提出质疑，并呼吁那些持有该观点的人提出更有说服力的论据和证据来支持替代方法。然而，我们指出，还需要进一步的研究来确立和巩固虚拟资产系统作为估值方法的潜力。

abstract.text: This paper applies the inverse probability weighted (IPW) least-squares method to estimate the effects of treatment on total medical cost, subject to censoring, in a panel-data setting. IPW pooled ordinary-least squares (POLS) and IPW random effects (RE) models are used. Because total medical cost might not be independent of survival time under administrative censoring, unweighted POLS and RE cannot be used with censored data, to assess the effects of certain explanatory variables. Even under the violation of this independency, IPW estimation gives consistent asymptotic normal coefficients with easily computable standard errors. A traditional and robust form of the Hausman test can be used to compare weighted and unweighted least squares estimators. The methods are applied to a sample of 201 Medicare beneficiaries diagnosed with lung cancer between 1994 and 1997.

10.1002/hec.1087.abstractZh: 本文采用逆概率加权（IPW）最小二乘法，在面板数据环境下，在存在截尾现象的情况下，估计治疗对总医疗成本的影响。研究中使用了IPW合并普通最小二乘法（POLS）和IPW随机效应模型。由于在行政截尾条件下，总医疗成本可能与生存时间不独立，因此未经加权的POLS和RE模型无法用于评估某些解释变量的影响。即使在这种独立性被违反的情况下，IPW估计仍然能够得出一致的渐近正态系数，并且标准误差易于计算。传统的Hausman检验方法可用于比较加权最小二乘估计量和未加权估计量。该方法被应用于1994年至1997年间被诊断出患有肺癌的201名医疗保险受益人的样本数据。

abstract.text: Self-reported health (SRH) is one of the most frequently employed measures for assessing income-related health inequalities between counties. A previous study has shown that 28% of respondents changed their assessment of their health status when asked a SRH question on two occasions in the same survey (first as part of self-completed questionnaire and then in a personal interview). This study re-examines this issue using another survey where SRH was again asked twice of respondents, but this time the personal interview was first and self-completion second. We find the same variation in responses, but the predominant direction is away from the 'extreme' categories 'Excellent' and 'Poor' which is the opposite direction to the previous study. We therefore conclude that the most likely explanation is a mode of administration effect that makes people less likely to choose the extreme categories in a self-completion questionnaire, but not a personal interview. However, this effect has a relatively minor impact on measures of inequality. This is due to a large proportion of the movement (i.e. movement to the middle) not being related to income and hence does not systematically impact on the cumulative distribution of health across this measure of socio-economic status.

10.1002/hec.1089.abstractZh: 自我报告健康状况是评估各县之间与收入相关的健康不平等最常用的指标之一。先前的一项研究表明，在一项调查中，当被问及自我报告健康状况时，28%的受访者改变了他们对自身健康状况的评估（首次是在自我填写的问卷中，随后则是在个人访谈中）。本研究再次对这一问题进行探讨，这次在调查中两次询问了自我报告健康状况，但个人访谈先于自我填写问卷进行。我们发现，受访者的回答仍然存在同样的差异，但主要趋势是远离“优秀”和“差”这两个极端类别，这与先前的研究方向相反。因此，我们认为最可能的解释是某种施测方式的影响，这种影响使得人们在自我填写问卷时不太可能选择极端类别，但在个人访谈中则不会如此。不过，这种影响对不平等程度的衡量结果影响相对较小。这是因为大部分的变化（即向中间趋势的转变）与收入无关，因此不会系统性地影响这一社会经济地位指标下健康状况的累积分布。

abstract.text: This paper models heterogeneity in the relationship between exposure to information at school or in the media and cannabis use and heavy drinking, using latent class techniques applied to data on French teenagers collected in 1993. Teenagers cluster in five classes which differ in their tastes for drunkenness and cannabis, and in the correlations between information exposure and cannabis use or heavy drinking. Teenager heterogeneity and habit-formation or precociousness effects limit the effectiveness of general information policies. Improving the impact of prevention requires that interventions be better targeted and personalised. We show how economic theory, latent class techniques and existing psychometric questionnaires can be used to build simple statistical tools for targeting prevention policies.

10.1002/hec.1090.abstractZh: 本文利用1993年收集的法国青少年数据，通过潜在类分析模型来研究学校或媒体中接触信息与大麻使用及酗酒之间的关系中的异质性。青少年被划分为五个类别，这些类别在饮酒和大麻的偏好以及信息接触与大麻使用或酗酒之间的相关性方面存在差异。青少年的异质性和习惯形成或早熟效应限制了一般信息政策的有效性。要提高预防政策的效果，需要更加精准和个性化的干预措施。本文展示了如何利用经济理论、潜在类分析技术和现有的心理测量问卷，来构建用于针对性预防政策的简单统计工具。

abstract.text: This study investigates the effects of alcohol advertising on adolescent alcohol consumption. The theory of an industry response function and evidence from prior studies indicate the importance of maximizing the variance in advertising measures. Monitoring the Future (MTF) and National Longitudinal Survey of Youth 1997 (NLSY97) data are augmented with alcohol advertising, originating on the market level, for five media. The large sample of the MTF allows estimation of race and gender-specific models. The longitudinal nature of the NLSY97 allows controls for unobserved heterogeneity with state-level and individual fixed effects. Price and advertising effects are generally larger for females relative to males. Controls for individual heterogeneity yield larger advertising effects, implying that the MTF results may understate the effects of alcohol advertising. Results from the NLSY97 suggest that a 28% reduction in alcohol advertising would reduce adolescent monthly alcohol participation from 25% to between 24 and 21%. For binge participation, the reduction would be from 12% to between 11 and 8%. The past month price-participation elasticity is estimated at -0.26, consistent with prior studies. The results show that reduction of alcohol advertising can produce a modest decline in adolescent alcohol consumption, though effects may vary by race and gender.

10.1002/hec.1091.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了酒精广告对青少年饮酒行为的影响。根据行业响应函数的理论以及先前研究的证据，最大化广告效果的差异具有重要意义。本研究使用了“监测未来”项目和“1997年青少年纵向调查”的数据，并加入了来自市场层面的五种媒体的酒精广告信息。由于“监测未来”项目样本量较大，因此能够估算出针对种族和性别的模型。而“1997年青少年纵向调查”的纵向数据则有助于控制未观察到的异质性，同时考虑了州级和个体固定效应。总体而言，女性相对于男性的价格和广告效应更为显著。控制个体异质性后，广告效应依然较大，这表明“监测未来”项目的结果可能低估了酒精广告的影响。根据“1997年青少年纵向调查”的结果，如果酒精广告减少28%，则青少年每月的饮酒参与率将从25%降至24%至21%之间。对于酗酒行为的参与率，减少幅度则为12%至11%至8%之间。过去一个月的饮酒参与率弹性估计为-0.26，这一结果与先前研究一致。研究结果表明，减少酒精广告可以适度降低青少年的饮酒量，不过这种影响可能因种族和性别而异。

abstract.text: Background Many criteria have been proposed to guide priority setting in health, but their relative importance has not yet been determined in a way that allows a rank ordering of interventions. Methods In an explorative study, a discrete choice experiment was carried out to determine the relative importance of different criteria in identifying priority interventions in Ghana. Thirty respondents chose between 12 pairs of scenarios that described interventions in terms of medical and non-medical criteria. Subsequently, a composite league table was constructed to rank order a set of interventions by mapping interventions on those criteria and considering the relative weights of different criteria. Results Interventions that are cost-effective, reduce poverty, target severe diseases, or target the young had a higher probability of being chosen than others. The composite league table showed that high priority interventions in Ghana are prevention of mother to child transmission in HIV/AIDS control, and treatment of pneumonia and diarrhoea in childhood. Low priority interventions are certain interventions to control blood pressure, tobacco and alcohol abuse. The composite league table lead to a different and more differentiated rank ordering of interventions compared to pure efficiency ratings. Conclusion This explorative study has introduced a multi-criteria approach to priority setting. It has shown the feasibility of accounting for efficiency, equity and other societal concerns in prioritization decisions, and its potentially large impact on priority setting.

10.1002/hec.1092.abstractZh:
背景  
已有许多标准被提出用于指导卫生领域的优先排序，但这些标准的相对重要性尚未得到明确界定，无法对干预措施进行排名。  

方法  
在一项探索性研究中，通过离散选择实验来确定不同标准在识别加纳优先干预措施中的相对重要性。30名受访者需要在12对描述不同干预措施的情景中对它们进行选择，这些情景分别基于医疗和非医疗标准。随后，通过将这些干预措施与标准进行对照，并考虑不同标准的相对权重，构建了一个综合排名表。  

结果  
具有成本效益、能减少贫困、针对严重疾病或针对年轻人的干预措施被选择的概率更高。综合排名表显示，加纳的优先干预措施包括预防艾滋病母婴传播、治疗儿童肺炎和腹泻。低优先级的干预措施则包括控制血压、烟草和酒精滥用的特定措施。与单纯的效率评估相比，综合排名表提供了更细致、更具差异性的干预措施排序。  

结论  
这项探索性研究引入了多标准优先排序方法。它证明了在优先决策中考虑效率、公平及其他社会关切的可行性，并对其对优先排序的影响具有潜在巨大意义。

abstract.text: The randomised controlled trial (RCT) has developed a central role in applied cost-effectiveness studies in health care as the vehicle for analysis. This paper considers the role of trial-based economic evaluation in this era of explicit decision making. It is argued that any framework for economic analysis can only be judged insofar as it can inform two key decisions and be consistent with the objectives of a health care system subject to its resource constraints. The two decisions are, firstly, whether to adopt a health technology given existing evidence and, secondly, an assessment of whether more evidence is required to support this decision in the future. It is argued that a framework of economic analysis is needed which can estimate costs and effects, based on all the available evidence, relating to the full range of possible alternative interventions and clinical strategies, over an appropriate time horizon and for specific patient groups. It must also enable the accumulated evidence to be synthesised in an explicit and transparent way in order to fully represent the decision uncertainty. These requirements suggest that, in most circumstances, the use of a single RCT as a vehicle for economic analysis will be an inadequate and partial basis for decision making. It is argued that RCT evidence, with or without economic content, should be viewed as simply one of the sources of evidence, which must be placed in a broader framework of evidence synthesis and decision analysis.

10.1002/hec.1093.abstractZh: 随机对照试验在医疗保健领域的应用成本效益研究中发挥了重要作用，成为进行分析的工具。本文探讨了在明确决策时代，基于试验的经济评估的作用。文章认为，任何经济分析框架的评判标准在于其能否为两个关键决策提供信息，并符合受资源限制的医疗体系的目标。这两个决策分别是：首先，根据现有证据是否采用某种医疗技术；其次，评估未来是否需要更多证据来支持这一决策。文章认为，需要一种经济分析框架，能够基于所有可用证据，估算与各种可能的干预措施和临床策略相关的成本和效果，并且适用于适当的时间范围以及特定的患者群体。此外，该框架还必须能够以明确和透明的方式整合累积的证据，以充分反映决策的不确定性。这些要求表明，在大多数情况下，仅使用单一的随机对照试验作为经济分析的工具是不充分且片面的。文章认为，无论是否包含经济内容，随机对照试验的证据都应被视为证据来源之一，必须将其纳入更广泛的证据综合和决策分析框架中。

abstract.text: This paper presents a test of the predictive validity of various classes of QALY models (i.e. linear, power and exponential models). We first estimated TTO utilities for 43 EQ-5D chronic health states and next these states were embedded in nonchronic health profiles. The chronic TTO utilities were then used to predict the responses to TTO questions with nonchronic health profiles. We find that the power QALY model clearly outperforms linear and exponential QALY models. Optimal power coefficient is 0.65. Our results suggest that TTO-based QALY calculations may be biased. This bias can be corrected using a power QALY model.

10.1002/hec.1095.abstractZh: 本文对各类QALY模型的预测有效性进行了测试，包括线性模型、幂律模型和指数模型。我们首先估算了43种EQ-5D慢性健康状态的TTO效用值，随后将这些状态纳入非慢性健康状况分析中。利用这些慢性TTO效用值，我们预测了使用非慢性健康状况数据对TTO问题的回答。研究发现，幂律QALY模型明显优于线性和指数QALY模型。最优幂系数值为0.65。我们的结果表明，基于TTO的QALY计算可能存在偏差，这种偏差可以通过使用幂律QALY模型来修正。

abstract.text: This paper estimates treatment effects of managed care plans on the utilization of health care services using data from two contemporaneous, nationally representative household surveys from the USA. The paper exploits recent advances in simulation-based econometrics to take the endogeneity of enrollment into managed care plans into account and identify the causal relationship between managed care enrollment and utilization. Overall, results from the two surveys are remarkably similar, lending credibility to their external validity and to the econometric model and estimation methods. There is significant evidence of self-selection into managed care plans. After accounting for selection, an individual enrolled in an health maintenance organization (HMO) plan has 2 more visits to a doctor and has 0.1 more visits to the emergency room per year than would the same individual enrolled in a nonmanaged care plan.

10.1002/hec.1096.abstractZh: 本文利用来自美国的两项同时进行的、具有全国代表性的家庭调查数据，估算了管理式护理计划对医疗服务利用的影响。文章利用基于模拟的计量经济学最新进展，考虑了加入管理式护理计划的内生性，并确定了管理式护理加入与医疗服务利用之间的因果关系。总体而言，两项调查的结果非常相似，这增强了其外部效度和计量经济模型及估计方法的可信度。有显著证据表明存在对管理式护理计划的自我选择行为。在考虑选择因素后，加入健康维护组织（HMO）计划的个体每年比加入非管理式护理计划的个体多进行2次医生就诊，并且多进行0.1次急诊室就诊。

abstract.text: This research attempts to close an important gap in health economics regarding the efficacy of prenatal care and policies designed to improve access to that care, such as Medicaid. We argue that a key beneficiary-- the mother-- has been left completely out of the analysis. If prenatal care significantly improves the health of the mother, then concluding that prenatal care is 'ineffective' or that the Medicaid expansions are a 'failure' is premature. This paper seeks to rectify the oversight by estimating the impact of prenatal care on maternal health and the associated cost savings. We first set up a joint maternal-infant health production framework that informs our empirical analysis. Using data from the National Maternal and Infant Health Survey, we estimate the effects of prenatal care on several different measures of maternal health such as body weight status and excessive hospitalizations. Our results suggest that receiving timely and adequate prenatal care may increase the probability of maintaining a healthy weight after the birth and, perhaps for blacks, of avoiding a lengthy hospitalization after the delivery. Given the costs to society of obesity and hospitalization, these are benefits worth exploring before making conclusions about the effectiveness of prenatal care-- and Medicaid.

10.1002/hec.1097.abstractZh: 本研究试图填补健康经济学领域中关于产前护理效果以及旨在改善该护理可及性的政策（如医疗补助计划）的重要空白。我们认为，一个关键的受益者——母亲——完全被排除在分析之外。如果产前护理显著改善了母亲的健康状况，那么认为产前护理“无效”或医疗补助计划的扩展是“失败”则是过早的结论。本文旨在通过估算产前护理对母亲健康及相关成本节约的影响来纠正这一疏忽。我们首先建立了一个联合的母婴健康分析框架，以指导我们的实证分析。利用全国母婴健康调查的数据，我们估算了产前护理对母亲健康多个方面的影响，例如体重状况以及过度住院的情况。我们的研究结果表明，及时且充分的产前护理可能会增加产后保持健康体重的可能性，对于黑人来说，甚至可以避免分娩后的长期住院。鉴于肥胖和住院对社会造成的成本，这些益处值得在得出关于产前护理及医疗补助计划有效性的结论之前加以探讨。

abstract.text: We investigate the impact of patient-obtained medical information (POMI) on the physician-patient relationship when patients, as a group, are heterogeneously informed and a physician's interests do not coincide with those of her patients. Introducing additional well-informed patients to the population discontinuously affects the physician's strategy, having no effect unless a sufficient quantity is added. When few patients are well informed, increasing the precision of their information level has no effect on the physician's strategy. Alternately, when a sufficient number of well-informed patients exists, increasing the precision of their information allows all patients to free-ride by receiving more appropriate treatment recommendations.Counterintuitively, we also identify circumstances under which increasing the general level of information may potentially harm patients.

10.1002/hec.1098.abstractZh: 我们研究了患者获取的医疗信息对医患关系的影响，特别是当患者群体信息参差不齐，且医生的利益与患者的利益不一致时。向人群中引入更多信息丰富的患者会干扰医生的决策策略，除非引入的患者数量足够多。当仅有少数患者具备丰富的信息时，提高他们信息的准确性对医生的决策策略没有影响。相反，当存在足够数量的信息丰富的患者时，提高他们信息的准确性可以让所有患者通过获得更合适的治疗建议而从中受益。与直觉相反，我们还发现了在某些情况下，提高整体信息水平可能会对患者造成伤害的情况。

abstract.text: We investigate how the scale of estimation in risk-adjustment models for health-care costs affects the covariate effect, where the scale of interest for the covariate effect may be different from the scale of estimation. As an illustrative example, we use claims data to estimate the incremental costs associated with heart failure within one year subsequent to myocardial infarction. Here, the scale of interest for the effect of heart failure on costs is additive. However, traditional methods for modeling costs use predetermined scale of estimation - for example, ordinary least squares (OLS) regression assumes an additive scale while log-transformed OLS and generalized linear models with log-link assume a multiplicative scale of estimation. We compare these models with a new flexible model that lets the data determine the appropriate scale of estimation. We use a variety of goodness-of-fit measures along with a modified Copas test to assess robustness, lack of fit, and over-fitting properties of the alternative estimators. Biases up to 19% in the scale of interest are observed due to the misrepresentation of the scale of estimation. The new flexible model is found to appropriately represent the scale of estimation and less susceptible to over-fitting despite estimating additional parameters in the link and the variance functions.

10.1002/hec.1099.abstractZh: 我们研究了在健康成本风险调整模型中，估计规模对协变量效应的影响，其中协变量效应的关注规模可能与估计规模不同。以理赔数据为例，我们估计了心肌梗死后一年内心力衰竭相关的增量成本。在这里，心力衰竭对成本影响的关注规模是加性的。然而，传统的成本建模方法使用预定的估计规模——例如，普通最小二乘回归假设加性规模，而对数变换后的普通最小二乘回归和具有对数链接的广义线性模型则假设乘性估计规模。我们将这些模型与一个新的灵活模型进行比较，该模型允许数据决定适当的估计规模。我们使用多种拟合优度指标以及改进的Copas检验来评估替代估计量的稳健性、拟合不足和过拟合特性。由于估计规模的误表示，观察到高达19%的偏差。新的灵活模型被发现能够恰当地表示估计规模，并且尽管在链接函数和方差函数中估计了额外的参数，但仍不易出现过拟合。

abstract.text: Proposed changes to the mental health care system are usually debated in terms of either health benefits or costs savings. However, because of the extensive intersection between the mental health system and the criminal justice system, changes in the organization and financing of mental health services may change the jail detention rate. We analyze jail incarcerations for felonies and non-felonies following the start of a public managed mental health care program in King County, Washington (including Seattle). We analyze unique data that tracks individuals in and out of the public mental health, Medicaid, and criminal justice systems for 1993-1998. In this manuscript we examine individuals with severe mental illness who were enrolled in the Washington state Medicaid program. The final sample size has monthly observations on 6766 unique individuals aged 18-64. We estimate Markov models of the monthly transition probabilities among living in the community with no public mental health treatment, receiving inpatient or outpatient mental health or substance abuse services, or being in jail for either a felony or non-felony charge. The transition probabilities are adjusted for demographics and policy changes that occurred during our study period. There is little evidence of any change in the jail detention rate for severely mentally ill users of the county mental health system in contrast with other SMI individuals following the public managed care program.

10.1002/hec.1100.abstractZh: 关于心理健康护理系统的拟议变革，通常会从健康效益或成本节约的角度进行讨论。然而，由于心理健康系统与刑事司法系统之间存在广泛的交集，对心理健康服务组织和融资方式的变革可能会改变监狱拘留率。我们分析了华盛顿州金县（包括西雅图）在公共管理的心理健康护理计划启动后，重罪与非重罪罪犯的监狱羁押情况。我们分析了1993年至1998年间，个体在公共心理健康、医疗补助和刑事司法系统中的进出情况。在这篇论文中，我们重点关注了那些被纳入华盛顿州医疗补助计划的严重精神疾病患者。最终样本包含6766名年龄在18至64岁之间的个体，这些数据具有每月的观测记录。我们建立了马尔可夫模型，以估计个体在以下情况下的月度转移概率：在社区中未接受公共心理健康治疗、接受住院或门诊心理健康或物质滥用服务，或因重罪或非重罪指控而被关押在监狱中。这些转移概率根据研究期间发生的人口统计和政策变化进行了调整。与采用公共管理护理计划的其他严重精神疾病患者相比，该县心理健康系统中的严重精神疾病患者几乎没有出现监狱拘留率的变化。

abstract.text: We investigate whether job loss as the result of displacement causes hospitalization for stress-related diseases which are widely thought to be associated with unemployment. In doing this, we use much better data than any previous investigators.
