Our data are a random 10% sample of the male population of Denmark for the years 1981-1999 with full records on demographics, health and work status for each person, and with a link from every working person to a plant. We use the method of 'matching on observables' to estimate the counter-factual of what would have happened to the health of a particular group of displaced workers if they had not in fact been displaced. Our results indicate unequivocally that being displaced in Denmark does not cause hospitalization for stress-related disease. An analysis of the power of our test suggests that even though we are looking for a relatively rare outcome, our data set is large enough to show even quite small an effect if there were any. Supplementary analyses do not show any causal link from displacement or unemployment to our health outcomes for particular groups that might be thought to be more susceptible.

10.1002/hec.1101.abstractZh: 我们研究了因搬迁而导致的失业是否会导致人们因压力相关疾病而住院，这些疾病通常被认为与失业有关。为此，我们使用了比以往任何研究者都更优质的数据。我们的数据来自丹麦男性人口在1981至1999年间的随机选取的10%，包含每个人的人口统计、健康状况和工作状态等完整记录，并且每名工人都与一个工厂建立了联系。我们采用了“基于可观测变量匹配”的方法，来估计如果那些工人没有因搬迁而失业，他们的健康状况会发生什么变化。我们的研究结果明确表明，在丹麦，搬迁并不会导致人们因压力相关疾病而住院。对测试效力分析表明，尽管我们寻找的是一种相对罕见的结果，但我们的数据集足够庞大，即使存在某种效应，也能显示出相当小的效应。补充分析并未发现搬迁或失业与特定群体的健康结果之间存在任何因果关系，而这些群体被认为更容易受到这些因素的影响。

abstract.text: It is well established in the literature that the young and healthy are more inclined to switch health plan, given the opportunity. In countries where risk-adjusted capitation payments are used to create a level playing field for the competing health plans, as is the case in The Netherlands, it is important to determine whether plans could exploit such selective switching to gain unfair advantage. This study analyses whether various risk-adjustment models are capable of compensating adequately for selective switching in the Dutch sickness fund sector. Data concern information on health care expenditures, demographics and indicators of chronic diseases for 10 million members from 21 funds. Results indicate that switchers in 2000-2001 had expenditures that were around 40% below average in 1994-2002, confirming that movers are 'good' risks in absolute terms. However, after taking into account that these people are younger and healthier, the risk-adjusted payments for them nearly equalled actual expenditures. This holds for both people who in fact switched from one fund to another, and for those who were forced by regulation to leave the private insurance sector and who had to choose a sickness fund. Importantly, models using only demographics could not achieve this.

10.1002/hec.1102.abstractZh: 文献中已充分证明，年轻且健康的人群在有机会的情况下更倾向于更换健康保险计划。在那些采用风险调整制式付费机制来为竞争中的健康保险计划创造公平竞争环境的国家，如荷兰，确定这些计划是否可能利用这种选择性更换行为来获得不公平优势至关重要。本研究分析了各种风险调整模型是否能够充分补偿荷兰疾病保险领域中的选择性更换行为。数据涉及1000万会员的医疗保健支出、人口统计信息以及慢性疾病的指标，这些数据来自21个保险计划。研究结果表明，在2000-2001年间，更换保险计划的人们的支出比1994-2002年的平均水平低约40%，这证实了这些更换行为者在绝对风险方面属于“优质”风险。然而，考虑到这些人更年轻且更健康，对他们进行的风险调整支付几乎等于他们的实际支出。这一结论适用于那些真正从一家保险计划更换到另一家保险计划的人，也适用于那些因法规要求离开私人保险行业并不得不选择疾病保险计划的人。重要的是，仅使用人口统计数据的模型无法达到这一结果。

abstract.text: Reference pricing (RP) limits drug plan reimbursement of interchangeable medicines to a reference price, which is typically equal to the price of the lowest-cost interchangeable drug; any cost above that is borne by the patient. Much of the evidence of the effects of RP comes from 'before and after' studies of the RP scheme adopted by Pharmacare, the publicly funded drug plan for seniors and others in British Columbia, Canada. We critically assess the identifying assumption inherent in the before and after design - namely, that pre-RP trends accurately predict counterfactual outcomes - in the context of estimating the impact of RP on Pharmacare's expenditure on anti-hypertensive drugs for its senior beneficiaries. We use similar data from a public plan that has not introduced RP to estimate the effects on drug expenditures of patent expiration, secular changes in prescribing patterns and various other factors common to all Canadian public drug plans that could potentially confound the before and after estimates of the effect of RP on drug plan expenditures. We find that controlling for such factors reduces estimates of drug plan savings attributable to RP of the Calcium Channel Blockers by about half.

10.1002/hec.1103.abstractZh: 参考定价将药物计划的报销范围限制在可替代药物的参考价格上，该价格通常等于最低成本的可替代药物价格；超出该价格的部分由患者承担。关于参考定价影响的许多证据来自加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省为老年人和其他人群提供的公共药物计划Pharmacare采用参考定价方案前后的研究。我们批判性地评估了“前后对比”研究中固有的假设——即参考定价实施前的趋势能够准确预测实际情况——在评估参考定价对Pharmacare为老年受益人提供的抗高血压药物支出影响时的适用性。我们使用一个尚未引入参考定价的公共药物计划中的类似数据，来估算专利到期、长期处方模式变化以及其他可能影响参考定价对药物计划支出影响的因素对药物支出的影响。我们发现，控制这些因素后，参考定价对钙通道阻滞剂类药物节省的药物计划支出的估计值减少了约一半。

abstract.text: Investigation of the 'rationality' of responses to discrete choice experiments (DCEs) has been a theme of research in health economics. Responses have been deleted from DCEs where they have been deemed by researchers to (a) be 'irrational', defined by such studies as failing tests for non-satiation, or (b) represent lexicographic preferences. This paper outlines a number of reasons why deleting responses from DCEs may be inappropriate after first reviewing the theory underpinning rationality, highlighting that the importance placed on rationality depends on the approach to consumer theory to which one ascribes. The aim of this paper is not to suggest that all preferences elicited via DCEs are rational. Instead, it is to suggest a number of reasons why it may not be the case that all preferences labelled as 'irrational' are indeed so. Hence, deleting responses may result in the removal of valid preferences; induce sample selection bias; and reduce the statistical efficiency and power of the estimated choice models. Further, evidence suggests random utility theory may be able to cope with such preferences. Finally, we discuss a number of implications for the design, implementation and interpretation of DCEs and recommend caution regarding the deletion of preferences from stated preference experiments.

10.1002/hec.1104.abstractZh: 对离散选择实验（DCEs）中反应“合理性”的研究一直是健康经济学领域的研究主题。研究人员会删除那些被认为（a）“非理性”的回应，这些非理性反应通常表现为未能通过非饱和测试，或者（b）代表词汇偏好。本文首先回顾了支撑合理性的理论，然后指出了在删除DCEs中的回应时可能不适当的一些原因，并强调对合理性的重视程度取决于所采用的消费者理论。本文的目的不是断言所有通过DCEs获得的偏好都是理性的。相反，本文提出了一些理由，说明并非所有被标记为“非理性”的偏好都确实如此。因此，删除回应可能会导致有效偏好的丧失、样本选择偏差，并降低估计选择模型的统计效率和效力。此外，有证据表明随机效用理论或许能够处理这类偏好。最后，我们讨论了DCEs的设计、实施和解释方面的一些影响，并建议在陈述偏好实验中谨慎处理偏好的删除问题。

abstract.text: Many economists argue that willingness-to-pay (WTP) measures are most appropriate for assessing the welfare effects of health changes. Nevertheless, the health evaluation literature is still dominated by studies estimating nonmonetary health status measures (HSMs), which are often used to assess changes in quality-adjusted life years (QALYs). Using meta-regression analysis, this paper combines results from both WTP and HSM studies applied to acute morbidity, and it tests whether a systematic relationship exists between HSM and WTP estimates. We analyze over 230 WTP estimates from 17 different studies and find evidence that QALY-based estimates of illness severity--as measured by the Quality of Well-Being (QWB) Scale--are significant factors in explaining variation in WTP, as are changes in the duration of illness and the average income and age of the study populations. In addition, we test and reject the assumption of a constant WTP per QALY gain. We also demonstrate how the estimated meta-regression equations can serve as benefit transfer functions for policy analysis. By specifying the change in duration and severity of the acute illness and the characteristics of the affected population, we apply the regression functions to predict average WTP per case avoided.

10.1002/hec.1105.abstractZh: 许多经济学家认为，支付意愿（WTP）指标是最适合评估健康变化对福利影响的指标。然而，健康评估文献仍然以估计非货币健康状态指标（HSMs）的研究为主，这些指标通常用于评估质量调整生命年（QALYs）的变化。本文通过元回归分析，将WTP和HSM研究的结果结合起来，用于急性发病情况的分析，并检验HSM与WTP估计值之间是否存在系统性的关系。我们分析了17项研究中的230多个WTP估计值，发现基于QALY的病情严重程度估计值——通过质量福祉量表来衡量——是解释WTP差异的重要因素，同时疾病持续时间的变化以及研究人群的平均收入和年龄也是重要因素。此外，我们还检验并否定了每QALY增益对应的支付意愿保持不变的假设。我们还展示了如何通过估计的元回归方程作为政策分析中的效益转移函数。通过指定急性疾病的持续时间和严重程度的变化以及受影响人群的特征，我们可以将回归函数应用于预测每例避免病例的平均支付意愿。

abstract.text: This paper examines how premiums for ability are set and how these can enhance the quality of care provided in private markets. The specific context for this study is the market for tuberculosis (TB) care in the Philippines. While the most cost- and clinically-effective treatment method known as TB Directly Observed Treatment Short Course (TB DOTS) is increasingly being provided by the public sector, few private doctors have adopted this protocol. As findings of multivariate regression analyses of private physicians' fees suggest, this low adoption rate can be partly explained by the modest premiums private doctors receive for using TB DOTS. While the public provision of TB DOTS should be pursued in earnest, this paper argues that the complementarity between public and private provision of TB DOTS should be strengthened, especially since Filipino TB patients seem to prefer private doctors. This goal can be achieved through user fees that (i) include a sufficiently large premium for physician ability and (ii) are paid through the social insurance system.

10.1002/hec.1106.abstractZh: 本文探讨了能力收费的设定方式，以及这些收费如何提升私人市场中的医疗服务质量。本研究的具体背景是菲律宾的结核病治疗市场。虽然被称为“直接观察短程治疗”的最经济且有效的结核病治疗方法正越来越多地由公共部门提供，但很少有私人医生采用这一方案。通过对私人医生收费的多变量回归分析发现，这种低采用率部分可以归因于私人医生使用直接观察短程治疗所获得的适度收费。虽然应继续推进公共部门对直接观察短程治疗的提供，但本文认为，应加强公共与私人部门在直接观察短程治疗方面的互补性，尤其是因为菲律宾的结核病患者似乎更青睐私人医生。这一目标可以通过用户收费来实现，这些收费应：(i)包含足够高的能力收费；(ii)通过社会保险体系进行支付。

abstract.text: The use of discrete-choice contingent valuation (CV) to elicit individuals' preference, expressed as maximum willingness-to-pay (WTP), although primarily developed in environmental economics, has been popular in the economic evaluation of health and healthcare. However, a concern with this method is the potential for 'over-estimating' WTP values due to the presence of response acquiescence, or 'yea-saying' bias. Based on a CV survey conducted to estimate physicians' valuation of clinic computerization, the extent of such bias was estimated from a within-sample open-ended valuation question following the respondents' discrete choice response. Analysis of this data suggests that not only was response acquiescence an issue, but also that the parametric estimation of mean and median WTP, the most common approach to estimating WTP from discrete-choice data, would potentially magnify such bias (to various degrees depending on the distributional assumptions applied). The possible extent of CV design versus analysis in discrete-choice methods therefore warrants further exploration.

10.1002/hec.1107.abstractZh: 离散选择条件价值评估（CV）方法虽然最初主要用于环境经济学，但在健康与医疗保健的经济评估中也被广泛采用，用于引出个体偏好，以最大支付意愿（WTP）的形式表达。然而，这种方法的一个问题是，由于受访者可能出于默认或“肯定回答”的偏见，导致对WTP值的“高估”。通过对医生对诊所计算机化的评估进行CV调查，可以估计这种偏见的程度。数据分析表明，不仅存在默认回答的问题，而且最常用的参数估计方法——基于离散选择数据的均值和中位数WTP估计方法，也可能加剧这种偏见（程度取决于所应用的分布假设）。因此，离散选择方法中的CV设计与分析可能性的程度值得进一步探讨。

abstract.text: In a health state valuation study, respondents may be asked to rank a deck of cards, with each card representing a particular health state. A logical inconsistency occurs when a more severe health state card is ranked higher than a less severe card. Occasional inconsistencies may be justified by errors in judgment or measurement. However, when respondents return shuffled decks, their responses must be removed from the sample; otherwise, valuation estimates will be biased toward the median. In this paper, we present a logical consistency criterion for sample selection in health state valuation studies. This statistical criterion is based on the relative risk of a shuffled deck and generalizable to all health state classification systems, subsets (or decks) of health states, and valuation techniques. We applied the criterion to secondary data collected from 4048 United States and 3395 United Kingdom respondents. In both studies, respondents evaluated 12-card decks of EQ-5D health states using time trade-off and visual analog scale techniques. Among the UK respondents, a small portion (approximately 5%) did not satisfy the criterion; their exclusion significantly changed the sample characteristics and the mean value estimates of the EQ-5D health states. Similar results were found among the US respondents.

10.1002/hec.1108.abstractZh: 在健康状态评估研究中，受访者可能被要求对一副扑克牌进行排序，每张牌代表一种特定的健康状态。当较严重的健康状态牌被排在较轻微状态牌之上时，就会出现逻辑上的不一致。偶尔出现的不一致可能是由于判断或测量错误造成的。然而，当受访者返回时，他们手中的扑克牌已经洗牌，因此他们的回答必须从样本中剔除；否则，评估估计值将偏向于中位数。在本文中，我们提出了一种用于健康状态评估研究样本选择的逻辑一致性标准。这一统计标准基于洗牌后的扑克牌的相对风险，并且适用于所有健康状态分类系统、健康状态的子集（或扑克牌组）以及评估技术。我们将这一标准应用于从4048名美国受访者和3395名英国受访者那里收集到的次级数据。在这两项研究中，受访者使用时间权衡法和视觉类比量表法对12张扑克牌的健康状态进行了评估。在英国受访者中，有少量人（约5%）不符合这一标准；他们的排除显著改变了样本特征和EQ-5D健康状态的平均值估计。在美国受访者中发现了类似的结果。

abstract.text: Propensity score matching is used to investigate the causal relationship between alcoholism and earnings in a young cohort of males and females drawn from the 1989 and 1994 National Longitudinal Survey of Youth (NLSY) in order to investigate productivity losses attributed to alcoholism and to quantify these effects. Results suggest that there are productivity losses attributable to alcoholism; that they become more pronounced over the life cycle; and that they differ between men and women. Ways in which estimates from propensity score matching may or may not improve on instrumental variables estimates are discussed.

10.1002/hec.1109.abstractZh: 本研究采用倾向得分匹配方法，针对1989年和1994年《全国青年纵向调查》中的年轻男女样本，探讨酗酒与收入之间的因果关系，以评估因酗酒导致的生产力损失，并量化这些影响。研究结果表明，酗酒确实会导致生产力损失；这种损失在生命周期中逐渐加剧；且男女之间也存在差异。文中还讨论了倾向得分匹配得出的估计结果与工具变量估计结果之间的优劣差异。

abstract.text: We examine the evolving structure of the US hospital industry since 1970, focusing on how ownership form influences entry and exit behavior. We develop theoretical predictions based on the model of Lakdawalla and Philipson, in which for-profit and not-for-profit hospitals differ regarding their objectives and costs of capital. The model predicts for-profits would be quicker to enter and exit than not-for-profits in response to changing market conditions. We test this hypothesis using data for all US hospitals from 1984 to 2000. Examining annual and regional entry and exit rates, for-profit hospitals consistently have higher entry and exit rates than not-for-profits. Econometric modeling of entry and exit rates yields similar patterns. Estimates of an ordered probit model of entry indicate that entry is more responsive to demand changes for for-profit than not-for-profit hospitals. Estimates of a discrete hazard model for exit similarly indicate that negative demand shifts increase the probability of exit more for for-profits than not-for-profits. Finally, membership in a hospital chain significantly decreases the probability of exit for for-profits, but not not-for-profits.

10.1002/hec.1111.abstractZh: 我们研究了自1970年以来美国医院行业的结构变化，重点关注所有权形式如何影响医院的进入和退出行为。我们基于Lakdawalla和Philipson的模型提出了理论预测，该模型指出营利性和非营利性医院在目标和资本成本方面存在差异。模型预测，在市场条件变化的情况下，营利性医院比非营利性医院更能够迅速进入和退出市场。我们使用1984年至2000年间所有美国医院的数据来验证这一假设。通过考察年度和地区的进入和退出率，我们发现营利性医院的进入和退出率始终高于非营利性医院。对进入和退出率的计量经济学建模也显示了类似的趋势。有序Probit模型的估计结果显示，营利性医院对需求变化的反应比非营利性医院更为敏感。离散风险模型的估计则表明，负面需求变化对营利性医院的退出概率影响更大。最后，加入医院连锁体系显著降低了营利性医院的退出概率，但并未对非营利性医院产生类似影响。

abstract.text: This paper explores different approaches to econometric modelling of count measures of health care utilisation, with an emphasis on latent class models. A new model is proposed that combines the features of the two most common approaches: the hurdle model and the finite mixture negative binomial. Additionally, the panel structure of the data is taken into account. The proposed finite mixture hurdle model is shown to fit the data substantially better than the existing models for a particular application to data from the RAND Health Insurance Experiment. The estimation results indicate a higher price effect for low users of health care. It is furthermore found that this results mainly from the difference of the price effects on the probability to visit a doctor, while the price effect on the conditional number of visits does not differ significantly between high and low users.

10.1002/hec.1112.abstractZh: 本文探讨了针对医疗利用计数指标进行计量经济建模的不同方法，重点研究了潜在类模型。提出了一种新模型，结合了两种最常用方法的优点：障碍模型和有限混合负二项模型。此外，还考虑了数据的面板结构。实验表明，所提出的有限混合障碍模型在拟合RAND健康保险实验数据方面，比现有模型表现更为出色。估计结果显示，低医疗使用者的价格效应较高。此外，研究发现，这种差异主要源于价格对就诊概率的影响不同，而价格对就诊次数的影响在高低用户之间并无显著差异。

abstract.text: We evaluate the effect of the size of deductibles in the basic health insurance in Switzerland on the probability of a doctor visit. We employ nonparametric bounding techniques to minimise statistical assumptions. In order to tighten the bounds we consider two further assumptions: mean independence of an instrument and monotone treatment response. Under these two assumption we are able to bound the causal effect of high deductibles compared to low deductibles below zero. We conclude that the difference in health care utilisation is partly due to a reduction of moral hazard effects.

10.1002/hec.1113.abstractZh: 我们评估了瑞士基本医疗保险中免赔额大小对就医概率的影响。我们采用非参数边界技术来最小化统计假设。为了进一步收紧边界，我们考虑了另外两个假设：工具变量的均值独立性以及处理响应的单调性。在这两个假设下，我们能够将高免赔额与低免赔额的因果效应限制在零以下。我们得出结论，医疗利用差异部分是由于道德风险效应的减少所致。

abstract.text: Any population can be divided into two groups, one with the presence of a given disease or condition, and the other without. Diagnosis consists of using tests to sort the population into these groups. Diagnostic tests use a threshold value of a diagnostic variable to distinguish between disease-positive and disease-negative individuals. The analysis of error in diagnostic tests has typically been undertaken using receiver-operator characteristic (ROC) curves. More recently, economic value of information (VOI) methods have characterised the costs and consequences of testing. This paper develops a new method for economic test evaluation, which we call ROTS analysis. The ROTS curve plots the costs and effects of changing test thresholds, in cost-effectiveness space. We illustrate the use of our method with a worked example, and show how it can answer three key questions: (1) Is there any test that is worth doing? (2) What is a test's optimum operating point in terms of sensitivity and specificity? (3) If two tests are available, which is best? We contrast the merits of our method with those of established ROC and VOI analysis. We argue that ROTS analysis more clearly reveals the link between changing test thresholds and the cost-effectiveness of different treatments.

10.1002/hec.1114.abstractZh: 任何人群都可以被分为两组，一组存在某种疾病或状况，另一组则不存在。诊断是通过测试将人群分为这两组。诊断测试使用诊断变量的阈值来区分疾病阳性个体和疾病阴性个体。对诊断测试误差的分析通常使用接收者操作特征曲线（ROC曲线）来进行。最近，信息经济价值方法被用来描述测试的成本和后果。本文提出了一种新的经济测试评估方法，我们称之为ROTS分析。ROTS曲线绘制了改变测试阈值在成本效益空间中的成本和效果。我们通过一个实际案例来说明我们的方法，并展示它如何回答三个关键问题：（1）是否有值得进行的测试？（2）在敏感性和特异性方面，测试的最佳运行点是什么？（3）如果有两种测试可供选择，哪种最好？我们将我们的方法与现有的ROC和VOI分析进行了对比。我们认为，ROTS分析更清晰地揭示了改变测试阈值与不同治疗方法的成本效益之间的关系。

abstract.text: This paper uses longitudinal data from the British Household Panel Survey to calculate the compensating income variation (CIV) of cardiovascular disease. It is found that the CIV decreases with age and is higher for men than for women. For women the estimated CIV is similar to those calculated by Groot et al. (2004). For men the estimates are somewhat higher than earlier reported.

10.1002/hec.1116.abstractZh: 本文利用英国家庭面板调查的长期数据，计算了心血管疾病的补偿收入变化。研究发现，补偿收入变化随年龄增长而减少，且男性比女性的补偿收入变化更高。女性的补偿收入变化估计值与Groot等人（2004年）的计算结果相似。而男性的补偿收入变化估计值则略高于之前的研究结果。

abstract.text: The objective of this paper is to analyse the impact that attribute ordering has on the relative importance of the price attribute. A discrete choice experiment was performed in order to elicit psoriasis patients' preferences for treatment. We tested for ordering effect with respect to the price attribute, and disclosed noticeable higher price sensitivity when the price attribute was placed at the end of the program description. Our results indicate that preferences are context dependent and that heuristics may be used in the choice process. Our result does not, however, suggest that ordering effect is a symptom of lexicographic ordering.

10.1002/hec.1117.abstractZh: 本文的目的是分析属性排序对价格属性相对重要性影响。为了了解银屑病患者对治疗的偏好，我们进行了离散选择实验。我们测试了价格属性排序对偏好的影响，发现当价格属性位于程序描述末尾时，患者的价格敏感度明显更高。我们的结果表明，偏好是依赖于上下文的，选择过程中可能会使用启发式方法。然而，我们的结果并不表明排序效应是词典排序的一种表现。

abstract.text: We assess whether distance to provider moderates the effect of a change in mental health benefits on treatment initiation of employees of a large US-based company for psychiatric disorders. Mental health treatment administrative claims data plus eligibility information provided by a Fortune 50 company for the years 1995-1998 are used for the analysis. The effect of distance is measured using the relative effect of the initiative on residents living far from providers compared to those living close to providers. We model the probability of treatment initiation using a random effects logit specification. We find that the effect of distance to provider has the potential to over-shadow other incentives to initiate treatment, especially at distances greater than 4 miles. These results lend further support to the notion that geographic dispersion of providers should be an important consideration when forming a selective contracting network.

10.1002/hec.1118.abstractZh: 我们评估了距离医疗服务提供者的距离是否会影响美国一家大型公司员工因精神疾病而开始治疗的效果。研究使用了1995至1998年间该财富50强公司提供的心理健康治疗行政索赔数据以及资格信息。通过对比居住在远离医疗服务提供者者与居住在靠近医疗服务提供者者之间的相对治疗效果，来衡量距离的影响。我们使用随机效应逻辑斯蒂模型来模拟治疗开始的概率。研究发现，距离医疗服务提供者的距离可能会对治疗开始的效果产生显著影响，尤其是在距离超过4英里的情况下。这些结果进一步支持了在构建选择性合同网络时，应充分考虑服务提供者的地理分布这一因素。

abstract.text: We show that the proportion of community social capital attributable to religious groups is inversely and strongly related to the number of cigarettes that smokers consume. We do not find overall community social capital or the proportion of community social capital attributable to religious groups to be related to the overall prevalence of smoking. Using a new validated measure of community social capital, the Petris Social Capital Index and three years (1998-2000) of US data on 39 369 adults, we estimate a two-part demand model incorporating the following controls: community-level fixed effects, price (including excise taxes), family income, a smuggling indicator, nonsmoking regulations, education, marital status, sex, age, and race/ethnicity.

10.1002/hec.1119.abstractZh: 我们指出，社区社会资本中由宗教团体所贡献的部分与吸烟者所消费的香烟数量呈负相关且关系紧密。我们并未发现社区社会资本整体或其中由宗教团体所贡献的部分与吸烟的整体普及率之间存在关联。通过使用一种新的经过验证的社区社会资本测量方法——Petris社会资本指数，并结合1998至2000年间美国39,369名成年人的数据，我们建立了一个包含以下控制变量的两部分需求模型：社区层面的固定效应、价格（包括消费税）、家庭收入、走私指标、禁烟规定、教育水平、婚姻状况、性别、年龄以及种族/民族属性。

abstract.text: Ukraine's history has given it a split personality (e.g. divergent cultural influences on economic and managerial behavior), as was observed in the recent political developments both prior to and following the December 2004 elections. Eastern regions were heavily influenced by Russo-Soviet rule, while western regions have more of a European outlook. This study, which is largely exploratory, compares recent trends in hospital efficiency in Ukraine to see if this split personality manifests itself in differential rates of improvement. Given the inflexibility of Soviet-style planned economies, it is hypothesized that western regions will show greater improvement in economic efficiency that can be attributed to higher levels of managerial and medical entrepreneurship. Data for this study comes from three oblasts (i.e. geopolitical regions), one in the west and two in the east, spanning from 1997 to 2001. Data envelopment analysis (DEA) was used to estimate technical efficiency for the hospitals. After correcting for bias, a second-stage Tobit regression was estimated. Results indicate that hospitals in the west improved efficiencies, while those in the east stayed constant. These western areas of the nation, being more amenable to western management and medical 'business' practice, may be quicker to pick up on new techniques to increase healthcare delivery efficiencies. This may stem from the more limited effects of a shorter history of incorporation into a Soviet-style planned and controlled economy in which individual decision-making and entrepreneurship was suppressed in favor of central decision-making by the state.

10.1002/hec.1120.abstractZh: 乌克兰的历史赋予了它一种双重性格（例如，经济和管理行为受到不同的文化影响），这一点在2004年12月选举前后的政治发展中都有体现。东部地区深受俄罗斯-苏联统治的影响，而西部地区则更具欧洲特色。本研究主要是探索性的，比较了乌克兰医院效率的近期趋势，以观察这种双重性格是否体现在不同的改进速度上。鉴于苏联式计划经济的僵化特性，我们假设西部地区的经济效率会有更大的提升，这可能与更高的管理和医疗创业精神有关。本研究的数据来自三个州（即地缘政治区域），一个位于西部，两个位于东部，时间跨度为1997年至2001年。采用数据包络分析（DEA）方法来评估医院的技术效率。在纠正偏差后，还进行了第二阶段Tobit回归分析。结果表明，西部的医院效率有所提高，而东部的医院效率则保持不变。这些西部地区由于更适应西方的管理和医疗“商业”实践，可能更快地掌握新的技术来提高医疗服务的效率。这可能是由于较短的历史背景使得个人决策和创业精神受到抑制，而国家层面的决策则更为主导。

abstract.text: This study analyzes prenatal care and birthweight in Uruguay. These data are unique since they represent a population of urban, poor women who gave birth in a health care system that provides both prenatal and obstetric care free of charge. This study finds a positive effect of increased prenatal care use on birthweight and evidence of bias in OLS estimates, similar to studies that use US data. The results highlight the usefulness of existing methodologies for estimating the effect of prenatal care on birthweight and the importance of extending these methodologies to data from countries other than the US.

10.1002/hec.1121.abstractZh: 本研究分析了乌拉圭的产前护理和出生体重情况。这些数据具有独特性，因为它们涉及的是城市贫困妇女群体，她们在免费提供产前和产科护理的医疗保健系统中分娩。研究发现，增加产前护理的使用对出生体重有积极影响，并且OLS估计结果存在偏差，这与使用美国数据的研究类似。研究结果强调了现有方法在估算产前护理对出生体重影响方面的实用性，以及将这些方法扩展到美国以外的国家数据的重要性。

abstract.text: This paper proposes a theoretical framework, drawing on Hicks utility theory, for the Time Trade-off (TTO) method conventionally used to value health states. We briefly describe that theory and posit four distinctive TTO valuation approaches suggested by it: each of compensating variation and equivalent variation for both gains and losses in health, with valuation of health states in each case derived from trade-offs between health and length of life. Recent developments and research on TTO valuation are placed in the context of this framework.

10.1002/hec.1122.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个理论框架，该框架基于希克斯效用理论，用于评估传统上用于健康状态价值评估的时间权衡方法。我们简要描述了这一理论，并提出了该理论提出的四种不同的时间权衡估值方法：针对健康带来的收益和损失分别采用补偿变异和等价变异的估值方法。每种方法的健康状态估值都是基于健康与寿命之间的权衡得出的。本文还将时间权衡估值领域的最新发展和研究置于这一框架的语境中进行了阐述。

abstract.text: This was a longitudinal, general population study based on a Northern Finland 1966 Birth Cohort, using a structural equation approach to estimate the health production function and health input functions for four lifestyle variables (smoking, alcohol consumption, exercise and unhealthy diet) for males and females. In particular, we examined the productive and allocative effects of education on health. We used 15D, a generic measure of health-related quality of life, as a single index score measure but we also estimated models for some of its dimensions. Among the males, the important factors impacting on health were education and all the four lifestyle factors, as well as some exogenous variables at 31 years and variables describing parents' background, and health and behaviour at 14 years. An increase of five years in schooling increased the health score by 0.008, of which about 50% was due to direct effect and 50% due to indirect effects. Among the females, education does not impact on health, but health was affected by the use of alcohol, exercise and diet, but not by smoking. Our results indicate that policy options that increase education among men will increase their health indirectly via healthier lifestyles. However, since the total effect was rather modest and the direct effect insignificant, an increase of schooling is not a cost-effective way to increase health given the present high educational level of Finland. The young adults' and particularly women's internationally high educational status in Finland might be a reason why we find only a modest effect of schooling on health and the non-existence of such effects among women.

10.1002/hec.1123.abstractZh: 这是一项基于1966年芬兰北部出生队列的纵向总体人群研究，采用结构方程模型来估算四个生活方式变量（吸烟、饮酒、运动和不健康饮食）对男性和女性健康的产出函数与投入函数。我们特别研究了教育对健康的生产性和配置性影响。我们使用15D这一通用健康相关生活质量指标作为单一评分指标，同时也对其某些维度进行了模型估计。在男性中，影响健康的重要因素包括教育、所有四个生活方式因素，以及一些外生变量，这些变量在31岁时被测量，同时还有描述父母背景以及14岁时健康和行为的变量。增加五年的教育年限可使健康评分提高0.008，其中约50%是由于直接效应，50%是由于间接效应。在女性中，教育对健康没有影响，但健康受到饮酒、运动和饮食的影响，而吸烟则没有这种影响。我们的研究结果表明，提高男性教育水平的政策选择可以通过更健康的生活方式间接提升他们的健康水平。然而，由于总效应相当微弱且直接效应不显著，考虑到芬兰当前较高的教育水平，增加教育年限并不是一种具有成本效益的健康提升方式。芬兰年轻人群尤其是女性的高教育水平可能是导致教育对健康影响较为微弱的原因之一，而在女性中则不存在这种效应。

abstract.text: The objective of this study was to estimate a Dutch EQ-5D tariff and to determine in a simulation study using the dataset of the original UK valuation study, the number of health states and respondents needed to estimate a reliable tariff. In all, 300 Dutch respondents directly valued 17 states compared to 3000 respondents and 42 states in the original MVH protocol. The results reaffirmed differences in health-related preferences between countries, justifying the estimation of national tariffs. The mean absolute error was 0.030. The design of this study is recommended for national EQ-5D valuation studies.

10.1002/hec.1124.abstractZh: 本研究的目标是估算荷兰的EQ-5D价格表，并通过使用原始英国评估研究的数据集，在模拟研究中确定估算可靠价格表所需的健康状态数量和受访者数量。最终，300名荷兰受访者直接评估了17个健康状态，而原始MVH协议则需要3000名受访者评估42个健康状态。研究结果再次证实了不同国家之间在健康相关偏好上的差异，这证明了估算国家价格表的必要性。平均绝对误差为0.030。本研究的设计建议用于国家层面的EQ-5D评估研究。

abstract.text: Various preference-based measures of health are available for use as an outcome measure in cost-utility analysis. The aim of this study is to compare two such measures EQ-5D and SF-6D in mental health patients. Baseline data from a Dutch multi-centre randomised trial of 616 patients with mood and/or anxiety disorders were used. Mean and median EQ-5D and SF-6D utilities were compared, both in the total sample and between severity subgroups based on quartiles of SCL-90 scores. Utilities were expected to decline with increased severity. Both EQ-5D and SF-6D utilities differed significantly between patients of adjacent severity groups. Mean utilities increased from 0.51 at baseline to 0.68 at 1.5 years follow-up for EQ-5D and from 0.58 to 0.70 for SF-6D. For all severity subgroups, the mean change in EQ-5D utilities as well as in SF-6D utilities was statistically significant. Standardised response means were higher for SF-6D utilities. We concluded that both EQ-5D and SF-6D discriminated between severity subgroups and captured improvements in health over time. However, the use of EQ-5D resulted in larger health gains and consequent lower cost-utility ratios, especially for the subgroup with the highest severity of mental health problems.

10.1002/hec.1125.abstractZh: 有多种基于偏好的健康评估指标可用于成本-效用分析的结果衡量。本研究旨在比较两种此类指标：EQ-5D和SF-6D在精神健康患者中的应用。研究使用了来自一项荷兰多中心随机试验的基线数据，该试验涉及616名患有情绪和/或焦虑障碍的患者。比较了总体样本以及根据SCL-90评分的四分位数划分的严重程度亚组中的EQ-5D和SF-6D效用值。预期随着病情严重程度的增加，效用值会下降。EQ-5D和SF-6D的效用值在相邻严重程度组之间存在显著差异。EQ-5D的效用值从基线的0.51增加到1.5年随访时的0.68，而SF-6D的效用值则从0.58增加到0.70。对于所有严重程度亚组，EQ-5D和SF-6D的效用值平均变化均具有统计学意义。SF-6D的效用值标准化均值更高。我们得出结论，EQ-5D和SF-6D都能区分不同严重程度亚组，并反映随时间推移的健康改善情况。然而，使用EQ-5D能够获得更大的健康收益，从而导致成本-效用比率降低，尤其是在精神健康问题最严重的亚组中。

abstract.text: Since 1988, the minimum legal drinking age (MLDA) has been 21 years for all 50 US states. The increasing prevalence of teenagers driving under the influence (DUI) of alcohol and the resulting traffic accidents were two main reasons for raising the MLDA to 21 years. Following the passage of this legislation, several published studies have found that the higher MLDA is associated with a significant reduction in both fatal and non-fatal accidents. While the relationship between MLDA and DUI events among young adults has been extensively studied, less information is available on other potential consequences of underage drinking. The present study uses data from the National Epidemiologic Survey on Alcohol and Related Conditions (NESARC), a recent nationally representative survey, to investigate the effects of underage drinking on a variety of delinquency and criminal activity consequences. After controlling for the endogeneity of alcohol use where appropriate, we find strong evidence that various measures of alcohol consumption are related both to delinquency and to criminal activity. However, the findings are not uniform across gender as we find striking differences between males and females. These results have interesting policy and public health implications regarding underage drinking.

10.1002/hec.1126.abstractZh: 自1988年以来，美国所有50个州的最低法定饮酒年龄均为21岁。青少年酒后驾车现象日益严重，由此引发的交通事故是将最低法定饮酒年龄提高到21岁的两个主要原因。该法律实施后，多项研究指出，较高的法定饮酒年龄与致命和非致命事故数量的显著减少有关。虽然关于法定饮酒年龄与青少年酒后驾车事件之间的关系已有大量研究，但关于未成年人饮酒可能带来的其他后果的信息则相对较少。本研究利用《全国酒精及相关疾病流行病学调查》的数据，该调查是一项具有全国代表性的最新调查，旨在探讨未成年人饮酒对各种违法行为和犯罪活动的影响。在适当控制酒精使用的内生性因素后，我们发现各种酒精消费指标与违法行为和犯罪活动之间存在密切关联。然而，这些发现在不同性别之间并不一致，我们发现男性和女性之间存在显著差异。这些结果对于未成年人饮酒相关的政策和公共卫生问题具有重要的意义。

abstract.text: This paper offers an empirical test concerning how hospital ownership mix affects consumer welfare in the US. The test compares the market benefits and costs resulting from an increased presence of nonprofit hospitals by observing empirically how the nonprofit market share impacts hospital care utilization at the margin. The empirical results suggest that too many not-for-profit and public hospitals exist in the inpatient care segment of the typical hospital services industry of the US. In contrast, the empirical findings indicate that too many for-profit hospitals operate in the outpatient care portion of the hospital services industry. The policy implication is that more quality of care per dollar might be obtained by promoting increased for-profit activity to inpatient care and more nonprofit activity to outpatient care in some market areas. This conclusion, however, is tempered with several caveats. We discuss these and also make recommendations for further research.

10.1002/hec.1127.abstractZh: 本文对医院所有制结构如何影响美国消费者福利进行了实证检验。通过观察非营利医院市场份额对医院护理利用的影响，本文比较了非营利医院增加所带来的市场收益和成本。实证结果表明，在美国典型的医院服务行业中，住院护理领域存在过多的非营利和公立医院。相反，实证发现，在门诊护理领域，营利性医院的数量过多。政策上的启示是，在某些市场领域，通过增加营利性医院的住院护理业务，以及增加非营利医院的门诊护理业务，可以每美元获得更高的护理质量。然而，这一结论也受到一些限制条件的制约。我们讨论了这些限制条件，并提出了进一步研究的建议。

abstract.text: This paper uses information about prime age individuals living in Amsterdam to study the dynamics in the use of tobacco, cannabis, and cocaine. The analysis examines transitions from non-use to use, as well as transitions from use to non-use. Particular attention is given to the effect of the age of onset on quitting behavior. The empirical analysis shows that for most of the drugs investigated, the earlier individuals start using a particular drug the less likely they are to stop using that drug.

10.1002/hec.1128.abstractZh: 本文利用关于阿姆斯特丹地区适龄个体的信息，研究烟草、大麻和可卡因使用行为的动态变化。分析涉及从不使用转变为使用，以及从使用转变为不使用的过程。特别关注起始年龄对戒烟行为的影响。实证分析表明，对于所研究的大多数药物而言，个体开始使用某种药物的越早，停止使用该药物的可能性就越低。

abstract.text: In this paper, we demonstrate how matching estimators can be used to evaluate policy interventions which are implemented in relatively few regions at different times. Our technique is based on translating calendar time into 'experimental time' to provide a common starting point for entry by different areas into the scheme. Such an approach is likely to have many applications, in particular to cases of state- or country-level interventions for which only aggregate data are available. We illustrate the technique using the case of free over-the-counter access to emergency birth control for teenagers at pharmacies in England. We construct matching estimates of the impact of this scheme on the under-18 conception rate in local authorities. Irrespective of either the matching or the adjustment procedure, we find no evidence that over-the-counter emergency birth control schemes lead to lower teenage pregnancy rates.

10.1002/hec.1129.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们展示了如何利用匹配估计器来评估在不同时间、在相对较少的地区实施的政策干预措施。我们的技术基于将日历时间转化为“实验时间”，为不同地区实施该计划提供一个共同的起点。这种方法可能有很多应用，特别是在只有汇总数据的情况下，用于国家或地区级别的干预措施。我们以英格兰药店为青少年提供免费紧急避孕服务为例，来说明这一技术。我们构建了关于该计划对地方当局18岁以下受孕率影响的匹配估计。无论是匹配还是调整程序，我们都未发现免费紧急避孕计划会导致青少年怀孕率下降的证据。

abstract.text: Background An analytical framework using Bayesian decision theory and value-of-information analysis has recently been advocated for the economic evaluation of health technologies. The purpose of this study was to apply this framework to screening for abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA) in Sweden and to compare the conclusions from this study with the conclusions presented in an assessment performed by the Swedish Council of Technology Assessment (SBU). Methods A probabilistic decision-analytical model was developed to establish the cost-effectiveness of a screening programme for AAA relative to current clinical practice and to calculate the value-of-information. Results The cost per quality-adjusted life-year for screening was 9700 euro. The expected value of perfect information for the assessment of overall cost-effectiveness was low, suggesting little benefit in conducting further research. Expected value of perfect partial information indicated that rupture probabilities were associated with the highest uncertainty. By contrast, the SBU report concluded there was limited evidence of cost-effectiveness and proposed further research. Conclusion The investigated screening programme for AAA is likely to be cost-effective and conducting another clinical trial is unlikely to add much valuable information to this decision problem. These recommendations contrast with the vaguer recommendations from SBU that more evidence is required of costs-effectiveness.

10.1002/hec.1130.abstractZh:
背景  
最近，采用贝叶斯决策理论和信息价值分析的方法框架被推荐用于健康技术的经济评估。本研究的目的是将这一框架应用于瑞典的腹主动脉瘤筛查，并将本研究的结果与瑞典技术评估委员会进行的评估结论进行比较。  

方法  
开发了一个概率决策分析模型，以评估腹主动脉瘤筛查计划相对于当前临床实践的成本效益，并计算信息价值。  

结果  
筛查的每质量调整生命年的成本为9700欧元。完全信息的预期价值对整体成本效益的评估较低，表明进一步研究的好处不大。完全部分信息的预期价值表明，破裂概率与最高的不确定性相关。相比之下，瑞典技术评估委员会的报告认为成本效益的证据有限，并建议进行进一步研究。  

结论  
所研究的腹主动脉瘤筛查计划可能具有成本效益，再次进行临床试验不太可能为这一决策问题提供更多有价值的信息。这些建议与瑞典技术评估委员会更为模糊的建议形成对比，后者认为需要更多关于成本效益的证据。

abstract.text: Alcohol consumption in Russia is legendary and has been reported to be the third leading cause of death in the former Soviet Union after heart disease and cancer. Are Russian alcohol consumers rational addicts? This paper uses eight rounds of a nationally representative Russian survey spanning the period 1994-2003 to estimate a rational addiction (RA) model for alcohol consumption. This is done in a panel data setting as well as on a wave-by-wave basis. The profile of the Russian drinker finds a huge difference between males and females and the model is estimated by gender. We do not find support for the RA model in Russia for women. For men, although we find that some implications of the RA model are satisfied, we fail to endorse the model empirically on grounds of implausible negative estimates of the discount rate.

10.1002/hec.1131.abstractZh: 俄罗斯的酒精消费现象非常普遍，据报告，酒精消费是前苏联继心脏病和癌症之后的第三大死亡原因。俄罗斯的酒精消费者是理性的成瘾者吗？本文利用1994年至2003年间的一项具有全国代表性的俄罗斯调查数据，对酒精消费的理性成瘾模型进行了估计。研究采用了面板数据方法和逐波分析的方法。研究发现，俄罗斯男性与女性的饮酒情况存在巨大差异，模型也按性别进行了区分。对于女性而言，我们没有发现支持理性成瘾模型的证据。对于男性而言，虽然我们发现理性成瘾模型的一些推论得到了支持，但由于折现率的负面估计结果难以置信，我们未能从实证上支持这一模型。

abstract.text: This paper studies the relationship between medical compliance and health outcomes - hospitalization and mortality rates - using a large panel of patients residing in a local health authority in Italy. These data allow us to follow individual patients through all their accesses to public health care services until they either die or leave the local health authority. We adopt a disease specific approach, concentrating on hypertensive patients treated with ACE-inhibitors. Our results show that medical compliance has a clear effect on both hospitalization and mortality rates: health outcomes clearly improve when patients become more compliant to drug therapy. At the same time, we are able to infer valuable information on the role that drug co-payment can have on compliance, and as a consequence on health outcomes, by exploiting the presence of two natural experiments during the period of analysis. Our results show that drug co-payment has a strong effect on compliance, and that this effect is immediate.

10.1002/hec.1135.abstractZh: 本文研究了医疗依从性与健康结果之间的关系——包括住院率和死亡率——通过研究意大利某地方卫生当局管辖范围内的大量患者数据。这些数据使我们能够追踪个别患者从初次接受公共医疗服务到最终死亡或离开该卫生当局的整个过程。我们采用疾病特异性研究方法，重点关注接受ACE抑制剂治疗的高血压患者。研究结果表明，医疗依从性对住院率和死亡率都有显著影响：当患者更遵守药物治疗时，健康结果明显改善。同时，通过利用分析期间发生的两个自然实验，我们能够推断出药物共付制对依从性以及健康结果的影响。研究结果显示，药物共付制对依从性有显著影响，且这种影响是立竿见影的。

abstract.text: Compensating wage differentials are used to estimate marginal rates of substitution between income and both fatal and non-fatal occupational-injury risks in the Mexico City metropolitan area. Data are obtained by in-person survey of almost 600 workers and include workers' perceived risks of fatal and non-fatal occupational injury supplemented by actuarial-risk estimates from government statistics. Results using both actuarial- and perceived-risk estimates are reasonably consistent. Estimates of the value per statistical life are between 235,000 US dollars and 325,000 US dollars and estimates of the value per statistical non-fatal injury are between 3500 US dollars and 11,000 US dollars (2002 US dollars). These values are much smaller than corresponding estimates for higher-income countries but are compatible with the small number of prior estimates for lower-income countries.

10.1002/hec.1137.abstractZh: 补偿工资差异的方法被用来估算墨西哥城大都会区中收入与致命和非致命职业伤害风险之间的边际替代率。数据来源于对近600名工人的面对面调查，包括工人对致命和非致命职业伤害风险的感知，并辅以政府统计数据提供的精算风险估计。使用精算风险估计和感知风险估计的结果相当一致。每统计生命期的价值估计在235,000美元到325,000美元之间，而每统计非致命伤害期的价值估计在3500美元到11,000美元之间（以2002美元计）。这些数值远低于高收入国家的相应估计值，但与低收入国家之前的一些估计值相吻合。

abstract.text: Empirical evidence suggests the existence of a positive relationship between fear of sickness (FS) - as measured by the level of future utility lost when sickness occurs - and the level of effort to prevent the occurrence of sickness. By looking theoretically at this issue, we develop new results on the determinants of optimal prevention for health risks. In particular, we show that a sufficient condition to pursue more prevention for an individual with a higher FS than another is to have lower prudence in Kimball's (1990) sense, whatever the distribution of risk. These findings reinforce the role of prudence as a main determinant of the optimal level of prevention.

10.1002/hec.1138.abstractZh: 实证证据表明，对疾病的恐惧（FS）——通过疾病发生时未来效用损失的程度来衡量——与预防疾病发生的努力程度之间存在正相关关系。从理论上分析这一问题，我们得出了关于健康风险最优预防因素的新结论。具体而言，我们发现，对于恐惧程度较高的个体而言，要采取更多的预防措施，一个充分条件就是其谨慎程度低于Kimball（1990）所定义的谨慎水平，无论风险分布如何。这些发现进一步强调了谨慎程度作为最优预防水平主要决定因素的作用。

abstract.text: ESRD patients have to deal with two choices: the first is related to the dialysis modality; the second concerns the type of dialysis unit (public vs private) where to undertake the treatment. Such a choice is related to unobservable factors, among which there might be patients' clinical factors as well as factors related to the characteristics of each unit. We employ a recursive bivariate probit estimation on a sample of ESRD Sicilian patients in order to evaluate the impact of these factors. Results can have important implications for Sicily in order to organize dialysis services: here, in fact, the number of private centres is higher than in other Italian Regions.

10.1002/hec.1139.abstractZh: 终末期肾病患者面临两个选择：第一个选择与透析方式有关；第二个选择与进行治疗的透析机构类型有关，即公立还是私立机构。这种选择受到不可观测因素的影响，其中包括患者的临床因素以及各机构的特点。我们对西西里岛的终末期肾病患者样本进行了递归双变量Probit估计，以评估这些因素的影响。研究结果对西西里岛的透析服务组织具有重要意义：事实上，西西里岛的私立透析中心数量比其他意大利地区要多。

abstract.text: Models for the economic evaluation of health technologies provide valuable information to decision makers. The choice of model structure is rarely discussed in published studies and can affect the results produced. Many papers describe good modelling practice, but few describe how to choose from the many types of available models. This paper develops a new taxonomy of model structures. The horizontal axis of the taxonomy describes assumptions about the role of expected values, randomness, the heterogeneity of entities, and the degree of non-Markovian structure. Commonly used aggregate models, including decision trees and Markov models require large population numbers, homogeneous sub-groups and linear interactions. Individual models are more flexible, but may require replications with different random numbers to estimate expected values. The vertical axis of the taxonomy describes potential interactions between the individual actors, as well as how the interactions occur through time. Models using interactions, such as system dynamics, some Markov models, and discrete event simulation are fairly uncommon in the health economics but are necessary for modelling infectious diseases and systems with constrained resources. The paper provides guidance for choosing a model, based on key requirements, including output requirements, the population size, and system complexity.

10.1002/hec.1148.abstractZh: 经济评估健康技术的模型为决策者提供了宝贵的信息。在已发表的研究中，模型结构的选择很少被讨论，这可能会影响研究结果。许多论文描述了良好的建模实践，但很少有人说明如何从众多可用模型中选择。本文提出了一种新的模型结构分类法。分类法的横轴描述了关于期望值的作用、随机性、实体的异质性以及非马尔可夫结构程度的假设。常用的聚合模型，包括决策树和马尔可夫模型，需要大量的人口数量、同质的子群体以及线性交互作用。个体模型更为灵活，但可能需要使用不同的随机数进行重复实验以估计期望值。分类法的纵轴描述了各个参与者之间的潜在交互作用，以及这些交互作用随时间的变化情况。使用交互作用的模型，如系统动力学、某些马尔可夫模型和离散事件仿真，在健康经济学中较为少见，但对于建模传染病和资源受限的系统来说是必要的。本文根据关键要求，如输出要求、人口规模和系统复杂性，为选择模型提供了指导。

abstract.text: This paper explores the hospital quality measures based on routine administrative data such as patient discharge records. Most of the measures used in the literature are based on in-hospital mortality risks rather than post-discharge events. The in-hospital outcomes are sensitive to the hospital's discharge policy, thus could bias the quality estimates. This study aims at identifying out-of-hospital mortality risks and disentangling discharge and re-hospitalization rates from mortality rates using patient discharge data. It is shown that these objectives can be achieved without post-discharge death records. This is an example of the use of public use administrative data for estimating empirical relations when key dependent variables are not available. Using data on the lengths of hospitalizations and out-of-hospital spells, the mortality rates before and after discharge are estimated for a sample of heart-attack patients hospitalized in California between 1992 and 1998. The results suggest that the quality assessments that ignore the variation of discharge rates among hospitals could be misleading.

10.1002/hec.1150.abstractZh: 本文探讨了基于常规行政数据（如患者出院记录）的医院质量评估方法。文献中大多数评估方法都是基于住院期间的死亡风险，而非出院后的事件。住院期间的结果容易受到医院出院政策的影响，从而可能扭曲质量评估的结果。本研究旨在利用患者出院数据，识别院外死亡风险，并区分出院率和再次住院率与死亡率之间的关系。研究表明，即使没有出院死亡记录，也能实现这些目标。这是一个利用公共行政数据来估计关键因变量不可用时经验关系的例子。通过收集1992年至1998年间在加利福尼亚州住院的心脏病患者的住院时间和院外治疗时间数据，本文估计了出院前后的死亡率。结果表明，忽略医院间出院率差异的质量评估可能会带来误导。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the relationship between health shocks and labour outcomes in the Spanish population using the European Community Household Panel. In order to control for the non-experimental nature of the data we use difference in difference and matching techniques. Our results suggest that there is a significant effect running from health to the probability of employment and to labour income. Moreover, while we cannot investigate the influence of childhood events and other phenomena that trigger long run causal pathways from socio-economic status to health, we are able to find a significant reduction in the probability of reporting good health in individuals who transit out of employment in comparison with individuals who are otherwise identical in terms of reported health status at the time of the transition.

10.1002/hec.1151.abstractZh: 本文利用欧洲共同体家庭面板数据，研究了健康冲击与西班牙人口劳动成果之间的关系。为了控制数据的非实验性质，我们采用了差异替代和匹配技术。研究结果表明，从健康状况到就业概率以及劳动收入之间存在显著的影响。此外，虽然我们无法研究童年经历及其他引发从社会经济状况到健康状况长期因果路径的现象的影响，但我们发现，与在转型时健康状况相同的个体相比，那些正在脱离就业状态的个体，报告良好健康状况的概率显著降低。

abstract.text: Dental service providers in the British National Health Service (NHS) operate under a number of remuneration arrangements that give rise to different incentives. Using data derived from the Scottish dental system, we examine the relationships between remuneration, patient exemption status and treatment intensity. After controlling for differences in patient need and dentist-specific preferences, we find that self-employed dentists treat patients who are exempt from payment more intensively than their salaried counterparts. The results imply that changes in remuneration can have a large effect on the distribution of treatments. More generally, our results provide support for economic models that view financial incentives as important determinants of physician behaviour.

10.1002/hec.1162.abstractZh: 英国国家健康服务系统中的牙科服务提供者遵循多种薪酬安排，这些安排产生了不同的激励措施。基于苏格兰牙科系统的数据，我们研究了薪酬、患者免付资格与治疗强度之间的关系。在控制了患者需求差异和牙医个人偏好后，我们发现自雇牙医对免付患者的治疗强度高于领取薪水的牙医。这些结果表明，薪酬的变化对治疗分配有着显著的影响。更普遍地说，我们的研究结果支持了将经济激励视为医生行为重要决定因素的经济模型。

abstract.text: In this paper we estimate and validate a three-period sequential model of older workers' labor force transitions following a health/disability shock, using retrospective information from Spanish cross-section data. Central to the analysis are the effects of the various disabilities and their severity. We find that the probability of remaining employed decreases both with age and the severity of the shock. Moreover, we find strong interactions between age and severity for older workers and none for prime-age workers. Suffering any kind of disability reduces the probability of being employed immediately prior to retirement age, and in such cases it is severity which is the strongest indicator. With respect to demographics, we find that female gender, having a retired spouse or being married all reduce the probabilities of both remaining in employment and returning to work following a spell of inactivity; in turn, principal breadwinner status, education and skill levels increase this likelihood.

10.1002/hec.1163.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们基于西班牙的横截面数据，使用回顾性信息对老年工人因健康/残疾冲击而发生的劳动力转换进行了估计和验证，采用了一种三阶段序贯模型。分析的核心在于各种残疾及其严重程度的影响。我们发现，无论年龄大小以及冲击的严重程度如何，工人继续就业的概率都会下降。此外，我们发现年龄与残疾严重程度之间存在强烈的相互作用，而年轻工人则不存在这种相互作用。任何类型的残疾都会降低在退休前继续就业的概率，在这种情况下，残疾的严重程度是最强的预测指标。从人口统计学的角度来看，我们发现女性性别、有退休的配偶或已婚状态都会降低继续就业或在不活动期后重返工作的可能性；相反，作为主要经济支柱、教育水平和技能水平则会增加这种可能性。

abstract.text: This paper tests for income-related reporting heterogeneity in self-assessed health (SAH). It also constructs a synthetic measure of clinical health to decompose the effect of income on SAH into an effect on clinical health (which is called a health production effect) and a reporting heterogeneity effect. We find health production effects essentially for low-income individuals, and reporting heterogeneity for the choice between the medium labels, i.e. 'fair' vs 'good' and for high-income individuals. As such, SAH should be used cautiously for the assessment of income-related health inequalities in France. It is however possible to minimize the reporting heterogeneity bias by converting SAH into a binary variable for poor health vs other health statuses.

10.1002/hec.1164.abstractZh: 本文研究了自我评估健康状况与收入相关的报告异质性。同时，我们构建了一个综合健康指标，以将收入对自我评估健康状况的影响分解为对临床健康的影响（称为健康产出效应）以及报告异质性效应。研究发现，低收入群体的健康产出效应明显，而中等收入群体在选择“公平”与“良好”之间的标签时存在报告异质性，高收入群体则表现出报告异质性。因此，在评估法国与收入相关的健康不平等问题时，应谨慎使用自我评估健康状况这一指标。不过，通过将自我评估健康状况转换为二元变量（即健康不良与其他健康状态），可以最小化报告异质性带来的偏差。

abstract.text: In this paper we evaluate the respective effects of demographic change, changes in morbidity and changes in practices on growth in health care expenditures. We use microdata, i.e. representative samples of 3441 and 5003 French individuals observed in 1992 and 2000. Our data provide detailed information about morbidity and allow us to observe three components of expenditures: ambulatory care, pharmaceutical and hospital expenditures. We propose an original microsimulation method to identify the components of the drift observed between 1992 and 2000 in the health expenditure age profile. On the one hand, we find empirical evidence of health improvement at a given age: changes in morbidity induce a downward drift of the profile. On the other hand, the drift due to changes in practices is upward and sizeable. Detailed analysis attributes most of this drift to technological innovation. After applying our results at the macroeconomic level, we find that the rise in health care expenditures due to ageing is relatively small. The impact of changes in practices is 3.8 times larger. Furthermore, changes in morbidity induce savings which more than offset the increase in spending due to population ageing.

10.1002/hec.1165.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们评估了人口变化、发病率变化以及医疗实践变化对医疗支出增长的不同影响。我们使用微观数据，即1992年和2000年对3441名和5003名法国个体进行的代表性样本观测。我们的数据提供了关于发病率的详细信息，并使我们能够观察到医疗支出的三个组成部分：门诊护理、药品和医院支出。我们提出了一种原创的微观模拟方法，以识别1992年至2000年间医疗支出年龄结构变化的组成部分。一方面，我们发现了一个关于特定年龄段健康状况改善的实证证据：发病率的变化导致该年龄段的支出有所下降。另一方面，由于医疗实践变化导致的支出增长是显著且较大的。详细分析表明，这种增长主要归因于技术创新。在将我们的结果应用于宏观经济层面后，我们发现由于人口老龄化导致的医疗支出增长相对较小。而医疗实践变化的影响则大了3.8倍。此外，发病率的变化带来了节省，这些节省足以抵消由于人口老龄化导致的支出增加。

abstract.text: In order to address the persistent problems of access to and delivery of health care in rural India, a better understanding of the individual provider choice decision is required. This paper is an attempt in this direction as it investigates the determinants of outpatient health care provider choice in rural India in the mixed multinomial logit (MMNL) framework. This is the first application of the mixed logit to the modeling of health care utilization. We also use the multiple imputation technique to impute the missing prices of providers that an individual did not visit when she was ill. Using data from National Sample Survey Organization of India, we find the following: price and distance to a health facility play significant roles in health care provider choice decision; when health status is poor, distance plays a less significant role in an adult's provider choice decision; price elasticity of demand for outpatient care varies with income, with low-income groups being more price-sensitive than high-income ones. Furthermore, outpatient care for children is more price-elastic than that for adults, which reflects the socio-economic structure of a typical household in rural India where an adult's health is more important than that of a child for the household's economic sustenance.

10.1002/hec.1166.abstractZh: 为了解决印度农村地区在获得和提供医疗服务方面持续存在的难题，有必要更好地理解个体提供者的选择决策。本文正是朝着这个方向进行的尝试，它利用混合多项逻辑模型框架，研究了印度农村地区门诊医疗服务提供者选择的决定因素。这是混合逻辑模型首次应用于医疗服务利用的建模中。我们还使用了多重插补技术来填补个体在生病时未就诊的医疗服务提供者价格信息。根据印度国家抽样调查组织的统计数据，我们发现以下结论：医疗服务提供者的选择中，价格和医疗设施的距离起着重要作用；当健康状况不佳时，距离对成年人选择提供者的决策影响较小；门诊服务的需求价格弹性随收入变化而变化，低收入群体比高收入群体更敏感于价格因素。此外，儿童门诊服务的价格弹性大于成人服务，这反映了印度农村地区典型家庭的社会经济结构，即对于家庭的经济稳定而言，成年人的健康比儿童的健康更为重要。

abstract.text: Managed care health insurers in the USA restrict their enrollees' choice of hospitals to within specific networks. This paper considers the implications of these restrictions. A three‐step econometric model is used to predict consumer preferences over health plans conditional on the hospitals they offer. The results indicate that consumers place a positive and significant weight on their expected utility from the hospital network when choosing plans. A welfare analysis, assuming fixed prices, implies that restricting consumers' choice of hospitals leads to a loss to society of approximately $1 billion per year across the 43 US markets considered. This figure may be outweighed by the price reductions generated by the restriction.

10.1002/jae.896.abstractZh: 美国的医疗管理保险公司限制其参保者选择特定网络内的医院。本文探讨了这些限制所带来的影响。通过三步计量经济模型，可以预测消费者在选定健康计划时的偏好，前提是他们所选择的医院属于特定网络。研究结果表明，消费者在选择计划时，会非常重视从医院网络中获得的预期效用。基于固定价格假设的福利分析表明，限制消费者选择医院的行为会导致美国43个市场每年损失约10亿美元。不过，这一损失可能被限制措施带来的价格降低所抵消。

abstract.text: Swedish cross-sectional survey data on young individuals aged 12-18-year-old was used to analyse school-class based peer effects in binge drinking, smoking and illicit-drug use. Significant and positive peer effects were found for all three activities. By introducing school/grade fixed effects, the estimated peer effects were identified by variation in peer behaviour across school-classes within schools and grades, implying that estimates were not biased due to endogenous sorting of students across schools. Further, endogeneity bias due to bi-directionality of peer effects was found for binge drinking and smoking. Controlling for this source of endogeneity resulted in even stronger peer effects.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.02.001.abstractZh: 本研究采用了瑞典对12至18岁青少年进行的横断面调查数据，分析基于学校年级的同伴效应对酗酒、吸烟和非法药物使用的影响。研究发现，这三种行为都存在显著的积极同伴效应。通过引入学校/年级固定效应，可以识别出学校内不同年级之间同伴行为的差异，从而得出准确的同伴效应估计值，这表明估计结果并未因学生在不同学校之间的内生排序而产生偏差。此外，由于同伴效应的双向性，酗酒和吸烟行为还存在内生性偏差。控制这一内生性来源后，同伴效应得到了进一步强化。

abstract.text: I consider the problem of estimating the effect of a health care reform on the frequency of individual doctor visits when the reform effect is potentially different in different parts of the outcome distribution. Quantile regression is a powerful method for studying such heterogeneous treatment effects. Only recently has this method been extended to situations where the dependent variable is a (non-negative integer) count. An analysis of a 1997 health care reform in Germany shows that lower quantiles, such as the first quartile, fell by substantially larger amounts than what would have been predicted based on Poisson or negative binomial models.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.03.005.abstractZh: 我考虑了一个问题：如何估计医疗改革对个人就诊频率的影响，特别是当改革效果在结果分布的不同部分可能存在差异时。分位数回归是一种研究这种异质性处理效应的有力方法。直到最近，这种方法才被扩展到因变量为（非负整数）计数的情况。对1997年德国医疗改革的分析表明，较低的分位数，如第一四分位数，下降幅度远大于基于泊松或负二项模型所预测的幅度。

abstract.text: A choice-theoretic model of household decision-making with respect to care-giving time allocations and the use of publicly and privately financed home care services are proposed. Predictions concerning the effect of increased availability of publicly financed home care services on home care utilization, informal care giving, and health status are derived. These predictions are assessed through use of Canadian inter-provincial survey data on home care use and care giving that are matched with data on home care funding for the period 1992-1998. Increased availability of publicly financed home care is associated with an increase in its utilization, a decline in informal care giving, and an improvement in self-reported health status.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.03.009.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个选择理论模型，用于分析家庭在照顾时间分配以及公共和私人资金支持的居家护理服务使用方面的决策行为。文章推导了公共资金支持的居家护理服务增加对居家护理使用、非正式照顾行为以及健康状况的影响预测。这些预测通过加拿大各省份在1992-1998年期间关于居家护理使用和照顾行为的调查数据，以及相关的居家护理资金数据进行了评估。研究结果表明，公共资金支持的居家护理服务增加与居家护理使用的增加、非正式照顾行为的减少以及自我报告健康状况的改善相关。

abstract.text: We examine the interaction in the market for physician services when the total budget for reimbursement is fixed. Physicians obtain points for the services they render. At the end of the period the budget is divided by the sum of all points submitted, which determines the price per point. We show that this retrospective payment system involves -- compared to a fee-for-service remuneration system -- a severe coordination problem, which potentially leads to the "treadmill effect". We argue that when market entry is possible, a budget can be efficiency enhancing, if in addition a price floor is used.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.04.004.abstractZh: 我们研究了在报销预算固定的情况下，医生服务市场的互动情况。医生因其提供的服务获得点数。在期限结束时，预算会被所有提交的点数总和分摊，从而确定每点的价格。我们发现，与按服务收费的报酬制度相比，这种追溯性支付制度存在严重的协调问题，这可能会导致“跑步机效应”。我们认为，当市场准入是可能的时，如果同时采用价格下限措施，那么预算分配可以提高效率。

abstract.text: This study uses the Continuous Medicare History Sample (CMHS), a longitudinal sample of Medicare beneficiaries from 1974 to 1997, to identify persistence in Medicare reimbursements. Consistent estimates of Medicare reimbursement persistence are obtained using a dynamic panel Tobit model. Lagged reimbursements are statistically significant in explaining a beneficiary's current year reimbursements, yet their effect is moderate in magnitude. An additional dollar of Medicare spending in the previous year gives rise to 0.19 US dollars in spending in the current year for those who have positive expenditures, and the effect ranges between 0.16 US dollars and 0.25 US dollars. Past spending patterns for up to 5 years are also used to evaluate the out-of-sample prediction capabilities of a multi-equation cross-sectional model. Simulated spending patterns for several cohorts are derived and compared to actual spending. The simulated spending distributions are used to study the feasibility of establishing retirement health accounts for Medicare patients.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.04.006.abstractZh: 本研究采用连续医疗保险历史样本（CMHS），即1974年至1997年间收集的医疗保险受益人的纵向数据，来研究医疗保险报销的持续性。通过动态面板Tobit模型得出一致的结论：医疗保险报销的持续性是存在的。滞后期间的报销情况在解释受益人当年的报销金额方面具有统计学意义，但其影响程度较为温和。对于那些有正支出的受益人来说，前一年每多支出1美元，当年就会增加0.19美元的支出；这一效应在0.16美元到0.25美元之间。此外，还利用过去5年的支出模式来评估多方程横截面模型在样本外预测能力方面的表现。对多个群体的模拟支出模式进行了分析，并与实际支出进行了比较。通过这些模拟支出分布，可以研究为医疗保险患者建立退休健康账户的可行性。

abstract.text: During the 1990s, a record number of U.S. hospitals entered into some form of vertical combination with physicians. During the same period, many integrated hospital-physician arrangements broke up. Using data from California, we investigate whether such vertical activity affected hospital pricing. We find that neither integration nor disintegration was associated with significant changes in prices. Integration among rural hospitals is associated with large price decreases, but the sample of such hospitals is small.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.04.008.abstractZh: 在1990年代，美国有创纪录数量的医院与医生进行了某种形式的纵向合并。与此同时，许多医院与医生的整合安排也发生了破裂。我们利用加利福尼亚州的数据，研究这种纵向合并是否影响了医院的定价。研究发现，无论是整合还是分离，都没有导致价格的显著变化。农村医院之间的整合确实导致了价格的大幅下降，但这类医院的样本数量较少。

abstract.text: A striking development in the healthcare market place has been the formation of strategic relationships between hospitals and physicians. Hospital-physician integration appears to be a response to rapidly expanding managed care health insurance. We examine whether integration lead to efficiency gains from transaction cost economies thereby allowing providers to offer managed care insurance plans lower prices or whether integration is really a strategy to improve bargaining power and thereby increase prices. We find that integration has little effect on efficiency, but is associated with an increase in prices, especially when the integrated organization is exclusive and occurs in less competitive markets.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.04.009.abstractZh: 医疗保健市场的一个显著发展是医院与医生之间形成了战略合作关系。医院与医生之间的整合似乎是对快速扩展的管理式医疗保健保险的一种回应。我们研究这种整合是否能够通过降低交易成本来提高效率，从而使医疗服务提供者能够提供更低价格的管理式保险计划，或者这种整合是否真的是一种提高议价能力从而增加价格的策略。我们发现，整合对效率的影响很小，但会导致价格上升，尤其是在整合后的组织是独家经营且市场竞争不激烈的情况下。

abstract.text: In this paper robust statistical procedures are presented for the analysis of skewed and heavy-tailed outcomes as they typically occur in health care data. The new estimators and test statistics are extensions of classical maximum likelihood techniques for generalized linear models. In contrast to their classical counterparts, the new robust techniques show lower variability and excellent efficiency properties in the presence of small deviations from the assumed model, i.e. when the underlying distribution of the data lies in a neighborhood of the model. A simulation study, an analysis on real data, and a sensitivity analysis confirm the good theoretical statistical properties of the new techniques.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.04.010.abstractZh: 本文提出了用于分析医疗保健数据中常见的偏态和重尾结果的稳健统计方法。这些新的估计量和检验统计量是对广义线性模型经典最大似然技术的扩展。与传统的统计方法相比，这些新的稳健技术表现出更低的变异性和在模型假设存在微小偏差时的优异效率特性，即当数据的潜在分布位于模型的邻域内时。通过模拟研究、对实际数据的分析以及敏感性分析，证实了这些新技术的良好统计理论特性。

abstract.text: An Ordered Generalised Extreme Value (OGEV) model by Small (1987) is proposed for application to ordered discrete choice data. Relative to conventional Ordered Probit/Logit (OP/OL) and Multinomial Logit (MNL) models, the OGEV model is flexible, is defined by random utility maximization, and allows for correlation across choices via unobservable individual characteristics according to locations of the choices in the ordering. The OGEV model is applied to unit record data from Australia to study the impacts of prices, income and demographic characteristics on levels of alcohol consumption. Model selection analysis suggests that OGEV is preferred to both OP and MNL for the application.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.04.011.abstractZh: Small在1987年提出了一种有序广义极值模型（OGEV），该模型适用于有序离散选择数据。与传统的有序Probit/Logit模型和多项Logit模型相比，OGEV模型具有更高的灵活性，其模型基于随机效用最大化原理构建，并允许通过不可观测的个体特征来解释选择之间的相关性。该模型被应用于澳大利亚的单元记录数据，以研究价格、收入和人口特征对酒精消费水平的影响。模型选择分析表明，在应用该模型时，OGEV优于传统的OP和MNL模型。

abstract.text: While prior studies tend to view hospital integration through the lens of horizontal consolidation, I provide an analysis of its vertical aspects. I examine the effect of hospital acquisitions in New York State on the distribution of market share for major cardiac procedures across providers in target markets. I find evidence of benefits to acquirers via business stealing, with the resulting redistribution of volume across providers having small effects, if any, on total welfare with respect to cardiac care. The results of this analysis -- along with similar assessments for other services -- can be incorporated into future studies of hospital consolidation.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.05.003.abstractZh: 虽然以往的研究往往从横向整合的角度来探讨医院整合问题，但我对此提出了垂直维度的分析。我研究了纽约州医院收购对目标市场主要心脏手术服务在各类医疗服务提供者之间的市场份额分布的影响。研究发现，收购方通过业务窃取获得了一定的利益，而由此导致的服务量重新分配对心脏护理的整体福利影响甚微。这一分析结果，以及其他类似服务的评估结果，可以为未来关于医院整合的研究提供参考。

abstract.text: We examine the effect of ill health on retirement decisions in Britain, using the British Household Panel Survey (1991-1998). As self-reported health status is likely to be endogenous to the retirement decision, we instrument self-reported health by a constructed 'health stock' measure using a set of health indicator variables and personal characteristics, as suggested by Bound et al. (Bound, J., Schoenbaum, M., Stinebrickner, T.M., Waidmann, M., 1999. The dynamic effects of health on the labor force transitions of older workers. Labour Economics 6, 179-202). Using a range of econometric techniques, we show that adverse shocks to individual health stocks predict individual retirement behaviour among workers aged from 50 until state pension age. We compare responses of economic activity to constructed health measures with that arising using direct indicators of functional limitations and specific health problems. We also examine the dynamics of health shocks and whether adverse and positive health shocks have symmetric effects on transitions in and out of economic activity.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.05.004.abstractZh: 我们研究了健康状况不佳对英国退休决策的影响，使用了英国家庭面板调查数据（1991-1998年）。由于自我报告的健康状况很可能与退休决策存在内生关系，我们采用一种由健康指标变量和个人特征构成的“健康存量”来衡量自我报告的健康状况，这一方法参考了Bound等人（Bound, J., Schoenbaum, M., Stinebrickner, T.M., Waidmann, M., 1999. 健康对老年工人劳动力转移的动态影响。劳动经济学 6, 179-202）的研究方法。通过一系列计量经济技术，我们发现个体健康存量的负面冲击会预测50岁至国家养老金年龄段的工人的退休行为。我们将使用构建的健康指标与直接使用功能限制和特定健康问题的指标所得到的经济活动反应进行了比较。我们还研究了健康冲击的动态变化，以及负面和正面健康冲击对经济活动转换的效应是否对称。

abstract.text: This study analyzes health plan choices of retirees in an employer-sponsored health benefits program that resembles "premium support" models proposed for Medicare. In this program, out-of-pocket premiums depend on when an individual retired and his or her years of service as of that date. Since this price variation is exogenous to unobserved plan attributes and retiree characteristics, it is possible to obtain unbiased premium elasticity estimates. The results indicate a significantly negative effect of premiums. The implied elasticities are at the low end of the range found in previous studies on active employees.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.06.001.abstractZh: 本研究分析了在雇主赞助的健康福利计划中，退休人员对健康保险计划的选择，该计划类似于为医疗保险所提出的“保费支持”模式。在该计划中，个人自付的保费取决于其退休时间以及截至该日期的服役年限。由于这种价格差异是独立于未观察到的计划属性和退休人员特征而存在的，因此可以获得无偏见的保费弹性估计值。研究结果表明，保费具有显著的负面影响。所得到的弹性值处于以往针对在职员工研究中的较低水平。

abstract.text: We use data on the enrollment decisions of federal annuitants to estimate the influence of publicized ratings on health plan choice. We focus on the impact of ratings disseminated by the National Committee for Quality Assurance (NCQA), and use our estimates to calculate the value of the information. Our approach exploits a novel feature of the data-the availability of non-public plan ratings-to correct for a source of bias that is inherent in studies of consumer responsiveness to information on product quality: since publicized ratings are correlated with other quality signals known to consumers (but unobserved by researchers), the estimated influence of ratings is likely to be overstated. We control for this bias by comparing the estimated impact of publicized ratings to the estimated impact of ratings that were never disclosed. The results indicate that NCQA's plan ratings had a meaningful influence on individuals' choices, particularly for individuals choosing a plan for the first time. Although we estimate that a very small fraction of individual decisions were materially affected by the information, for those that were affected the implied utility gains are substantial.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.06.002.abstractZh: 我们利用联邦年金领取者的参保决策数据，来估算公开评级对健康计划选择的影响。我们重点关注由全国质量保障委员会（NCQA）发布的评级所产生的影响，并通过我们的估算来计算这些信息的价值。我们的方法利用了数据中的一个新颖特征——非公开计划的评级信息——来纠正一个固有的偏差，这种偏差存在于对消费者对产品质量信息反应的研究中：由于公开评级与消费者已知的其他质量信号相关（但研究人员无法观察到），因此评级的影响可能被高估了。我们通过比较公开评级的估计影响与从未公开的评级的估计影响，来控制这种偏差。结果表明，NCQA的计划评级对个人的选择产生了显著影响，尤其是在首次选择计划时。尽管我们估计只有极少数个人决策受到了这些信息的实质性影响，但对于那些受到影响的个人来说，所获得的效用提升是显著的。

abstract.text: We study effects of direct-to-consumer advertising (DTCA) in the prescription drug market. There are two pharmaceutical firms providing horizontally differentiated (branded) drugs. Patients differ in their susceptibility to the drugs. If DTCA is allowed, this can be employed to induce (additional) patient visits. Physicians perfectly observe the patients' type (of illness), but rely on information to prescribe the correct drug. Drug information is conveyed by marketing (detailing), creating a captive and a selective segment of physicians. First, we show that detailing, DTCA and price (if not regulated) are complementary strategies for the firms. Thus, allowing DTCA induces more detailing and higher prices. Second, firms benefit from DTCA if detailing competition is not too fierce, which is true if investing in detailing is sufficiently costly. Otherwise, firms are better off with a ban on DTCA. Finally, DTCA tends to lower welfare if insurance is generous (low copayments) and/or price regulation is lenient. The desirability of DTCA also depends on whether or not the regulator is concerned with firms' profit.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.06.003.abstractZh: 我们研究了直接面向消费者广告在处方药市场中的影响。有两家制药公司提供横向差异化的品牌药品。患者对这些药物的敏感程度各不相同。如果允许直接面向消费者广告，这可以被用来促进患者的额外就诊。医生完全能够了解患者的疾病类型，但需要在信息的基础上来开具正确的药物。药品信息通过营销宣传传达，从而形成了医生中的特定群体和选择性市场。首先，我们发现营销宣传、直接面向消费者广告以及价格（如果不加以监管）是这些公司的互补策略。因此，允许直接面向消费者广告会促使更多的营销宣传和更高的价格。其次，如果营销宣传的竞争不是太激烈，那么公司可以从直接面向消费者广告中获益，前提是投入营销宣传的成本足够高。否则，禁止直接面向消费者广告对公司的利益更为有利。最后，如果保险政策宽松（copayments较低）和/或价格监管较为宽松，直接面向消费者广告往往会降低整体福利。直接面向消费者广告的吸引力还取决于监管机构是否关注公司的利润。

abstract.text: This paper studies factor substitution in one important sector: the nursing home industry. Specifically, we measure the extent to which nursing homes substitute materials for labor when labor becomes relatively more expensive. From a policy perspective, factor substitution in this market is important because materials-intensive methods of care are associated with greater risks of morbidity and mortality among nursing home residents. Studying longitudinal data from 1991 to 2000 on nearly every nursing home in the United States, we use the method of instrumental variables (IV) to address measurement error in nursing home wages. The results from the IV models yield evidence of factor substitution: higher nursing home wages are associated with greater use of psychoactive drugs and lower quality.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.06.004.abstractZh: 本文研究了重要行业之一——养老院产业中的要素替代现象。具体而言，我们衡量了在劳动力成本相对上升时，养老院在何种程度上用材料替代劳动力。从政策角度来看，该市场的要素替代现象非常重要，因为以材料密集型方式提供护理服务与养老院居民更高的发病率和死亡率相关。通过对1991年至2000年间美国几乎所有养老院的长期数据进行分析，我们采用工具变量方法来解决养老院工资计量误差的问题。工具变量模型的结果表明，要素替代现象确实存在：较高的养老院工资与更多使用精神活性药物以及较低的服务质量相关。

abstract.text: The strong negative correlation over time between smoking rates and obesity have led some to suggest that reduced smoking is increasing weight gain in the U.S. This conclusion is supported by the findings of Chou et al. [Chou, S.-Y., Grossman, M., Saffer, H., 2004. An economic analysis of adult obesity: results from the behavioral risk factor surveillance system. Journal of Health Economics 23, 565-587], who conclude that higher cigarette prices lead to increased body weight. We investigate this issue and find no evidence that reduced smoking leads to weight gain. Using the cigarette tax rather than the cigarette price and controlling for non-linear time effects, we find a negative effect of cigarette taxes on body weight, implying that reduced smoking leads to lower body weights. Yet our results, as well as Chou et al., imply implausibly large effects of smoking on body weight. Thus, we cannot confirm that falling smoking leads in a major way to rising obesity rates in the U.S.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.07.005.abstractZh: 吸烟率与肥胖率之间存在显著的负相关关系，这导致一些人认为减少吸烟会导致美国体重的增加。Chou等人[Chou, S.-Y., Grossman, M., Saffer, H., 2004. 成人肥胖的经济分析：来自行为风险因素监测系统的结果。《健康经济学杂志》23, 565-587]的研究结果支持了这一观点，他们得出结论认为较高的香烟价格会导致体重增加。我们对此进行了研究，发现没有证据表明减少吸烟会导致体重增加。通过使用香烟税而非香烟价格，并控制非线性时间效应后，我们发现香烟税对体重有负面影响，这意味着减少吸烟会导致体重下降。然而，我们的研究结果以及Chou等人的研究都表明，吸烟对体重的影响可能过于显著。因此，我们无法确认减少吸烟会显著导致美国肥胖率的上升。

abstract.text: The Master Settlement Agreement (MSA) between the major tobacco companies and 46 states created an abrupt 20% increase in cigarette prices in November 1998. Earlier estimates of the elasticity of prenatal smoking implied that the price rise would reduce prenatal cigarette smoking by 7-20%. Using birth records on 9.8 million US births between January 1996 and February 2000, we examined the change in smoking during pregnancy and conditional smoking intensity in response to the MSA. Overall, adjusting for secular trends in smoking, prenatal smoking declined by less than half what was predicted in response to the MSA.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.07.006.abstractZh: 主要烟草公司与46个州之间达成的《主协议》在1998年11月导致香烟价格突然上涨20%。此前对产前吸烟弹性的估计表明，价格上涨将使产前吸烟量减少7-20%。利用1996年1月至2000年2月期间980万美国婴儿的出生记录，我们研究了在《主协议》实施期间怀孕期间的吸烟情况以及吸烟强度的变化。总体而言，考虑到吸烟的长期趋势后，产前吸烟量的减少幅度远小于《主协议》预期的效果。

abstract.text: This study measures the effect of case management interview (CMI) on 1,000 long-term sick-listed employees' probability of returning to work. In contrast to previous studies, we use instrumental variables to correct for selection effects in CMI. Using a competing hazard rate model, we find that CMI increases the probability of returning to work for the pre-sick leave employer, but has no effect on the probability of resuming work for a new employer. We argue that CMI either motivates the sick-listed employees to resume work or adjusts for asymmetric information between the employee and the pre-sick leave employer.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.07.007.abstractZh: 本研究评估了案例管理访谈对1000名长期病假员工重返工作岗位概率的影响。与以往的研究不同，我们采用工具变量来纠正案例管理访谈中的选择效应。通过对比风险率模型，我们发现案例管理访谈确实增加了病假前雇主员工重返工作岗位的概率，但对新雇主员工重返工作岗位的概率没有影响。我们认为，案例管理访谈要么能够激励病假员工重返工作岗位，要么能够解决员工与病假前雇主之间的信息不对称问题。

abstract.text: In this paper we report the estimation of conditional logistic regression models for the Health Utilities Index Mark 2 and the SF-6D, using ordinal preference data. The results are compared to the conventional regression models estimated from standard gamble data, and to the observed mean standard gamble health state valuations. For both the HUI2 and the SF-6D, the models estimated using ordinal data are broadly comparable to the models estimated on standard gamble data and the predictive performance of these models is close to that of the standard gamble models. Our research indicates that ordinal data have the potential to provide useful insights into community health state preferences. However, important questions remain.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.07.008.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们报告了使用序数偏好数据对健康效用指数Mark 2和SF-6D进行条件逻辑回归模型估计的结果。这些结果与基于标准赌博数据估计的传统回归模型以及观察到的标准赌博健康状态估值进行了比较。对于HUI2和SF-6D而言，使用序数数据估计的模型与基于标准赌博数据估计的模型在总体上是可比较的，这些模型的预测性能也接近标准赌博模型。我们的研究表明，序数数据有潜力为社区健康状态的偏好提供有用的见解。然而，仍有一些重要问题需要解决。

abstract.text: The pursuit of multiple objectives by public sector organisations makes it difficult to assess and compare their performance. Considering objectives in isolation ignores the possibility of correlations between objectives, and a single index of performance requires subjective judgements to be made about the relative value of each objective. An alternative approach is to estimate a multivariate system of equations in which objectives are analysed individually but correlations across objectives are considered explicitly. We analyse the performance of English health authorities against 13 objectives using hierarchical data for electoral wards that are nested within health authorities. We find evidence of correlation across objectives, suggesting that some are complementary and others subject to trade-off. The estimates generated when assessing performance with multivariate multilevel models as compared to ordinary least squares or multilevel models differ, with the magnitudes varying by objective and health authority.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.07.009.abstractZh: 公共部门组织追求多个目标，这使得评估和比较其绩效变得困难。孤立地考虑各个目标会忽略目标之间可能存在的相关性，而单一的绩效指标则需要主观判断来确定每个目标的相对价值。另一种方法是估计一个多变量方程组，在这种模型中，各个目标被单独分析，但目标之间的相关性也被明确考虑。我们分析了英格兰卫生当局在13个目标下的绩效，使用了嵌套在卫生当局内部的选区数据。我们发现目标之间存在相关性，这表明某些目标是互补的，而另一些则存在权衡关系。使用多变量多层模型评估绩效时得到的估计结果与普通最小二乘法或多层次模型有所不同，不同目标及卫生当局的估计结果也有所差异。

abstract.text: In many health care systems generalist physicians act as gatekeepers to secondary care. Under the English fundholding scheme from 1991/1992 to 1998/1999 general practices could elect to be given a budget to meet the costs of certain types of elective surgery (chargeable electives) for their patients and could retain any surplus. They did not pay for non-chargeable electives or for emergency admissions. Non-fundholding practices did not bear the cost of any type of hospital admissions. Fundholding is to be reintroduced from April 2005. We estimate the effect of fundholding using a differences in differences methodology on a large 4-year panel of English general practices before and after the abolition of fundholding. The abolition of fundholding increased ex-fundholders' admission rates for chargeable elective admissions by between 3.5 and 5.1%. The effect on the early wave fundholders was greater (around 8%) than on later wave fundholders. We also use differences in differences for two types of admissions (non-chargeable electives, emergencies) not covered by fundholding as additional controls for unobserved temporal factors. These differences in differences in differences estimates suggest that the abolition of fundholding increased ex-fundholders' chargeable elective admissions by 4.9% (using the non-chargeables DID) and by 3.5% (using the emergencies DID).

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.08.001.abstractZh: 在许多医疗保健系统中，全科医生扮演着二级医疗服务的把关者角色。在1991/1992年至1998/1999年的英国基金持有制度下，全科诊所可以选择获得预算，用于支付患者某些类型的选择性手术费用（需收费的选择性手术），并可以保留任何盈余。这些诊所无需承担非收费选择性手术或紧急住院的费用。没有基金持有的诊所则无需承担任何类型的住院费用。从2005年4月开始，基金持有制度将重新引入。我们使用差异差异方法，对英国全科诊所在基金持有制度废除前后4年的数据进行了分析。基金持有制度的废除使原有基金持有者的收费选择性手术住院率增加了3.5%至5.1%。对于早期基金持有者来说，这一影响更为显著（约8%），而后期基金持有者则受到的影响较小。我们还使用了两种未涵盖在基金持有制度中的住院类型（非收费选择性手术、紧急住院）作为额外控制变量，以排除未观察到的时间因素。这些差异差异估计结果表明，基金持有制度的废除使原有基金持有者的收费选择性手术住院率增加了4.9%（针对非收费选择性手术）和3.5%（针对紧急住院）。

abstract.text: We investigated the reliability of an internet-based stated-preference survey to elicit preferences for priority setting using a conjoint study like approach. Preferences were elicited among members of an Internet survey panel in an experimental "allocation of points" task at two times. The main finding is that the survey showed good reliability and most participants consistently adjusted their allocations of points to differences in presented scenarios. At the repetition of the survey, respondents were more likely to prioritize between new treatment programs competing for funding and those that did prioritize discriminated stronger between programs.
