We found no evidence that respondents were making easy choices or arbitrarily "clicked" through the survey.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.08.002.abstractZh: 我们研究了基于互联网的陈述偏好调查在引出优先排序偏好方面的可靠性，采用了类似联合研究的分析方法。在实验性的“积分分配”任务中，我们在互联网调查小组的成员中收集了偏好数据，并在两次不同时间进行了调查。主要发现是，该调查显示出良好的可靠性，大多数参与者会根据呈现的情景差异及时调整他们的积分分配。在重复调查时，受访者更有可能在争夺资金的新治疗项目和那些已经确定优先顺序的项目之间进行选择，并且他们之间的区分更为明显。我们没有发现受访者是在轻松做出选择，或者随意地点击完成调查的情况。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the empirical relationship between cocaine and heroin prices and drug-related hospital ED admissions for 21 U.S. cities. These outcomes bypass some of the problems with self-reports and directly measure a component of healthcare costs associated with heavy drug usage. The price elasticity of the probability of a cocaine and heroin episode is estimated at -0.27 and -0.10, respectively. A 10% increase in prices can prevent 10,723 cocaine and heroin-related ED visits, with cost savings between 21 million dollars and 47 million dollars. These low magnitudes of the drug outcome-price response have implications for the cost-effectiveness of enforcement-driven price increases.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.08.003.abstractZh: 本文对21个美国城市的可卡因和海洛因价格与药物相关急诊入院情况之间的实证关系进行了估算。这些结果避免了自我报告的一些问题，并直接衡量了与严重药物使用相关的医疗成本的一部分。可卡因和海洛因发作发生概率的价格弹性分别估计为-0.27和-0.10。价格上涨10%可以防止10,723次与可卡因和海洛因相关的急诊就诊，从而节省费用达2100万至4700万美元。这些药物结果-价格反应的小幅度变化对于以执法为手段的价格上涨的成本效益具有重要意义。

abstract.text: Moving between choice and direct valuation procedures can cause substantial, systematic preference reversals, which is problematic because it leaves us unsure as to which procedure (if any) is 'best'. This article reports a study that tests whether using a ranking procedure to infer values rather than more conventional direct valuation can negate this phenomenon. The results suggest that the ranking procedure can render strict preference reversals both less substantial and less systematic. This could have important implications for the valuation of health outcomes, and in attempting to ascertain whether choice, valuation or ranking best uncovers people's preferences, similar tests in the context of more realistic health outcome descriptions are recommended.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.08.004.abstractZh: 在选择程序和直接估值程序之间切换可能会导致显著的、系统性的偏好逆转，这很成问题，因为我们无法确定哪种程序（如果有的话）是“最佳”的。本文报道了一项研究，旨在测试使用排名程序来推断价值是否比传统的直接估值更能避免这种现象。研究结果表明，排名程序可以使严格的偏好逆转变得不那么显著和系统性。这对于健康结果的估值具有重要意义，同时，为了确定选择、估值或排名哪种方法最能揭示人们的偏好，建议在更现实的健康结果描述背景下进行类似的测试。

abstract.text: This study explores factors that influence participation in genetic testing programs and the acceptance of multiple tests. Tay Sachs and cystic fibrosis are both genetically determined recessive disorders with differing severity, treatment availability, and prevalence in different population groups. We used a discrete choice experiment with a general community and an Ashkenazi Jewish sample; data were analysed using multinomial logit with random coefficients. Although Jewish respondents were more likely to be tested, both groups seem to be making very similar tradeoffs across attributes when they make genetic testing choices.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.09.002.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了影响人们参与基因检测项目以及接受多次检测的因素。泰萨克斯病和囊性纤维化都是由遗传因素导致的隐性疾病，其严重程度、治疗的可获得性以及在不同人群中的发病率各不相同。我们采用离散选择实验方法，对普通社区和阿什肯纳兹犹太人群进行了研究；数据采用多项式逻辑模型进行分析，并设定了随机系数。尽管犹太受访者更有可能接受基因检测，但两组人在做出基因检测选择时，似乎在多个属性上做出了非常相似的权衡。

abstract.text: An interview study with 101 members of public compared the protocols used in valuation studies for EQ-5D (using ranking, visual analogue scale, and time trade-off), and SF-6D (using ranking and standard gamble). Respondents were given one of the two protocols and asked to value four states each from EQ-5D and SF-6D. VAS scores suggest the narrower range of SF-6D values is partly attributable to the descriptive system; TTO values for milder states were higher than SG values; and the mean value for EQ-5D pits using TTO and SF-6D pits using SG were closer than across the two original valuation studies.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.09.003.abstractZh: 一项针对101名公众成员的访谈研究，比较了EQ-5D评估研究中使用的两种协议：一种采用排名法、视觉模拟量表和时间权衡法，另一种采用排名法和标准赌博法。受访者被要求使用这两种协议中的任何一种，对EQ-5D和SF-6D中的四种状态进行估值。视觉模拟量表的得分表明，SF-6D的估值范围较窄，部分原因是由于其描述性系统的特性；较温和状态的TTO值高于SG值；而使用TTO的EQ-5D平均值与使用SG的SF-6D平均值更为接近，这一结果优于最初的两项评估研究。

abstract.text: The identification of the types of bidirectional interactions that take place between longevity and economic growth in the long-run is carried out by means of the integration of human capital accumulation, innovation in medical technology, a health goods sector, and individual decisions on health and longevity in a dynamic general equilibrium set-up. In this context, in which individual agents decide not only on their "quality" of life but also on its "quantity", the mere process of biological deterioration, that is to say, the continuous loss of health goods effectiveness in maintaining a given level of health as individuals age, provides the reason for an additional, and new, engine of growth.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.09.004.abstractZh: 通过整合人力资本积累、医疗技术创新、健康商品产业以及个人在健康和长寿方面的决策，本文探讨了长期内长寿与经济增长之间双向互动的类型。在这种情境下，个体不仅决定自己的“生活质量”，还决定“生活数量”。单纯的生物退化过程，即随着个体年龄增长，保持健康所需的健康商品有效性持续下降，成为推动经济增长的额外动力。

abstract.text: In this paper I investigate the impact of body mass index (BMI) on occupational attainment in England. Using pooled cross-sectional health survey data for 1997 and 1998 I find using OLS that, conditional on a comprehensive set of individual and area covariates, BMI has a positive and significant effect on occupational attainment in males and a negative and significant effect in females. Subsequent analyses with different covariates show considerable variation in the results for males, while for females the effect of BMI is significant and negative irrespective of the covariates used. IV coefficients on the BMI measures are insignificant in all models, though I am unable to identify any endogeneity problems with respect to BMI.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.09.005.abstractZh: 在本文中，我研究了体重指数（BMI）对英格兰人职业成就的影响。利用1997年和1998年的综合健康调查数据，通过OLS回归分析发现，在考虑一系列个体和地区协变量的情况下，BMI对男性的职业成就有正面且显著的影响，而对女性则具有负面且显著的影响。后续使用不同协变量的分析显示，男性结果存在较大差异，而无论使用何种协变量，BMI对女性的影响都是显著且负面的。在所有模型中，BMI指标的交互项系数均不显著，不过我未能发现与BMI相关的内生性问题。

abstract.text: Criteria for initiation of highly active antiretroviral treatments (HAART) in HIV-infected patients remain a matter of debate world-wide because short-term benefits have to be balanced with costs of these therapies, and restrictions placed on future treatment options if resistant viral strains develop. On the other hand, postponing the introduction of HAART may involve a therapeutic opportunity cost if a patient's health is allowed to deteriorate to such an extent of becoming unable to benefit from new treatments currently under development when they become available. We introduce a two period model where period one treatment adoption is an irreversible act with future, but uncertain, consequences. New information, both endogenous and exogenous, arises over time and shapes the conditions surrounding the second period therapeutic decision. A surprising result is that, under conditions that appear close to those surrounding the HAART debate, the magnitude of the feared resistance effect has no effect on leaves the optimal treatment decision as far as it is high enough.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.09.006.abstractZh: 关于是否对HIV感染者开始使用高效抗逆转录病毒疗法（HAART）的标准，全球范围内仍存在争议。因为短期内的益处需要与这些疗法的成本进行权衡，同时还需要考虑如果出现耐药病毒株时对未来治疗选择的限制。另一方面，推迟HAART的引入可能会带来治疗机会成本，因为如果患者的健康状况恶化到无法从当前正在开发的新疗法中获益的程度，那么推迟引入HAART可能会带来损失。我们引入了一个双时期模型，其中第一个时期的接受治疗是一个不可逆的行为，其后果是未知的。随着时间的推移，新的信息，无论是内生的还是外生的，都会影响第二个时期的治疗决策。令人惊讶的是，在与HAART争议相关的条件下，所担心的耐药效应的大小并不会影响最佳治疗决策，只要这种疗法的效果足够高即可。

abstract.text: A model of contracting for hospital treatments is presented. For a given diagnosis of the patient, two treatments are available: a high-intensity (surgical) treatment and a low-intensity (medical) treatment. A purchaser (the National Health Service, public or private insurer) offers a contract to the provider (the hospital) to maximise the patients' benefit net of costs. We show that if the average severity of the patient is private information known only by the provider, the hospital has an incentive to over-provide the surgical treatment to the low-severity patients. The optimal contract with asymmetric information is such that hospitals that provide a higher share of surgical treatments receive a higher price for the surgical treatment and a lower price for the medical treatment. This situation differs from current remuneration systems in which the price for each type of treatment is uniform. A related result is that with asymmetric information the optimal contract involves a higher transfer than with symmetric information.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.09.007.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个关于医院治疗合同签订的模型。对于某一患者的诊断结果，有两种治疗选择：高强度治疗（手术）和低强度治疗（内科治疗）。购买方（如国家卫生服务系统、公共或私人保险公司）向提供方（医院）提供合同，以在扣除成本后最大化患者的收益。研究表明，如果患者的平均病情严重程度是仅由提供方知晓的私人信息，那么医院会有动机为病情较轻的患者提供更多的手术治疗。在信息不对称的情况下，最优合同安排是：提供较多手术治疗的医院可以获得更高的手术治疗价格，而内科治疗的价格则较低。这种情况与当前统一的报酬制度不同。另一个相关结果是，在信息不对称的情况下，最优合同涉及的转移支付金额比对称信息情况下更高。

abstract.text: Theoretical models of guaranteed renewable insurance display front-loaded premium schedules. Such schedules both cover lifetime total claims of low-risk and high-risk individuals and provide an incentive for those who remain low-risk to continue to purchase the policy. Questions have been raised of whether actual individual insurance markets in the US approximate the behavior predicted by these models, both because young consumers may not be able to "afford" front-loading and because insurers may behave strategically in ways that erode the value of protection against risk reclassification. In this paper, the optimal competitive age-based premium schedule for a benchmark guaranteed renewable health insurance policy is estimated using medical expenditure data. Several factors are shown to reduce the amount of front-loading necessary. Indeed, the resulting optimal premium path increases with age. Actual premium paths exhibited by purchasers of individual insurance are close to the optimal renewable schedule we estimate. Finally, consumer utility associated with the feature is examined.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.09.008.abstractZh: 理论模型显示，保证续保保险具有前置保费安排。这种安排既涵盖了低风险和高风险个体的终身总索赔，同时也激励了低风险群体继续购买保险。然而，人们质疑美国实际的个人保险市场是否真的符合这些模型预测的行为模式，一方面是因为年轻消费者可能“负担不起”前置保费，另一方面是因为保险公司可能会采取策略性行为，从而削弱风险重新分类带来的保障价值。本文利用医疗支出数据，估算了基准保证续保健康保险的最优竞争性年龄基准保费安排。研究表明，有几种因素可以减少前置保费的需求。实际上，最优保费路径随年龄增长而上升。实际个人保险购买者所呈现的保费路径与我们估算的最优续保安排较为接近。最后，本文还探讨了与这一特性相关的消费者效用。

abstract.text: Frankel and Romer [Frankel, J., Romer, D., 1999. Does trade cause growth? American Economic Review 89 (3), 379-399] documented positive effects of geographically determined trade openness on economic growth. At the same time, critics fear that openness can lead to a "race to the bottom" that increases pollution and reduces government resources for investments in health and education. We use Frankel and Romer's gravity model of trade to examine how openness to trade affects children. Overall, we find little harm from trade, and potential benefits largely through slightly faster GDP growth.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.10.001.abstractZh: Frankel和Romer在1999年的《美国经济评论》期刊上发表了研究，探讨了地理上确定的贸易开放程度对经济增长的积极影响。同时，批评者担心这种开放可能会导致“竞相降低标准”的现象，从而加剧污染问题，并减少政府在健康和教育方面的投资资源。我们利用Frankel和Romer提出的贸易引力模型来研究贸易开放程度对儿童的影响。总体而言，我们发现贸易带来的负面影响很小，其潜在益处主要体现在GDP增长略有加快上。

abstract.text: Quality reports about health plans and providers are becoming more prevalent in health care markets. This paper casts the decision about what information to report to consumers about health plans as a policy decision. In a market with adverse selection, complete information about quality leads to inefficient outcomes. In a Rothschild-Stiglitz model, we show that averaging quality information into a summary report can enforce pooling in health insurance, and by choice of the right weights in the averaged report, a payer or regulator can induce first-best quality choices. The optimal quality report is as powerful as optimal risk adjustment in correcting adverse selection inefficiencies.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.10.002.abstractZh: 关于健康计划和提供者的质量报告在医疗保健市场中越来越普遍。本文将消费者所需了解的健康计划信息选择问题视为一项政策决策。在存在逆向选择的市场中，完整的质量信息会导致效率低下。在Rothschild-Stiglitz模型中，我们表明将质量信息汇总到一份报告中，可以促进健康保险领域的资源整合；通过合理选择汇总报告中的权重，支付方或监管机构可以引导消费者做出最优质量选择。最优质量报告在纠正逆向选择带来的效率问题方面，与最优风险调整一样具有强大的作用。

abstract.text: In January 2004, a California law passed in 1999 became effective regulating minimum nurse to patient ratios in hospital units. This legislation was prompted by results from previous research showing higher adverse patient outcomes when hospital nurse/patient ratios are low. In this study, we use a census of hospital discharges in California over the 1996-2000 period to estimate the impact of hospital staff levels on adverse events by examining whether outcomes are correlated with the number of admissions in the hospital over the next 2 days. Because hospital staff levels are determined in advance, a large influx of patients to a hospital over the next 2 days will reduce the effective staff levels for patients admitted previously. We focus on the outcomes of patients admitted on Thursdays because hospital admissions are the most variable on Friday and Saturday and hospital staffs are lowest during the weekend. We find some evidence that large shocks to admissions on Friday and Saturday tend to reduce the length of stay and increase the chance of a subsequent readmission, but these coefficients are very small. We find quantitatively small and statistically insignificant effects of Friday and Saturday admission shocks on mortality rates of patients admitted on Thursdays. These results suggest that the portion of the California law designed to guarantee adequate staffing when the patient census increases unexpectedly should have little impact on patient outcomes.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.10.003.abstractZh: 2004年1月，加利福尼亚州于1999年通过的一项法律生效，规定了医院各科室中护士与患者的最低比例。这项立法是基于先前的研究结果，这些研究指出当医院护士与患者的比例较低时，患者的不良后果会更为严重。在这项研究中，我们利用了1996至2000年期间加利福尼亚州的医院出院数据，通过考察患者在接下来2天内的住院次数与不良事件之间的关系，来估算医院工作人员数量对不良事件的影响。由于医院工作人员数量是在事前确定的，因此在接下来2天内大量涌入的患者会减少对之前入院患者的有效工作人员数量。我们重点关注周四入院的患者，因为周五和周六的住院情况最为不稳定，而周末医院工作人员的数量最少。我们发现，周五和周六住院人数大幅波动往往会缩短住院时间，并增加患者再次住院的可能性，但这些影响都非常小。从数量上看，周五和周六住院人数波动对周四入院患者的死亡率影响很小，且在统计上也不显著。这些结果表明，加利福尼亚州法律中旨在确保在患者数量意外增加时能够提供足够工作人员的部分内容，对患者的结果影响应该不大。

abstract.text: Do urban hospital closures affect health care access or health outcomes? We study closures in Los Angeles County between 1997 and 2003, through their effect on distance to the nearest hospital. We find that increased distance to the closest hospital increases deaths from heart attacks and unintentional injuries. This finding is robust to several sensitivity checks. We also find that, for residents with health insurance, increased distance shifts regular care towards doctor's offices. While most residents are otherwise unaffected, we find some evidence that seniors perceive more difficulty accessing care.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.10.006.abstractZh: 城市医院的关闭是否会影响医疗保健的获取或健康结果？我们研究了1997年至2003年间洛杉矶县的医院关闭情况，以及这些关闭对居民到最近医院距离的影响。研究发现，距离最近医院的距离增加会导致心脏病发作和非故意伤害的死亡率上升。这一发现经过多次敏感性检验后依然成立。我们还发现，对于拥有健康保险的居民来说，距离的增加使得常规护理更多地转向医生诊所。虽然大多数居民并未受到直接影响，但我们发现一些证据表明，老年人觉得获取医疗服务更加困难。

abstract.text: The cost of violence goes beyond its material dimension, including also the welfare loss due to higher mortality. A given mortality, and its distribution across age groups, determines a reduction in life expectancy that can be valued using the marginal willingness to pay approach. We estimate the health dimension of the welfare cost of violence for 73 countries. On average, 1 year of life expectancy lost to violence is associated with a yearly social cost of 3.8% of GDP. The health dimension increases the estimated social costs of violence by 40% in the United States and by 57% in Latin America.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.10.007.abstractZh: 暴力的成本不仅仅体现在物质层面，还包括因死亡率上升而导致的福利损失。一定的死亡率及其在不同年龄组中的分布，会决定预期寿命的减少，而这种减少可以通过边际支付意愿的方法进行估算。我们对73个国家的暴力福利成本进行了健康层面的估算。平均而言，因暴力而损失的1年预期寿命，对应的社会成本相当于GDP的3.8%。在美国，暴力造成的健康损失使估计的社会成本增加了40%，在拉丁美洲则增加了57%。

abstract.text: The recent rise of specialty hospitals--typically for-profit firms that are at least partially owned by physicians--has led to substantial debate about their effects on the cost and quality of care. Advocates of specialty hospitals claim they improve quality and lower cost; critics contend they concentrate on providing profitable procedures and attracting relatively healthy patients, leaving (predominantly nonprofit) general hospitals with a less-remunerative, sicker patient population. We find support for both sides of this debate. Markets experiencing entry by a cardiac specialty hospital have lower spending for cardiac care without significantly worse clinical outcomes. In markets with a specialty hospital, however, specialty hospitals tend to attract healthier patients and provide higher levels of intensive procedures than general hospitals.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.11.001.abstractZh: 最近，专科医院的兴起——这些医院通常是由医生至少部分拥有的营利性机构——引发了关于其对医疗成本和质量影响的广泛讨论。支持者认为，专科医院能够提升医疗质量并降低费用；批评者则认为，这些医院专注于提供盈利性手术，并吸引相对健康的患者，导致（主要是非营利性的）综合医院面对的是病情更严重的患者，从而降低了收益。我们发现，这一争论双方的观点都有一定的依据。在引入专科医院的市场中，心脏疾病的医疗支出有所降低，但临床效果并未显著恶化。然而，在拥有专科医院的市场中，专科医院往往能够吸引更健康的患者，并提供比综合医院更高水平的重症治疗。

abstract.text: The length of hospital stay and effectiveness of medical treatment are analyzed using data of patients hospitalized due to hip fractures of four hospitals in Japan. The influence of the Revision of the Medical Service Fee Schedule in April, 2002, is evaluated, and factors which may have affected the length of stay and effectiveness of treatment (walking ability upon departure from the hospital) are also analyzed by a newly developed simultaneous equation model.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.11.002.abstractZh: 本研究利用日本四家医院因髋部骨折而住院患者的数据，分析了住院时间和医疗治疗效果。同时，评估了2002年4月医疗服务费用调整方案的影响，并通过新开发的联立方程模型，分析了可能影响住院时间和治疗效果的因素（即患者出院时的行走能力）。

abstract.text: In this paper, we investigate the meaning of "affordability" in the context of health insurance. Assessing the relationship between the affordability of coverage and the large number of uninsured in the U.S. is important for understanding the barriers to purchasing coverage and evaluating the role of policy in reducing the number of uninsured. We propose several definitions of affordability and examine the implications of alternative definitions for estimates of the proportion of uninsured who are unable to afford coverage. We find that, depending on the definition, health insurance was affordable to between one-quarter and three-quarters of the uninsured in the United States in 2000.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.11.003.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们探讨了在健康保险背景下“可负担性”的含义。评估保险可负担性与美国无保险人数之间的关系，对于理解购买保险所面临的障碍以及政策在减少无保险人数方面的作用至关重要。我们提出了几种关于可负担性的定义，并研究了不同定义对无保险人群无法负担保险比例的估计结果的影响。研究发现，根据定义的不同，2000年在美国，有四分之一到四分之三的无保险人群能够负担得起健康保险。

abstract.text: We examine the factors that lead employees to search for health plan quality information and the effect of such information on the decision to switch plans. Extending Hirshleifer and Riley's model [Hirshleifer, J., Riley, J.G., 1979. The analytics of uncertainty and information--an expositional survey. Journal of Economic Literature 17 (December (4)), 1375-1421] of the economics of information, we develop a two-equation model of quality information awareness and switching behavior. We estimate the model using data from a random sample of 651 single employees from 16 firms that are members of the Buyers Health Care Action Group, a health care purchasing coalition in the Minneapolis-St. Paul region. Our empirical results do not support either a link between quality information and switching behavior, or between perceived health plan satisfaction and switching. We do, however, find that switching is influenced by changes in premiums and whether an individual has an existing relationship with a health care provider.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.11.004.abstractZh: 我们研究了促使员工寻找健康计划质量信息的因素，以及这些信息对更换计划决策的影响。在扩展了Hirshleifer和Riley的信息经济学模型的基础上，我们建立了一个包含两个方程的模型，用于分析质量信息意识与更换行为之间的关系。我们使用来自16家公司的651名单身员工的数据来估计该模型，这些员工是 Minneapolis-St. Paul地区医疗保健采购联盟“Buyers Health Care Action Group”的成员。我们的实证结果并未支持质量信息与更换行为之间存在关联，也未发现感知到的健康计划满意度与更换行为之间存在关联。不过，我们发现更换行为确实受到保费变化以及个人是否已有与医疗保健提供商的合作关系的影响。

abstract.text: Over the last decade, there has been a growing interest in examining health expenditures. In this paper, we study the behaviour of health expenditures in the G3 countries (USA, the UK, and Japan) and three European countries (the UK, Switzerland and Spain) over the period 1960-2000 from a different perspective, in that we examine: (1) whether there is a common structural break in health expenditures across the G3 and European countries; (2) whether structural breaks have slowed down health expenditure growth rates in these countries or vice versa. Our main findings are that: (1) health expenditures share a common break in both bivariate and trivariate cases, and structural breaks and break intervals suggest that either one or a combination of events (second oil price shock, the 1987 stock market crash and/or recessions) have contributed to the commonality of break in health expenditures in the G3, while the oil price shocks have been instrumental in the commonality of breaks for the European countries; (2) except for the UK, structural breaks have slowed down growth rates in health expenditures for the USA, Japan, Switzerland and Spain.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.12.001.abstractZh: 在过去十年中，对医疗支出的研究越来越受到关注。本文从不同的角度研究了1960至2000年间G3国家（美国、英国和日本）以及三个欧洲国家（英国、瑞士和西班牙）的医疗支出情况。我们考察了以下几点：(1) G3国家和欧洲国家的医疗支出是否存在共同的结构性变化；(2) 这些国家的医疗支出增长率是否因结构性变化而放缓，或者相反。我们的主要发现是：(1) 在双变量和三变量分析中，G3国家和欧洲国家的医疗支出都存在共同的结构性变化。结构性变化及其发生的时间段表明，单一事件或多种事件的结合（如第二次油价冲击、1987年股市崩盘和/或经济衰退）导致了G3国家医疗支出的共同性变化，而油价冲击在欧洲国家的这种共同性变化中起到了关键作用；(2) 除了英国外，美国、日本、瑞士和西班牙的医疗支出增长率因结构性变化而放缓。

abstract.text: This paper analyses hospitals' decisions regarding the supply of elective surgery in a dynamic model in the presence of waiting times and waiting lists. We show that periods of increasing (decreasing) supply and increasing (decreasing) waiting list may be optimal paths towards the steady state. We also analyse the hospitals' response to exogenous shocks on the demand and the supply. For example, an increase in the marginal tariff for the provider generates overshooting in the supply: supply jumps upwards when the shock is introduced and then slowly reduces towards the steady-state value.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.12.002.abstractZh: 本文在一个动态模型中分析了医院在存在等待时间和等待名单的情况下，关于选择性手术供应的决策。我们指出，供应增加（减少）以及等待名单增加（减少）可能是达到稳态的最优路径。我们还分析了医院对需求和供应方面外部冲击的响应。例如，提供者边际关税的增加会导致供应出现过度反应：在冲击出现时供应会迅速上升，随后会缓慢下降至稳态值。

abstract.text: A central theme in the international debate on genetic testing concerns the extent to which insurance companies should be allowed to use genetic information when offering insurance contracts. We provide a welfare analysis of this issue within a model of an insurance market with asymmetric information, having the following crucial feature: in addition to a state-contingent consumption profile, a person's well-being depends on her attitude towards resolution of future health uncertainty, and this attitude varies across the population. We present stylized facts that motivate this approach. In the formal analysis, we find that both tested high-risks and untested individuals are equally well off whether or not test results can be used by insurers. Individuals who test for being low-risks, on the other hand, are made worse off by not being able to verify this to insurers. This implies that, in terms of welfare, a regulatory regime in which the use of genetic information by insurers is allowed is better than one in which it is not allowed.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.12.003.abstractZh: 在国际关于基因检测的辩论中，一个核心问题是保险公司在提供保险合同时应被允许使用何种程度的基因信息。我们在一个信息不对称条件下的保险市场模型中对这一问题进行了福利分析，该模型具有一个关键特征：除了基于状态的条件消费特征外，一个人的福祉还取决于其对未来健康不确定性解决方案的态度，而这种态度在不同人群中有所不同。我们提出了一些典型事实来支撑这一分析方法。在形式化分析中，我们发现，无论检测结果能否被保险公司使用，那些高风险个体和未检测个体在福利上都是相当不错的。而那些被检测为低风险个体，由于无法向保险公司证明自己的低风险状态，其福利反而会下降。这意味着，从福利的角度来看，允许保险公司使用基因信息的监管制度比不允许使用的制度更为理想。

abstract.text: The Wisconsin BadgerCare program, which became operational in July 1999, expanded public health insurance eligibility to both parents and children in families with incomes below 185% of the U.S. poverty line (200% for those already enrolled). This eligibility expansion was part of a federal initiative known as the State Children's Health Insurance Program (SCHIP). Wisconsin was one of only four states that initially expanded coverage to parents of eligible children. In this paper, we attempt to answer the following question: To what extent does a public program with the characteristics of Wisconsin's BadgerCare program reduce the proportion of the low-income adult population without health care coverage? Using a coordinated set of administrative databases, we track three cohorts of mother-only families: those who were receiving cash assistance under the Wisconsin AFDC and TANF programs in September 1995, 1997, and 1999, and who subsequently left welfare. We follow these 19,201 "welfare leaver" families on a quarterly basis for up to 25 quarters, from 2 years before they left welfare through the end of 2001, making it possible to use the labor market information and welfare history of the women in analyzing outcomes. We apply multiple methods to address the policy evaluation question, including probit, random effects, and two difference-in-difference strategies, and compare the results across methods. All of our estimates indicate that BadgerCare substantially increased public health care coverage for mother-only families leaving welfare. Our best estimate is that BadgerCare increased the public health care coverage of all adult leavers by about 17-25% points.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.12.005.abstractZh: 威斯康星州BadgerCare计划于1999年7月开始实施，该计划将公共健康保险资格扩展至收入低于美国贫困线185%的家庭中的父母和子女（已参保者则为200%）。这一资格扩展是联邦“州儿童健康保险计划”（SCHIP）倡议的一部分。威斯康星州是最初将保险范围扩展至符合条件的儿童父母的四个州之一。在本文中，我们试图回答以下问题：具有威斯康星州BadgerCare计划特征的公共计划在多大程度上减少了没有健康保险的低收入成年人口比例？通过协调一系列行政数据库，我们追踪了三个仅由母亲组成的家庭群体：1995年、1997年和1999年9月时正在接受威斯康星州AFDC和TANF计划现金援助，并随后脱离福利制度的家庭。我们对这19,201个“脱离福利”的家庭进行了为期25个季度的季度跟踪调查，时间跨度从他们脱离福利前两年一直持续到2001年底，从而能够利用劳动力市场和女性福利历史数据来分析结果。我们采用了多种方法来评估这一政策效果，包括Probit模型、随机效应模型以及两种差异-差异策略，并比较了不同方法的结果。所有估计结果均表明，BadgerCare计划显著增加了仅由母亲组成的家庭脱离福利后的公共健康保险覆盖率。我们的最佳估计是，BadgerCare计划使所有脱离福利的成年人的公共健康保险覆盖率增加了约17-25个百分点。

abstract.text: The hospital sector in the Province of Ontario has recently completed a large scale restructuring marked by wide ranging hospital closures, mergers and program transfers. Given a generally inconclusive economics literature, regulators used an accounting, as opposed to an economic, approach when predicting gains to consolidations. This paper uses an economic cost function to examine economies of scale and scope in the years preceding restructuring, where there was little doubt that economies were possible. Issues relating to output aggregation, functional form, and scale and scope testing are addressed and an equilibrium cost function is derived from an estimated short run function to measure the cost concepts of interest. Using index and direct approaches, we examine a variety of potential reconfigurations and conclude that there were indeed large scale unexploited gains to strategic consolidation in the hospital sector. Furthermore, these gains may not have been detected using standard approaches in the literature.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.12.006.abstractZh: 安大略省的医院行业最近完成了一次大规模重组，其中包括大量医院的关闭、合并以及业务转移。由于经济学文献普遍缺乏定论，监管机构在预测合并带来的收益时采用了会计方法而非经济学方法。本文利用经济成本函数来研究重组前几年出现的规模经济和范围经济现象，当时人们普遍认为这些经济效应是可行的。文章还探讨了与产出汇总、函数形式以及规模与范围相关的议题，并从估计的短期函数推导出均衡成本函数，以衡量相关成本概念。通过指数法和直接法，我们研究了多种潜在的重组方案，并得出结论：医院行业中的战略整合确实存在大量未被充分利用的潜在收益。此外，这些收益可能不会被文献中的标准方法所发现。

abstract.text: People distrust managed care organizations (MCOs) more than traditional health plans. This phenomenon has become known as "managed-care backlash." Using a model of the interaction between insurers, physicians, and patients, this paper identifies two possible motivations for MCO backlash. The first, which comes from traditional health plans' superior ability to credibly commit to providing better than least-cost care, is efficiency promoting. The second, which arises when patients are able to obtain higher-benefit treatments through reneging on their initial insurance contracts through "doctor shopping," may reduce efficiency.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2005.12.007.abstractZh: 人们对比传统健康计划更不信任管理式护理组织。这种现象被称为“管理式护理的反动”。本文通过保险公司、医生与患者之间的互动模型，提出了两种可能导致管理式护理反动的动机。第一种动机源于传统健康计划在提供优于最低成本护理方面的卓越能力，这种动机有助于提高效率。第二种动机则源于患者通过“医生咨询”的方式，在违背初始保险合同的情况下获得更高价值的医疗服务，这种动机可能会降低效率。

abstract.text: This paper reports the results of a study that used discrete choice experiment (DCE) methodology to estimate quality weights for a of social care outcome measure. To reflect different states of need, a five-dimensional profile measure was developed. Experimental design techniques were used to derive a sample of states for which preferences were elicited. The DCE approach was employed to elicit values and regression techniques used to estimate a model that could predict index scores for all 243 possible outcomes. The utility model, estimated on the basis of 297 responses, had good test-retest reliability and converged with preferences elicited from a rating exercise.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.01.001.abstractZh: 本文报告了一项研究的结果，该研究采用离散选择实验方法，用于估算一项社会护理结果指标的质量权重。为了反映不同的需求状态，研究人员开发了一个五维的评估指标。通过实验设计技术，选取了若干状态进行偏好调查。离散选择实验方法被用于获取数值数据，而回归技术则被用来构建模型，以预测所有243种可能结果的指标得分。基于297份回复数据估算的效用模型具有良好的重测信度，并且与通过评分活动获得的偏好数据高度一致。

abstract.text: The empirical literature on the measurement of health inequalities is vast and rapidly expanding. To date, however, no foundation in welfare economics exists for the proposed measures of health inequality. This paper provides such a foundation for commonly used measures like the health concentration index, the Gini index, and the extended concentration index. Our results indicate that these measures require assumptions that appear restrictive. One way forward may be the development of multi-dimensional extensions.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.01.002.abstractZh: 关于健康不平等测量的实证文献非常丰富且正在迅速扩展。然而，迄今为止，还没有基于福利经济学的健康不平等测量方法。本文为常用的健康不平等测量指标，如健康集中度指数、基尼指数和扩展集中度指数，提供了这样的理论基础。我们的研究结果表明，这些测量方法需要一些看似限制性的假设。一种可行的改进方向可能是开发多维扩展的衡量方法。

abstract.text: In the U.S., Great Britain and in many other countries, the gap between the demand and the supply of human organs for transplantation is on the rise, despite the efforts of governments and health agencies to promote donor registration. In some countries of continental Europe, however, cadaveric organ procurement is based on the principle of presumed consent. Under presumed consent legislation, a deceased individual is classified as a potential donor in absence of explicit opposition to donation before death. This article analyzes the impact of presumed consent laws on donation rates. For this purpose, we construct a dataset on organ donation rates and potential factors affecting organ donation for 22 countries over a 10-year period. We find that while differences in other determinants of organ donation explain much of the variation in donation rates, after controlling for those determinants presumed consent legislation has a positive and sizeable effect on organ donation rates. We use the panel structure of our dataset to test and reject the hypothesis that unmeasured determinants of organ donation rates confound our empirical results.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.01.003.abstractZh: 在美国、英国以及许多其他国家，尽管政府和卫生机构努力推动器官捐赠登记，但用于移植的人类器官的需求与供应之间的差距仍在扩大。然而，在欧洲大陆的一些国家，尸体器官获取是基于“推定同意”原则进行的。根据“推定同意”法律，在死亡者生前未明确表示反对捐赠的情况下，该个体被归类为潜在捐赠者。本文分析了“推定同意”法律对捐赠率的影响。为此，我们构建了一个包含22个国家在10年期间的器官捐赠率及相关影响因素的数据集。研究发现，虽然其他影响器官捐赠的因素解释了捐赠率差异的很大一部分，但在控制这些因素后，“推定同意”法律对器官捐赠率有积极且显著的影响。我们利用数据集的面板结构来检验并排除那些未测量到的器官捐赠率影响因素对我们实证结果的干扰。

abstract.text: This paper presents a study to estimate a preference-based participation index from the Dutch London Handicap Scale (LHS) classification system that can be applied to past or future Dutch LHS data sets. A subset of 60 states were valued by a representative sample of 285 respondents of the Dutch general adult population. Different models were estimated for predicting health state valuations for all 46,656 states defined by the LHS. Several criteria were used for comparison of the different models and for arguing which one is the most preferred model to use. Our data showed that using the English index would give systematic errors for the Dutch population preferences.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.01.004.abstractZh: 本文提出了一项研究，旨在利用荷兰伦敦 handicap 量表（LHS）分类系统来估算基于偏好的参与指数，该系统可应用于过去的或未来的荷兰 LHS 数据集。研究选取了 60 个州作为样本，由 285 名荷兰普通成年人口的受访者进行评估。针对 LHS 所定义的 46,656 个州，研究人员分别建立了不同的模型来预测其健康状况的估值。在比较不同模型时，采用了多种标准来确定最值得使用的模型。我们的数据显示，使用英语指数会导致荷兰人口偏好评估出现系统性误差。

abstract.text: Paying insurers risk-adjusted prices for covering different individuals can correct selection incentives and induce the market to provide optimal insurance policies. To calculate the optimal risk-adjusted prices we need to know (a) what the optimal policies are; (b) how much they cost; and (c) how competitive the market is. We examine these issues in a model with spatial heterogeneity and adverse selection. Market equilibrium is characterized, and delivery of the socially optimal insurance policies is possible, as long as providers are paid risk-adjusted fees for each individual they serve. When the payment can be made on the basis of an individual's risk, it should be sufficient to cover the expected cost of the socially optimal policy for that person, plus a mark-up. If payments can be made only on the basis of a partially informative signal, the optimal risk-based payments should be adjusted according to a simple linear transformation, identified by Glazer and McGuire [Glazer, J., McGuire, T., 2000. Optimal risk adjustment of health insurance premiums: an application to managed care.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.01.005.abstractZh: 向保险公司支付风险调整后的费用，以覆盖不同的个体，可以纠正选择激励，并促使市场提供最优的保险政策。要计算最优的风险调整费用，我们需要了解：(a) 最优的政策是什么；(b) 这些政策的成本是多少；(c) 市场的竞争程度如何。我们在一个具有空间异质性和逆向选择的模型中研究了这些问题。只要提供者根据为每个个体服务所获得的风险调整费用来支付费用，市场均衡就能实现，从而提供社会最优的保险政策。如果支付可以基于个体的风险来进行，那么支付金额应该足以覆盖该个体社会最优政策的预期成本，再加上一定的利润。如果支付只能基于部分信息化的信号来进行，那么基于风险的支付应该通过简单的线性变换来调整，这一变换由Glazer和McGuire在2000年的研究确定。

abstract.text: Differences in the mean, spread and skewness of cost data collected from different countries present problems for analysis and interpretation. Here we develop generalised linear multilevel models to estimate the effects of patient and national characteristics on costs. Using gamma distributions and multiplicative effects for patient characteristics fitted the data better than models which assumed normal distributions or estimated additive effects. A multilevel gamma model is employed to allow for heterogeneity in the effects of patient case-mix across centres. Analysis of multinational cost data must recognise differences in mean, spread and skewness across centres, as well as the data's hierarchical structure.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.02.001.abstractZh: 来自不同国家的成本数据在均值、分布范围和偏度方面的差异给分析和解释带来了问题。在这里，我们开发了广义线性多层模型来估计患者特征和国家特征对成本的影响。使用伽马分布和患者特征的乘法效应，能够比假设正态分布或估计加法效应的模型更好地拟合数据。采用多层伽马模型可以考虑到不同中心之间患者病例组合效应的异质性。对跨国成本数据的分析必须认识到不同中心在均值、分布范围和偏度方面的差异，以及数据的层次结构。

abstract.text: We use nine waves of BHPS data to examine interactions between spouses in terms of a behaviour with important health repercussions: cigarette smoking. Correlation between partners' behaviours may be due to correlated effects, as a consequence of matching or information revealed by others' behaviours, or to endogenous effects generated by bargaining within marriage. A simple bivariate probit reveals a positive correlation between own current smoking and partner's past smoking, which is consistent with endogenous effects. However, after controlling for individual effects, we find that own current smoking and partner's past smoking are statistically independent: all of the correlation in smoking status works through the correlation in individual effects. As such the correlation in the raw smoking data is consistent with positive assortative matching in marriage over smoking, rather than bargaining within the couple or social learning.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.02.002.abstractZh: 我们使用九波BHPS数据来研究配偶之间的互动，特别是与重要健康后果相关的行为：吸烟。伴侣行为之间的相关性可能是由于匹配效应或他人行为所揭示的信息导致的，也可能是由于婚姻内部讨价还价产生的内生效应所致。简单的双变量Probit分析显示，当前吸烟状况与伴侣过去的吸烟状况之间存在正相关关系，这与内生效应是一致的。然而，在控制了个体效应后，我们发现当前吸烟状况与伴侣过去的吸烟状况在统计上是独立的：所有吸烟状况上的相关性都通过个体效应中的相关性体现出来。因此，原始吸烟数据中的相关性与婚姻中的正选择匹配有关，而不是夫妻之间的讨价还价或社会学习。

abstract.text: This paper examines the relationship between relative income and mortality. Our research is motivated by recent literature that posits that, holding individual income fixed, those whose income are low relative to the incomes of those in a reference group will have worse health. We develop an empirical model in which an individual's health is a function of his or her own income and the incomes of those who live in the same geographical area. We show how this individual-level model can be estimated using semi-aggregated data on the mortality rates of people categorized by age, race, gender, and place of residence. The model is estimated using mortality data from the 1980 and 1990 Compressed Mortality Files, merged with income data from the 1980 and 1990 5% Public Use samples of the US Census. We find no evidence that having relatively wealthy neighbors, holding own income fixed, is associated with higher mortality. Instead, we find evidence that among some demographic and age groups--in particular working-aged black males--having relatively wealthy neighbors is associated with lower mortality. For example, among younger (aged 25-64) black men, an increase in the income of others is estimated to have a beneficial effect on mortality that is 40% as large as an equivalent increase in own income.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.02.003.abstractZh: 本文探讨了相对收入与死亡率之间的关系。我们的研究基于近期文献的观点，即在不改变个人收入的情况下，相对于参照群体而言收入较低的人健康状况会较差。我们建立了一个实证模型，该模型认为个人的健康状况取决于其自身收入以及同一地理区域内其他人的收入。我们展示了如何利用按年龄、种族、性别和居住地点分类的人口死亡率数据来估算这一个体层面的模型。该模型基于1980年和1990年的压缩死亡文件中的死亡数据，并结合了1980年和1990年美国人口普查5%公共使用样本中的收入数据进行估算。我们发现，在固定自身收入的情况下，拥有相对富裕的邻居并不会导致更高的死亡率。相反，我们发现在某些人口年龄组和特定人群——尤其是工作年龄的黑人男性——中，拥有相对富裕的邻居与较低的死亡率相关。例如，在较年轻的黑人男性中（25-64岁），其他人收入的增加对死亡率的降低效果相当于自身收入增加40%。

abstract.text: One in five U.S. youngsters has a mental disorder, but we know little about the effects of these disorders on child outcomes. We examine U.S. and Canadian children with symptoms of Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD), the most common child mental health problem. Our innovations include the use of nationally representative samples of children, the use of questions administered to all children rather than focusing only on diagnosed cases, and the use of sibling fixed effects to control for omitted variables. We find large negative effects on test scores and schooling attainment suggesting that mental health conditions are a more important determinant of average outcomes than physical health conditions.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.03.001.abstractZh: 在美国，每五个年轻人中就有一个患有精神障碍，但我们对这些疾病对儿童成长的影响知之甚少。我们研究了美国和加拿大患有注意力缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）的儿童的情况，这是最常见的儿童心理健康问题。我们的研究创新点包括使用具有全国代表性的儿童样本、对所有儿童进行问卷调查而非仅关注被诊断出的病例，以及利用兄弟姐妹固定效应来控制遗漏变量。我们发现，这些疾病对测试成绩和学业成就有显著的负面影响，这表明心理健康状况对平均结果的影響比身体健康状况更为重要。

abstract.text: Empirical evidence shows that in recessions the rate of workplace accidents goes down. This paper presents a theory and an empirical investigation to explain this phenomenon. The theory is based on the idea that reporting an accident affects the reputation of a worker and raises the probability that he is fired. If the unemployment rate is high, a worker faces a big loss when fired and fewer workplace accidents are reported. The empirical investigation concerns workplace accidents in 16 OECD countries. We conclude that cyclical fluctuations in workplace accident rates have to do with reporting behavior of workers and not with changes in workplace safety.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.03.002.abstractZh: 实证证据表明，在经济衰退期间，工作场所的事故率会下降。本文提出了一个理论以及一项实证研究来解释这一现象。该理论基于这样一个观点：报告事故会影响工人的声誉，并增加被解雇的可能性。如果失业率较高，工人被解雇时面临的损失较大，因此报告事故的情况也会减少。实证研究涉及16个经合组织国家的工作场所事故情况。我们得出结论，工作场所事故率的周期性波动与工人的报告行为有关，而非工作场所安全状况的变化所致。

abstract.text: We show that when health care providers have market power and engage in Cournot competition, a competitive upstream health insurance market results in over-insurance and over-priced health care. Even though consumers and firms anticipate the price interactions between these two markets - the price set in one market affects the demand expressed in the other - Pareto improvements are possible. The results suggest a beneficial role for Government intervention, either in the insurance or the health care market.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.03.003.abstractZh: 我们指出，当医疗服务提供者具有市场力量并参与库尔诺竞争时，竞争性上游保险市场会导致过度保险和过高的医疗服务价格。尽管消费者和企业都预期这两个市场之间的价格互动——一个市场设定的价格会影响另一个市场的需求——但帕累托改进仍然是可能的。研究结果表明，政府在保险或医疗服务市场中的干预具有积极意义。

abstract.text: This paper analyses the impact of economic conditions and access to primary health care on health outcomes in Norway. Total mortality rates, grouped into four causes of death, were used as proxies for health, and the number of general practitioners (GPs) at the municipality level was used as the proxy for access to primary health care. Dynamic panel data models that allow for time persistence in mortality rates, incorporate municipal fixed effects, and treat both the number and types of GPs in a district as endogenous were estimated using municipality data from 1986 to 2001. We reject the significant relationship between mortality and the number of GPs per capita found in most previous studies. However, there is a significant effect of the composition of GPs, where an increase in the number of contracted GPs reduces mortality rates when compared with GPs employed directly by the municipality.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.04.001.abstractZh: 本文分析了经济状况和初级医疗保健获取情况对挪威健康结果的影响。以四类死亡原因的总死亡率作为健康指标的替代，以市镇级别的全科医生数量作为初级医疗保健获取情况的替代指标。使用1986至2001年的市镇数据，通过动态面板数据模型来估计死亡率的时间持续性，并纳入市镇固定效应，同时将某一地区的全科医生数量和类型视为内生变量。我们否定了大多数先前研究中发现的死亡率与人均全科医生数量之间存在显著关系的结论。然而，全科医生的构成确实具有显著影响：与由市镇直接雇用的全科医生相比，增加签约全科医生的数量能够降低死亡率。

abstract.text: Recent research indicates that 3 million children leave Medicaid or the Children's Health Insurance Program (CHIP) each year and become uninsured, despite continuing eligibility. This paper explores the effect of family coverage on drop-out among children in these two programs, using instrumental variables to address the endogeneity of parental and sibling coverage in Medicaid/CHIP. Using the Current Population Survey March Supplement (1999-2004), I find that having a parent (primarily a mother) or sibling in public insurance is associated with a significantly lower risk of drop-out; after instrumenting with parental and sibling eligibility, only parental coverage remains a significant predictor of retention. I conclude that policy attempts to expand health insurance to the 8.5 million uninsured children in the U.S. would be much more effective if they covered parents and children in the same program.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.04.003.abstractZh: 近期的研究表明，每年有300万儿童离开医疗补助计划或儿童健康保险计划，成为无保险者，尽管他们仍然具有参保资格。本文通过工具变量分析，探讨了家庭保险覆盖对这两个计划中儿童辍学率的影响，以解决父母和兄弟姐妹在医疗补助/儿童健康保险计划中的参保资格的内生性问题。利用1999-2004年的人口普查数据，我发现，有父母（主要是母亲）或兄弟姐妹在公共保险计划中参保，与辍学风险显著降低有关；在纳入父母和兄弟姐妹的参保资格后，只有父母的参保资格仍然是预测儿童保留参保资格的重要因素。因此，如果政策能够同时覆盖父母和子女，那么将健康保险扩展到美国850万无保险儿童的目标将更为有效。

abstract.text: The received model for optimal demand-side cost sharing trades off moral hazard and risk avoidance. This model appears to lie behind recent increases in initial cost sharing, such as those embodied in Health Savings Accounts and Health Reimbursement Accounts. At the same time there is evidence that lower cost sharing for certain drugs can reduce future total health care costs and/or improve future health, and this may be true of other medical services as well. To the degree that individuals remain in the same common insurance pool, lower cost sharing that induces increases in certain services that reduce total costs, including future costs, represents a classic case for a subsidy and will minimize an employer's labor costs. Even if total costs increase, the value of a change in health could increase more. In that case such a subsidy is consistent with recent work in behavioral economics for those with self-control problems.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2006.06.003.abstractZh: 现有的最优需求侧成本分担模型在降低道德风险与规避风险之间进行了权衡。这一模型似乎是近期初始成本分担增加的原因，例如健康储蓄账户和健康报销账户中的做法。同时，有证据表明，对某些药物的较低成本分担可以降低未来的总医疗成本，并/或改善未来的健康状况，这一点可能也适用于其他医疗服务。只要个体仍然处于同一共同保险池中，较低的成本分担会促使增加某些能够降低总成本的医疗服务，包括未来的成本，这代表了补贴的一个典型案例，并且会最小化雇主的劳动力成本。即使总成本有所增加，健康状况的改善所带来的价值也可能更大。在这种情况下，这种补贴与行为经济学领域针对那些存在自我控制问题的人群的研究是一致的。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: Catheter-related bloodstream infections occurring in the intensive care unit (ICU) are common, costly, and potentially lethal. METHODS: We conducted a collaborative cohort study predominantly in ICUs in Michigan. An evidence-based intervention was used to reduce the incidence of catheter-related bloodstream infections. Multilevel Poisson regression modeling was used to compare infection rates before, during, and up to 18 months after implementation of the study intervention. Rates of infection per 1000 catheter-days were measured at 3-month intervals, according to the guidelines of the National Nosocomial Infections Surveillance System. RESULTS: A total of 108 ICUs agreed to participate in the study, and 103 reported data. The analysis included 1981 ICU-months of data and 375,757 catheter-days. The median rate of catheter-related bloodstream infection per 1000 catheter-days decreased from 2.7 infections at baseline to 0 at 3 months after implementation of the study intervention (P< or =0.002), and the mean rate per 1000 catheter-days decreased from 7.7 at baseline to 1.4 at 16 to 18 months of follow-up (P<0.002). The regression model showed a significant decrease in infection rates from baseline, with incidence-rate ratios continuously decreasing from 0.62 (95% confidence interval [CI], 0.47 to 0.81) at 0 to 3 months after implementation of the intervention to 0.34 (95% CI, 0.23 to 0.50) at 16 to 18 months. CONCLUSIONS: An evidence-based intervention resulted in a large and sustained reduction (up to 66%) in rates of catheter-related bloodstream infection that was maintained throughout the 18-month study period.

10.1056/nejmoa061115.abstractZh: 背景：在重症监护病房发生的导管相关血流感染既常见又昂贵，且可能致命。方法：我们在密歇根州的重症监护病房进行了合作队列研究。采用基于证据的干预措施来降低导管相关血流感染的发生率。使用多层泊松回归模型来比较研究干预实施前、实施期间以及实施后18个月内的感染率。根据国家院内感染监测系统的指南，以3个月为间隔测量每1000导管日的感染率。结果：共有108个重症监护病房同意参与研究，其中103个报告了数据。分析包括1981个重症监护病房月的数据和375,757个导管日。实施研究干预后3个月，每1000导管日的导管相关血流感染率从2.7例降至0例（P<或=0.002），而在16至18个月的随访期间，每1000导管日的平均感染率从7.7例降至1.4例（P<0.002）。回归模型显示，感染率从基线水平显著下降，从实施干预后0至3个月的0.62（95%置信区间[CI]，0.47至0.81）持续降至16至18个月的0.34（95% CI，0.23至0.50）。结论：基于证据的干预措施使得导管相关血流感染的发生率大幅且持续降低（最高达66%），这一效果在18个月的研究期间得以维持。

abstract.text: The debate about public report cards for physicians and hospitals never seems to end.1 Some praise report cards for their role in improving the quality of care, patient safety, and the choices of patients, referring physicians, and organizations that purchase health care. Others argue that such reports can have negative consequences — for example, if physicians or hospitals, in order to protect their rankings, avoid performing surgery on severely ill patients for whom surgical treatment might otherwise be recommended. Nonetheless, more and more data are being collected and released, although policies regarding the public availability of information vary widely. Thirty-seven . . .

10.1056/nejmp068222.abstractZh: 关于医生和医院的公共成绩单的争论似乎永无止境。一些人称赞成绩单在提高护理质量、患者安全以及患者、转诊医生及购买医疗服务的机构的选择方面发挥了作用。另一些人则认为，这类报告可能带来负面后果——例如，为了维护自己的排名，医生或医院可能会避免为病情严重的患者实施手术，而这些患者本应接受手术治疗。尽管如此，越来越多的数据正在被收集和发布，不过关于信息公开的政策差异很大。三十七……

abstract.text: This paper proposes and estimates a static transferable utility model of the marriage market. The model generates a nonparametric marriage matching function with spillover effects. It rationalizes the standard interpretation of marriage rate regressions and points out its limitations. The model was used to estimate U.S. marital behavior in 1971/72 and 1981/82. The marriage matching function estimates show that the gains to marriage for young adults fell substantially over the decade. Unlike contradictory marriage rate regression results, the marriage matching function estimates showed that the legalization of abortion had a significant quantitative impact on the fall in the gains to marriage for young men and women.

10.1086/498585.abstractZh: 本文提出并估计了一个静态的可转移效用模型，用于描述婚姻市场。该模型生成了一个具有溢出效应的非参数婚姻匹配函数。文章对婚姻率回归的标准解释进行了理性分析，并指出了其局限性。该模型被用于估算1971/72年和1981/82年的美国婚姻行为。婚姻匹配函数的估算结果显示，年轻人在这一十年间从婚姻中获得的收益显著下降。与矛盾性的婚姻率回归结果不同，婚姻匹配函数的估算表明，堕胎合法化对年轻男女从婚姻中获得的收益下降产生了显著的量化影响。

abstract.text: The role of the market in mitigating and mediating various forms of behavior is perhaps the central issue facing behavioral economics today. This study designs a field experiment that is explicitly linked to a controlled laboratory experiment to examine whether, and to what extent, social preferences influence outcomes in actual market transactions. While agents drawn from a well-functioning marketplace behave in accord with social preference models in tightly controlled laboratory experiments, when they are observed in their naturally occurring settings, their behavior approaches what is predicted by self-interest theory. In the limit, much of the observed behavior in the marketplace that is consistent with social preferences is due to reputational concerns: suppliers who expect to have future interactions with buyers provide higher product quality only when the buyer can verify quality via a third-party certifier. The data also speak to theories of how reputation effects enhance market performance. In particular, reputation and the monitoring of quality are found to be complements, and findings suggest that the private market can solve the lemons problem through third-party verification.

10.1086/498587.abstractZh: 市场在缓解和调节各种行为中的作用，或许是当今行为经济学面临的核心问题。本研究设计了一项实地实验，该实验与一项受控实验室实验紧密关联，旨在探讨社会偏好是否以及在多大程度上影响实际市场交易的结果。虽然来自运作良好的市场的参与者在受控实验室实验中表现出符合社会偏好模式的行为，但在自然环境中观察时，他们的行为则更接近自利理论所预测的结果。在极限情况下，市场中许多符合社会偏好的行为是由于声誉问题导致的：那些期望未来与买家进行互动的供应商，只有在买家能够通过第三方认证机构验证产品质量时，才会提供更高品质的产品。数据还支持了关于声誉如何影响市场绩效的理论。具体而言，声誉与质量监控被认为是互补的，研究结果表明，私人市场可以通过第三方验证来解决“柠檬问题”。

abstract.text: We present and estimate a model in which the choice between entrepreneurship and wage work may be influenced by financial market imperfections. The model allows for limited liability, moral hazard, and a combination of both constraints. The paper uses structural techniques to estimate the model and identify the source of financial market imperfections using data from rural and semiurban households in Thailand. Structural, nonparametric, and reduced-form estimates provide independent evidence that the dominant source of credit market imperfections is moral hazard. We reject the hypothesis that limited liability alone can explain the data.

10.1086/498917.abstractZh: 我们提出并估计了一个模型，该模型认为在创业与工资工作之间的选择可能会受到金融市场不完善因素的影响。该模型考虑了有限责任、道德风险以及这两种约束的结合。本文采用结构分析技术来估计模型，并利用泰国农村和半城市家庭的数据来确定金融市场不完善的根源。结构分析、非参数分析和简化形式的估计结果均表明，信贷市场不完善的主要根源是道德风险。我们否定了仅依靠有限责任就能解释数据的假设。

abstract.text: This paper considers the costs of reducing consumption of a good by making its production illegal and punishing apprehended illegal producers. We use illegal drugs as a prominent example. We show that the more inelastic either demand for or supply of a good is, the greater the increase in social cost from further reducing its production by greater enforcement efforts. So optimal public expenditures on apprehension and conviction of illegal suppliers depend not only on the difference between the social and private values from consumption but also on these elasticities. When demand and supply are not too elastic, it does not pay to enforce any prohibition unless the social value is negative. We also show that a monetary tax could cause a greater reduction in output and increase in price than optimal enforcement against the same good would if it were illegal, even though some producers may go underground to avoid a monetary tax. When enforcement is costly, excise taxes and quantity restrictions are not equivalent.

10.1086/498918.abstractZh: 本文探讨了通过使某种商品的生产变得非法以及惩罚被抓获的非法生产者来减少该商品消费的成本。我们以非法药物为例进行说明。研究表明，某种商品的需求或供应越缺乏弹性，通过加强执法力度进一步减少其生产所带来的社会成本就越高。因此，对非法供应商进行逮捕和定罪所需的公共支出不仅取决于消费的社会价值与私人价值之间的差距，还取决于这些弹性系数。当需求和供应都不太具有弹性时，除非社会价值为负，否则实施禁令是没有意义的。我们还发现，与对相同商品实施最优执法相比，征收货币税可能会导致更大的产量减少和价格上升，尽管一些生产者可能会通过地下活动来规避货币税。当执法成本较高时，消费税和数量限制并不具有同等效果。

abstract.text: A Bayesian consumer who is uncertain about the quality of an information source will infer that the source is of higher quality when its reports conform to the consumer's prior expectations. We use this fact to build a model of media bias in which firms slant their reports toward the prior beliefs of their customers in order to build a reputation for quality. Bias emerges in our model even though it can make all market participants worse off. The model predicts that bias will be less severe when consumers receive independent evidence on the true state of the world and that competition between independently owned news outlets can reduce bias. We present a variety of empirical evidence consistent with these predictions.

10.1086/499414.abstractZh: 一个对信息源质量不确定的贝叶斯消费者，会认为当该信息源的报道符合消费者的先验预期时，该信息源的质量更高。我们利用这一事实构建了一个媒体偏见模型，其中企业会调整其报道，以符合消费者的先验信念，从而建立质量声誉。尽管这种偏见可能会使所有市场参与者的情况恶化，但我们的模型预测，当消费者获得关于世界真实状态的独立证据时，偏见会减轻。此外，独立运营的新闻机构之间的竞争也可以减少偏见。我们提供了与这些预测一致的多种实证证据。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the effect of privatization on multifactor productivity using comprehensive panel data on initially state‐owned manufacturing firms in four economies. We exploit the data’s longitudinal dimension to control for preprivatization selection and estimate long‐run impacts. The estimates are robust to functional form but sensitive to selection controls. Our preferred random growth estimates imply positive multifactor productivity effects of 15 percent in Romania, 8 percent in Hungary, and 2 percent in Ukraine, but a −3 percent effect in Russia. The foreign privatization effect is larger (18–35 percent) in all countries. Positive domestic effects appear immediately in Hungary, Romania, and Ukraine and continue growing thereafter, but emerge only five years after privatization in Russia.

10.1086/499547.abstractZh: 本文利用四个经济体中最初由国家拥有的制造企业的综合面板数据，估计了私有化对多因素生产率的影响。我们利用数据的纵向特性来控制私有化前的选择因素，并估算长期影响。估计结果对函数形式具有稳健性，但对选择控制因素较为敏感。我们首选的随机增长模型估计显示，罗马尼亚的多因素生产率提升幅度为15%，匈牙利为8%，乌克兰为2%，而俄罗斯的效应为-3%。在所有国家中，外国私有化的影响更为显著，达到18%至35%。匈牙利、罗马尼亚和乌克兰的多因素生产率提升效应在私有化后立即显现，并持续增长；而在俄罗斯，这种效应在私有化五年后才出现。

abstract.text: In a democracy, a political majority can influence both the corporate governance structure and the return to human and financial capital. We argue that when financial wealth is sufficiently concentrated, there is political support for high labor rents and a strong governance role for banks or large investors. The model is consistent with the "great reversal" phenomenon in the first half of the twentieth century. We offer evidence that in several financially developed countries a financially weakened middle class became concerned about labor income risk associated with free markets and supported a more corporatist financial system.

10.1086/500278.abstractZh: 在民主制度下，政治多数派可以影响企业治理结构以及人力资本和金融资本的回报。我们认为，当金融财富高度集中时，政治层面会支持较高的劳动力租金，并赋予银行或大型投资者更强的治理角色。这一模型与20世纪上半叶的“大逆转”现象相一致。我们有证据表明，在几个金融发达的国家，经济地位较弱的中产阶级开始担忧自由市场带来的劳动收入风险，并支持更加企业化的金融体系。

abstract.text: A medical treatment is said to have placebo effects if patients who are optimistic about the treatment respond better to the treatment. This paper proposes a simple test for placebo effects. Instead of comparing the treatment and control arms of a single trial, one should compare the treatment arms of two trials with different probabilities of assignment to treatment. If there are placebo effects, patients in the higher-probability trial will experience better outcomes simply because they believe that there is a greater chance of receiving treatment. This paper finds evidence of placebo effects in trials of antiulcer and cholesterol-lowering drugs.

10.1086/500279.abstractZh: 如果患者对治疗持乐观态度，并且因此对该治疗反应更好，那么这种治疗就被认为具有安慰剂效应。本文提出了一种简单的测试方法来验证安慰剂效应。与其比较单一试验中的治疗组和对照组，不如比较两个试验中具有不同治疗分配概率的治疗组。如果存在安慰剂效应，那么具有较高分配概率的试验中的患者会因为相信自己有更大的机会接受治疗而获得更好的治疗效果。本文在抗溃疡药和降胆固醇药物的试验中发现了安慰剂效应的证据。

abstract.text: We analyze an implementation of an optimal disability insurance system as a competitive equilibrium with taxes. An optimum is implemented by an asset-tested disability system in which a disability transfer is paid only if an agent has assets below a specified maximum. The logic behind this result is that an agent who plans to falsely claim disability (a) finds doing so unattractive if he does not adjust his savings and (b) cannot collect disability insurance if he does adjust his savings in the desired direction (upward). For a calibrated economy, we find that welfare gains from asset testing are significant.

10.1086/500549.abstractZh: 我们分析了一种最优残疾保险制度的实施方式，将其视为一个包含税收的竞争均衡。该最优制度采用资产测试机制，只有当代理人的资产低于规定的最大值时，才会支付残疾转移金。这一结果背后的逻辑是：如果代理人计划虚假申请残疾，那么如果不调整其储蓄，这样做并不具有吸引力；而如果代理人确实按照预期方向调整储蓄，则无法获得残疾保险。在一个经过校准的经济体系中，我们发现通过资产测试所带来的福利增益是显著的。

abstract.text: We study the evolution of social distance among economists over the period 1970–2000. While the number of economists has more than doubled, the distance between them, which was already small, has declined significantly. The key to understanding the short average distances is the observation that economics is spanned by a collection of interlinked stars. A star is an economist who writes with many other economists, most of whom have few coauthors and generally do not write with each other.

10.1086/500990.abstractZh: 我们研究了1970年至2000年间经济学家之间社交距离的变化。尽管经济学家的数量增加了一倍多，但他们之间原本就较小的距离却显著缩小了。理解这种短暂平均距离的关键在于，经济学是由一系列相互关联的经济学家组成的群体所构成的。一个经济学家指的是那些与其他许多经济学家共同撰写文章的学者，而大多数经济学家通常很少与其他人合作，也不常相互交流。

abstract.text: We compare the performance of organizational forms (M-form and U-form) in experimenting with uncertain projects. In our framework, organizational forms affect the information structure of an organization and thus the way to coordinate changes. Compared to the U-form, the M-form organization achieves better coordination in "attribute matching" but suffers from coordination in "attribute compatibility" and less gains in specialization. The distinctive advantage of the M-form is its flexibility in choosing between small-scale and full-scale experimentation.

10.1086/501170.abstractZh: 我们比较了组织形式（M型与U型）在不确定项目实验中的表现。在我们的框架中，组织形式会影响组织的信息结构，从而影响协调变化的方式。与U型组织相比，M型组织在“属性匹配”方面的协调效果更好，但在“属性兼容性”方面的协调则有所欠缺，且在专业化方面的收益也较少。M型组织的独特优势在于其在小规模实验与大规模实验之间选择的灵活性。

abstract.text: This paper examines a single, narrow decision—the choice on fourth down in the National Football League between kicking and trying for a first down—as a case study of the standard view that competition in the goods, capital, and labor markets leads firms to make maximizing choices. Play-by-play data and dynamic programming are used to estimate the average payoffs to kicking and trying for a first down under different circumstances. Examination of actual decisions shows systematic, clear-cut, and overwhelmingly statistically significant departures from the decisions that would maximize teams' chances of winning. Possible reasons for the departures are considered.

10.1086/501171.abstractZh: 本文以美国国家橄榄球联盟中第四档进攻时关于踢球与尝试获得首攻的选择这一单一、具体的决策为例，来探讨一种标准观点：即商品、资本和劳动力市场的竞争促使企业做出最大化收益的决策。通过详细的数据分析和动态规划方法，本文估算了在不同情况下踢球与尝试获得首攻的平均收益。对实际决策的分析表明，这些决策与能够最大化球队胜算的决策之间存在系统性、明确且统计学上显著的差异。文章还探讨了这些差异可能的原因。

abstract.text: We study indirect democracy in which countries, states, or districts each elect a representative who later votes at a union level on their behalf. We show that the voting rule that maximizes the total expected utility of all agents in the union involves assigning a weight to each district's vote and then sticking with the status quo unless at least a threshold of weighted votes is cast for change. We analyze how the weights relate to the population size of a country and the correlation structure of agents' preferences, and then we compare the voting weights in the Council of the European Union under the Nice Treaty and the recently proposed Constitution.

10.1086/501172.abstractZh: 我们研究了间接民主制度，在这种制度下，各个国家、州或地区各自选出一名代表，该代表随后在联盟层面代表这些地区进行投票。我们发现，旨在最大化联盟内所有成员总预期效用的投票规则，涉及为每个地区的投票分配一个权重，然后除非至少有一定比例的加权投票支持变革，否则维持现状。我们分析了这些权重与一个国家人口规模之间的关系，以及成员偏好之间的相关结构，并比较了《尼斯条约》下欧洲联盟理事会以及最新提议的宪法中投票权重的差异。

abstract.text: What I am going to describe for you is a revolution in macroeconomics, a transformation in methodology that has reshaped how we conduct our science. Prior to the transformation, macroeconomics was largely separate from the rest of economics. Indeed, some considered the study

10.1086/503205.abstractZh: 我将要向您描述的，是宏观经济学的一场革命，是一种方法论上的转变，它重新塑造了我们进行科学研究的方式。在这一转变之前，宏观经济学在很大程度上与其他经济学领域是分离的。事实上，有些人认为这种研究……

abstract.text: Behavioral economics has demonstrated systematic decision-making biases in both lab and field data. Do these biases extend across contexts, cultures, or even species? We investigate this question by introducing fiat currency and trade to a colony of capuchin monkeys and recovering their preferences over a range of goods and gambles. We show that capuchins react rationally to both price and wealth shocks but display several hallmark biases when faced with gambles, including reference dependence and loss aversion. Given our capuchins' inexperience with money and trade, these results suggest that loss aversion extends beyond humans and may be innate rather than learned.

10.1086/503550.abstractZh: 行为经济学已经证明了在实验室和实地数据中都存在系统性的决策偏差。这些偏差是否适用于不同的环境、文化甚至物种呢？我们通过向卷尾猴群体引入法定货币和贸易行为，来研究这个问题，并收集它们对各类商品和赌博行为的偏好。我们发现，卷尾猴对价格和财富冲击的反应是理性的，但在面对赌博行为时，它们表现出一些典型的偏差，包括参照依赖和损失厌恶。鉴于卷尾猴在货币和贸易方面的经验不足，这些结果表明损失厌恶现象可能不仅仅存在于人类身上，而是与生俱来的，而非后天习得的。

abstract.text: Productivity risk is pervasive in underdeveloped countries. This paper highlights a way in which underdevelopment exacerbates productivity risk. Productivity shocks cause larger changes in the wage when workers are poorer, less able to migrate, and more credit-constrained because of such workers' inelastic labor supply. This equilibrium wage effect hurts workers. In contrast, it acts as insurance for landowners. Agricultural wage data for 257 districts in India for 1956–87 are used to test the predictions, with rainfall as an instrument for agricultural productivity. In districts with fewer banks or higher migration costs, the wage is much more responsive to fluctuations in productivity.

10.1086/503579.abstractZh: 在欠发达国家，生产率风险普遍存在。本文探讨了欠发展如何加剧生产率风险的一种机制。当劳动者较为贫困、迁移能力较弱且信贷受限时，生产率冲击会导致工资发生更大的变动，因为这类劳动者的劳动力供给缺乏弹性。这种均衡工资效应对劳动者不利。相比之下，它对土地所有者却具有保护作用。本文利用印度1956年至1987年间257个地区的农业工资数据，以降雨量作为农业生产率的指标，来验证相关预测。结果显示，在银行较少或迁移成本较高的地区，工资对生产率波动的反应更为敏感。

abstract.text: Do Walrasian markets function orderly in the presence of adverse selection? In particular, is their outcome efficient when exclusive contracts are enforceable? This paper addresses these questions in the context of a Rothschild-Stiglitz insurance economy. We identify an externality associated with the presence of adverse selection as a special form of consumption externality. Consequently, we show that competitive equilibria always exist but are not typically incentive efficient. However, as markets for pollution rights can internalize environmental externalities, markets for consumption rights can be designed to internalize the consumption externality due to adverse selection. With such markets competitive equilibria exist and incentive-constrained versions of the first and second welfare theorems hold.

10.1086/503754.abstractZh: 在逆向选择存在的情况下，瓦尔拉斯市场能否有序运行？特别是当排他性合同具有执行力时，它们的结果是否高效？本文在罗斯柴尔德-斯蒂格利茨保险经济模型的基础上探讨了这些问题。我们发现，逆向选择的存在会导致一种特殊的消费外部性。因此，我们指出竞争均衡总是存在，但通常并不具有激励效率。然而，由于污染权市场能够内部化环境外部性，消费权市场也可以被设计成能够内部化由于逆向选择而产生的消费外部性。在这样的市场中，竞争均衡是存在的，并且第一和第二福利定理在激励约束条件下的版本也成立。

abstract.text: The risk of repudiation plays a central role in determining the size of international capital flows. In this paper I compare a centralized arrangement for international debt, where only governments borrow and lend internationally, with a decentralized arrangement, where individual borrowers have access to international capital markets. I show that a centralized setup allows more international risk sharing and higher welfare than a decentralized setup. That is, there is a positive role for government regulation of international borrowing.

10.1086/503755.abstractZh: 拒绝风险在决定国际资本流动规模中起着核心作用。在本文中，我比较了政府主导的国际债务集中式安排与个体借款人可进入国际资本市场的分散式安排。研究表明，集中式安排能够实现更多的国际风险分担，并提高福利水平。也就是说，政府对国际借贷的监管具有积极意义。

abstract.text: Fifty years ago this Journal published Simon Rottenberg's "The Baseball Players' Labor Market," the first professional journal article in sports economics. In this retrospective we review some of his insights and analyses with regard to competitive balance, constraints on payroll and freedoms to contract, revenue sharing, territorial rights, and the supply of talent. We also note subsequent industry developments Rottenberg could not have anticipated and identify where he was ahead of his time.

10.1086/503756.abstractZh: 五十年前，本期刊发表了西蒙·罗滕伯格的《棒球运动员的劳动力市场》一文，这是体育经济学领域中的第一篇专业期刊文章。在这篇回顾性文章中，我们回顾了他在竞争平衡、薪资限制与合同自由、收入分享、地域权利以及人才供应等方面的一些见解和分析。我们还注意到罗滕伯格未能预见的行业后续发展，并指出了他在当时所处的领先位置。

abstract.text: This paper introduces signaling in a global game so as to examine the informational role of policy in coordination environments such as currency crises and bank runs. While exogenous asymmetric information has been shown to select a unique equilibrium, we show that the endogenous information generated by policy interventions leads to multiple equilibria. The policy maker is thus trapped into a position in which self-fulfilling expectations dictate not only the coordination outcome but also the optimal policy. This result does not rely on the freedom to choose out-of-equilibrium beliefs, nor on the policy being a public signal; it may obtain even if the policy is observed with idiosyncratic noise.

10.1086/504901.abstractZh: 本文介绍了在全局博弈中的信号传递机制，以探讨政策在货币危机和银行挤兑等协调环境中的信息作用。虽然外部的非对称信息已被证明会选择一个独特的均衡，但我们发现，政策干预所产生的内生信息会导致多个均衡的出现。因此，政策制定者陷入了一种境地：自我实现的预期不仅决定了协调结果，也决定了最优政策。这一结果并不依赖于选择非均衡信念的自由，也不依赖于政策作为公共信号的作用；即使政策受到特异性噪声的干扰，这一结果仍然可能成立。

abstract.text: The neoclassical growth model is used to identify the short-run effects of neutral technology shocks, which affect the production of all goods homogeneously, and investment-specific shocks, which affect only investment goods. The real equipment price, crucial for identifying the investment shocks, experiences an abrupt increase in its average rate of decline in 1982, so the analysis is based on a split sample. On the basis of the preferred specification, the two technology shocks account for 73 percent of hours' and 44 percent of output's business cycle variation before 1982, and 38 percent and 80 percent afterward. The shocks also account for more than 40 percent of hours' and 58 percent of output's forecast errors over a three- to eight-year horizon in both samples. The majority of these effects are driven by the investment shocks.

10.1086/505048.abstractZh: 新古典增长模型被用来识别中性技术冲击的短期效应，这些冲击对所有商品的生产产生同等影响；而特定于投资的冲击则仅影响投资商品。对于识别投资冲击而言至关重要的实际设备价格，在1982年其平均下降速率出现了急剧上升，因此分析基于一个分割样本。根据最优模型设定，在1982年之前，这两种技术冲击分别占小时数和产出波动的73%和44%，而在1982年之后则分别占38%和80%。在这两个样本期间，这两种冲击还分别占小时数和产出预测误差的40%以上和58%。这些效应中的大部分是由投资冲击所驱动的。

abstract.text: We incorporate multiagent, principal-agent theory into general equilibrium analysis. The traded commodities are multiagent contracts that include a description of the individual's job, effort level, and state-contingent consumption. These contracts are club goods. The competitive equilibrium and the Pareto program are formulated. The contracts are identified with firms, so the market determines which firms exist and who is assigned to which firm in what capacity. An example is provided in which the internal organization of firms and the distribution of firm classes vary with the aggregate capital endowment and its distribution across agents. A simplex-based algorithm for solving the Pareto program is developed.

10.1086/505231.abstractZh: 我们将多智能体理论及委托-代理理论融入一般均衡分析中。所交易的商品实际上是多智能体合约，这些合约包含了个体工作的描述、努力水平以及基于状态的消费信息。这些合约属于俱乐部商品。我们构建了竞争均衡和帕累托程序。这些合约被识别为 firms，因此市场决定了哪些 firm 会存在，以及哪些人会被分配到哪些 firm 中担任何种角色。文中提供了一个例子，其中 firms 的内部组织结构和 firm 类别的分布会随着总资本投入及其在代理人之间的分配而变化。我们还开发了一种基于单纯形的算法来求解帕累托程序。

abstract.text: We analyze the optimal trading and ownership policy of a large shareholder who must trade off diversification and monitoring incentives. Without commitment, the problem is similar to durable goods monopoly: the share price today depends on expected future trades. We show that the large shareholder ultimately trades to the competitive price-taking allocation, even though it entails inefficient monitoring. With continuous trading, the large shareholder trades immediately to this allocation if moral hazard is weak enough that her private valuation of a share is decreasing in her stake. Otherwise, the large shareholder adjusts her stake gradually. We consider implications for asset pricing, IPO underpricing, and lockup provisions.

10.1086/506334.abstractZh: 我们分析了大型股东的最优交易和持股策略，该股东必须在多元化与监控激励之间做出权衡。在没有承诺的情况下，这个问题类似于耐用消费品垄断的情况：今天的股价取决于预期的未来交易。我们发现，大型股东最终会进行交易，以追求竞争性的价格接受分配，尽管这会带来低效的监控。在连续交易的情况下，如果道德风险足够低，以至于她对股票的私人估值随着持股比例的减少而下降，那么大型股东会立即进行这种交易。否则，大型股东会逐步调整其持股比例。我们考虑了这些结论对资产定价、首次公开募股定价以及锁定期规定的影响。

abstract.text: We solve each household's optimal saving decisions using a life cycle model that incorporates uncertain lifetimes, uninsurable earnings and medical expenses, progressive taxation, government transfers, and pension and social security benefits. With optimal decision rules, we compare, household by household, wealth predictions from the life cycle model using a nationally representative sample. We find, making use of household-specific earnings histories, that the model accounts for more than 80 percent of the 1992 cross-sectional variation in wealth. Fewer than 20 percent of households have less wealth than their optimal targets, and the wealth deficit of those who are undersaving is generally small.

10.1086/506335.abstractZh: 我们通过一个生命周期模型来解决每个家庭的最优储蓄决策问题，该模型考虑了不确定的寿命、不可保收益和医疗费用、累进税制、政府转移支付以及养老金和社会保障福利等因素。利用最优决策规则，我们针对每个家庭，使用具有全国代表性的样本数据，比较生命周期模型预测的财富情况。研究发现，通过利用家庭特定的收益历史数据，该模型能够解释1992年财富截面变化中的80%以上。不到20%的家庭的财富低于其最优目标值，而那些储蓄不足的家庭的财富赤字通常较小。

abstract.text: This study examines educational and labor outcomes of children affected by a ban on abortions. I use evidence from Romania, where in 1966 dictator Nicolae Ceauescu declared abortion and family planning illegal. Birth rates doubled in 1967 because formerly abortion had been the primary method of birth control. Children born after the abortion ban attained more years of schooling and greater labor market success. The reason is that urban, educated women were more likely to have abortions prior to the policy change, and the relative number of children born to this type of woman increased after the ban. However, when I control for composition using observable background variables, children born after the ban on abortions had worse educational and labor market achievements as adults.

10.1086/506336.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了因禁止堕胎而受到影响的儿童在教育与就业方面的成果。我以罗马尼亚为例进行分析，该国在1966年，独裁者尼古拉·齐奥塞斯库宣布堕胎和计划生育为非法行为。由于过去堕胎曾是主要的避孕手段，1967年的出生率翻了一番。在禁止堕胎之后出生的儿童，其接受教育的年限更长，在就业市场上的表现也更为出色。其原因是，在政策变更之前，城市中的受过教育的女性更有可能进行堕胎，而在禁令实施之后，这类女性所生育的儿童数量有所增加。然而，当我使用可观测的背景变量来控制变量后，发现禁止堕胎之后出生的儿童在成年后的教育水平和就业市场表现都较差。

abstract.text: This paper develops a general model of private provision of a public good that includes the option to consume an impure public good. The model is used to investigate the positive and normative consequences of "green markets," which are based on technologies with joint production of a private good and an environmental public good. It is shown that under reasonable conditions green markets can have beneficial or detrimental effects on environmental quality and social welfare. The analysis applies equally to nonenvironmental choice settings, with examples ranging from socially responsible investments to commercial activities associated with charitable fund-raising.

10.1086/506337.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个关于私人提供公共物品的通用模型，该模型包含了消费不纯净公共物品的可能性。该模型用于研究基于私人物品与环境公共物品共同生产的技术的“绿色市场”所带来的积极和规范性影响。研究表明，在合理条件下，绿色市场可能对环境质量和社会福利产生有益或有害的影响。这一分析同样适用于非环境选择的情形，例如从社会责任投资到与慈善筹款相关的商业活动。

abstract.text: We develop a dynamic model of experience goods pricing with independent private valuations. We show that the optimal paths of sales and prices can be described in terms of a simple dichotomy. In a mass market, prices are declining over time. In a niche market, the optimal prices are initially low followed by higher prices that extract surplus from the buyers with a high willingness to pay. We consider extensions of the model to integrate elements of social rather than private learning and turnover among buyers.

10.1086/506923.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个动态模型，用于分析具有独立私人估值的体验商品定价问题。我们表明，销售和价格的最优路径可以用一个简单的二分法来描述。在大众市场中，价格会随时间下降；而在小众市场中，最优价格最初较低，随后会上升，以从那些支付意愿较高的买家那里获取更多收益。我们考虑对该模型进行扩展，以纳入社会学习以及买家之间的流动性等因素。

abstract.text: This paper uses the 1918 influenza pandemic as a natural experiment for testing the fetal origins hypothesis. The pandemic arrived unexpectedly in the fall of 1918 and had largely subsided by January 1919, generating sharp predictions for long-term effects. Data from the 1960–80 decennial U.S. Census indicate that cohorts in utero during the pandemic displayed reduced educational attainment, increased rates of physical disability, lower income, lower socioeconomic status, and higher transfer payments compared with other birth cohorts. These results indicate that investments in fetal health can increase human capital.

10.1086/507154.abstractZh: 本文以1918年流感大流行作为自然实验，来检验“胎儿起源假说”。该大流行在1918年秋季突然爆发，到1919年1月基本消退，因此人们对其长期影响有诸多预测。1960至1980年美国十年一次的人口普查数据显示，在大流行期间，胎儿时期所处的群体在教育水平、身体残疾率、收入、社会经济地位以及转移支付方面均表现较差。这些结果表明，对胎儿健康的投资能够提升人力资本。

abstract.text: Ten of the 15 seats on the U.N. Security Council are held by rotating members serving two-year terms. We find that a country's U.S. aid increases by 59 percent and its U.N. aid by 8 percent when it rotates onto the council. This effect increases during years in which key diplomatic events take place (when members' votes should be especially valuable), and the timing of the effect closely tracks a country's election to, and exit from, the council. Finally, the U.N. results appear to be driven by UNICEF, an organization over which the United States has historically exerted great control.

10.1086/507155.abstractZh: 在联合国安全理事会15个席位中，有10个席位由任期两年的轮值成员担任。我们发现，当一个国家轮值进入安理会时，其获得的美国援助会增加59%，而获得的联合国援助则增加8%。这种效应在关键外交事件发生的年份更为明显（此时成员们的投票尤为重要），且这种效应的出现时间与一个国家进入和退出安理会的时间密切相关。最后，联合国的相关结果似乎受到联合国儿童基金会的推动，而美国历史上一直对联合国儿童基金会拥有很大的控制权。

abstract.text: We estimate auto accident externalities (more specifically insurance externalities) using panel data on state-average insurance premiums and loss costs. Externalities appear to be substantial in traffic-dense states: in California, for example, we find that the increase in traffic density from a typical additional driver increases total statewide insurance costs of other drivers by $1,725–$3,239 per year, depending on the model. High–traffic density states have large economically and statistically significant externalities in all specifications we check. In contrast, the accident externality per driver in low-traffic states appears quite small. On balance, accident externalities are so large that a correcting Pigouvian tax could raise $66 billion annually in California alone, more than all existing California state taxes during our study period, and over $220 billion per year nationally.

10.1086/508030.abstractZh: 我们通过使用关于州平均保险费和损失成本的面板数据，来估算交通事故的外部性（更具体地说，是保险外部性）。在交通密度高的州，这些外部性似乎相当显著：例如，在加利福尼亚州，我们发现，每增加一个额外的驾驶员，全州其他驾驶者的保险费用每年会增加1,725至3,239美元，具体数值取决于所使用的模型。在交通密度高的州，无论采用何种模型，交通事故的外部性在经济和统计上都具有较大的重要性。相比之下，在交通密度低的州，每名驾驶者的交通事故外部性则相对较小。总体而言，交通事故的外部性非常大，仅在加利福尼亚州，一项修正性的皮古税每年就能带来660亿美元的收入，这超过了我们研究期间加利福尼亚州所有现有税收的总和，全国范围内则每年超过2,200亿美元。

abstract.text: We consider organizations that optimally choose the level of adaptation to a changing environment when coordination among specialized tasks is a concern. Adaptive organizations provide employees with flexibility to tailor their tasks to local information. Coordination is maintained by limiting specialization and improving communication. Alternatively, by letting employees stick to some preagreed action plan, organizations can ensure coordination without communication, regardless of the extent of specialization. Among other things, our theory shows how extensive specialization results in organizations that ignore local knowledge, and it explains why improvements in communication technology may reduce specialization by pushing organizations to become more adaptive.

10.1086/508031.abstractZh: 我们考虑了那些在协调专业任务时，能够最优选择适应变化环境的组织。适应性强的组织为员工提供了灵活性，使他们能够根据当地信息调整自己的任务。通过限制专业化程度并改善沟通，可以维持协调。或者，通过让员工遵循预先约定的行动计划，组织可以在不依赖沟通的情况下确保协调，无论专业化程度如何。此外，我们的理论还揭示了广泛专业化会导致组织忽视当地知识的情况，并解释了为什么通信技术的改进可能会减少专业化，促使组织变得更加适应性强。

abstract.text: This paper constructs and calibrates a parsimonious model of occupational choice that allows for entrepreneurial entry, exit, and investment decisions in the presence of borrowing constraints. The model fits very well a number of empirical observations, including the observed wealth distribution for entrepreneurs and workers. At the aggregate level, more restrictive borrowing constraints generate less wealth concentration and reduce average firm size, aggregate capital, and the fraction of entrepreneurs. Voluntary bequests allow some high-ability workers to establish or enlarge an entrepreneurial activity. With accidental bequests only, there would be fewer very large firms and less aggregate capital and wealth concentration.

10.1086/508032.abstractZh: 本文构建并校准了一个简约的职业选择模型，该模型考虑了在借贷约束存在的情况下，企业家进入、退出和投资决策的情况。该模型很好地拟合了多项实证观察结果，包括企业家和工人的财富分布情况。从总体上看，更严格的借贷约束会导致财富集中度降低，同时也会减小平均企业规模、总资本以及企业家所占的比例。自愿遗赠使得一些能力较高的工人能够建立或扩大自己的创业活动。而如果只有意外遗赠的情况，那么大型企业的数量将会减少，总资本和财富集中度也会降低。

abstract.text: We develop a framework for valuing improvements in health and apply it to past and prospective reductions in mortality in the United States. We calculate social values of (i) increased longevity over the twentieth century, (ii) progress against various diseases after 1970, and (iii) potential future progress against major diseases. Cumulative gains in life expectancy after 1900 were worth over $1.2 million to the representative American in 2000, whereas post-1970 gains added about $3.2 trillion per year to national wealth, equal to about half of GDP. Potential gains from future health improvements are also large; for example, a 1 percent reduction in cancer mortality would be worth $500 billion.

10.1086/508033.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个评估健康改善价值的框架，并将其应用于美国过去和未来的死亡率下降情况。我们计算了以下方面的社会价值：(i) 二十世纪以来的寿命延长；(ii) 1970年之后的各种疾病防治进展；(iii) 未来在主要疾病防治方面可能取得的进展。1900年之后的预期寿命累积增长，在2000年时对普通美国人而言价值超过120万美元；而1970年之后的增长每年为国家财富增加了约3.2万亿美元，相当于GDP的一半左右。未来健康改善带来的潜在收益同样巨大；例如，癌症死亡率降低1%，其价值可达5000亿美元。

abstract.text: Many randomized experiments are plagued by attrition, even among subjects receiving more effective treatments. We estimate the subject's utility associated with the receipt of treatment, as revealed by dropout behavior, to evaluate treatment effects. Utility is a function of both "publicly observed" outcomes and side effects privately observed by the subject. We analyze an influential AIDS clinical trial, ACTG 175, and show that for many subjects, AZT yields the highest level of utility despite having the smallest impact on the publicly observed outcome because of mild side effects.
