Moreover, although subjects enter the experiment uncertain of treatment effectiveness (and often the treatment received), the learning process implies that early dropout in ACTG 175 is primarily driven by side effects, whereas later attrition reflects declining treatment effectiveness.

10.1086/508239.abstractZh: 许多随机实验都受到流失问题的困扰，即使是在接受更有效治疗的人群中也是如此。我们通过分析受试者因退出实验而产生的效用变化，来评估治疗效果。效用是“公开观察到的结果”和受试者私下观察到的副作用的函数。我们分析了具有影响力的艾滋病临床试验ACTG 175，发现尽管AZT对公开观察到的结果影响最小，但由于其副作用轻微，许多受试者认为AZT带来的效用最高。此外，尽管受试者进入实验时对治疗效果并不确定（通常也不确定所接受的治疗），但学习过程表明，ACTG 175中早期的退出主要是由于副作用造成的，而后期流失则反映了治疗效果的下降。

abstract.text: This study quantitatively assesses the effects of inflation through changes in the value of nominal assets. It documents nominal asset positions in the United States across sectors and groups of households and estimates the wealth redistribution caused by a moderate inflation episode. The main losers from inflation are rich, old households, the major bondholders in the economy. The main winners are young, middle-class households with fixed-rate mortgage debt. Besides transferring resources from the old to the young, inflation is a boon for the government and a tax on foreigners. Lately, the amount of U.S. nominal assets held by foreigners has grown dramatically, increasing the potential for a large inflation-induced wealth transfer from foreigners to domestic households.

10.1086/508379.abstractZh: 本研究通过名义资产价值的变化来定量评估通货膨胀的影响。它记录了美国不同行业和家庭群体的名义资产状况，并估算了适度通货膨胀事件所导致的财富再分配情况。通货膨胀的主要受害者是富裕且年长的家庭，以及经济中的主要债券持有者。而主要受益者是拥有固定利率抵押贷款债务的年轻中产阶级家庭。除了将资源从老年人转移到年轻人之外，通货膨胀对政府来说是一种福音，对外国人而言则是一种负担。近年来，外国人持有的美国名义资产数量显著增长，这增加了因通货膨胀而导致外国资本向国内家庭转移财富的潜力。

abstract.text: We consider a directed search model in which workers differ in productivity. Productivity becomes observable to firms after assessing their workers on the job, but it is not verifiable. Firms with vacancies choose between posting a noncontingent wage and leaving wages subject to bargaining with the worker. Under wage bargaining, firms cannot optimize the trade-off between paying higher wages and having a larger probability of filling vacancies. But wage bargaining makes wages increasing in worker productivity and so may allow firms to attract better workers into the vacancy. When workers' heterogeneity is large and bargaining powers come close to satisfying Hosios's rule, firms opt for bargaining. Yet, equilibria with bargaining fail to maximize aggregate net income and sometimes are not constrained Pareto optimal.

10.1086/509816.abstractZh: 我们考虑了一个有向搜索模型，其中工人的生产力存在差异。企业在评估工人的工作表现后能够观察到他们的生产力，但这种表现是无法验证的。有空缺职位的企业可以选择支付固定的工资，或者让工资水平根据与工人的谈判来决定。在工资谈判的情况下，企业无法在支付更高工资和增加填补空缺的概率之间实现最优权衡。然而，工资谈判使得工资随着工人生产力的提高而上升，因此可能有助于企业吸引更优秀的工人填补空缺。当工人的异质性较大且谈判能力接近满足霍西奥斯规则时，企业会选择谈判方式。不过，带有谈判机制的均衡并不能最大化总净收入，有时甚至不是帕累托最优的。

abstract.text: Consider a heterogeneous agent matching model in which the payoff of each matched individual is a fixed function of both partners' types. In a 1973 article, Becker showed that assortative matching arises in a frictionless setting simply if everyone prefers higher partners. This paper shows that if finding partners requires time-consuming search and individuals are impatient, then productive interaction matters. Matching is positively assortative—higher types match with higher sets of types—when the proportionate gains from having better partners rise in one's type. With multiplicatively separable payoffs, these proportionate gains are constant in one's type, and "block segregation" arises, a common finding of the literature.

10.1086/510440.abstractZh: 考虑一个异质代理人匹配模型，其中每个匹配个体的收益是双方类型的一个固定函数。在1973年的一篇文章中，贝克尔指出，在无摩擦的环境中，只要每个人都更喜欢高类型的伴侣，就会出现选择性匹配。本文表明，如果寻找伴侣需要耗费时间，而个体又缺乏耐心，那么富有成效的互动就变得至关重要。当拥有更好伴侣所带来的收益随着自身类型的提升而递增时，匹配就会呈现积极的选择性——即高类型的个体会匹配更高类型的伴侣。在可乘法分离的收益情况下，这些随着自身类型提升而增加的收益是恒定的，此时就会出现“区块隔离”现象，这是文献中常见的发现。

abstract.text: This paper presents a model of cumulative innovation in which firms are heterogeneous in their research ability. We study the optimal reward policy when the quality of the ideas and their subsequent development effort are private information. Monopoly power is a scarce resource to be allocated across innovators who arrive at various times. The optimal assignment of property rights must counterbalance the incentives of current and future innovators. The resulting mechanism resembles a menu of patents that have infinite duration and fixed scope. This optimal patent menu can be implemented with a simple buyout scheme: The innovator commits at the outset to a price ceiling at which he will sell his rights to a future inventor. When a larger fee is paid initially, a higher price ceiling is obtained. Any subsequent innovator must pay this price and purchase his own buyout fee contract. We relate this mechanism to the proposed compulsory licensing schemes.

10.1086/510562.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个累积创新的模型，其中企业在研究能力上存在差异。我们研究了在想法质量及其后续开发努力为私人信息的情况下，最优的奖励政策。垄断力量是一种稀缺资源，需要分配给在不同时间出现的创新者。产权的最优分配必须平衡当前和未来创新者的激励。由此产生的机制类似于一个具有无限持续时间和固定范围的专利菜单。这种最优专利菜单可以通过一个简单的收购方案来实现：创新者一开始就承诺一个价格上限，并将自己的权利出售给未来的发明者。如果最初支付的费用更高，则获得的定价上限也会更高。任何后续的创新者都必须支付这个价格，并购买自己的收购费用合同。我们将这种机制与所提出的强制许可方案联系起来。

abstract.text: In 2003 the federal-state Medicaid program provided prescription drug coverage to more than 50 million people. To determine the price that it will pay for each drug, Medicaid uses the average private sector price. When Medicaid is a large part of the demand for a drug, this creates an incentive for its maker to increase prices for other health care consumers. Using drug utilization and expenditure data for the top 200 drugs in 1997 and in 2002, we investigate the relationship between the Medicaid market share (MMS) and the average price of a prescription. Our estimates imply that a 10-percentage-point increase in the MMS is associated with a 7 to 10 percent increase in the average price of a prescription. In addition, the Medicaid rules increase a firm's incentive to introduce new versions of a drug in order to raise price. We find empirical evidence that firms producing newer drugs with larger sales to Medicaid are more likely to introduce new versions. Taken together, our findings suggest that government procurement rules can alter equilibrium price and product proliferation in the private sector.

10.1093/qje/121.1.1.abstractZh: 2003年，联邦与州政府联合实施的医疗补助计划为超过5000万人提供了处方药报销服务。为了确定每款药物的报销价格，医疗补助计划采用私营部门的平均价格作为参考。当医疗补助成为某种药物需求的重要来源时，这就会促使制药企业提高其他医疗保健消费者的价格。通过对比1997年和2002年前200种最常用药物的用药情况和支出数据，我们研究了医疗补助市场份额与处方药平均价格之间的关系。我们的估计表明，医疗补助市场份额增加10个百分点，会导致处方药平均价格上涨7%至10%。此外，医疗补助政策还会促使企业推出新版本的药物以提高价格。我们的实证研究发现，生产新药物且在新医疗补助市场中有较大销售量的企业，更有可能推出新版本的产品。综合来看，我们的研究结果表明，政府采购政策能够改变私营部门的均衡价格和产品推广情况。

abstract.text: This paper models interactions between a party with anticipatory emotions and a party who responds strategically to those emotions, a situation that is common in many health, political, employment, and personal settings. An “agent” has information with both decision-making value and emotional implications for an uninformed “principal” whose utility she wants to maximize. If she cannot directly reveal her information, to increase the principal's anticipatory utility she distorts instrumental decisions toward the action associated with good news. But because anticipatory utility derives from beliefs about instrumental outcomes, undistorted actions would yield higher ex ante total and anticipatory utility. If the agent can certifiably convey her information, she does so for good news, but unless this leads the principal to make a very costly mistake, to shelter his feelings she pretends to be uninformed when the news is bad.

10.1093/qje/121.1.121.abstractZh: 本文模拟了具有预期情绪的一方与对该情绪进行策略性回应的一方之间的互动，这种情况在许多健康、政治、就业和个人领域都很常见。一个“代理人”拥有对不知情的“主体”具有决策价值与情感影响的资讯，而主体则希望最大化其效用。如果代理人无法直接透露其资讯，为了提升主体的预期效用，她会扭曲工具性决策，选择与好消息相关的行动。但由于预期效用源自对工具性结果的信念，未被扭曲的行动将带来更高的事前总效用和预期效用。如果代理人能够确凿地传递其资讯，她会这样做以传递好消息，但除非这导致主体做出代价高昂的错误，否则在消息不好的情况下，她会假装不知情，以安抚主体的情绪。

abstract.text: Managers appear to manipulate firm earnings through their characterizations of pension assets to capital markets and alter investment decisions to justify, and capitalize on, these manipulations. Managers are more aggressive with assumed long-term rates of return when their assumptions have a greater impact on reported earnings. Firms use higher assumed rates of return when they prepare to acquire other firms, when they are near critical earnings thresholds, and when their managers exercise stock options. Changes in assumed returns, in turn, influence pension plan asset allocations. Instrumental variables analysis indicates that 25 basis point increases in assumed rates are associated with 5 percent increases in equity allocations.

10.1093/qje/121.1.157.abstractZh: 管理者似乎通过向资本市场描述养老金资产的方式来操纵公司收益，并改变投资决策以合理化这些操纵行为并从中获利。当管理者的假设对报告收益的影响更大时，他们会在长期回报率上采取更激进的态度。当公司准备收购其他公司、接近关键的收益门槛或管理者行使股票期权时，会使用更高的假设回报率。假设回报的变化反过来会影响养老金计划的资产分配。工具变量分析表明，假设回报率增加25个基点与股权分配增加5%相关。

abstract.text: The independence of editorial content from advertisers' influence is a cornerstone of journalistic ethics. We test whether this independence is observed in practice. We find that mutual fund recommendations are correlated with past advertising in three personal finance publications but not in two national newspapers. Our tests control for numerous fund characteristics, total advertising expenditures, and past mentions. While positive mentions significantly increase fund inflows, they do not successfully predict returns. Future returns are similar for the funds we predict would have been mentioned in the absence of bias, suggesting that the cost of advertising bias to readers is small.

10.1093/qje/121.1.197.abstractZh: 编辑内容不受广告商影响的独立性是新闻伦理的基石。我们测试了这一独立性在实际情况中是否得到体现。研究发现，共同基金推荐与三份个人理财出版物中的过往广告存在关联，但与两份全国性报纸则没有这种关联。我们的测试考虑了众多基金特征、总广告支出以及过往提及情况。虽然正面提及显著增加了基金的资金流入，但它们并不能成功预测收益。对于我们认为在没有偏见的情况下也会被提及的基金，其未来收益情况相似，这表明广告对读者的偏见所带来的成本很小。

abstract.text: There is widespread evidence supporting the conjecture that borrowing constraints have important implications for firm growth and survival. In this paper we model a multiperiod borrowing/lending relationship with asymmetric information. We show that borrowing constraints emerge as a feature of the optimal long-term lending contract, and that such constraints relax as the value of the borrower's claim to future cash flows increases. We also show that the optimal contract has interesting implications for firm dynamics. In agreement with the empirical evidence, as age and size increase, mean and variance of growth decrease, and firm survival increases.

10.1093/qje/121.1.229.abstractZh: 有大量证据支持这样的猜想：借款限制对企业的成长和生存具有重要影响。在本文中，我们模拟了一个具有信息不对称的多期借贷关系。我们指出，借款限制是最优长期借贷合同的一个特征，并且随着借款人对未来现金流要求的价值增加，这种限制会有所放松。我们还发现，最优合同对企业动态有着有趣的影响。与实证证据一致，随着企业年龄和规模的扩大，增长的平均值和方差都会降低，企业的生存能力也会增强。

abstract.text: This paper exploits the variation occurring from the different timing of divorce law reforms across the United States to evaluate how unilateral divorce changed family violence and whether the option provided by unilateral divorce reduced suicide and spousal homicide. Unilateral divorce both potentially increases the likelihood that a domestic violence relationship ends and acts to transfer bargaining power toward the abused, thereby potentially stopping the abuse in extant relationships. In states that introduced unilateral divorce we find a 8–16 percent decline in female suicide, roughly a 30 percent decline in domestic violence for both men and women, and a 10 percent decline in females murdered by their partners.

10.1093/qje/121.1.267.abstractZh: 本文通过分析美国不同州离婚法律改革的时间差异，评估了单方面离婚对家庭暴力的影响，以及这种离婚方式是否有助于减少自杀和配偶谋杀事件。单方面离婚可能会增加家庭暴力关系结束的可能性，并有助于将谈判权力转移到受虐待的一方，从而在一定程度上阻止现有关系中的暴力行为。在引入单方面离婚制度的州，我们发现女性自杀率下降了8%至16%，男女双方的家庭暴力行为减少了约30%，女性被伴侣谋杀的比例则下降了10%。

abstract.text: The release of Enovid in 1960, the first birth control pill, afforded U. S. women unprecedented freedom to plan childbearing and their careers. This paper uses plausibly exogenous variation in state consent laws to evaluate the causal impact of the pill on the timing of first births and extent and intensity of women's labor-force participation. The results suggest that legal access to the pill before age 21 significantly reduced the likelihood of a first birth before age 22, increased the number of women in the paid labor force, and raised the number of annual hours worked.

10.1093/qje/121.1.289.abstractZh: 1960年，第一种避孕药Enovid的问世，为美国女性提供了前所未有的自由，使她们能够规划生育和职业生涯。本文通过假设性的州法律变化，评估了这种避孕药对首次生育时间、女性劳动力参与程度及强度的影响。研究结果表明，在21岁之前合法使用避孕药显著降低了22岁之前首次生育的可能性，增加了女性从事有偿工作的比例，并提高了她们每年的工作小时数。

abstract.text: How does the formation of cross-country teams affect the organization of work and the structure of wages?To study this question we propose a theory of the assignment of heterogeneous agents into hierarchical teams, where less skilled agents specialize in production and more skilled agents specialize in problem solving.We first analyze the properties of the competitive equilibrium of the model in a closed economy, and show that the model has a unique and efficient solution.We then study the equilibrium of a two-country model (North and South), where countries differ in their distributions of ability, and in which agents in different countries can join together in teams.We refer to this type of integration as globalization.Globalization leads to better matches for all southern workers but only for the best northern workers.As a result, we show that globalization increases wage inequality in the South but not necessarily in the North.We also study how globalization affects the size distribution of firms and the patterns of consumption and trade in the global economy.

10.1093/qje/121.1.31.abstractZh: 跨国团队的组建如何影响工作组织和工资结构？为了研究这个问题，我们提出了一个关于将不同能力的个体分配到层级团队中的理论模型。在这个模型中，能力较低的个体专注于生产，而能力较高的个体则专注于问题解决。我们首先分析了该模型在封闭经济中的竞争均衡特性，并证明了该模型存在唯一且有效的解。随后，我们研究了一个双国模型（北方和南方）的均衡情况，这两个国家在能力分布上有所不同，不同国家的个体可以组成团队。我们将这种整合方式称为“全球化”。全球化使得所有南方地区的工人都能获得更好的匹配，但只有最优秀的北方工人能够受益。结果表明，全球化加剧了南方的工资不平等，但在北方不一定如此。我们还研究了全球化如何影响企业的规模分布以及全球经济中的消费和贸易模式。

abstract.text: We examine how people form social networks among their peers. We use a unique data set that tells us the volume of email between any two people in the sample. The data are from students and recent graduates of Dartmouth College. First-year students interact with peers in their immediate proximity and form long-term friendships with a subset of these people. This result is consistent with a model in which the expected value of interacting with an unknown person is low (making traveling solely to meet new people unlikely), while the benefits from interacting with the same person repeatedly are high. Geographic proximity and race are greater determinants of social interaction than are common interests, majors, or family background. Two randomly chosen White students interact three times more often than do a Black student and a White student. However, placing the Black and White student in the same freshman dorm increases their frequency of interaction by a factor of three. A traditional “linear in group means” model of peer ability is only a reasonable approximation to the ability of actual peers chosen when we form the groups around all key factors including distance, race and cohort.

10.1093/qje/121.1.79.abstractZh: 我们研究了人们如何在其同龄人中建立社交网络。我们使用了一个独特的数据集，该数据集记录了样本中任意两人之间的电子邮件交流量。这些数据来自达特茅斯学院的学生和应届毕业生。一年级学生会与他们身边的同龄人互动，并与其中一部分人建立长期的友谊。这一结果与一种模型相符，即与陌生人的互动预期价值较低（因此单独去结识新人的可能性较低），而与同一人反复互动的好处则较高。地理位置和种族比共同兴趣、专业或家庭背景更能决定社交互动的频率。随机选取的两名白人学生与一名黑人学生互动的频率是三名白人学生的三倍。然而，将黑人和白人学生安排在同一栋新生宿舍中，他们的互动频率会增加三倍。传统的“群体均值线性模型”只能合理地近似实际同伴的能力，当我们根据距离、种族和班级等关键因素来划分群体时，这种模型更为准确。

abstract.text: We develop a model of reference-dependent preferences and loss aversion where “gain-loss utility” is derived from standard “consumption utility” and the reference point is determined endogenously by the economic environment. We assume that a person's reference point is her rational expectations held in the recent past about outcomes, which are determined in a personal equilibrium by the requirement that they must be consistent with optimal behavior given expectations. In deterministic environments, choices maximize consumption utility, but gain-loss utility influences behavior when there is uncertainty. Applying the model to consumer behavior, we show that willingness to pay for a good is increasing in the expected probability of purchase and in the expected prices conditional on purchase. In within-day labor-supply decisions, a worker is less likely to continue work if income earned thus far is unexpectedly high, but more likely to show up as well as continue work if expected income is high.

10.1093/qje/121.4.1133.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个基于参考依赖偏好和损失厌恶的模型，其中“收益-损失效用”是从标准的“消费效用”中推导出来的，而参考点则由经济环境内生地决定。我们假设一个人的参考点是其过去对结果的理性预期，这些预期在个人均衡中必须与给定预期的最优行为一致。在确定性环境中，选择会最大化消费效用，但在不确定性存在的情况下，收益-损失效用会影响行为。将模型应用于消费者行为，我们发现人们愿意为商品支付的金额随着购买预期概率和购买条件下的预期价格而增加。在一天内的劳动力供应决策中，如果迄今为止获得的收入出乎意料地高，工人不太可能继续工作；但如果预期收入较高，则更有可能出现并继续工作。

abstract.text: We analyze a “golden rule” that separates capital and ordinary account budgets and allows a government to finance only capital items with debt. Many national governments followed this rule in the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries, and most U. S. states do today. We study an overlapping-generations economy where majorities choose durable and nondurable public goods in each period. When demographics imply even moderate departures from Ricardian equivalence, the golden rule substantially improves efficiency. Examples calibrated to U. S. demographics show greater improvements at the state level or with nineteenth century demographics than under current national demographics.

10.1093/qje/121.4.1167.abstractZh: 我们分析了一种“黄金法则”，该法则将资本预算与普通预算分开，并允许政府仅用债务来融资资本项目。许多国家政府在18和19世纪遵循了这一规则，而大多数美国州至今仍如此。我们研究了一个跨代际经济模型，其中大多数人在每个时期都会选择耐用和非耐用的公共产品。当人口统计特征导致与李嘉图等价原则出现适度偏差时，黄金法则能显著提高效率。根据美国人口统计数据进行校准的实例表明，在州级或19世纪的人口统计数据下，这种效率提升更为显著。

abstract.text: From 1997 through 2003, the UN Oil for Food Program allowed Iraq to export oil for humanitarian supplies. We hypothesize that Iraq deliberately set the price of its oil below market prices to solicit bribes from oil buyers. By comparing the price gap between Iraqi oil and its close substitutes during the Program to the gap prior to the Program, we find evidence of significant underpricing. Our central estimate suggests that Iraq collected $1.3 billion in bribes from underpricing its oil, or 2 percent of oil revenues. Underpricing is higher during periods of high volatility in oil markets—when detection is more difficult—but declines after the UN limited Iraq's ability to set the price of its oil.

10.1093/qje/121.4.1211.abstractZh: 从1997年到2003年，联合国“石油换食品”计划允许伊拉克出口石油以换取人道主义物资。我们假设伊拉克故意将石油价格定在市场价格以下，以向石油买家收取贿赂。通过比较该计划期间伊拉克石油与其替代品之间的价格差距，以及计划开始前的价格差距，我们发现存在明显的价格低估现象。我们的估算结果显示，伊拉克因价格低估而收取了13亿美元的贿赂，这相当于其石油收入的2%。在石油市场波动较大的时期，价格低估现象更为严重，因为此时检测难度增加；但在联合国限制伊拉克设定石油价格后，价格低估现象有所减少。

abstract.text: This paper explores to what extent secondary policy issues are influenced by electoral incentives. We develop a two-dimensional political agency model, in which a politician decides on both a frontline policy issue and a secondary policy issue. The model predicts when the incumbent should manipulate the secondary policy to attract voters. We test our model by using panel data on environmental policy choices in the U. S. states. In contrast to the popular view that secondary policies are largely determined by lobbying, we find that there are strong effects of electoral incentives.

10.1093/qje/121.4.1249.abstractZh: 本文探讨了次要政策问题在多大程度上受到选举激励的影响。我们构建了一个二维的政治代理模型，其中政治家需要同时处理主要政策问题和次要政策问题。该模型预测了现任官员何时应该操纵次要政策以吸引选民。我们通过使用美国各州环境政策选择的面板数据来测试我们的模型。与普遍认为次要政策主要由游说活动决定的观点不同，我们发现选举激励对次要政策有着显著的影响。

abstract.text: Expected utility theory, prospect theory, and most other models of risky choice are based on the fundamental premise that individuals choose among risky prospects by balancing the value of the possible consequences. These models, therefore, require that the value of a risky prospect lie between the value of that prospect's highest and lowest outcome. Although this requirement seems essential for any theory of risky decision-making, we document a violation of this condition in which individuals value a risky prospect less than its worst possible realization. This demonstration, which we term the uncertainty effect, draws from more than 1000 experimental participants, and includes hypothetical and real pricing and choice tasks, as well as field experiments in real markets with financial incentives. Our results suggest that there are choice situations in which decision-makers discount lotteries for uncertainty in a manner that cannot be accommodated by standard models of risky choice. From the time of Bernoulli on, it has been common to argue that (a) individuals tend to display aversion to the taking of risks, and (b) that risk aversion in turn is an explanation for many observed phenomena in the economic world [Arrow 1971, p. 90].

10.1093/qje/121.4.1283.abstractZh: 期望效用理论、前景理论以及大多数其他风险选择模型都基于这样一个基本前提：个体在面临风险选择时，会权衡可能后果的价值来进行决策。因此，这些模型要求一个风险前景的价值介于其最乐观和最悲观结果的价值之间。尽管这一要求对于任何风险决策理论来说似乎是必不可少的，但我们发现有一种情况违反了这一条件——即个体对某个风险前景的估值低于其最糟糕的结局。这种现象我们称之为“不确定性效应”。我们的研究基于1000多名实验参与者，包括假设性和真实性的定价与选择任务，以及在实际市场中带有财务激励的实地实验。我们的研究结果表明，存在一些选择情境，其中决策者因不确定性而低估了彩票的价值，这种情况无法用标准的风险选择模型来解释。自伯努利时代以来，人们普遍认为：(a) 个体倾向于厌恶风险，以及(b) 这种风险厌恶现象可以解释经济领域中许多观察到的现象[Arrow 1971, p. 90]。

abstract.text: We analyze a randomized experiment in which 14,000 tax filers in H&R Block offices in St. Louis received matches of zero, 20 percent, or 50 percent of IRA contributions. Take-up rates were 3 percent, 8 percent, and 14 percent, respectively. Among contributors, contributions, excluding the match, averaged $765 in the control group and $1100 in the match groups. Taxpayer responses to similar incentives in the Saver's Credit are much smaller. Taxpayers did not game the experiment by receiving a match and strategically withdrawing funds. Tax professionals significantly influenced contribution choices. These results suggest that both incentives and information affect behavior.

10.1093/qje/121.4.1311.abstractZh: 我们分析了一项随机实验，实验中，圣路易斯H&R Block办事处的14,000名税务申报人获得了零、20%或50%的IRA资金匹配。匹配后的接受率分别为3%、8%和14%。在贡献者中，不包括匹配部分的贡献，对照组的平均金额为765美元，而匹配组的平均金额为1100美元。纳税人对储蓄信用额度中类似激励措施的响应要小得多。纳税人并没有通过接受匹配并策略性撤回资金来操纵实验。税务专业人士对贡献选择产生了显著影响。这些结果表明，激励措施和信息都会影响行为。

abstract.text: In a laboratory experiment we show that minimum wages have significant and lasting effects on subjects' reservation wages. The temporary introduction of a minimum wage leads to a rise in subjects' reservation wages which persists even after the minimum wage has been removed. Firms are therefore forced to pay higher wages after the removal of the minimum wage than before its introduction. As a consequence, the employment effects of removing the minimum wage are significantly smaller than are the effects of its introduction. The impact of minimum wages on reservation wages may also explain the anomalously low utilization of subminimum wages if employers are given the opportunity to pay less than a minimum wage previously introduced. It may further explain why employers often increase workers' wages after an increase in the minimum wage by an amount exceeding that necessary for compliance with the higher minimum. At a more general level, our results suggest that economic policy may affect people's behavior by shaping the perception of what is a fair transaction and by creating entitlement effects.

10.1093/qje/121.4.1347.abstractZh: 在实验室实验中，我们发现最低工资对劳动者的保留工资有显著且持久的影响。临时实施最低工资会导致劳动者的保留工资上升，这种影响即使在最低工资取消后仍然持续。因此，企业在取消最低工资后必须支付更高的工资。结果，取消最低工资对就业的影响明显小于其实施的影响。最低工资对保留工资的影响还可能解释为什么在雇主有机会支付低于先前规定的最低工资的情况下，次最低工资的实际利用率却异常低。此外，这也解释了为什么雇主在最低工资提高后，通常会增加工人的工资，增加的幅度超过了遵守更高最低工资的必要程度。从更普遍的角度来看，我们的研究结果表明，经济政策可以通过塑造人们对公平交易的认知以及产生权利效应来影响人们的行为。

abstract.text: We present an equilibrium theory of the organization of work in an economy where knowledge is an essential input in production and agents are heterogeneous in skill. Agents organize production by matching with others in knowledge hierarchies designed to use and communicate their knowledge efficiently. Relative to autarky, organization leads to larger cross-sectional differences in knowledge and wages: low skill workers learn and earn relatively less. We show that improvements in the technology to acquire knowledge lead to opposite implications on wage inequality and organization than reductions in communication costs.

10.1093/qje/121.4.1383.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种关于经济中工作组织均衡的理论，其中知识是生产中的关键投入要素，而各主体在技能上存在差异。主体通过匹配知识层次结构中的其他成员来组织生产，以便高效利用和传递知识。与自给自足状态相比，组织化会导致知识水平和工资水平的差异扩大：低技能工人学习和获得的报酬相对较少。我们指出，获取知识的技术的进步对工资不平等和组织化的影响与通信成本降低的影响相反。

abstract.text: A continuum of ages exists at school entry due to the use of a single school cutoff date—making the “oldest” children approximately 20 percent older than the “youngest” children. We provide substantial evidence that these initial maturity differences have long-lasting effects on student performance across OECD countries. In particular, the youngest members of each cohort score 4–12 percentiles lower than the oldest members in grade four and 2–9 percentiles lower in grade eight. In fact, data from Canada and the United States show that the youngest members of each cohort are even less likely to attend university.

10.1093/qje/121.4.1437.abstractZh: 由于采用单一的入学年龄标准，学校阶段存在明显的年龄差异——这使得“年龄最大的”儿童比“年龄最小的”儿童大约大20%。我们有大量证据表明，这种初始的成熟度差异会对学生在 OECD 国家的表现产生长期影响。具体而言，每个年级中年龄最小的成员在四年级时的成绩比年龄最大的成员低4到12个百分点，而在八年级时则低2到9个百分点。事实上，来自加拿大和美国的数据表明，每个年级中年龄最小的成员上大学的可能性甚至更低。

abstract.text: Empirically, disincentive effects on work of generous welfare state arrangements tend to appear with a substantial time lag. One explanation is that norms concerning work and benefit dependency delay such effects. We model altruistic parents' economic incentives for instilling such work norms in their children. Anticipated economic support from parents may reduce work effort, and parental altruism makes threats to withdraw such support noncredible. Instilling norms mitigates this problem. However, generous social insurance arrangements tend to weaken parents' incentives to instill such norms in their children. We find empirical support for this prediction.

10.1093/qje/121.4.1473.abstractZh: 从经验来看，福利制度对工作的抑制作用往往会在相当长的时间后才显现出来。一种解释是，关于工作和依赖福利的规范会延迟这些效应的出现。我们构建了利他型父母在子女身上灌输此类工作规范的的经济激励模型。父母预期的经济支持可能会降低子女的工作积极性，而父母的利他行为使得撤回这种支持的威胁变得不可信。灌输相关规范可以缓解这个问题。然而，完善的社会保险制度往往会削弱父母在子女身上灌输此类规范的动机。我们发现这一预测得到了实证支持。

abstract.text: We study dynamic optimal taxation in a class of economies with private information. Optimal allocations in these environments are complicated and history-dependent. Yet, we show that they can be implemented as competitive equilibria in market economies supplemented with simple tax systems. The market structure in these economies is similar to that in Bewley (1986); agents supply labour and trade risk-free claims to future consumption, subject to a budget constraint and a debt limit. Optimal taxes are conditioned only on two observable characteristics—an agent's accumulated stock of claims, or wealth, and her current labour income. We show that optimal taxes are generally non-linear and non-separable in these variables and relate the structure of marginal wealth and income taxation to the properties of agent preferences.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.00367.x.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个具有私人信息的经济类中的动态最优税收问题。在这些环境中，最优分配方案复杂且依赖于历史因素。然而，我们证明这些方案可以通过在市场经济中辅以简单的税收体系来实施，从而形成竞争均衡。这些经济体的市场结构与Bewley（1986）所描述的类似；代理人提供劳动力，并交易未来消费的风险无收益承诺，同时受到预算限制和债务上限的约束。最优税收仅取决于两个可观测特征——代理人的累积收益或财富，以及其当前的劳动收入。我们表明，最优税收通常是非线性的，并且这些变量之间是不可分割的。我们还研究了边际财富和收入税收结构与代理人偏好属性之间的关系。

abstract.text: A theoretical analysis is proposed of segregation as an equilibrium phenomenon in a random-matching model of the marriage market. Otherwise identical partners possess a pay-off-irrelevant characteristic, colour. We derive the set of colour-blind equilibria and show that they are generically constrained inefficient. Equilibrium segregation strategies are strategies that condition actions on the type of match. It is shown that distributions of types exist such that segregation equilibrium pay-offs Pareto dominate colour-blind pay-offs. For other distributions, segregation also generates conflict, where the majority unambiguously gains, while the minority group may lose. Giving preferential treatment, that is, minority bias, can increase overall welfare.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.00368.x.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种理论分析，探讨在随机匹配模型中的婚姻市场中，隔离作为一种均衡现象。具有完全相同特征的伴侣拥有一种与收益无关的特性——颜色。我们推导出了色盲均衡状态，并发现这些均衡状态通常是不高效的。均衡隔离策略是指根据匹配类型来制定行动策略。研究表明，存在某些匹配类型分布，使得隔离均衡的收益在帕累托意义上优于色盲均衡的收益。对于其他类型的匹配分布，隔离行为还会引发冲突，其中多数人会明显受益，而少数群体则可能受损。给予优先待遇，即少数群体的偏向，可以提高整体福利。

abstract.text: In a model where agents have unequal skills and heterogeneous preferences over consumption and leisure, we look for the optimal tax on the basis of efficiency and fairness principles and under incentive-compatibility constraints. The fairness principles considered here are: (1) a weak version of the Pigou—Dalton transfer principle; (2) a condition precluding redistribution when all agents have the same skills. With such principles we construct and justify specific social preferences and derive a simple criterion for the evaluation of income tax schedules. Namely, the lower the greatest average tax rate over the range of low incomes, the better. We show that, as a consequence, the optimal tax should give the greatest subsidies to the working poor (the agents having the lowest skill and choosing the largest labour time).

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.00369.x.abstractZh: 在一个代理人技能不等且对消费和休闲有不同偏好的模型中，我们基于效率和公平原则，并在激励相容性的约束下寻找最优税收方案。这里考虑的公平原则包括：(1) 弱版本的皮古-道尔顿转移原则；(2) 当所有代理人的技能相同时，禁止再分配的条件。基于这些原则，我们构建并证明特定的社会偏好，并推导出评估所得税表的简单标准。即，低收入范围内的最高平均税率越低越好。我们表明，因此，最优税收应给予工作贫困者最大的补贴（即技能最低且选择最长劳动时间的代理人）。

abstract.text: This paper suggests that the demise of the capitalists—workers class structure was a socio-economic transformation orchestrated by the capitalists in reaction to the increasing importance of human capital in sustaining their profit rates. Physical capital accumulation in the process of industrialization enhanced the importance of human capital in production and generated incentives for capitalists to support the provision of public education for the masses, triggering the demise of the existing class structure. The implications of the theory are consistent with the voting patterns on England's education reform of 1902.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.00370.x.abstractZh: 本文认为，资本家阶级的衰落是经济社会结构发生转变的结果，这一转变是由资本家为了应对人力资本在维持利润率方面日益重要的作用而策划的。在工业化过程中，物质资本的积累增强了人力资本在生产中的重要性，同时也激励了资本家支持公共教育的发展，从而导致了现有阶级结构的瓦解。该理论的观点与1902年英国教育改革中的投票模式相吻合。

abstract.text: I analyse the emergence of property rights in a model of conflict and production in the absence of institutions of enforcement. The population of agents evolves dynamically through conflicts for possession of factor goods among pairs of randomly matched agents. Conflicts are incomplete information wars of attrition with an agent's type consisting of his or her independently drawn valuation of the prize and cost of competing for it. I prove equilibrium existence and show that in the steady state of the game, the population sorts into two stable groups (resource “haves” and “have-nots”) in accordance with a known function of their primitive types.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.00371.x.abstractZh: 我分析了一种在没有执行机构的情况下，财产权利如何出现的模型。代理人群体通过冲突动态演化，这些冲突是争夺生产要素的博弈，参与博弈的代理人是随机匹配的。这些冲突属于不完全信息下的消耗战，每个代理人的类型由其对奖励的估值以及争夺该奖励的成本决定。我证明了均衡的存在，并表明在博弈的稳态下，代理人群体会分为两个稳定的群体——资源“拥有者”和“无拥有者”，这一划分与它们原始类型的已知函数关系相符。

abstract.text: I estimate a model in which new technology entails random adjustment needs. Rapid adjustments may cause measured productivity to decline. The slow-downs persist because adjustment is costly, and hence protracted. The model explains both the “steepness” and the “deepness” asymmetry of cycles. Adjustment costs amount to about 14% of output and technological inefficiency to about 28%. Firms abandon technologies long before they are perfected—current practice total factor productivity (TFP) is 20% below its maximal level.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.00372.x.abstractZh: 我提出了一个模型，该模型认为新技术的引入会导致随机的调整需求。快速的调整可能会导致实际生产率下降。调整过程的持续是因为调整成本较高，因此过程会持续较长时间。该模型解释了周期中“陡峭度”与“深度”的不对称性。调整成本约占产出的14%，而技术效率低下则约占28%。企业在技术完善之前就会放弃该技术——当前全要素生产率比其最高水平低20%。

abstract.text: Using data from the Consumer Expenditure Survey, we first document that the recent increase in income inequality in the U.S. has not been accompanied by a corresponding rise in consumption inequality. Much of this divergence is due to different trends in within-group inequality, which has increased significantly for income, but little for consumption. We then develop a simple framework that allows us to characterize analytically how within-group income inequality affects consumption inequality in a world in which agents can trade a full set of contingent consumption claims, subject to endogenous constraints emanating from the limited enforcement of intertemporal contracts. Finally, we quantitatively evaluate, in the context of a calibrated general equilibrium production economy, whether this set-up, or alternatively a standard incomplete markets model, can account for the documented stylized consumption inequality facts from the U.S. data.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.00373.x.abstractZh: 通过消费者支出调查的数据，我们首先发现美国近期收入不平等的加剧并未伴随着消费不平等的相应上升。这种差异很大程度上是由于组内不平等趋势的不同：收入方面的不平等显著增加，而消费方面的不平等则几乎没有变化。随后，我们提出了一个简单的框架，用于分析在代理人可以交易一系列条件性消费需求的条件下，组内收入不平等如何影响消费不平等。这一框架基于来自时间间契约执行有限性的内生约束。最后，我们在一个经过校准的一般均衡生产经济模型中，定量评估了这种设定或标准的不完全市场模型是否能够解释美国数据中记录的消费不平等现象。

abstract.text: This paper generalizes the standard habit-formation model to an environment in which agents form habits over individual varieties of goods as opposed to over a composite consumption good. We refer to this preference specification as “deep habit formation”. Under deep habits, the demand function faced by individual producers depends on past sales. This feature is typically assumed ad hoc in customer-market and brand-switching-cost models. A central result of the paper is that deep habits give rise to countercyclical mark-ups, which is in line with the empirical evidence. This result is important, because ad hoc formulations of customer-market and switching-cost models have been criticized for implying procyclical and hence counterfactual mark-up movements. Under deep habits, consumption and wages respond procyclically to government-spending shocks. The paper provides econometric estimates of the parameters pertaining to the deep-habit model.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.00374.x.abstractZh: 本文将标准习惯形成模型推广到一种环境中，在这种环境中，代理人形成的是针对不同种类的商品的习惯，而非针对一种复合消费商品的习惯。我们将这种偏好规范称为“深度习惯形成”。在深度习惯下，个体生产者面临的需求函数取决于过去的销售情况。这一特征通常在客户市场与品牌转换成本模型中被临时假设。本文的一个核心结论是，深度习惯会导致反周期性的加价行为，这与实证证据是一致的。这一结论非常重要，因为客户市场与转换成本模型的临时设定方式曾受到批评，因为它们暗示了顺周期性的加价行为，从而与实际情况不符。在深度习惯下，消费和工资会对政府支出的冲击产生顺周期性的反应。本文还提供了与深度习惯模型相关的参数的计量经济学估计结果。

abstract.text: This paper derives a concept of aggregate real income for a competitive economy in general equilibrium consisting of heterogeneous infinitely lived people and relates it to current and future consumption possibilities. An important characteristic of our measure of income, which we call Real Income, is that deflation is carried out using a consumption deflator rather than any price index of output. We suggest that it may be inappropriate to regard capital gains as income. We also present a coherent treatment of the effects of changes to the terms of trade on Real Income and explain the implications of this for resource-exporting economies.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.00375.x.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种针对竞争经济的一般均衡下的总实际收入概念，该经济由具有不同寿命的异质个体构成，并将这一概念与当前和未来的消费可能性联系起来。我们所称的实际收入的一个重要特点是，通缩是通过消费平减指数而非任何产出价格指数来衡量的。我们认为，将资本收益视为收入可能并不恰当。此外，本文还提出了一种对贸易条件变化对实际收入影响的连贯解释，并阐明了这对资源出口型经济体的影响。

abstract.text: We propose a coherent unified approach to the study of the linkages among economic growth, financial structure, and inequality, bringing together disparate theoretical and empirical literature. That is, we show how to conduct model-based quantitative research on transitional paths. With analytical and numerical methods, we calibrate and make tractable a prototype canonical model and take it to an application, namely, Thailand 1976–1996, an emerging market economy in a phase of economic expansion with uneven financial deepening and increasing inequality. We look at the expected path generated by the model and conduct robustness experiments. Because the actual path of the Thai economy is imagined here to be just one realization of many possible histories of the model economy, we construct a covariance-normalized squared error metric of closeness and find the best-fit simulation. We also construct a confidence region from a set of simulations and formally test the model. We broadly replicate the actual data and identify anomalies.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.00376.x.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种连贯统一的研究方法，用于探讨经济增长、金融结构与不平等之间的关系，将不同的理论和实证文献整合在一起。也就是说，我们展示了如何基于模型进行定量研究，以分析过渡路径。通过分析和数值方法，我们校准并简化了原型规范模型，并将其应用于1976至1996年的泰国经济案例，这是一个处于经济扩张阶段的新兴市场经济体，其金融深化程度不均衡，不平等现象日益严重。我们分析了模型所预测的经济发展路径，并进行了稳健性实验。由于泰国经济的实际发展路径只是模型经济多种可能历史中的一种表现，我们构建了一种基于协方差标准化的平方误差度量方法，以确定最佳拟合模拟结果。我们还从一系列模拟结果中构建了一个置信区间，并正式检验了模型的有效性。我们广泛复制了实际数据，并发现了异常情况。

abstract.text: This paper is motivated by the empirical regularity that industries differ greatly in the level of firm turnover, and that entry and exit rates are positively correlated across industries. Our objective is to investigate the effect of sunk costs and, in particular, market size on entry and exit rates, and hence on the age distribution of firms. We analyze a stochastic dynamic model of a monopolistically competitive industry. Each firm's efficiency is assumed to follow a Markov process. We show existence and uniqueness of a stationary equilibrium with simultaneous entry and exit: efficient firms survive while inefficient ones leave the market and are replaced by new entrants. We perform comparative dynamics with respect to the level of sunk costs: entry costs are negatively and fixed production costs positively related to entry and exit rates. A central empirical prediction of the model is that the level of firm turnover is increasing in market size. The intuition is as follows. In larger markets, price-cost margins are smaller since the number of active firms is larger. This implies that the marginal surviving firm has to be more efficient than in smaller markets. Hence, in larger markets, the expected life span of firms is shorter, and the age distribution of firms is first-order stochastically dominated by that in smaller markets. In an extension of the model with time-varying market size, we explore the comovements between market size and entry and exit rates. It is shown that both entry and exit rates tend to rise over time in growing markets. In the empirical part, the prediction on market size and firm turnover is tested on industries where firms compete in well-defined geographical markets of different sizes. Using data on hair salons in Sweden, we show that an increase in market size or fixed costs shifts the age distribution of firms towards younger firms, as predicted by the model.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.00377.x.abstractZh: 本文的动机源于一个经验性规律：不同行业的企业周转率存在显著差异，且行业间的进入与退出率呈正相关。我们的研究目标是探讨沉没成本以及市场规模对进入与退出率的影响，进而分析企业年龄分布的变化。我们研究了一个垄断竞争行业的随机动态模型。假设每家企业的效率遵循马尔可夫过程。我们证明了存在唯一的一个稳态均衡状态，在这种状态下，企业会同时进入和退出市场：效率高的企业能够存活下来，而效率低的企业则会退出市场，并被新进入的企业所取代。我们还将模型与沉没成本水平进行了比较：进入成本与退出率呈负相关，而固定生产成本则与退出率呈正相关。该模型的一个核心经验预测是，企业周转率随着市场规模的增加而上升。其直觉是：在更大的市场中，由于活跃企业的数量更多，价格与成本之间的差距更小。这意味着，在更大市场中，存活下来的企业必须比在较小市场中更有效率。因此，在更大市场中，企业的预期寿命更短，企业年龄分布首先受到较小市场规模的影响。在模型扩展版本中，我们探讨了市场规模与进入和退出率之间的相关性。结果显示，在增长的市场中，进入和退出率往往会随时间上升。在实证部分，我们对市场规模与企业周转率之间的预测进行了检验，这些检验是在那些企业在不同规模的地理市场中竞争的行业进行的。通过瑞典理发店的数据分析，我们发现市场规模的扩大或固定成本的降低会使企业的年龄分布向更年轻的方向转变，这与模型预测的结果一致。

abstract.text: The identification of aggregate human-capital externalities is still not fully understood. The existing (Mincerian) approach confounds positive externalities with wage changes due to a downward sloping demand curve for human capital. As a result, the Mincerian approach yields positive externalities even when wages equal marginal social products. We propose an approach that identifies human-capital externalities, whether or not aggregate demand for human capital slopes downward. Another advantage of our approach is that it does not require estimates of the individual return to human capital. Applications to U.S. cities and states between 1970 and 1990 yield no evidence of significant average-schooling externalities.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.00380.x.abstractZh: 关于人力资本外部性的识别仍然尚未完全理解。现有的（Mincerian）方法将正外部性与因人力资本需求曲线向下倾斜而导致的工资变化混淆了。因此，即使工资等于边际社会产品，Mincerian方法仍然会得出正外部性的结论。我们提出了一种方法，能够识别人力资本外部性，无论人力资本总需求是否呈下降趋势。我们方法的另一个优势是，它不需要对个体人力资本回报进行估计。对1970年至1990年间美国城市和州的数据分析表明，不存在显著的平均学校教育外部性。

abstract.text: This paper models an agent in a three-period setting who does not update according to Bayes' Rule and who is self-aware and anticipates her updating behaviour when formulating plans. Gul and Pesendorfer's theory of temptation and self-control is a key building block. The main result is a representation theorem that generalizes (the dynamic version of) Anscombe-Aumann's theorem so that both the prior and the way in which it is updated are subjective. The model can accommodate updating biases analogous to those observed by psychologists.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.00381.x.abstractZh: 本文模拟了一个在三周期环境下行动的代理人，该代理人不会根据贝叶斯规则进行更新，并且具有自我意识，能够预见到自己在制定计划时的更新行为。Gul和Pesendorfer关于诱惑与自我控制的理论是本文的关键基础。主要结果是一个表示定理，该定理推广了Anscombe-Aumann定理的动态版本，使得先验信息及其更新方式都是主观的。该模型能够容纳类似于心理学家观察到的更新偏差。

abstract.text: A monetary union is modelled as a technology that makes a surprise policy deviation impossible and requires voluntarily participating countries to follow the same monetary policy. Within a fully dynamic context, we show that such an arrangement may dominate a regime with independent national currencies. Two new results are delivered by the voluntary participation assumption. First, the optimal plan is shown to respond to a country's temptation to leave the union by tilting both current and future policy in its favour. This yields a non-linear rule according to which each country weight in policy decisions is time-varying and depends on its incentive to abandon the union. Second, we show that there might be conditions such that a break-up of the union, as has occurred in some historical episodes, is efficient. The paper thus provides a first formal analysis of the incentives behind the formation, sustainability, and disruption of a monetary union.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.00382.x.abstractZh: 货币联盟被建模为一种技术，这种技术使得突然的政策偏离变得不可能，并要求自愿参与的国家遵循相同的货币政策。在一个完全动态的背景下，我们表明这样的安排可能会主导一个拥有独立国家货币的制度。自愿参与假设带来了两个新的结果。首先，最优计划被证明能够应对一个国家想要脱离联盟的诱惑，通过倾斜当前和未来的政策来使其受益。这产生了一个非线性规则，根据该规则，每个国家在政策决策中的权重随时间变化，并取决于其脱离联盟的动机。其次，我们表明，可能存在一些条件，使得联盟的破裂（如历史上某些情况下发生的那样）是有效的。因此，本文首次对货币联盟的形成、可持续性和破裂背后的动机进行了正式分析。

abstract.text: This paper argues that both unequal opportunity and social mobility are necessary implications of an efficient societal arrangement when incentives must be provided.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.00384.x.abstractZh: 本文认为，在必须提供激励的情况下，机会的不平等和社会流动性是高效社会安排的必要结果。

abstract.text: This paper studies the assignment of people to projects over time in a model with private information. The combination of risk neutrality with incomplete contracts that restrict the ability of an agent to report on interim states is a force for long-term assignments. More generally, however, rotating agents can be valuable because it conceals information from agents, which mitigates incentive constraints. With complete contracts that communicate interim states, rotation allows for even more concealment possibilities and better-targeted incentives. Furthermore, it allows for the reporting of interim shocks at no cost to the principal. Properties of the production technology are also shown to matter. Substitutability of intertemporal effort is a force for long-term assignments, while coordination with Nash equilibrium strategies is a force for job rotation.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.00386.x.abstractZh: 本文研究了一个具有私人信息的模型中，人们如何随时间被分配到不同的项目中。风险中立性与不完全契约的结合，限制了代理人报告中期状态的能力，这成为长期分配的一种驱动力。然而，更普遍地来说，代理人之间的轮换是有价值的，因为它能够隐藏信息，从而缓解激励约束。而完备的契约能够传达中期状态，则使得轮换能够进一步隐藏信息，并提供更精准的激励措施。此外，它还允许在不增加委托人的成本的情况下报告中期冲击。生产技术的特性也显示出其重要性。跨期努力的可替代性促进了长期分配，而与纳什均衡策略的协调则促进了工作轮换。

abstract.text: This paper models and estimates net urban agglomeration economies for cities. Economic models of cities postulate an inverted U shape of real income per worker against city employment, where the inverted U shifts with industrial composition across the urban hierarchy of cities. This relationship has never been estimated, in part because of data requirements. China has the necessary data and context. We find that urban agglomeration benefits are high—real incomes per worker rise sharply with increases in city size from a low level. They level out nearer the peak and then decline very slowly past the peak. We find that a large fraction of cities in China are undersized due to nationally imposed, strong migration restrictions, resulting in large income losses.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.00387.x.abstractZh: 本文对城市的城市群经济效应进行了建模和估计。城市经济模型假设每个工人的实际收入与城市就业数量呈倒U形关系，且这种倒U形关系会随着城市等级结构的工业构成而变化。这一关系此前从未被估算过，部分原因是数据需求的限制。中国拥有必要的数据和背景信息。我们发现，城市群带来的收益很高——每个工人的实际收入随着城市规模的增加而显著上升，在较低水平时开始上升，在峰值附近趋于平稳，之后则缓慢下降。我们还发现，由于国家实施的严格移民限制，中国许多城市的规模偏小，导致较大的收入损失。

abstract.text: We present a multiperiod agency model of stock-based executive compensation in a speculative stock market, where investors have heterogeneous beliefs and stock prices may deviate from underlying fundamentals and include a speculative option component. This component arises from the option to sell the stock in the future to potentially overoptimistic investors. We show that optimal compensation contracts may emphasize short-term stock performance, at the expense of long-run fundamental value, as an incentive to induce managers to pursue actions which increase the speculative component in the stock price. Our model provides a different perspective on the recent corporate crisis than the “rent extraction view” of executive compensation.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.00388.x.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个基于多期代理模型的股票型高管薪酬模型，该模型适用于投机性股票市场，其中投资者持有不同的信念，股票价格可能会偏离基本面，并包含投机性期权成分。这一成分源于未来向过于乐观的投资者出售股票的期权。我们指出，最优的薪酬合同可能会强调短期股票表现，而牺牲长期的基本面价值，以此激励管理者采取增加股票价格中投机性成分的行动。我们的模型为最近的企业危机提供了不同于“租金提取观点”的视角。

abstract.text: This paper studies the nature of capital adjustment at the plant level. We use an indirect inference procedure to estimate the structural parameters of a rich specification of capital adjustment costs. In effect, the parameters are optimally chosen to reproduce a set of moments that capture the non-linear relationship between investment and profitability found in plant-level data. Our findings indicate that a model, which mixes both convex and non-convex adjustment costs, fits the data best.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.00389.x.abstractZh: 本文研究了工厂层面资本调整的性质。我们采用间接推断方法，来估计资本调整成本模型的参数。实际上，这些参数的选择是为了再现工厂层面数据中投资与盈利能力之间的非线性关系。我们的研究结果表明，一个结合了凸形和非凸形调整成本的模型，能够最好地拟合数据。

abstract.text: This paper proposes a procedure to test for the correct specification of the functional form of the volatility process within the class of eigenfunction stochastic volatility models. The procedure is based on the comparison of the moments of realized volatility measures with the corresponding ones of integrated volatility implied by the model under the null hypothesis. We first provide primitive conditions on the measurement error associated with the realized measure, which allow to construct asymptotically valid specification tests. Then we establish regularity conditions under which the considered realized measures, namely, realized volatility, bipower variation, and modified subsampled realized volatility, satisfy the given primitive assumptions. Finally, we provide an empirical illustration based on three stocks from the Dow Jones Industrial Average.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.00390.x.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种程序，用于检验特征函数随机波动模型中的波动过程功能形式的正确指定。该程序基于将实际波动度量的矩与模型在零假设下所暗示的积分波动度量的相应矩进行比较。我们首先提出了与实际度量相关的测量误差的原始条件，这些条件允许构建渐近有效的指定检验。然后，我们建立了考虑的实际度量——即实际波动、双功率变异和修正的子采样实际波动——满足给定原始假设的规律性条件。最后，我们基于道琼斯工业平均指数中的三只股票提供了实证示例。

abstract.text: We report the results of an experiment in which subjects play games against changing opponents. In one treatment, “senders” send “receivers” messages indicating intended actions in that round, and receivers observe senders' previous-round actions (when matched with another receiver). In another treatment, the receiver additionally observes the sender's previous-round message to the previous opponent, enabling him to determine whether the sender had lied. We find that allowing multiple signals leads to better outcomes when signals are aligned (all pointing to the same action), but worse outcomes when signals are crossed. Also, senders' signals tend to be truthful, though the degree of truthfulness depends on the game and treatment, and receivers' behaviour combines elements of pay-off maximization and reciprocity.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.00391.x.abstractZh: 我们报告了一项实验的结果，实验中参与者需要与不断变化的对手进行游戏。在一种处理方案中，“发送者”向“接收者”发送信息，告知该轮次的预期行动，而接收者则观察发送者上一轮的行动（当与另一个接收者匹配时）。在另一种处理方案中，接收者还会观察发送者之前对上一对手发送的信息，从而判断发送者是否撒了谎。我们发现，当信号一致时（所有信号都指向相同的行动），允许多个信号会带来更好的结果；而当信号交叉时，结果则会变差。此外，发送者的信号往往具有真实性，不过真实性的程度取决于游戏和处理方案的不同，而接收者的行为则结合了收益最大化原则和互惠原则。

abstract.text: In standard contract-theoretic models, the underlying assumption is that agent types differ in their preference or cost parameters, and the principal's objective is to design contracts in order to screen this type. We study a contract-theoretic model in which the heterogeneity among agent types is of a “cognitive” nature. In our model, the agent has dynamically inconsistent preferences. Agent types differ only in their degree of “sophistication”, that is, their ability to forecast the change in their future tastes. We fully characterize the menu of contracts which the principal offers in order to screen the agent's sophistication. The menu does not exclude any type: it provides a perfect commitment device for relatively sophisticated types, and “exploitative” contracts which involve speculation with relatively naive types. More naive types are more heavily exploited and generate a greater profit for the principal. Our results allow us to interpret real-life contractual arrangements in a variety of industries.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.00392.x.abstractZh: 在标准的契约理论模型中，基本的假设是各类型代理人的偏好或成本参数存在差异，而委托人的目标是通过设计契约来筛选这些类型。我们研究了一个契约理论模型，其中代理人类型的差异具有“认知”性质。在我们的模型中，代理人具有动态不一致的偏好。不同类型的代理人仅在“复杂性”程度上有所不同，即他们预测未来需求变化的能力。我们详细描述了委托人为了筛选代理人的复杂性而提供的契约选项。这些契约选项并不排除任何类型：它为相对复杂的类型提供了完美的承诺机制，同时也为涉及相对简单类型进行投机行为的“剥削性”契约提供了可能。较为简单的类型更容易被剥削，从而为委托人带来更大的利润。我们的研究结果使我们能够解释现实生活中的各种行业中的契约安排。

abstract.text: Standard theoretical arguments tell us that countries with relatively little capital benefit from financial integration as foreign capital flows in and speeds up the process of convergence. We show in a calibrated neoclassical model that conventionally measured welfare gains from this type of convergence appear relatively limited for the typical emerging country. The welfare gain from switching from financial autarky to perfect capital mobility is roughly equivalent to a 1% permanent increase in domestic consumption for the typical emerging economy. This is negligible relative to the potential welfare gain of a take-off in domestic productivity of the magnitude observed in some countries.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.00393.x.abstractZh: 标准理论观点认为，资本相对匮乏的国家可以从金融一体化中受益，因为外国资本的流入会加速趋同进程。我们在一个经过校准的新古典模型中指出，这种趋同所带来的传统意义上的福利增益对于典型的新兴经济体来说相对有限。从金融自给自足状态转向完全资本流动状态所带来的福利增益，大约相当于国内消费增加1%，这一数值与一些国家所观察到的国内生产力提升所带来的潜在福利增益相比微不足道。

abstract.text: This paper characterizes optimal non-linear income taxation in an economy with a continuum of unobservable productivity levels and endogenous involuntary unemployment due to frictions in the labour markets. Redistributive taxation distorts labour demand and wages. Compared to their efficient values, gross wages, unemployment, and participation are lower. Average tax rates are increasing. Marginal tax rates are positive, even at the top. Finally, numerical simulations suggest that redistribution is much more important in our setting than in a comparable Mirrlees-type setting.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.00394.x.abstractZh: 本文描述了在具有连续可观测生产力水平的经济体中，由于劳动力市场中的摩擦导致非自愿失业，最优的非线性所得税制度。再分配性税收会扭曲劳动力需求和工资。与它们的有效价值相比，总工资、失业率和参与率都较低。平均税率正在上升。边际税率即使在最高收入群体中也呈正值。最后，数值模拟表明，在我们的设定中，再分配的重要性远高于类似Mirrlees类型的设定。

abstract.text: We use experiments to examine whether the auctioning of entry rights affects the behaviour of market entrants. Standard economic arguments suggest that the licence fee paid at the auction will not affect pricing since it constitutes a sunk cost. This argument is not uncontested though, and this paper puts it to an experimental test. Our results indicate that an auction of entry licences has a significant positive effect on average prices in oligopoly but not in monopoly. These results are consistent with the conjecture that entry fees induce players to take more risk in pursuit of higher expected profits. In oligopoly, entry fees increase the probability that the market entrants coordinate on a collusive price path. In monopoly, taking more risk does not make sense since average prices are already close to the profit-maximizing price.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.00395.x.abstractZh: 我们通过实验来研究拍卖进入权是否会影响市场新进入者的行为。标准的经济理论表明，拍卖中支付的许可费不会影响定价，因为这是一种沉没成本。不过，这一论点并非没有争议，本文对此进行了实验验证。我们的结果表明，在寡头垄断中，进入权的拍卖对平均价格有显著的积极影响，而在垄断中则没有这种效应。这些结果与“进入费促使参与者为了追求更高的预期利润而承担更多风险”的假设一致。在寡头垄断中，进入费增加了市场新进入者协同制定勾结性价格路径的可能性；而在垄断中，承担更多风险是没有意义的，因为平均价格已经接近利润最大化价格。

abstract.text: I present and solve the problem of a producer who faces costs of acquiring, absorbing, and processing information. I establish a series of theoretical results describing the producer's behaviour. First, I find the conditions under which the producer prefers to set a plan for the price he or she charges, or instead prefers to set a plan for the quantity he or she sells. Second, I show that the agent rationally chooses to be inattentive to news, only sporadically updating his or her information. I solve for the optimal length of inattentiveness and characterize its determinants. Third, I explicitly aggregate the behaviour of many such producers. I apply these results to a model of inflation. I find that the model can fit the quantitative facts on post-war inflation remarkably well, that it is a good forecaster of future inflation, and that it survives the Lucas critique by fitting also the pre-war facts on inflation moderately well.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.00396.x.abstractZh: 我提出并解决了生产者面临获取、吸收和处理信息成本的问题。我建立了一系列理论结果来描述生产者的行为。首先，我找到了生产者倾向于选择制定价格计划还是销售数量计划的条件。其次，我表明代理人理性地选择对新闻保持不关注，只是偶尔更新其信息。我计算了最优不关注时间长度，并确定了其决定因素。第三，我明确汇总了许多此类生产者的行为。我将这些结果应用于通货膨胀模型。我发现该模型能够非常准确地拟合战后通货膨胀的定量数据，是未来通货膨胀的良好预测工具，并且能够通过拟合战前通货膨胀的定量数据而经受住卢卡斯批判的检验。

abstract.text: Traditional asset pricing models predict that covariance between prices of different assets should be lower than what we observe in the data. This paper introduces markets for information that generate high price covariance within a rational expectations framework. When information is costly, rational investors only buy information about a subset of the assets. Because information production has high fixed costs, competitive producers charge more for low-demand information than for high-demand information. The low price of high-demand information makes investors want to purchase the same information that others are purchasing. When investors price assets using a common subset of information, news about one asset affects the other assets' prices; asset prices comove. The cross-sectional and time-series properties of comovement are consistent with this explanation.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.00397.x.abstractZh: 传统的资产定价模型预测，不同资产价格之间的协方差应该低于实际数据中的观测值。本文介绍了一种信息市场模型，该模型在理性预期框架内产生了较高的资产价格协方差。当信息成本较高时，理性投资者只会购买与资产子集相关的信息。由于信息产生的固定成本较高，竞争性的信息提供者会对低需求信息收取更高的费用，而对高需求信息则收取较低的费用。高需求信息的低价格使得投资者倾向于购买其他人正在购买的信息。当投资者使用共同的资产子集来定价时，某一资产的新闻会影响到其他资产的价格，从而导致资产价格出现共同变动。这种共同变动的截面和时间序列特性与这一解释是一致的。

abstract.text: We develop a model of undescribable events. Examples of events that are well understood by economic agents but are prohibitively difficult to describe in advance abound in real-life. This notion has also pervaded a substantial amount of economic literature. We put forth a model of such events using a simple co-insurance problem as backdrop. Undescribable events in our model are understood by economic agents - their consequences and probabilities are known - but are such that every finite description of such events necessarily leaves out relevant features that have a non-negligible impact on the parties' expected utilities. We also show that two key ingredients of our model - probabilities that are finitely additive but fail countable additivity, and a state space that is small (discrete in our model) in a measure-theoretic sense - are necessary ingredients of any model of undescribable events that delivers our results.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.00399.x.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个描述无法描述的事件的模型。在现实生活中，有许多事件虽然被经济主体所理解，但事先却难以描述。这一概念也广泛存在于大量的经济文献中。我们基于一个简单的共同保险问题，提出了这种事件的模型。在我们的模型中，无法描述的事件被经济主体所理解——其后果和概率都是已知的——但任何对这类事件的有限描述都会遗漏对各方预期效用有不可忽视影响的相关特征。我们还表明，我们模型的两个关键要素——概率具有有限可加性但缺乏可数可加性，以及状态空间在测度论意义上较小（在我们的模型中是离散的）——是任何能够产生我们结果的无法描述事件模型所必需的要素。

abstract.text: We analyse a model of equilibrium directed search in a large labour market. Each worker, observing the wages posted at all vacancies, makes a fixed, finite number of applications, a. We allow for the possibility of ex post competition should more than one vacancy want to hire the same worker. For each a, there is a unique symmetric equilibrium in which all vacancies post the same wage. When a = 1, the common posted wage lies between the competitive and monopsony levels, and equilibrium is efficient. When a > 1, all vacancies post the monopsony wage. Some workers fail to find a job, some find a job at the monopsony wage, and some—those for whom there is competition—get the competitive wage. Equilibrium is inefficient when a > 1; in particular, there is excessive vacancy creation.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.00400.x.abstractZh: 我们分析了一个关于大型劳动力市场中定向搜索均衡的模型。每个工人都会查看所有职位发布的工资，然后做出固定次数的申请。我们考虑了当多个职位都想雇佣同一工人时，可能会出现的事后竞争的情况。对于每一次申请，都存在一个唯一的对称均衡状态，在这种状态下，所有职位发布的工资都是相同的。当申请次数为1时，共同发布的工资介于竞争水平和垄断工资之间，此时均衡是有效的。当申请次数大于1时，所有职位发布的工资都是垄断工资。有些工人找不到工作，有些工人以垄断工资找到工作，而那些面临竞争的人则获得竞争工资。当申请次数大于1时，均衡是无效的；特别是，会出现过多的职位空缺。

abstract.text: We propose a method to test a prediction of the distribution of a stochastic process. In a non-Bayesian, non-parametric setting, a predicted distribution is tested using a realization of the stochastic process. A test associates a set of realizations for each predicted distribution, on which the prediction passes, so that if there are no type I errors, a prediction assigns probability 1 to its test set. Nevertheless, these test sets can be “small”, in the sense that “most” distributions assign it probability 0, and hence there are “few” type II errors. It is also shown that there exists such a test that cannot be manipulated, in the sense that an uninformed predictor, who is pretending to know the true distribution, is guaranteed to fail on an uncountable number of realizations, no matter what randomized prediction he employs. The notion of a small set we use is category I, described in more detail in the paper.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.00401.x.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种方法来检验随机过程分布预测。在非贝叶斯、非参数化的环境中，通过随机过程的实现来检验预测分布。该检验为每个预测分布关联一组实现结果，如果预测成立，则该测试集的概率为1。然而，这些测试集可能“规模较小”，因为“大多数”分布将其概率设为0，因此“第二类错误”较少。此外，我们还证明了存在一种不可操纵的测试，即一个不知情的预测者，即使他试图了解真实分布，也将在无数个实现结果上失败，无论他采用何种随机预测方法。我们使用的“小集合”概念属于第一类错误，具体描述详见本文。

abstract.text: There are a large number of tests for instability or breaks in coefficients in regression models designed for different possible departures from the stable model. We make two contributions to this literature. First, we consider a large class of persistent breaking processes that lead to asymptotically equivalent efficient tests. Our class allows for many or relatively few breaks, clustered breaks, regularly occurring breaks, or smooth transitions to changes in the regression coefficients. Thus, asymptotically nothing is gained by knowing the exact breaking process of the class. Second, we provide a test statistic that is simple to compute, avoids any need for searching over high dimensions when there are many breaks, is valid for a wide range of data-generating processes and has good power and size properties even in heteroscedastic models.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.00402.x.abstractZh: 针对回归模型中可能出现的各种不稳定性或系数断裂情况，存在大量相关测试。我们在这一领域做出了两项贡献。首先，我们考虑了一类持久性的断裂过程，这些过程能够产生渐近等价的高效测试。我们的分类允许存在许多或相对少量的断裂、聚集的断裂、周期性出现的断裂，或是回归系数变化的平滑过渡。因此，了解该分类的确切断裂过程在渐近意义上并不会带来任何优势。其次，我们提供了一种计算简单的测试统计量，当存在大量断裂时，无需进行高维搜索，且该统计量适用于广泛的数据生成过程，并且在异方差模型中仍具有良好的功效和统计性质。

abstract.text: We introduce non-homothetic preferences into an innovation-based growth model and study how income and wealth inequality affect economic growth. We identify a (positive) price effect—where increasing inequality allows innovators to charge higher prices and (negative) market-size effects—with higher inequality implying smaller markets for new goods and/or a slower transition of new goods into mass markets. It turns out that price effects dominate market-size effects. We also show that a redistribution from the poor to the rich may be Pareto improving for low levels of inequality.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.00403.x.abstractZh: 我们将非同伦偏好引入基于创新的成长模型中，研究收入与财富不平等如何影响经济增长。我们发现存在一种（正向的）价格效应——不平等程度越高，创新者就能收取更高的价格；同时还存在一种（负向的）市场规模效应——不平等程度越高，新产品的市场规模越小，新产品进入大众市场的过程也会更加缓慢。结果表明，价格效应对市场规模效应的影响更为显著。我们还指出，从穷人向富人的财富再分配，在较低的不平等水平下可能带来帕累托改进效应。

abstract.text: We examine the relevance of an auction format in a competitive environment by comparing uniform and discriminatory price auctions with many bidders in a private values setting. We show that if the number of objects for sale is small relative to the number of bidders, then all equilibria of both auctions are approximately efficient and lead to approximately the same revenue. When the number of objects for sale is proportional to the number of bidders, then the particulars of the auction format matter. All equilibria of the uniform auction are efficient, while all of the equilibria of the discriminatory auction are inefficient. The relative revenue rankings of the auction formats can go in either direction, depending on the specifics of the environment. These conclusions regarding the efficiency and revenue ranking are in contrast to the previous literature, which focused on the case of independent information across agents.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.00404.x.abstractZh: 我们通过比较统一拍卖和歧视性拍卖在多个投标者参与下的竞争环境中的相关性，来研究拍卖形式的重要性。我们发现，如果待售物品数量相对于投标者数量较少，那么两种拍卖的所有均衡都大致有效，并且产生的收入也大致相同。而当待售物品数量与投标者数量成正比时，拍卖形式的具体特点就变得重要起来。统一拍卖的所有均衡都是有效的，而歧视性拍卖的所有均衡则都是无效的。拍卖形式的相对收入排名可能向任一方向变化，这取决于具体环境的特点。这些关于效率和收入排名的结论与以往的研究有所不同，以往的研究主要关注了代理之间信息独立的情况。

abstract.text: This paper proposes an aggregative model of total factor productivity (TFP) in the spirit of Houthakker (1955–1956). It considers a frictional labour market where production units are subject to idiosyncratic shocks and jobs are created and destroyed as in Mortensen and Pissarides (1994). An aggregate production function is derived by aggregating across micro-production units in equilibrium. The level of TFP is explicitly shown to depend on the underlying distribution of shocks as well as on all the characteristics of the labour market as summarized by the job-destruction decision. The model is also used to study the effects of labour-market policies on the level of measured TFP.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.00405.x.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种以Houthakker（1955–1956）思想为灵感的总因素生产率聚合模型。该模型考虑了一个摩擦性劳动力市场，其中生产单位受到特定冲击的影响，就业岗位的创造与消失类似于Mortensen和Pissarides（1994）所描述的情景。通过均衡状态下对微观生产单位进行聚合，得到了总生产函数。研究明确表明，总因素生产率的水平不仅取决于冲击的基本分布，还取决于劳动力市场的所有特征，这些特征通过岗位消灭决策得以体现。该模型还用于研究劳动力市场政策对测量到的总因素生产率水平的影响。

abstract.text: This paper studies how changes in the two key parameters of unemployment insurance—the benefit replacement rate (RR) and the potential benefit duration (PBD)—affect the duration of unemployment. To identify such an effect we exploit a policy change introduced in 1989 by the Austrian government, which affected various unemployed workers differently: a first group experienced an increase in RR; a second group experienced an extension of PBD; a third group experienced both a higher RR and a longer PBD; and a fourth group experienced no change in the policy parameters. We find that unemployed workers react to the disincentives by an increase in unemployment duration, and our empirical results are consistent with the predictions of job search theory. We use our parameter estimates to split up the total costs to unemployment insurance funds into costs due to changes in the unemployment insurance system with unchanged behaviour and costs due to behavioural responses of unemployed workers. Our results indicate that costs due to behavioural responses are substantial.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.00406.x.abstractZh: 本文研究了失业保险两个关键参数——福利替代率（RR）和潜在福利持续时间（PBD）的变化如何影响失业持续时间。为了识别这种影响，我们利用了奥地利政府在1989年引入的一项政策变化，该变化对不同失业工人产生了不同的影响：第一组工人的福利替代率有所提高；第二组工人的福利持续时间有所延长；第三组工人同时面临更高的福利替代率和更长的福利持续时间；第四组工人的政策参数没有发生变化。我们发现，失业工人对这种不利因素的反应是增加失业持续时间，我们的实证结果与求职理论的预测一致。我们利用参数估计值将失业保险基金的总成本分解为因失业保险体系变化而产生的成本，以及因失业工人的行为反应而产生的成本。我们的结果表明，因行为反应而产生的成本相当可观。

abstract.text: In two-sided multi-unit auctions having a variety of payment rules, including uniform-price and discriminatory auctions, a monotone pure-strategy equilibrium (MPSE) exists when bidders are risk neutral with independent multi-dimensional types and interdependent values. In fact, all mixed-strategy equilibria are ex post allocation and interim expected payment equivalent to MPSE. Thus, for standard expected surplus/revenue analysis, there is no loss restricting attention to monotone strategies.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.00407.x.abstractZh: 在具有多种支付规则的双边多单位拍卖中，包括统一价格和歧视性拍卖，当投标者具有风险中性的独立多维类型以及相互依赖的价值时，存在单调纯策略均衡。实际上，所有混合策略均衡都是事后分配和临时预期支付等同于单调策略均衡的结果。因此，对于标准的预期收益/收入分析而言，关注单调策略是没有损失的。

abstract.text: This paper provides a new approach to forecasting time series that are subject to discrete structural breaks. We propose a Bayesian estimation and prediction procedure that allows for the possibility of new breaks occurring over the forecast horizon, taking account of the size and duration of past breaks (if any) by means of a hierarchical hidden Markov chain model. Predictions are formed by integrating over the parameters from the meta-distribution that characterizes the stochastic break-point process. In an application to U.S. Treasury bill rates, we find that the method leads to better out-of-sample forecasts than a range of alternative methods.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.00408.x.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种针对受离散结构突变影响的时间序列预测的新方法。我们提出了一种贝叶斯估计与预测程序，该程序允许在预测范围内出现新的突变，并通过分层隐马尔可夫模型来考虑过去突变的规模和持续时间（如果有的话）。预测结果是通过对表征随机突变点的元分布中的参数进行积分得到的。在对美国国债利率的应用中，我们发现该方法得出的样本外预测结果优于一系列其他方法。

abstract.text: This paper establishes that posting a price in each period is a revenue-maximizing allocation mechanism in a finite period model without commitment. A risk-neutral seller has one object to sell and faces a risk-neutral buyer whose valuation is private information and drawn from an arbitrary bounded subset of the real line. The seller has all the bargaining power: she designs a mechanism to sell the object at t, but if trade does not occur at t she can propose another mechanism at t + 1. We show that posting a price in each period is an optimal mechanism. A methodological contribution of the paper is to develop a procedure to characterize optimal dynamic incentive schemes under non-commitment that is valid irrespective of the structure of the agent's type.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.00409.x.abstractZh: 本文证明了，在无承诺的有限周期模型中，每个周期发布价格是一种收益最大化的分配机制。风险中性的卖方有一个待售物品，而风险中性的买方对物品的估值属于私人信息，且这一估值来自实数线上任意有界子集。卖方拥有全部议价能力：她可以在时间t设计一种销售机制，但如果交易在t时刻未达成，她可以在t+1时刻提出另一种机制。我们证明了在每个周期发布价格是一种最优机制。本文的一个方法论贡献是提出了一种程序，用于描述无承诺条件下的最优动态激励方案，该程序不依赖于代理人类型的具体结构。

abstract.text: A group of n “quacks” plays a price-competition game, facing a continuum of “patients” who recover with probability α, whether they acquire a quack's “treatment”. If patients chose rationally, the market would be inactive. I assume, however, that patients choose according to a boundedly rational procedure, which reflects “anecdotal” reasoning. This element of bounded rationality has significant implications. The market for quacks is active, and patients suffer a welfare loss which behaves non-monotonically w.r.t. n and α. In an extended model that endogenizes the quacks' choice of “treatments”, the quacks minimize the force of price competition by offering maximally differentiated treatments. The patients' welfare loss is robust to market interventions, which would crowd out low-quality firms in standard models. Thus, as long as the patients' quality of reasoning is not lifted above the anecdotal level, ordinary competition policies may be ineffective.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.00410.x.abstractZh: 一群n个“庸医”参与了一场价格竞争游戏，他们面对的是一群“患者”，这些患者接受“治疗”后，有α的概率能够康复。如果患者能够理性选择，市场将不会活跃。然而，我假设患者是根据一种有限理性的程序做出选择的，这种程序反映了“轶事性”的推理方式。这种有限理性的特性具有重要意义。庸医的市场是活跃的，而患者的福利损失与n和α呈非单调关系。在一个扩展了模型的情况下，庸医通过提供差异最大的“治疗”来最小化价格竞争的压力。患者的福利损失对市场干预具有鲁棒性，而在标准模型中，市场干预会淘汰低质量的企业。因此，只要患者的推理质量没有提升到轶事性水平以上，普通的竞争政策可能是无效的。

abstract.text: We study a linear public goods game using an inter-generational approach. Subjects in one generation leave advice for the succeeding generation via free-form messages. Such advice can be private knowledge (advice left by one player in generation t is given only to his or her immediate successor in generation t + 1), public knowledge (advice left by players of generation t is made available to all members of generation t + 1), and common knowledge (where the advice is not only public but is also read aloud by the experimenter). Common knowledge of advice generates a process of social learning that leads to high contributions and less free-riding. This behaviour is sustained by advice that is generally exhortative, suggesting high contributions, which in turn creates optimistic beliefs among subjects about others' contributions. We suggest that socially connected communities may achieve high contributions to a public good even in the absence of punishment for norm violators.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.0379.x.abstractZh: 我们采用代际视角研究了一个线性公共物品博弈。一代人通过自由形式的消息为下一代人提供建议。这些建议可以是私人知识（即某一代玩家留下的建议仅对其直接继承者有效）、公共知识（即某一代玩家留下的建议可供所有继承者使用）以及共同知识（即建议不仅公开，还由实验者大声朗读）。共同知识的存在促进了社会学习过程，从而促使人们做出更多贡献，减少搭便车行为。这种行为源于建议通常具有激励性，鼓励人们做出更多贡献，进而在参与者之间形成对其他人贡献的乐观预期。我们认为，即使在没有对违规行为进行惩罚的情况下，具有紧密社会联系的社区也能实现对公共物品的较高贡献。

abstract.text: This paper analyses a model in which two groups repeatedly compete with each other for a prize in every time period. We assume that there is a status quo bias: if there is a fight today, yesterday's winner is in a stronger position than the other group. Hence, a change of the status quo has long-term consequences that groups need to take into account. Important applications of this model include lobbying for legislation and political transitions through revolutions. We analyse the strategic timing of attacks on the status quo, which is similar to investment decisions under uncertainty. We find that the attack threshold is considerably lower than in a comparable one-period game, and that the expenditure level necessary to change the status quo is low in comparison to the prize; this provides a possible solution to Tullock's “rent-seeking paradox” in lobbying.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.0385.x.abstractZh: 本文分析了一个模型，其中两个群体在每个时期都会反复竞争一个奖项。我们假设存在一种现状偏见：如果今天发生竞争，那么昨天的获胜者就会处于比另一个群体更强的地位。因此，现状的变化会带来长期的影响，这些影响需要被各群体考虑在内。该模型的重要应用包括为立法进行游说以及通过革命实现政治转型。我们分析了针对现状的攻击的战略时机选择，这与在不确定性下的投资决策类似。研究发现，攻击的阈值明显低于一个时期内的竞争模型，而且改变现状所需的支出水平相对于奖金额来说较低；这为解决Tullock在游说领域提出的“寻租悖论”提供了一个可能的解决方案。

abstract.text: This paper studies the effect of asymmetric information on the price formation process in a quote-driven market. One market-maker receives private information on the value of the quoted asset and repeatedly competes with market-makers who are uninformed. We show that despite the fact that the informed market-maker's quotes are public, the market is never strong-form efficient with certainty until the last stage. We characterize a reputational equilibrium in which the informed market-maker influences and possibly misleads the uninformed market-makers' beliefs. At this equilibrium, a price leadership effect arises, the informed market-maker's expected pay-off is positive and the rate of price discovery increases in the last stages of trade.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.378_1.x.abstractZh: 本文研究了信息不对称对报价驱动市场价格形成过程的影响。其中一个做市商拥有被报价资产价值的私人信息，并不断与信息不灵的做市商竞争。我们指出，尽管知情做市商的报价是公开的，但市场直到最后阶段才具有强形式效率。我们描述了一种声誉均衡状态，在这种状态下，知情做市商会影响甚至误导信息不灵的做市商的信念。在这种均衡状态下，会出现价格领导效应，知情做市商的预期收益为正，且交易最后阶段的价格发现率会增加。

abstract.text: We propose a life-cycle model of the housing market with a property ladder and a credit constraint. We focus on equilibria that replicate the facts that credit constraints delay some households' first home purchase and force other households to buy a home smaller than they would like. The model helps us identify a powerful driver of the housing market: the ability of young households to afford the down payment on a starter home, and in particular their income. The model also highlights a channel whereby changes in income may yield housing price overreaction, with prices of trade-up homes displaying the most volatility, and a positive correlation between housing prices and transactions. This channel relies on the capital gains or losses on starter homes incurred by credit-constrained owners. We provide empirical support for our arguments with evidence from both the U.K. and the U.S.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2006.383_1.x.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个包含房产阶梯和信用约束的住房市场生命周期模型。我们重点关注那些能够反映以下事实的均衡状态：信用约束导致一些家庭推迟首次购房，并迫使其他家庭购买比他们理想中更小的房子。该模型帮助我们识别出一个重要的住房市场驱动因素：年轻家庭能够负担得起首套住房的首付款，尤其是他们的收入能力。该模型还揭示了收入变化可能导致房价过度反应的一个渠道，其中用于升级的住房价格表现出最大的波动性，且房价与交易活动之间存在正相关关系。这一渠道依赖于信用受限的业主在首套住房上所遭受的资本收益或损失。我们通过来自英国和美国的证据为我们的论点提供了实证支持。

abstract.text: One of the most striking changes in the U.S. economy over the past 50 years has been the growth in the service sector. Between 1950 and 2000, service-sector employment grew from 57 to 75 percent of total employment. However, over this time, the real hourly wage in the service sector grew only slightly faster than in the goods sector. In this paper, we assess whether or not the essential constancy of the relative wage implies that individuals face small costs of switching sectors, and we quantify the relative importance of labor supply and demand factors in the growth of the service sector. We specify and estimate a two-sector labor market equilibrium model that allows us to address these empirical issues in a unified framework. Our estimates imply that there are large mobility costs: output in both sectors would have been double their current levels if these mobility costs had been zero. In addition, we find that demand-side factors, that is, technological change and movements in product and capital prices, were responsible for the growth of the service sector.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00648.x.abstractZh: 在过去50年中，美国经济最显著的变化之一就是服务行业的增长。从1950年到2000年，服务行业的就业人数占总就业人数的比例从57%上升到75%。然而，在这段时间里，服务行业的实际小时工资增长速度仅略高于商品行业。在本文中，我们评估了相对工资的稳定性是否意味着个人在行业间转换的成本较低，并量化了劳动力供给和需求因素在服务行业增长中的相对重要性。我们构建并估计了一个双部门劳动力市场均衡模型，以便在一个统一的框架内解决这些实证问题。我们的估计结果表明，行业间的流动成本很高：如果这些流动成本为零，那么两个行业的产出都将达到当前水平的两倍。此外，我们发现，需求方面的因素，即技术变革以及产品和资本价格的变化，是服务行业增长的主要原因。

abstract.text: We consider large double auctions with private values. Values need be neither symmetric nor independent. Multiple units may be owned or desired. Participation may be stochastic. We introduce a very mild notion of “a little independence.” We prove that all nontrivial equilibria of auctions that satisfy this notion are asymptotically efficient. For any α>0, inefficiency disappears at rate 1/n2-α.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00649.x.abstractZh: 我们考虑具有私人价值的大型双拍卖。这些价值既不一定对称，也不一定相互独立。多个单位可能被拥有或渴望。参与行为可能是随机的。我们引入了一个非常宽松的“轻微独立性”概念。我们证明，满足这一概念的拍卖中所有非平凡均衡都是渐进有效的。对于任何大于0的α，非效率会以1/n2-α的速率消失。

abstract.text: This paper studies the econometrics of computed dynamic models. Since these models generally lack a closed-form solution, their policy functions are approximated by numerical methods. Hence, the researcher can only evaluate an approximated likelihood associated with the approximated policy function rather than the exact likelihood implied by the exact policy function. What are the consequences for inference of the use of approximated likelihoods? First, we find conditions under which, as the approximated policy function converges to the exact policy, the approximated likelihood also converges to the exact likelihood. Second, we show that second order approximation errors in the policy function, which almost always are ignored by researchers, have first order effects on the likelihood function. Third, we discuss convergence of Bayesian and classical estimates. Finally, we propose to use a likelihood ratio test as a diagnostic device for problems derived from the use of approximated likelihoods.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00650.x.abstractZh: 本文研究了计算动态模型的计量经济学特性。由于这些模型通常缺乏封闭形式的解，其政策函数需要通过数值方法进行近似处理。因此，研究者只能评估与近似政策函数相关的近似似然值，而无法得到精确政策函数所蕴含的精确似然值。使用近似似然值对推断结果有何影响？首先，我们找到了条件，即当近似政策函数收敛到精确政策函数时，近似似然值也会收敛到精确似然值。其次，我们指出政策函数中的二阶近似误差，这些误差几乎总是被研究者忽略，但它们对似然函数有显著影响。第三，我们讨论了贝叶斯估计与经典估计的收敛性。最后，我们提出了使用似然比检验作为诊断工具，以识别因使用近似似然值而产生的问题。

abstract.text: We develop and analyze a model of random choice and random expected utility. A decision problem is a finite set of lotteries that describe the feasible choices. A random choice rule associates with each decision problem a probability measure over choices. A random utility function is a probability measure over von Neumann–Morgenstern utility functions. We show that a random choice rule maximizes some random utility function if and only if it is mixture continuous, monotone (the probability that a lottery is chosen does not increase when other lotteries are added to the decision problem), extreme (lotteries that are not extreme points of the decision problem are chosen with probability 0), and linear (satisfies the independence axiom).

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00651.x.abstractZh: 我们开发并分析了一个随机选择与随机期望效用的模型。决策问题是一组有限的彩票，描述了可行的选择方案。随机选择规则为每个决策问题关联一个选择方案的概率测度。随机效用函数则是冯·诺伊曼-莫根斯特恩效用函数的概率测度。我们证明了，一个随机选择规则能够最大化某个随机效用函数，当且仅当该规则具有混合连续性、单调性（当在决策问题中加入其他彩票时，选择某个彩票的概率不会增加）、极端性（非决策问题的极端点彩票被选中的概率为零），以及线性性（满足独立性公理）。

abstract.text: This paper provides a first order asymptotic theory for generalized method of moments (GMM) estimators when the number of moment conditions is allowed to increase with the sample size and the moment conditions may be weak. Examples in which these asymptotics are relevant include instrumental variable (IV) estimation with many (possibly weak or uninformed) instruments and some panel data models covering moderate time spans and with correspondingly large numbers of instruments. Under certain regularity conditions, the GMM estimators are shown to converge in probability but not necessarily to the true parameter, and conditions for consistent GMM estimation are given. A general framework for the GMM limit distribution theory is developed based on epiconvergence methods. Some illustrations are provided, including consistent GMM estimation of a panel model with time varying individual effects, consistent LIML estimation as a continuously updated GMM estimator, and consistent IV structural estimation using large numbers of weak or irrelevant instruments. Some simulations are reported.
