10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00652.x.abstractZh: 本文为广义矩估计（GMM）估计量提供了一个一阶渐近理论，该理论适用于矩条件数量随样本量增加而增加的情况，且这些矩条件可能是较弱的。这些渐近性理论适用的例子包括使用许多（可能是较弱或信息不足的）工具变量进行工具变量估计，以及一些涵盖中等时间跨度且包含大量工具变量的面板数据模型。在某些常规条件下，GMM估计量被证明在概率意义上收敛，但不一定收敛到真实参数值，同时给出了一致GMM估计的条件。基于广义收敛方法，本文还发展了一个关于GMM极限分布理论的一般框架。文中提供了一些示例，包括使用大量弱或无关工具变量对面板模型进行一致GMM估计，作为连续更新的GMM估计量进行一致LIML估计，以及使用大量弱或无关工具变量进行一致工具变量结构估计。文中还报告了一些模拟结果。

abstract.text: This paper demonstrates how time consistency of the Ramsey policy - the optimal fiscal and monetary policy under commitment - can be achieved. Each government should leave its successor with a unique maturity structure for the nominal and indexed debt, such that the marginal benefit of a surprise inflation exactly balances the marginal cost. Unlike in earlier papers on the topic, the result holds for quite a general Ramsey policy, including timevarying polices with positive inflation and positive nominal interest rates. We compare our results with those in Persson, Persson, and Svensson (1987), Calvo and Obstfeld (1990), and Alvarez, Kehoe, and Neumeyer (2004).

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00653.x.abstractZh: 本文阐述了如何实现Ramsey政策的时间一致性——即在承诺约束下的最优财政和货币政策。每个政府都应为其继任者留下独特的名义债务和指数化债务的到期结构，使得意外通胀的边际收益与边际成本完全平衡。与之前的相关研究不同，我们的结果适用于较为通用的Ramsey政策，包括具有正通胀率和正名义利率的变动政策。我们将我们的结果与Persson、Persson和Svensson（1987年）、Calvo和Obstfeld（1990年）以及Alvarez、Kehoe和Neumeyer（2004年）的研究结果进行了比较。

abstract.text: A number of studies, most notably Crémer and McLean (1985, 1988), have shown that in generic type spaces that admit a common prior and are of a fixed finite size, an uninformed seller can design mechanisms that extract all the surplus from privately informed bidders. We show that this result hinges on the nonconvexity of such a family of priors. When the ambient family of priors is convex, generic priors do not allow for full surplus extraction provided that for at least one prior in this family, players' beliefs about other players' types do not pin down the players' own preferences. In particular, full surplus extraction is generically impossible in finite type spaces with a common prior. Similarly, generic priors on the universal type space do not allow for full surplus extraction.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00654.x.abstractZh: 多项研究，尤其是Crémer和McLean在1985年和1988年的研究，表明在允许共同先验且具有固定有限大小的通用类型空间中，一个信息不足的卖家可以设计机制，从私人知情投标者那里获取全部剩余收益。我们证明这一结果取决于这类先验的非凸性。当环境先验集是凸的时候，只要该家族中的至少一个先验无法确定其他参与者的类型偏好，通用先验就无法实现全部剩余收益的获取。特别地，在具有共同先验的有限类型空间中，完全获取剩余收益是根本不可能的。同样，在通用类型空间上，通用先验也无法实现全部剩余收益的获取。

abstract.text: Matching estimators for average treatment effects are widely used in evaluation research despite the fact that their large sample properties have not been established in many cases. The absence of formal results in this area may be partly due to the fact that standard asymptotic expansions do not apply to matching estimators with a fixed number of matches because such estimators are highly nonsmooth functionals of the data. In this article we develop new methods for analyzing the large sample properties of matching estimators and establish a number of new results. We focus on matching with replacement with a fixed number of matches. First, we show that matching estimators are not N1/2-consistent in general and describe conditions under which matching estimators do attain N1/2-consistency. Second, we show that even in settings where matching estimators are N1/2-consistent, simple matching estimators with a fixed number of matches do not attain the semiparametric efficiency bound. Third, we provide a consistent estimator for the large sample variance that does not require consistent nonparametric estimation of unknown functions. Software for implementing these methods is available in Matlab, Stata, and R.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00655.x.abstractZh: 尽管匹配估计量在评估研究中被广泛使用，但其在大样本性质方面的表现在许多情况下尚未得到证实。这一领域缺乏正式的研究成果，部分原因可能是标准的渐近展开不适用于具有固定匹配次数的匹配估计量，因为这些估计量是对数据的高度非光滑函数。在本文中，我们开发了分析匹配估计量大样本性质的新方法，并取得了一些新的研究结果。我们重点关注具有固定匹配次数的替换匹配方法。首先，我们表明匹配估计量通常不具备N1/2一致性，并描述了匹配估计量达到N1/2一致性的条件。其次，我们指出即使在匹配估计量具有N1/2一致性的情况下，具有固定匹配次数的简单匹配估计量也无法达到半参数效率界限。第三，我们提供了一种大样本方差的一致估计方法，该方法不需要对未知函数进行一致的非参数估计。这些方法的实现软件可在Matlab、Stata和R中获取。

abstract.text: ONE OF THE MAIN PUZZLES in international finance is portfolio home bias: typical investors hold most of their wealth in domestic assets (despite the fact that international diversification permits a sizable reduction in risk). Serrat (2001) claims that the nontradable nature of many consumption goods explains

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00656.x.abstractZh: 国际金融中的一个主要谜题是投资组合的本土偏好：典型的投资者将大部分财富投资于国内资产（尽管国际多元化可以降低风险）。Serrat（2001）认为，许多消费品的不可贸易性质可以解释这一现象。

abstract.text: Most applications of Nash bargaining over wages ignore between-employer competition for labor services and attribute all of the workers' rent to their bargaining power. In this paper, we write and estimate an equilibrium model with strategic wage bargaining and on-the-job search and use it to take another look at the determinants of wages in France. There are three essential determinants of wages in our model: productivity, competition between employers resulting from on-the-job search, and the workers' bargaining power. We find that between-firm competition matters a lot in the determination of wages, because it is quantitatively more important than wage bargaining à la Nash in raising wages above the workers' “reservation wages,” defined as out-of-work income. In particular, we detect no significant bargaining power for intermediate- and low-skilled workers, and a modestly positive bargaining power for high-skilled workers.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00665.x.abstractZh: 在关于工资纳什谈判的多数研究中，忽视了雇主之间对劳动力服务的竞争，并将所有工人的工资成本都归因于他们的谈判能力。在本文中，我们构建并估计了一个包含战略性工资谈判和在职搜寻的均衡模型，以此来重新探讨法国工资的决定因素。在我们的模型中，有三个重要的决定工资的因素：生产率、由于在职搜寻而产生的雇主之间的竞争，以及工人的谈判能力。我们发现，企业之间的竞争在决定工资方面起着重要作用，其重要性超过了纳什式工资谈判，能够使工资高于工人的“保留工资”，即失业时的收入。具体而言，我们发现中等和低技能工人的谈判能力并不显著，而高技能工人的谈判能力则略呈正增长。

abstract.text: This paper studies the optimal trade-off between commitment and flexibility in an intertemporal consumption/savings choice model. Individuals expect to receive relevant information regarding their own situation and tastes - generating a value for flexibility - but also expect to suffer from temptations - generating a value for commitment. The model combines the representations of preferences for flexibility introduced by Kreps (1979) with its recent antithesis for commitment proposed by Gul and Pesendorfer (2002), which nests the hyperbolic discounting model. We set up and solve a mechanism design problem that optimizes over the set of consumption/saving options available to the individual each period. We characterize the conditions under which the solution takes a simple threshold form where minimum savings policies are optimal. Our analysis is also relevant for other issues such as situations with externalities or the problem faced by a paternalistic planner, which may be important for thinking about some regulations such as forced minimum schooling laws.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00666.x.abstractZh: 本文研究在跨期消费/储蓄选择模型中，承诺与灵活性之间的最佳权衡。个体期望获得关于自身情况和偏好的相关信息——这产生了灵活性的价值——但同时也面临诱惑——这产生了承诺的价值。该模型结合了Kreps（1979）提出的灵活性偏好表示方式，以及Gul和Pesendorfer（2002）提出的承诺的相反概念，后者将双曲贴现模型纳入其中。我们建立并解决了一种机制设计问题，旨在优化个体在每个时期可选择的消费/储蓄方案。我们分析了解决方案呈现简单阈值形式的条件，即最低储蓄政策是最优的。我们的分析还适用于其他问题，例如存在外部性的情况，或者家长式规划者面临的问题，这些问题对于思考某些法规（如强制最低教育年限的法律）具有重要意义。

abstract.text: The Lemke–Howson algorithm is the classical method for finding one Nash equilibrium of a bimatrix game. This paper presents a class of square bimatrix games for which this algorithm takes, even in the best case, an exponential number of steps in the dimension d of the game. Using polytope theory, the games are constructed using pairs of dual cyclic polytopes with 2d suitably labeled facets in d-space. The construction is extended to nonsquare games where, in addition to exponentially long Lemke–Howson computations, finding an equilibrium by support enumeration takes on average exponential time.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00667.x.abstractZh: Lemke–Howson算法是求解双矩阵博弈纳什均衡的经典方法。本文介绍了一类正方形双矩阵博弈，该算法在最佳情况下仍需要指数级数量的步骤来计算博弈维度d下的均衡。利用多面体理论，这些博弈通过双对循环多面体来构建，这些多面体在d空间中有2d个适当标记的面。该方法也适用于非正方形博弈，在这种情况下，除了需要指数级长度的Lemke–Howson计算外，通过支持枚举法寻找均衡的平均时间也是指数级的。

abstract.text: This paper develops an alternative approach to the widely used Difference-In-Difference (DID) method for evaluating the effects of policy changes. In contrast to the standard approach, we introduce a nonlinear model that permits changes over time in the effect of unobservables (e.g., there may be a time trend in the level of wages as well as the returns to skill in the labor market). Further, our assumptions are independent of the scaling of the outcome. Our approach provides an estimate of the entire counterfactual distribution of outcomes that would have been experienced by the treatment group in the absence of the treatment, and likewise for the untreated group in the presence of the treatment. Thus, it enables the evaluation of policy interventions according to criteria such as a mean-variance tradeoff. We provide conditions under which the model is nonparametrically identified and propose an estimator. We consider extensions to allow for covariates and discrete dependent variables. We also analyze inference, showing that our estimator is root-N consistent and asymptotically normal. Finally, we consider an application.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00668.x.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种替代方法，用于评估政策变化的影响，该方法不同于广泛使用的差异差分法（Difference-In-Difference，DID）。与标准方法不同，我们引入了一个非线性模型，允许不可观测因素随时间发生变化（例如，工资水平以及劳动力市场中的技能回报可能存在时间趋势）。此外，我们的假设与结果的可缩放性无关。我们的方法能够估计在没有政策干预的情况下，处理组所经历的全部反事实结果分布，同样也可以估计在政策干预存在的情况下，未处理组所经历的结果分布。因此，该方法能够根据均值-方差权衡等标准来评估政策干预的效果。我们提出了模型非参数识别的条件，并提出了一种估计量。我们还考虑了允许协变量和离散因变量的扩展。我们还分析了推断过程，表明我们的估计量在根N意义上一致，并且渐近正态。最后，我们考虑了一个应用案例。

abstract.text: Most theoretical or applied research on repeated games with imperfect monitoring has focused on public strategies: strategies that depend solely on the history of publicly observable signals. This paper sheds light on the role of private strategies: strategies that depend not only on public signals, but also on players' own actions in the past. Our main finding is that players can sometimes make better use of information by using private strategies and that efficiency in repeated games can be improved. Our equilibrium private strategy for repeated prisoners' dilemma games consists of two states and has the property that each player's optimal strategy is independent of the other player's state.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00669.x.abstractZh: 大多数关于不完全监控重复博弈的理论或应用研究都集中在公共策略上：这些策略仅依赖于公开可观察的信号的历史。本文则探讨了私人策略的作用：这些策略不仅依赖于公共信号，还依赖于玩家过去的行为。我们的主要发现是，玩家有时可以通过使用私人策略来更好地利用信息，从而提高重复博弈的效率。对于重复囚徒困境博弈，我们的均衡私人策略包含两种状态，并且每个玩家的最优策略都独立于其他玩家的状态。

abstract.text: This paper is concerned with inference about a function g that is identified by a conditional moment restriction involving instrumental variables. The paper presents a test of the hypothesis that g belongs to a finite-dimensional parametric family against a nonparametric alternative. The test does not require nonparametric estimation of g and is not subject to the ill-posed inverse problem of nonparametric instrumental variables estimation. Under mild conditions, the test is consistent against any alternative model. In large samples, its power is arbitrarily close to 1 uniformly over a class of alternatives whose distance from the null hypothesis is O(n−1/2), where n is the sample size. In Monte Carlo simulations, the finite-sample power of the new test exceeds that of existing tests.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00670.x.abstractZh: 本文探讨了关于一个函数g的推断问题，该函数通过包含工具变量的条件矩限制来识别。文章提出了一种检验假设的方法，即g是否属于有限维参数族，并针对非参数替代模型进行了检验。该检验不需要对g进行非参数估计，且不受非参数工具变量估计所面临的病态逆问题的影响。在适当的条件下，该检验对任何替代模型都是一致的。在大样本中，其检验功效在某一类替代模型上可以任意接近1，这些替代模型与零假设的距离满足O(n−1/2)的条件，其中n为样本量。在蒙特卡洛模拟中，新检验的有限样本功效优于现有检验。

abstract.text: Quantile regression (QR) fits a linear model for conditional quantiles just as ordinary least squares (OLS) fits a linear model for conditional means. An attractive feature of OLS is that it gives the minimum mean-squared error linear approximation to the conditional expectation function even when the linear model is misspecified. Empirical research using quantile regression with discrete covariates suggests that QR may have a similar property, but the exact nature of the linear approximation has remained elusive. In this paper, we show that QR minimizes a weighted mean-squared error loss function for specification error. The weighting function is an average density of the dependent variable near the true conditional quantile. The weighted least squares interpretation of QR is used to derive an omitted variables bias formula and a partial quantile regression concept, similar to the relationship between partial regression and OLS. We also present asymptotic theory for the QR process under misspecification of the conditional quantile function. The approximation properties of QR are illustrated using wage data from the U.S. census. These results point to major changes in inequality from 1990 to 2000.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00671.x.abstractZh: 分位数回归（QR）为条件分位数拟合线性模型，就像普通最小二乘法（OLS）为条件均值拟合线性模型一样。OLS的一个显著特点是，即使线性模型被误设，它也能给出条件期望函数的最小均方误差线性近似。使用分位数回归和离散协变量的实证研究表明，QR可能具有类似的特性，但线性近似的确切性质仍然不清楚。在本文中，我们展示了QR能够最小化因变量在真实条件分位数附近的加权均方误差损失函数。加权函数实际上是因变量在真实条件分位数附近的密度平均值。通过QR的加权最小二乘法解释，我们推导出了遗漏变量偏差公式以及部分分位数回归的概念，这与部分回归与OLS之间的关系类似。我们还提出了在条件分位数函数被误设情况下QR过程的渐近理论。通过使用美国人口普查中的工资数据来说明QR的近似特性。这些结果指出了从1990年到2000年不平等状况的重大变化。

abstract.text: A key argument in Caplin and Leahy (1997) states that the correlation between monetary shocks and output is falling in the variance of the money supply. We demonstrate that this conclusion depends on solving for the correlation in the non-stationary state of the model. In the stationary state, that correlation is initially rising.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00672.x.abstractZh: Caplin和Leahy在1997年的研究中提出了一个关键论点，即货币冲击与产出之间的相关性在货币供应量的方差中正在下降。我们证明，这一结论取决于在模型的非平稳状态下求解相关性。在平稳状态下，这种相关性最初是上升的。

abstract.text: The sensitivity of Bayesian implementation to agents' beliefs about others suggests the use of more robust notions of implementation such as ex post implementation, which requires that each agent's strategy be optimal for every possible realization of the types of other agents. We show that the only deterministic social choice functions that are ex post implementable in generic mechanism design frameworks with multidimensional signals, interdependent valuations, and transferable utilities are constant functions. In other words, deterministic ex post implementation requires that the same alternative must be chosen irrespective of agents' signals. The proof shows that ex post implementability of a nontrivial deterministic social choice function implies that certain rates of information substitution coincide for all agents. This condition amounts to a system of differential equations that are not satisfied by generic valuation functions.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00675.x.abstractZh: 贝叶斯实施的敏感性取决于代理人对其他代理人的信念，这表明需要使用更稳健的实施概念，例如事后实施，这要求每个代理人的策略对于其他代理人可能采取的所有实现方式都是最优的。我们证明，在具有多维信号、相互依赖的估值和可转移效用的通用机制设计框架中，唯一可以事后实施的非确定性社会选择函数是常数函数。换句话说，确定性事后实施要求无论代理人的信号如何，都必须选择相同的替代方案。证明表明，一个非平凡确定性社会选择函数的事后实施性意味着某些信息替代率对所有代理人来说都是相同的。这个条件相当于一个微分方程系统，而一般的估值函数无法满足这个条件。

abstract.text: Identification of dynamic nonlinear panel data models is an important and delicate problem in econometrics. In this paper we provide insights that shed light on the identification of parameters of some commonly used models. Using these insights, we are able to show through simple calculations that point identification often fails in these models. On the other hand, these calculations also suggest that the model restricts the parameter to lie in a region that is very small in many cases, and the failure of point identification may, therefore, be of little practical importance in those cases. Although the emphasis is on identification, our techniques are constructive in that they can easily form the basis for consistent estimates of the identified sets.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00676.x.abstractZh: 在计量经济学中，动态非线性面板数据模型的识别是一个重要且复杂的问题。本文提供了一些见解，有助于理解一些常用模型参数的识别问题。通过这些见解，我们通过简单的计算表明，在这些模型中，点识别往往会出现失败。另一方面，这些计算还表明，模型通常限制参数只能存在于一个非常小的区域内，因此在这些情况下，点识别的失败可能并不具有实际意义。尽管重点在于识别，但我们的技术具有建设性，因为它们可以很容易地为一致识别集的估计奠定基础。

abstract.text: This paper studies the problem of identification and estimation in nonparametric regression models with a misclassified binary regressor where the measurement error may be correlated with the regressors. We show that the regression function is non-parametrically identified in the presence of an additional random variable that is correlated with the unobserved true underlying variable but unrelated to the measurement error. Identification for semi-parametric and parametric regression functions follows straightforwardly from the basic identification result. We propose a kernel estimator based on the identification strategy and derive its large sample properties and also discuss alternative estimation procedures.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00677.x.abstractZh: 本文研究了非参数回归模型中识别与估计的问题，特别是在二元回归量被错误分类的情况下，此时测量误差可能与回归量存在相关性。我们证明了在存在一个与未观测的真实基础变量相关但与测量误差无关的额外随机变量的情况下，回归函数是非参数识别的。对于半参数和参数回归函数，识别结论可以直接从基本的识别结果中得出。我们提出了一种基于该识别策略的核估计方法，并推导了其大样本性质，同时讨论了其他估计方法。

abstract.text: In this paper, I analyze a decentralized search and matching economy with transferable utility composed of heterogeneous agents. I explore whether Becker's assortative matching result generalizes to an economy where agents engage in costly search. In an economy with explicit additive search costs, complementarities in joint production (supermodularity of the joint production function) lead to assortative matching. This is in contrast to previous literature, which had shown that in a search economy with discounting, assortative matching may fail even when the joint production function is supermodular.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00678.x.abstractZh: 在本文中，我分析了一个由异质代理人组成的、具有可转移效用的去中心化搜索与匹配经济体系。我探讨了贝克尔的匹配理论是否适用于那些代理人需要付出高昂搜索成本的经济体系。在存在显性加性搜索成本的经济体系中，联合生产的互补性（联合生产函数的超模块性）会导致匹配行为的 assortative 特性。这与以往文献的研究结果不同，后者指出，在带有折扣机制的搜索经济体系中，即使联合生产函数具有超模块性， assortative 匹配仍可能失败。

abstract.text: This paper considers the problem of conducting inference on the regression coefficient in a bivariate regression model with a highly persistent regressor. Gaussian asymptotic power envelopes are obtained for a class of testing procedures that satisfy a conditionality restriction. In addition, the paper proposes testing procedures that attain these power envelopes whether or not the innovations of the regression model are normally distributed.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00679.x.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在具有高度持久性回归变量的双变量回归模型中，对回归系数进行推断的问题。对于满足某种条件限制的一类检验程序，本文得到了高斯渐近功效包络。此外，本文还提出了一些检验程序，这些程序无论回归模型的创新项是否呈正态分布，都能达到这些功效包络。

abstract.text: This paper considers tests of the parameter on an endogenous variable in an instru-mental variables regression model. The focus is on determining tests that have some optimal power properties. We start by considering a model with normally distributed errors and known error covariance matrix. We consider tests that are similar and satisfy a natural rotational invariance condition. We determine a two-sided power envelope for invariant similar tests. This allows us to assess and compare the power properties of tests such as the conditional likelihood ratio (CLR), the Lagrange multiplier, and the Anderson–Rubin tests. We find that the CLR test is quite close to being uniformly most powerful invariant among a class of two-sided tests. The finite-sample results of the paper are extended to the case of unknown error co-variance matrix and possibly nonnormal errors via weak instrument asymptotics. Strong instrument asymptotic results also are provided because we seek tests that perform well under both weak and strong instruments.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00680.x.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在工具变量回归模型中，对内生变量参数进行检验的方法。重点在于寻找具有某些最优功效性质的检验方法。我们首先考虑一个误差呈正态分布且误差协方差矩阵已知的情况。我们研究了满足自然旋转不变性条件的类似检验方法。我们为这些不变性检验定义了一个双侧功效范围。这使我们能够评估和比较诸如条件似然比、拉格朗日乘数以及安德森-鲁宾检验等检验的功效特性。研究发现，在一系列双侧检验中，条件似然比检验几乎始终具有最大的功效。本文的有限样本结果还扩展到了误差协方差矩阵未知且误差可能非正态分布的情况，通过弱工具变量渐近方法得到了相应的结果。由于我们寻求在弱工具和强工具变量条件下都能表现良好的检验方法，因此还提供了强工具变量渐近结果。

abstract.text: In standard auctions resale creates a role for a speculator—a bidder who is commonly known to have no use value for the good on sale. We study this issue in environments with symmetric independent private-value bidders. For second-price and English auctions the efficient value-bidding equilibrium coexists with a continuum of inefficient equilibria in which the speculator wins the auction and makes positive profits. First-price and Dutch auctions have an essentially unique equilibrium, and whether or not the speculator wins the auction and distorts the final allocation depends on the number of bidders, the value distribution, and the discount factor. Speculators do not make profits in first-price or Dutch auctions.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00681.x.abstractZh: 在标准的拍卖中，转售行为为投机者创造了机会——这些投机者通常被认为对拍卖中的商品没有实际需求。我们研究了在具有对称独立私人价值出价者的环境中的这一问题。对于第二价格拍卖和英式拍卖，有效的价值出价均衡与一系列低效的均衡共存，在这些低效均衡中，投机者赢得拍卖并获取正利润。第一价格拍卖和荷兰式拍卖则具有本质上唯一的均衡，而投机者是否赢得拍卖并扭曲最终分配结果，取决于出价者数量、价值分布以及折扣因子。在第一价格拍卖或荷兰式拍卖中，投机者不会获得利润。

abstract.text: In this paper, we introduce a kernel-based estimation principle for nonparametric models named local partitioned regression (LPR). This principle is a nonparametric generalization of the familiar partition regression in linear models. It has several key advantages: First, it generates estimators for a very large class of semi- and nonparametric models. A number of examples that are particularly relevant for economic applications will be discussed in this paper. This class contains the additive, partially linear, and varying coefficient models as well as several other models that have not been discussed in the literature. Second, LPR-based estimators achieve optimality criteria: They have optimal speed of convergence and are oracle-efficient. Moreover, they are simple in structure, widely applicable, and computationally inexpensive. A Monte Carlo simulation highlights these advantages.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00683.x.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们介绍了一种基于核的非参数模型估计原理，称为局部分割回归（LPR）。这一原理是线性模型中熟悉的分割回归的非参数化扩展。它具有几个关键优势：首先，它为非常广泛的半参数和非参数模型生成估计量。本文将讨论一些特别适用于经济应用的例子。这类模型包括加法模型、部分线性模型、变系数模型，以及文献中未涉及的几种其他模型。其次，基于LPR的估计量达到了最优性标准：它们具有最优的收敛速度，并且具有预言效率。此外，它们的结构简单，应用广泛，计算成本较低。蒙特卡洛模拟进一步凸显了这些优势。

abstract.text: What on earth are economic theorists like me trying to accomplish? This paper discusses four dilemmas encountered by an economic theorist: The dilemma of absurd conclusions: Should we abandon a model if it produces absurd conclusions or should we regard a model as a very limited set of assumptions that will inevitably fail in some contexts? The dilemma of responding to evidence: Should our models be judged according to experimental results? The dilemma of modelless regularities: Should models provide the hypothesis for testing or are they simply exercises in logic that have no use in identifying regularities? The dilemma of relevance: Do we have the right to offer advice or to make statements that are intended to influence the real world?

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00689.x.abstractZh: 像我这样的经济理论家究竟试图实现什么目标？本文讨论了经济理论家面临的四个困境：荒谬结论的困境：如果某个模型得出的结论荒谬，我们应该放弃该模型，还是应该将模型视为一组有限的假设，这些假设在某些情境下必然会失败？对证据的回应困境：我们的模型是否应该根据实验结果来评判？无模型规律性的困境：模型是否应该为检验提供假设，还是它们仅仅是逻辑练习，对识别规律性毫无用处？相关性的困境：我们是否有权提供建议或发表旨在影响现实世界的声明？

abstract.text: We present an equilibrium model of the market for higher education. Our model simultaneously predicts student selection into institutions of higher education, financial aid, educational expenditures, and educational outcomes. We show that the model gives rise to a strict hierarchy of colleges that differ by the educational quality provided to the students. We also develop a new estimation procedure that exploits the observed variation in prices within colleges. Identification is based on variation in endowments and technology. It does not rely on observed variation in potentially endogenous characteristics of colleges such as peer quality measures and expenditures. We estimate the structural parameters using data collected by the National Center for Education Statistics and aggregate data from Peterson's and the National Science Foundation.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00690.x.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个高等教育市场的均衡模型。该模型同时预测了学生选择高等教育机构、经济援助、教育支出以及教育成果的情况。我们发现，该模型呈现出一种严格的大学等级体系，这些大学在为学生提供的教育质量上有所不同。我们还开发了一种新的估计方法，该方法利用了各大学内部价格的变化情况。识别过程基于捐赠资金和技术的变化，而不依赖于大学可能的内生特征，如同行质量指标和支出等方面的变化。我们使用国家教育统计中心收集的数据，以及Peterson和美国国家科学基金会提供的汇总数据来估计这些结构参数。

abstract.text: This paper provides an analysis of the asymptotic properties of consumption allocations in a stochastic general equilibrium model with heterogeneous consumers. In particular we investigate the market selection hypothesis, that markets favor traders with more accurate beliefs. We show that in any Pareto optimal allocation whether each consumer vanishes or survives is determined entirely by discount factors and beliefs. Since equilibrium allocations in economies with complete markets are Pareto optimal, our results characterize the limit behavior of these economies. We show that, all else equal, the market selects for consumers who use Bayesian learning with the truth in the support of their prior and selects among Bayesians according to the size of the their parameter space. Finally, we show that in economies with incomplete markets these conclusions may not hold. Payoff functions can matter for long run survival, and the market selection hypothesis fails.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00691.x.abstractZh: 本文分析了具有异质消费者的随机一般均衡模型中消费分配的渐近性质。我们特别研究了市场选择假设，即市场倾向于选择信念更精确的交易者。我们表明，在任何帕累托最优分配中，每个消费者是存活还是消亡完全取决于贴现因子和信念。由于完全市场经济中的均衡分配是帕累托最优的，我们的结果描述了这些经济体的极限行为。我们指出，在其他条件不变的情况下，市场会选择那些采用贝叶斯学习方法的消费者，并且会根据他们的参数空间大小在贝叶斯者中进行选择。最后，我们表明，在不完全市场经济中，这些结论可能不再成立。收益函数可能对长期生存产生影响，市场选择假设在这种情况下不再成立。

abstract.text: This paper presents a new approach to estimation and inference in panel data models with a general multifactor error structure. The unobserved factors and the individual-specific errors are allowed to follow arbitrary stationary processes, and the number of unobserved factors need not be estimated. The basic idea is to filter the individual-specific regressors by means of cross-section averages such that asymptotically as the cross-section dimension (N) tends to infinity, the differential effects of unobserved common factors are eliminated. The estimation procedure has the advantage that it can be computed by least squares applied to auxiliary regressions where the observed regressors are augmented with cross-sectional averages of the dependent variable and the individual-specific regressors. A number of estimators (referred to as common correlated effects (CCE) estimators) are proposed and their asymptotic distributions are derived. The small sample properties of mean group and pooled CCE estimators are investigated by Monte Carlo experiments, showing that the CCE estimators have satisfactory small sample properties even under a substantial degree of heterogeneity and dynamics, and for relatively small values of N and T.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00692.x.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种针对具有一般多因子误差结构的面板数据模型进行估计和推断的新方法。未观测因子以及个体特定误差被允许遵循任意的平稳过程，且无需估计未观测因子的数量。其基本思想是通过横截面平均值来过滤个体特定回归变量，使得当横截面维度（N）趋于无穷大时，未观测共同因子的差异效应被消除。该估计方法的优势在于，可以通过对辅助回归进行最小二乘运算来计算，其中观测到的回归变量会加上横截面平均值以及个体特定回归变量的信息。文中提出了若干估计量（称为共同相关效应估计量），并推导了它们的渐近分布。通过蒙特卡洛实验研究了均值组和汇总共同相关效应估计量的小样本性质，结果表明，即使在存在较大程度的异质性和动态性的情况下，以及对于相对较小的N和T值，这些估计量仍具有令人满意的小样本性质。

abstract.text: Building upon a continuous-time model of search with Nash bargaining in a station-ary environment, we analyze the effect of changes in minimum wages on labor market outcomes and welfare. Although minimum wage increases may or may not lead to in-creases in unemployment in our model, they can be welfare-improving to labor market participants on both the supply and demand sides of the labor market. We discuss iden-tification of the model using Current Population Survey data on accepted wages and unemployment durations, and show that by incorporating a limited amount of infor-mation from the demand side of the market it is possible to obtain credible and precise estimates of all primitive parameters. We show that the optimal minimum wage in 1996 depends critically on whether or not contact rates can be considered to be exogenous and we note that the limited variation in minimum wages makes testing this assumption problematic.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00693.x.abstractZh: 基于一个连续时间搜索模型，该模型考虑了在静态环境中进行纳什讨价还价的行为，我们分析了最低工资变化对劳动力市场结果和福利的影响。尽管在我们的模型中，最低工资的提高可能会导致或不会导致失业率的上升，但它们能够改善劳动力市场供需双方的福利状况。我们讨论了如何利用当前人口调查数据来识别模型，这些数据包含了被接受的工资水平和失业持续时间的信息。研究表明，通过结合市场中需求方面有限的信息，可以获得所有基本参数的可信且精确的估计值。我们还指出，1996年最优最低工资的高低取决于是否可以将接触率视为外生变量，而最低工资水平的有限变化使得这一假设的检测变得困难。

abstract.text: A contract with multiple agents may be susceptible to collusion. We show that agents' collusion imposes no cost in a large class of circumstances with risk neutral agents, including both uncorrelated and correlated types. In those circumstances, any payoff the principal can attain in the absence of collusion, including the second best level, can be attained in the presence of collusion in a way robust to many aspects of collusion behavior. The collusion-proof implementation generalizes to a setting in which only a subset of agents may collude, provided that noncollusive agents' incentives can be protected via an ex post incentive compatible and ex post individually rational mechanism. Our collusion-proof implementation also sheds light on the extent to which hierarchical delegation of contracts can optimally respond to collusion.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00694.x.abstractZh: 与多个代理人签订的合同可能会受到勾结的影响。我们证明，在包括不相关和相关的代理人在内的许多情况下，代理人的勾结并不会带来任何成本。在这些情况下，即使没有勾结，委托人所能获得的任何收益，包括第二好的收益水平，在存在勾结的情况下仍然可以得到，而且这种结果在应对多种勾结行为方面是稳健的。这种防止勾结的实现方式可以推广到只有部分代理人可能勾结的情况，前提是可以通过一个事后激励相容且事后个体理性的机制来保护非勾结代理人的利益。我们的防止勾结的实现方式还揭示了分层委托合同在应对勾结方面的优化响应程度。

abstract.text: We characterize dominant-strategy incentive compatibility with multidimensional types. A deterministic social choice function is dominant-strategy incentive compat-ible if and only if it is weakly monotone (W-Mon). The W-Mon requirement is the following: If changing one agent’s type (while keeping the types of other agents fixed) changes the outcome under the social choice function, then the resulting difference in utilities of the new and original outcomes evaluated at the new type of this agent must be no less than this difference in utilities evaluated at the original type of this agent.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00695.x.abstractZh: 我们描述了具有多维类型的优势策略激励相容性。一个确定性社会选择函数当且仅当它是弱单调的时，才是优势策略激励相容的。W-Mon要求如下：如果改变一个代理人的类型（同时保持其他代理人的类型不变），会导致社会选择函数下的结果发生变化，那么在新类型下，该代理人新旧结果的效用差异，必须不小于在原始类型下该代理人效用差异。

abstract.text: We consider the situation when there is a large number of series, N, each with T observations, and each series has some predictive ability for some variable of interest. A methodology of growing interest is first to estimate common factors from the panel of data by the method of principal components and then to augment an otherwise standard regression with the estimated factors. In this paper, we show that the least squares estimates obtained from these factor-augmented regressions are consistent and asymptotically normal if . The conditional mean predicted by the estimated factors is consistent and asymptotically normal. Except when T/N goes to zero, inference should take into account the effect of “estimated regressors” on the estimated conditional mean. We present analytical formulas for prediction intervals that are valid regardless of the magnitude of N/T and that can also be used when the factors are nonstationary.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00696.x.abstractZh: 我们考虑这样一种情况：存在大量序列，每个序列包含T个观测值，且每个序列都对某个感兴趣的变量具有一定的预测能力。一种越来越受欢迎的方法是首先通过主成分分析法从面板数据中估计共同因子，然后将这些估计因子加入到标准的回归模型中。在本文中，我们证明了如果这些条件满足，那么从这些因子增强的回归中得到的最小二乘估计量是一致且渐近正态的。由估计因子预测的条件均值也是一致且渐近正态的。除非T/N趋近于零，否则在进行推断时需要考虑“估计回归量”对估计条件均值的影响。我们提出了预测区间的分析公式，这些公式无论N/T的大小如何都是有效的，并且当因子是非平稳的时也可以使用这些公式。

abstract.text: We examine legislative policy making in institutions with two empirically relevant features: agenda setting occurs in real time and the default policy evolves. We demonstrate that these institutions select Condorcet winners when they exist, provided a sufficient number of individuals have opportunities to make proposals. In policy spaces with either pork barrel or pure redistributional politics (where a Condorcet winner does not exist), the last proposer is effectively a dictator or near-dictator under relatively weak conditions.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00701.x.abstractZh: 我们研究了具有两个实证相关特征的机构中的立法政策制定过程：议程设置是实时进行的，而默认政策会不断演变。我们证明，只要有足够的个体有机会提出提案，这些机构就会选择康德洛塞特获胜者。在存在“猪肉桶政治”或纯粹再分配政治的政策环境中（即不存在康德洛塞特获胜者的情况），在相对较弱的条件下，最后提出提案的人实际上相当于独裁者或近乎独裁者。

abstract.text: School choice has become an increasingly prominent strategy for enhancing academic achievement. To evaluate the impact on participants, we exploit randomized lotteries that determine high school admission in the Chicago Public Schools. Compared to those students who lose lotteries, students who win attend high schools that are better in a number of dimensions, including peer achievement and attainment levels. Nonetheless, we find little evidence that winning a lottery provides any systematic benefit across a wide variety of traditional academic measures. Lottery winners do, however, experience improvements on a subset of nontraditional outcome measures, such as self-reported disciplinary incidents and arrest rates.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00702.x.abstractZh: 学校选择已成为提升学术成就的日益重要的策略。为了评估其对参与者的影响，我们利用了芝加哥公立学校通过随机抽签来决定高中入学资格的方式。与未能赢得抽签的学生相比，赢得抽签的学生就读的学校在多个方面表现更好，包括同伴成就和学业水平。然而，我们发现几乎没有证据表明赢得抽签能在各种传统的学术指标上带来系统性优势。不过，赢得抽签的学生在一些非传统的结果指标上确实有所改善，例如自我报告的纪律事件数量和逮捕率。

abstract.text: A step toward a strategic foundation for rational expectations equilibrium is taken by considering a double auction with n buyers and m sellers with interdependent values and a ¢ liated private information. If there are su ¢ ciently many buyers and sellers, and their bids are restricted to a su ¢ ciently …ne discrete set of prices, then, generically, there is an equilibrium in nondecreasing bidding functions that is arbitrarily close to the unique fully revealing rational expectations equilibrium of the limit market with unrestricted bids and a continuum of agents. In particular, the large double auction equilibrium is almost e ¢ cient and almost fully aggregates the agents’information. 1.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00703.x.abstractZh: 通过考虑一个包含n个买家和m个卖家的双拍卖市场，这些买家和卖家具有相互依赖的价值，并且拥有相互关联的私人信息，可以朝着理性预期均衡的战略基础迈出一步。如果买家和卖家的数量足够多，并且他们的出价被限制在一个离散的价格范围内，那么通常存在一个非递减出价函数均衡，这个均衡几乎可以无限接近无限制出价和连续代理人构成的极限市场的唯一完全揭示理性预期均衡。特别是，大型双拍卖市场的均衡几乎是高效的，并且几乎完全整合了代理人的信息。

abstract.text: Comparisons of learning models in repeated games have been a central preoccupation of experimental and behavioral economics over the last decade. Much of this work begins with pooled estimation of the model(s) under scrutiny. I show that in the presence of parameter heterogeneity, pooled estimation can produce a severe bias that tends to unduly favor reinforcement learning relative to belief learning. This occurs when comparisons are based on goodness of fit and when comparisons are based on the relative importance of the two kinds of learning in hybrid structural models. Even misspecified random parameter estimators can greatly reduce the bias relative to pooled estimation.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00704.x.abstractZh: 在过去十年中，重复博弈中学习模型的比较一直是实验经济学和行为经济学的核心研究课题。许多相关研究都是从对受审查模型进行汇总估计开始的。我指出，在参数异质性存在的情况下，汇总估计可能会产生严重的偏差，这种偏差往往会使强化学习相对于信念学习占据优势。这种情况发生在基于拟合优度的比较中，以及基于混合结构模型中两种学习方式的相对重要性的比较中。即使随机参数估计器的设定存在错误，也能显著减少与汇总估计相比的偏差。

abstract.text: We introduce and solve a new class of “downward-recursive” static portfolio choice problems. An individual simultaneously chooses among ranked stochastic options, and each choice is costly. In the motivational application, just one may be exercised from those that succeed. This often emerges in practice, such as when a student applies to many colleges or when a firm simultaneously tries several technologies. We show that such portfolio choice problems quite generally entail maximizing a submodular function of finite sets—which is NP-hard in general. Still, we show that a greedy algorithm finds the optimal set, finding first the best singleton, then the best single addition to it, and so on. We show that the optimal choices are “less aggressive” than the sequentially optimal ones, but “more aggressive” than the best singletons. Also, the optimal set in general contains gaps. We provide some comparative statics results on the chosen set.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00705.x.abstractZh: 我们引入并解决了一种新的“向下递归”静态投资组合选择问题。个体在排名有序的随机选项中进行选择，而每个选择都会产生成本。在激励性应用中，只有成功的选择才能被实施。这种情况在实践中经常出现，例如学生申请多所大学时，或者企业同时尝试多种技术时。我们表明，这类投资组合选择问题通常涉及到对有限集合的亚模函数进行最大化——这通常属于NP难问题。不过，我们证明了一个贪婪算法可以找到最优集合，首先找到最佳的单一选项，然后找到对其的最佳补充选项，依此类推。我们发现，最优选择比顺序最优选择“不那么激进”，但比最佳的单一选项“更激进”。此外，最优集合通常包含间隙。我们还提供了一些关于所选集合的比较静态结果。

abstract.text: A seller and a buyer bargain over the terms of trade for an object. The seller receives a perfect signal that determines the value of the object to both players, whereas the buyer remains uninformed. We analyze the infinite-horizon bargaining game in which the buyer makes all the offers. When the static incentive constraints permit first-best efficiency, then under some regularity conditions the outcome of the sequential bargaining game becomes arbitrarily efficient as bargaining frictions vanish. When the static incentive constraints preclude first-best efficiency, the limiting bargaining outcome is not second-best efficient and may even perform worse than the outcome from the one-period bargaining game. With frequent buyer offers, the outcome is then characterized by recurring bursts of high probability of agreement, followed by long periods of delay in which the probability of agreement is negligible.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00706.x.abstractZh: 卖方和买方就某物品的交易条款进行协商。卖方获得了关于该物品价值的完整信息，而买方则对此一无所知。我们分析了一个无限期视角的协商游戏，其中买方做出所有提议。当静态激励约束允许达到最优效率时，在某些规则条件下，随着协商摩擦的消失，序贯协商游戏的结果将变得任意高效。而当静态激励约束阻碍最优效率的实现时，最终的协商结果并非次优效率，甚至可能比单期协商游戏的结果更差。在买方频繁提出提议的情况下，结果表现为高概率达成一致的短暂时期，随后是长时间的延迟，在此期间达成一致的概率几乎为零。

abstract.text: Recent discoveries in behavioral economics have led scholars to question the underpinnings of neoclassical economics. We use insights gained from one of the most influential lines of behavioral research—gift exchange—in an attempt to maximize worker effort in two quite distinct tasks: data entry for a university library and door-to-door fundraising for a research center. In support of the received literature, our field evidence suggests that worker effort in the first few hours on the job is considerably higher in the “gift” treatment than in the “nongift” treatment. After the initial few hours, however, no difference in outcomes is observed, and overall the gift treatment yielded inferior aggregate outcomes for the employer: with the same budget we would have logged more data for our library and raised more money for our research center by using the market-clearing wage rather than by trying to induce greater effort with a gift of higher wages.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00707.x.abstractZh: 行为经济学的最新发现使学者们开始质疑新古典经济学的理论基础。我们借鉴了行为经济学中最有影响力的研究方向之一——礼物交换理论，试图在两项截然不同的任务中最大化工人的努力程度：为大学图书馆输入数据和为研究中心进行上门筹款。根据现有文献，我们的实地研究表明，在“礼物”处理模式下，工人在工作的最初几个小时内付出的努力明显高于“非礼物”处理模式。然而，在最初的几个小时后，两种处理方式的结果没有差异，总体而言，“礼物”处理模式给雇主带来的总体效果更差：使用市场清算工资，我们本可以为其图书馆输入更多数据，并为研究中心筹集更多资金，而不是试图通过赠送更高工资的礼物来诱导更大的努力。

abstract.text: This paper examines an exchange economy with heterogeneous indivisible objects that can be substitutable or complementary. We show that a competitive equilibrium exists in such economies, provided that all the objects can be partitioned into two groups, and from the viewpoint of each agent, objects in the same group are substitutes and objects across the two groups are complements. This condition generalizes the well-known Kelso–Crawford gross substitutes condition and is called gross substitutes and complements. We also provide practical and typical examples from which substitutes and complements are both jointly observed.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00708.x.abstractZh: 本文研究了一种具有异质不可分割对象的交换经济，这些对象可以互相替代或互补。我们证明，只要所有对象可以被分为两组，且从每个参与者的角度来看，同一组中的对象互为替代品，而两组之间的对象互为互补品，那么这种经济中必然存在竞争均衡。这一条件推广了众所周知的Kelso–Crawford完全替代品条件，并被称为完全替代品和互补品条件。我们还提供了一些实际且典型的例子，在这些例子中，替代品和互补品同时被观察到。

abstract.text: Finite population noncooperative games with linear-quadratic utilities, where each player decides how much action she exerts, can be interpreted as a network game with local payoff complementarities, together with a globally uniform payoff substitutability component and an own-concavity effect. For these games, the Nash equilibrium action of each player is proportional to her Bonacich centrality in the network of local complementarities, thus establishing a bridge with the sociology literature on social networks. This Bonacich–Nash linkage implies that aggregate equilibrium increases with network size and density. We then analyze a policy that consists of targeting the key player, that is, the player who, once removed, leads to the optimal change in aggregate activity. We provide a geometric characterization of the key player identified with an intercentrality measure, which takes into account both a player's centrality and her contribution to the centrality of the others.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00709.x.abstractZh: 具有线性-二次效用函数的有限人口非合作博弈中，每个玩家都决定自己采取何种行动。这类博弈可以被视为一种具有局部支付互补性的网络博弈，同时具备全局统一的支付替代性特征以及自身凹性效应。对于这些博弈，每个玩家的纳什均衡行动与其在网络中Bonacich中心性的比例成正比，从而与关于社会网络的社会学文献建立了联系。这种Bonacich-纳什联系意味着总体均衡会随着网络规模和密度的增加而提升。接下来，我们分析了一种策略，即针对关键玩家进行干预，也就是那些一旦被移除就能导致总体活动最优变化的玩家。我们提供了一种几何化表征关键玩家的手段，该表征通过中间性度量来识别关键玩家，其中考虑了玩家的中心性以及她对其他人中心性的贡献。

abstract.text: The ethic of priority is a compromise between the extremely compensatory ethic of outcome equality and the needs-blind ethic of resource equality. We propose an axiom of priority and characterize resource-allocation rules that are impartial, prioritarian, and solidaristic. They comprise a class of rules that equalize across individuals some index of outcome and resources. Consequently, we provide an ethical rationalization for the many applications in which such indices have been used (e.g., the human development index, the index of primary goods, etc.).

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00710.x.abstractZh: 优先伦理是一种介于极端补偿性的结果平等伦理与不顾需求的资源平等伦理之间的折中方案。我们提出了一种优先公理，并描述了那些公正、优先考虑特定需求且具有团结精神的资源分配规则。这些规则能够使得个体之间的某些结果和资源的指标达到均衡。因此，我们为许多使用这些指标的情境提供了伦理上的合理性解释（例如，人类发展指数、基本商品指数等）。

abstract.text: This note revisits the identification theorems of Brown (1983) and Roehrig (1988). We describe an error in the proofs of the main identification theorems in these papers, and provide an important counterexample to the theorems on the identification of the reduced form. Specifically, the reduced form of a nonseparable simultaneous equations model is not identified even under the assumptions of these papers. We provide conditions under which the reduced form is identified and is recoverable using the distribution of the endogenous variables conditional on the exogenous variables. However, these conditions place substantial limitations on the structural model. We conclude the note with a conjecture that it may be possible to use classical exclusion restrictions to recover some of the key implications of the theorems in more general settings.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00711.x.abstractZh: 本文重新审视了Brown（1983）和Roehrig（1988）的识别定理。我们指出了这些论文中主要识别定理证明中的一个错误，并提供了一个重要的反例，用以反驳关于简化形式识别的定理。具体来说，即使在这些论文的假设条件下，非可分离的同时方程模型的简化形式也无法被识别。我们提出了一些条件，在这些条件下，简化形式可以被识别，并且可以通过条件于外生变量的内生变量的分布来恢复。然而，这些条件对结构模型施加了相当大的限制。最后，我们提出了一个猜想，即可能使用经典的排除限制来在更一般的情境下恢复这些定理的一些关键含义。

abstract.text: We characterize, in the Anscombe–Aumann framework, the preferences for which there are a utility functionu on outcomes and an ambiguity indexc on the set of probabilities on the states of the world such that, for all acts f and g, . The function u represents the decision maker's risk attitudes, while the index c captures his ambiguity attitudes. These preferences include the multiple priors preferences of Gilboa and Schmeidler and the multiplier preferences of Hansen and Sargent. This provides a rigorous decision-theoretic foundation for the latter model, which has been widely used in macroeconomics and finance.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00716.x.abstractZh: 在Anscombe–Aumann框架中，我们描述了一种偏好类型，其对应的效用函数u和不确定性指数c分别定义了世界状态的概率集合。对于所有行动f和g，满足以下条件。效用函数u代表了决策者的风险态度，而不确定性指数c则反映了其不确定性态度。这些偏好包括Gilboa和Schmeidler提出的多重先验偏好，以及Hansen和Sargent提出的乘数偏好。这为后者模型提供了严格的决策理论基础，该模型在宏观经济学和金融学中得到了广泛应用。

abstract.text: We prove the folk theorem for discounted repeated games under private, almost-perfect monitoring. Our result covers all finite, n-player games satisfying the usual full-dimensionality condition. Mixed strategies are allowed in determining the individually rational payoffs. We assume no cheap-talk communication between players and no public randomization device.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00717.x.abstractZh: 我们证明了在私人监控且监控几乎完美的情况下，折扣重复博弈的民间定理。我们的结果涵盖了所有满足通常的完全维度条件的有限n人博弈。在确定个体理性收益时，允许使用混合策略。我们假设玩家之间不存在廉价沟通，也不存在公开的随机化装置。

abstract.text: We propose a framework for out-of-sample predictive ability testing and forecast selection designed for use in the realistic situation in which the forecasting model is possibly misspecified, due to unmodeled dynamics, unmodeled heterogeneity, incorrect functional form, or any combination of these. Relative to the existing literature (Diebold and Mariano (1995) and West (1996)), we introduce two main innovations: (i) We derive our tests in an environment where the finite sample properties of the estimators on which the forecasts may depend are preserved asymptotically. (ii) We accommodate conditional evaluation objectives (can we predict which forecast will be more accurate at a future date?), which nest unconditional objectives (which forecast was more accurate on average?), that have been the sole focus of previous literature. As a result of (i), our tests have several advantages: they capture the effect of estimation uncertainty on relative forecast performance, they can handle forecasts based on both nested and nonnested models, they allow the forecasts to be produced by general estimation methods, and they are easy to compute. Although both unconditional and conditional approaches are informative, conditioning can help fine-tune the forecast selection to current economic conditions. To this end, we propose a two-step decision rule that uses current information to select the best forecast for the future date of interest. We illustrate the usefulness of our approach by comparing forecasts from leading parameter-reduction methods for macroeconomic forecasting using a large number of predictors.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00718.x.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个用于样本外预测能力测试和预测选择框架，该框架适用于以下现实情况：预测模型可能因未建模的动态、未建模的异质性、错误的函数形式或这些因素的组合而存在误设。与现有文献（Diebold和Mariano (1995)以及West (1996)）相比，我们引入了两个主要创新点：(i) 我们在一种环境中推导出测试方法，在这种环境中，预测所依赖的估计量的有限样本性质在渐近意义上得以保持。(ii) 我们考虑了条件评估目标（例如，能否预测未来某个日期哪个预测会更准确？），这些目标涵盖了之前文献中唯一关注的无条件目标（例如，平均而言哪个预测更准确？）。由于(i)的原因，我们的测试方法具有多个优势：它们能够捕捉估计不确定性对相对预测性能的影响，能够处理基于嵌套和非嵌套模型的预测，允许使用一般的估计方法生成预测，并且计算简单。尽管无条件和有条件的方法都具有信息量，但条件化可以帮助根据当前经济条件来微调预测选择。为此，我们提出了一种两步决策规则，该规则利用当前信息来选择未来日期的最佳预测。我们通过比较使用大量预测变量进行宏观经济预测的主要参数减少方法的预测结果，来说明我们方法的实用性。

abstract.text: We examine experimentally the impact of communication on trust and cooperation. Our design admits observation of promises, lies, and beliefs. The evidence is consistent with people striving to live up to others' expectations so as to avoid guilt, as can be modeled using psychological game theory. When players exhibit such guilt aversion, communication may influence motivation and behavior by influencing beliefs about beliefs. Promises may enhance trustworthy behavior, which is what we observe. We argue that guilt aversion may be relevant for understanding strategic interaction in a variety of settings, and that it may shed light on the role of language, discussions, agreements, and social norms in these contexts.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00719.x.abstractZh: 我们通过实验研究沟通对信任与合作的影响。我们的实验设计允许观察承诺、谎言和信念的行为。这些结果支持了人们为了避免负罪感而努力符合他人期望的观点，这一现象可以通过心理博弈论进行建模。当参与者表现出这种负罪感厌恶时，沟通可以通过影响对信念的信念来影响动机和行为。承诺可能会促进可信的行为，这正是我们所观察到的现象。我们认为，负罪感厌恶对于理解各种情境下的战略互动具有重要意义，并且它可能有助于揭示语言、讨论、协议和社会规范在这些情境中的作用。

abstract.text: We study a repeated game with asymmetric information about a dynamic state of nature. In the course of the game, the better-informed player can communicate some or all of his information to the other. Our model covers costly and/or bounded communication. We characterize the set of equilibrium payoffs and contrast these with the communication equilibrium payoffs, which by definition entail no communication costs.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00720.x.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个关于动态自然状态的重复博弈，其中一方存在信息不对称。在博弈过程中，信息更充分的一方可以将部分或全部信息传达给另一方。我们的模型考虑了成本高昂或有限的信息传递情况。我们描述了均衡收益集合，并将其与无信息传递情况下的均衡收益进行了对比。

abstract.text: Temporary price reductions (sales) are common for many goods and naturally result in large increases in the quantity sold. Demand estimation based on temporary price reductions may mis-measure the long run responsiveness to prices. In this paper we quantify the extent of the problem and assess its economic implications. We structurally estimate a dynamic model of consumer choice using two years of scanner data on the purchasing behavior of a panel of households. The results suggest that static demand estimates, which neglect dynamics: (i) overestimate own price elasticities by 30 percent; (ii) underestimate cross-price elasticities to other products by up to a factor of 5; and (iii) overestimate the substitution to the no purchase, or outside option, by over 200 percent.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00721.x.abstractZh: 临时降价促销活动在许多商品中很常见，这自然会导致销售量的大幅增加。基于临时降价促销活动的需求估计可能会误判对价格的长期反应。在本文中，我们量化了这个问题的严重程度，并评估了其经济影响。我们利用两年来的扫描数据，对消费者选择动态模型进行了结构性估计。研究结果表明，静态需求估计忽略了动态因素：(i) 高估了自身价格弹性30%；(ii) 低估了与其他产品的交叉价格弹性，最高可达5倍；(iii) 高估了选择不购买或选择其他替代方案的情况，超过200%。

abstract.text: In 1971 President Nixon declared war on cancer and increased the federal funds allocated to cancer research dramatically. Thirty years later, many have declared this war a failure. Overall cancer statistics confirm this view: age-adjusted mortality in 2000 was essentially unchanged from the early 1970s. At the same time, age-adjusted mortality rates from cardiovascular disease have fallen quite dramatically. Since the causes underlying cancer and cardiovascular disease are likely to be correlated, the decline in mortality rates from cardiovascular disease may be somewhat responsible for the rise in cancer mortality. It is natural to model mortality with more than one cause of death as a competing risks model. Such models are fundamentally unidentified, and it is therefore difficult to get a clear picture of the progress in cancer. This paper derives bounds for aspects of the underlying distributions under a number of different assumptions. Most importantly, we do not assume that the underlying risks are independent, and impose weak parametric assumptions in order to obtain identification. The theoretical contribution of the paper is to provide a framework to estimate competing risk models with interval data and discrete explanatory variables, both of which are common in empirical applications. We use our method to estimate changes in cancer and cardiovascular mortality since 1970. The estimated bounds for the effect of time on the duration until death for either cause are fairly tight and we find that trends in cancer show much larger improvements than previously estimated. For example, we find that time until death from cancer increased by about 10% for white males and 20% for white women.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00722.x.abstractZh: 1971年，尼克松总统宣布对癌症发起战争，并大幅增加用于癌症研究的联邦资金。三十年后，许多人认为这场战争失败了。整体癌症统计数据证实了这一观点：2000年的年龄调整死亡率与20世纪70年代初相比基本没有变化。与此同时，心血管疾病的年龄调整死亡率却大幅下降。由于癌症和心血管疾病的原因可能相互关联，心血管疾病死亡率的下降可能在一定程度上解释了癌症死亡率的上升。用多个死因来建模死亡情况是一种自然的方法，即使用竞争风险模型。然而，这样的模型本质上是不确定的，因此很难清晰地了解癌症研究的进展。本文在多种假设下推导了相关分布方面的界限。最重要的是，我们没有假设基础风险是独立的，而是采用了弱参数假设以获得确定性。本文的理论贡献在于提供了一个框架，用于估计具有区间数据和离散解释变量的竞争风险模型，这两种数据在实证应用中都很常见。我们使用该方法估计了自1970年以来癌症和心血管疾病死亡率的变化。对于这两种疾病的死亡时间，估计的时间效应界限相当紧密，我们发现癌症的改善趋势比之前估计的要大得多。例如，我们发现白人男性的癌症死亡时间增加了约10%，而白人女性的死亡时间增加了约20%。

abstract.text: In this paper a bootstrap algorithm for a reduced rank vector autoregressive model with a restricted linear trend and independent, identically distributed errors is analyzed. For testing the cointegration rank, the asymptotic distribution under the hypothesis is the same as for the usual likelihood ratio test, so that the bootstrap is consistent. It is furthermore shown that a bootstrap procedure for determining the rank is asymptotically consistent in the sense that the probability of choosing the rank smaller than the true one converges to zero.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00723.x.abstractZh: 本文分析了一种用于降秩向量自回归模型的自助法算法，该模型包含受限线性趋势以及独立同分布误差项。在检验共整合秩时，该假设下的渐近分布与通常的似然比检验相同，因此自助法具有一致性。此外，还证明了用于确定秩的自助法过程在渐近意义上也是一致的，即选择小于真实秩的秩的概率会收敛到零。

abstract.text: A convex, compact, and possibly discontinuous better reply secure game has a Nash equilibrium. We introduce a very weak notion of continuity that can be used to establish that a game is better reply secure and we show that this notion of continuity is satisfied by a large class of games.

10.1111/j.1468-0262.2006.00724.x.abstractZh: 一个凸的、紧凑的，且可能不连续的更优回复安全博弈存在纳什均衡。我们引入了一个非常弱连续的概念，可以用来证明一个博弈是更优回复安全的，并且我们展示了这一连续概念适用于大量博弈。

abstract.text: Educators worry that high-stakes testing will induce teachers and their students to focus only on the test and ignore other, untested aspects of knowledge. Some counter that although this may be true, knowing something is better than knowing nothing and many students would benefit even by learning the material that is to be tested. Using the metaphor of deterring drivers from speeding, it is shown that the optimal rules for high-stakes testing depend on the costs of learning and of monitoring. Incentives need to be concentrated for those whose costs of action are high. For high cost learners this implies announcing the exact requirements of the test. For more able students, a more amorphous standard produces superior results. This is analogous to announcing where the police are when the detection costs are high. Other applications are discussed.

10.1162/qjec.121.3.1029.abstractZh: 教育工作者担心，高风险测试会促使教师和学生只关注考试内容，而忽视其他未经过测试的知识领域。有人反驳说，虽然这可能是事实，但知道一些东西总比一无所知要好，许多学生即使通过学习即将考试的科目也能受益。以阻止司机超速行驶为例，研究表明，针对高风险测试的最佳规则取决于学习和监控的成本。需要为那些行动成本较高的人提供激励措施。对于成本较高的学习者来说，这意味着需要明确公布考试的具体要求。对于能力较强的学生，更灵活的标准能带来更好的效果。这类似于在检测成本较高时确定警力的位置。文章还讨论了其他应用案例。

abstract.text: Recent HIV treatment breakthroughs have lowered HIV mortality in the United States, but have also coincided with increased HIV incidence. We argue that these trends are causally linked, because new treatments have improved health and survival for the HIV +, increased their sexual activity, and thus facilitated HIV's spread. Using variation in state-level Medicaid eligibility rules as an instrument for HIV treatment, we find that treating HIV + individuals more than doubles their number of sex partners. A change of this magnitude would increase infection risk by at least 44 percent for the HIV-negative and likely have lowered their expected welfare.

10.1162/qjec.121.3.1063.abstractZh: 近期HIV治疗领域的突破降低了美国的HIV死亡率，但同时也伴随着HIV感染率的上升。我们认为这两种趋势之间存在因果关系，因为新的治疗方法改善了HIV阳性患者的健康和生存状况，从而增加了他们的性活动，进而促进了HIV的传播。通过以州级医疗补助资格规则的变化作为HIV治疗的指标，我们发现治疗HIV阳性患者会使他们的性伴侣数量增加一倍以上。如此大的变化将使HIV阴性患者的感染风险增加至少44%，并可能降低他们的预期福利。

abstract.text: Restaurant prices in the euro area increased dramatically after the introduction of the euro. We show that this increase can be explained by a common menu cost model, extended to include a state-dependent decision of firms on when to adopt the new currency. Two mechanisms drive this result. First, firms concentrate otherwise staggered price increases around the changeover. Second, before the adoption of the euro, prices do not reflect the marginal cost increases expected to occur after the changeover. This “horizon effect” disappears as soon as the new currency is adopted, causing a jump in the optimal price.

10.1162/qjec.121.3.1103.abstractZh: 欧元区内的餐厅价格在欧元引入后急剧上升。我们发现，这种价格上涨可以通过一个共同的菜单成本模型来解释，该模型还包括了企业在何时采用新货币时的状态依赖决策。有两个机制导致了这一结果。首先，企业在货币转换期间将原本分散的价格上调集中在同一时间。其次，在欧元引入之前，价格并未反映转换后预期的边际成本增加。这种“时间效应”在采用新货币后消失，导致最优价格出现跳跃性增长。

abstract.text: Several theories suggest that pay raises below a reference point will reduce job performance. Final offer arbitration for police unions provides a unique opportunity to examine these theories, as the police officers either receive their requested wage or receive a lower one. In the months after New Jersey police officers lose in arbitration, arrest rates and average sentence length decline, and crime reports rise relative to when they win. These declines in performance are larger when the awarded wage is further from the police union's demand. The findings support the idea that considerations of fairness, disappointment, and, more generally, reference points affect workplace behavior.

10.1162/qjec.121.3.783.abstractZh: 一些理论认为，低于参考点的加薪会降低工作表现。警察工会的薪酬仲裁提供了一个独特的机会来检验这些理论，因为警察们要么获得他们要求的工资，要么获得较低的工资。在新泽西州警察在仲裁中败诉后的几个月里，逮捕率和平均刑期都下降，而犯罪报告则相对增加。当获得的工资距离警察工会的要求更远时，这种表现下降更为明显。这些发现支持了这样一个观点：公平感、失望感，以及更一般的参考点，都会影响工作场所的行为。

abstract.text: The potential for rare economic disasters explains a lot of asset-pricing puzzles. I calibrate disaster probabilities from the twentieth century global history, especially the sharp contractions associated with World War I, the Great Depression, and World War II. The puzzles that can be explained include the high equity premium, low risk-free rate, and volatile stock returns. Another mystery that may be resolved is why expected real interest rates were low in the United States during major wars, such as World War II. The model, an extension of work by Rietz, maintains the tractable framework of a representative agent, time-additive and isoelastic preferences, and complete markets. The results hold with i.i.d. shocks to productivity growth in a Lucas-tree type economy and also with the inclusion of capital formation.

10.1162/qjec.121.3.823.abstractZh: 罕见的经济灾难的潜在性可以解释许多资产定价之谜。我根据20世纪全球历史数据来校准灾难发生的概率，特别是与第一次世界大战、大萧条以及第二次世界大战相关的剧烈经济收缩。这些谜题包括高股权溢价、低无风险利率以及股票回报的波动性等问题。另一个可能得到解答的谜题是，为何在重大战争期间，如第二次世界大战期间，美国的实际利率预期水平较低。该模型是Rietz工作的扩展，它维持了一个易于处理的框架，包括代表性代理人、时间加性和等弹性偏好，以及完全市场条件。研究结果在生产力增长存在独立同分布冲击的Lucas树型经济中仍然成立，并且当包含资本形成因素时，结果同样有效。

abstract.text: This paper provides an explanation for the run-up of U. S. inflation in the 1960s and 1970s and the sharp disinflation in the early 1980s, which standard macroeconomic models have difficulties in addressing. I present a model in which rational policy-makers learn about the behavior of the economy in real time and set stabilization policy optimally, conditional on their current beliefs. The steady state associated with the self-confirming equilibrium of the model is characterized by low inflation. However, prolonged episodes of high inflation ending with rapid disinflations can occur when policy-makers underestimate both the natural rate of unemployment and the persistence of inflation in the Phillips curve. I estimate the model using likelihood methods. The estimation results show that the model accounts remarkably well for the evolution of policy-makers' beliefs, stabilization policy, and the postwar behavior of inflation and unemployment in the United States.

10.1162/qjec.121.3.867.abstractZh: 本文对20世纪60年代和70年代美国通货膨胀的上升以及80年代初的急剧通货紧缩现象进行了解释，这些现象是标准宏观经济模型难以处理的。我提出了一个模型，在该模型中，理性的政策制定者能够实时了解经济行为，并根据当前的信念最优地制定稳定政策。该模型中的稳态与自我确认均衡相关，其特点是通货膨胀率较低。然而，当政策制定者低估了自然失业率以及菲利普斯曲线中通货膨胀的持久性时，可能会出现持续的高通货膨胀期，随后迅速出现通货紧缩。我使用似然方法对该模型进行了估计。估计结果显示，该模型能够很好地解释政策制定者信念的变化、稳定政策的制定，以及战后美国通货膨胀和失业率的演变。

abstract.text: This paper investigates how groups or coalitions of players can act in their collective interest in noncooperative normal form games even if equilibrium play is not assumed. The main idea is that each member of a coalition will confine play to a subset of their strategies if it is in their mutual interest to do so. An iterative procedure of restrictions is used to define a noncooperative solution concept, the set of coalitionally rationalizable strategies. The procedure is analogous to iterative deletion of never best response strategies, but operates on implicit agreements by different coalitions. The solution set is a nonempty subset of the rationalizable strategies.

10.1162/qjec.121.3.903.abstractZh: 本文研究在假设不存在均衡博弈的情况下，群体或联盟中的参与者如何以集体利益为行动目标。其核心思想是，如果某个联盟的成员这样做符合共同利益，那么该成员会将行动限制在部分策略上。本文采用迭代限制方法，定义了一个非合作博弈的解决方案概念，即联盟可理性化的策略集合。该过程类似于迭代删除最差响应策略，但针对的是不同联盟之间的隐含协议。该解决方案集合是理性化策略的一个非空子集。

abstract.text: I use variation across markets in the timing of television's introduction to identify its impact on voter turnout. The estimated effect is significantly negative, accounting for between a quarter and a half of the total decline in turnout since the 1950s. I argue that substitution away from other media with more political coverage provides a plausible mechanism linking television to voting. As evidence for this, I show that the entry of television in a market coincided with sharp drops in consumption of newspapers and radio, and in political knowledge as measured by election surveys. I also show that both the information and turnout effects were largest in off-year congressional elections, which receive extensive coverage in newspapers but little or no coverage on television.

10.1162/qjec.121.3.931.abstractZh: 我通过研究电视引入时间在不同市场中的差异，来探讨其对选民投票率的影响。估计的影响显著为负，占自20世纪50年代以来投票率下降总量的四分之一到一半。我认为，从其他媒体转向电视这种具有更多政治内容的媒体，是电视与投票之间联系的一个合理机制。作为证据，我展示了电视进入某个市场时，报纸和广播的收视率以及通过选举调查测量的政治知识水平都出现了急剧下降。我还发现，信息和投票率的影响在非年度国会选举中最为显著，因为这些选举在报纸上得到了广泛报道，但在电视上却几乎没有报道。

abstract.text: Both Black and White voter turnout increases 2–3 percentage points with each Black Democrat on the ballot. Given the groups' representations in the population, the White response is numerically greater. Whites of both parties are less likely to vote for their parties' candidate when s/he is Black. The turnout findings are not explained away by voter, election, or politician characteristics. However, the fact that there is no turnout response to Black Republicans suggests that a perception of Blacks' ideology may be a factor.

10.1162/qjec.121.3.973.abstractZh: 每有一位黑人民主党候选人参加投票，白人选民的投票率就会增加2-3个百分点。考虑到这两个群体在人口中的代表性，白人的投票率增幅更大。当黑人候选人出现时，两党中的白人更不可能投票给该党的候选人。这些投票率变化现象无法用选民、选举或政治人物的特征来解释。然而，没有针对黑人共和党候选人的投票率变化，这表明对黑人意识形态的看法可能是一个因素。

abstract.text: We use unique Swedish data with information on adopted children's biological and adoptive parents to estimate intergenerational mobility associations in earnings and education. We argue that the impact from biological parents captures broad prebirth factors, including genes and prenatal environment, and the impact from adoptive parents represents broad postbirth factors, such as childhood environment. We find that both pre- and postbirth factors contribute to intergenerational earnings and education transmissions, and that prebirth factors are more important for mother's education and less important for father's income. We also find some evidence for a positive interaction effect between postbirth environment and prebirth factors.

10.1162/qjec.121.3.999.abstractZh: 我们使用独特的瑞典数据，其中包含被收养儿童与其生父和养父的相关信息，来估算代际间在收入和教育方面的流动性关联。我们认为，生父的影响涵盖了广泛的出生前因素，包括基因和产前环境，而养父的影响则代表了广泛的出生后的因素，如童年环境。我们发现，出生前和出生后的因素都对代际间的收入和教育传递有所贡献，其中出生前因素对母亲的教育程度影响更大，对父亲的收入影响则较小。此外，我们还发现了一些证据表明，出生后的环境与出生前因素之间存在积极的互动效应。

abstract.text: We estimate the World Distribution of Income by integrating individual income distributions for 138 countries between 1970 and 2000. Country distributions are constructed by combining national accounts GDP per capita to anchor the mean with survey data to pin down the dispersion. Poverty rates and head counts are reported for four specific poverty lines. Rates in 2000 were between one-third and one-half of what they were in 1970 for all four lines. There were between 250 and 500 million fewer poor in 2000 than in 1970. We estimate eight indexes of income inequality implied by our world distribution of income. All of them show reductions in global inequality during the 1980s and 1990s.

10.1162/qjec.2006.121.2.351.abstractZh: 我们通过整合1970年至2000年间138个国家的个人收入分布来估算全球收入分布。国家分布的构建是通过结合国民账户的人均GDP来确定平均值，并结合调查数据来确定分布范围。针对四条特定的贫困线，报告了贫困率和人口数量。2000年的贫困率比1970年降低了三分之一到一半，四条贫困线均如此。2000年的贫困人口比1970年减少了2.5亿到5亿人。我们根据全球收入分布估算了八个收入不平等指数。所有这些指数都显示，在1980年代和1990年代，全球不平等程度有所降低。

abstract.text: The 1964 Securities Acts Amendments extended the mandatory disclosure requirements that had applied to listed firms since 1934 to large firms traded Over-the-Counter (OTC). We find several pieces of evidence indicating that investors valued these disclosure requirements, two of which are particularly striking. First, a firm-level event study reveals that the OTC firms most affected by the 1964 Amendments had abnormal excess returns of about 3.5 percent in the weeks immediately surrounding the announcement thai they had begun to comply with the new requirements. Second, we estimate that the most affected OTC firms had abnormal excess returns ranging between 11.5 and 22.1 percent in the period between when the legislation was initially proposed and when it went into force. These returns are adjusted for the standard four factors and are relative to NYSE/AMEX firms, matched on size and book-to-market equity, that were unaffected by the legislation. While we cannot determine how much of shareholders' gains were a transfer from insiders of these same companies, our results suggest that mandatory disclosure causes managers to focus more narrowly on maximizing shareholder value.

10.1162/qjec.2006.121.2.399.abstractZh: 1964年的证券法案修正案将自1934年以来适用于上市公司的强制性披露要求扩展到了场外交易的大型公司。我们发现多项证据表明投资者重视这些披露要求，其中两点尤为显著。首先，一项公司层面的事件研究显示，受1964年修正案影响最大的场外交易公司在宣布开始遵守新要求的几周内，出现了约3.5%的异常超额回报。其次，我们估计，在立法最初提出到正式实施期间，受影响最严重的场外交易公司出现了11.5%至22.1%的异常超额回报。这些回报已根据标准的四个因素进行调整，并与那些未受该立法影响的纽约证券交易所/美国证券交易所公司进行了比较，这些公司的规模和市净率都是相同的。虽然我们无法确定股东收益中有多少是来自这些公司的内部人士的转移，但我们的结果表明，强制性披露促使管理者更加专注于最大化股东价值。

abstract.text: We present a theory of excess stock market volatility, in which market movements are due to trades by very large institutional investors in relatively illiquid markets. Such trades generate significant spikes in returns and volume, even in the absence of important news about fundamentals. We derive the optimal trading behavior of these investors, which allows us to provide a unified explanation for apparently disconnected empirical regularities in returns, trading volume and investor size.

10.1162/qjec.2006.121.2.461.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种关于股市过度波动的理论，该理论认为市场波动是由大型机构投资者在相对流动性较低的市场中进行的交易引起的。这类交易即使在没有重要基本面新闻的情况下，也会产生显著的收益和交易量波动。我们推导出了这些投资者的最优交易行为，从而能够统一解释收益、交易量和投资者规模之间看似不相关的现象。

abstract.text: Bayesian consumers infer that hidden add-on prices (e.g., the cost of ink for a printer) are likely to be high prices. If consumers are Bayesian, firms will not shroud information in equilibrium. However, shrouding may occur in an economy with some myopic (or unaware) consumers. Such shrouding creates an inefficiency, which firms may have an incentive to eliminate by educating their competitors' customers. However, if add-ons have close substitutes, a “curse of debiasing” arises, and firms will not be able to profitably debias consumers by unshrouding add-ons. In equilibrium, two kinds of exploitation coexist. Optimizing firms exploit myopic consumers through marketing schemes that shroud high-priced add-ons. In turn, sophisticated consumers exploit these marketing schemes. It is not possible to profitably drive away the business of sophisticates. It is also not possible to profitably lure either myopes or sophisticates to nonexploitative firms. We show that informational shrouding flourishes even in highly competitive markets, even in markets with costless advertising, and even when the shrouding generates allocational inefficiencies.

10.1162/qjec.2006.121.2.505.abstractZh: 贝叶斯消费者推断，隐藏的附加费用（例如打印机的墨水成本）很可能是较高的价格。如果消费者具有贝叶斯思维，企业就不会在均衡状态下隐藏信息。然而，在一些目光短浅的消费者中，信息的隐藏仍可能发生。这种隐藏会导致效率低下，企业可能有动机通过教育竞争对手的客户来消除这种效率低下。然而，如果附加费用有近似的替代品，就会出现“去偏见诅咒”，企业将无法通过不隐藏附加费用来获利。在均衡状态下，两种类型的剥削并存：通过隐藏高价附加费用的营销方案，企业剥削目光短浅的消费者；而精明的消费者则反过来利用这些营销方案。无法以盈利的方式驱逐精明消费者的业务，也无法以盈利的方式吸引目光短浅或精明的消费者选择非剥削性的企业。我们表明，即使在高度竞争的市场中，即使在没有广告成本的市场中，即使隐藏信息的行为会产生分配效率低下，信息隐藏现象仍然普遍存在。

abstract.text: Since the seminal work of Krugman, product variety has played a central role in models of trade and growth. In spite ofthe general use oflove-of-variety models, there has been no systematic study of how the import of new varieties has contributed to national welfare gains in the United States. In this paper we show that the unmeasured growth in product variety from U. S. imports has been an important source of gains from trade over the last three decades (1972–2001). Using extremely disaggregated data, we show that the number of imported product varieties has increased by a factor of three. We also estimate the elasticities of substitution for each available category at the same level of aggregation, and describe their behavior across time and SITC industries. Using these estimates, we develop an exact aggregate price index and find that the upward bias in the conventional import price index over this time period was 28 percent or 1.2 percentage points per year. We estimate the value to U. S. consumers of the expanded import varieties between 1972 and 2001 to be 2.6 percent of GDP.

10.1162/qjec.2006.121.2.541.abstractZh: 自克鲁格曼的开创性研究以来，产品多样性在贸易与增长模型中一直扮演着核心角色。尽管“多样性偏好”模型被广泛使用，但尚无系统研究新品种进口如何为美国国民福利带来提升。本文指出，过去三十年（1972-2001年）美国进口产品多样性的增长是贸易带来的重要收益来源。通过极其详细的细分数据，我们发现进口产品种类的数量增加了三倍。我们还估算了同一层次数据下各产品类别的替代弹性，并分析了这些弹性随时间和SITC行业的变化情况。基于这些估算结果，我们构建了一个精确的总价格指数，发现在此期间传统进口价格指数的上升偏差为28%，即每年增加1.2个百分点。我们估算出1972至2001年间，进口产品多样性增加对美国消费者带来的价值占GDP的2.6%。

abstract.text: We study the extent to which U. S. urban development is sprawling and what determines differences in sprawl across space. Using remote-sensing data to track the evolution of land use on a grid of 8.7 billion 30 × 30 meter cells, we measure sprawl as the amount of undeveloped land surrounding an average urban dwelling. The extent of sprawl remained roughly unchanged between 1976 and 1992, although it varied dramatically across metropolitan areas. Ground water availability, temperate climate, rugged terrain, decentralized employment, early public transport infrastructure, uncertainty about metropolitan growth, and unincorporated land in the urban fringe all increase sprawl.

10.1162/qjec.2006.121.2.587.abstractZh: 我们研究了美国城市发展的扩散程度，以及哪些因素决定了不同地区的扩散情况。通过遥感数据追踪87亿个30×30米网格单元上的土地利用变化，我们将城市扩散定义为平均城市住宅周围未开发土地的数量。1976年至1992年间，城市扩散的程度基本保持不变，尽管不同大都市地区的扩散情况差异显著。地下水供应充足、气候温和、地形崎岖、就业分布分散、公共交通基础设施早期建设、大都市增长的不确定性，以及城市边缘的非建制土地，这些因素都会增加城市扩散。

abstract.text: We designed a commitment savings product for a Philippine bank and implemented it using a randomized control methodology. The savings product was intended for individuals who want to commit now to restrict access to their savings, and who were sophisticated enough to engage in such a mechanism. We conducted a baseline survey on 1777 existing or former clients of a bank. One month later, we offered the commitment product to a randomly chosen subset of 710 clients; 202 (28.4 percent) accepted the offer and opened the account. In the baseline survey, we asked hypothetical time discounting questions. Women who exhibited a lower discount rate for future relative to current trade-offs, and hence potentially have a preference for commitment, were indeed significantly more likely to open the commitment savings account. Mter twelve months, average savings balances increased by 81 percentage points for those clients assigned to the treatment group relative to those assigned to the control group. We conclude that the savings response represents a lasting change in savings, and not merely a short-term response to a new product.

10.1162/qjec.2006.121.2.635.abstractZh: 我们为一家菲律宾银行设计了一种承诺储蓄产品，并采用随机对照方法进行了实施。该储蓄产品旨在面向那些愿意立即做出承诺以限制储蓄访问权限，且具备足够成熟度来参与此类机制的人群。我们对该银行现有的1777名客户进行了基线调查。一个月后，我们向随机选取的710名客户提供了承诺储蓄产品；其中202名客户（占28.4%）接受了提议并开设了账户。在基线调查中，我们提出了假设的时间贴现问题。那些对未来相对当前权衡的贴现率较低的女性，因此更有可能选择开启承诺储蓄账户。经过十二个月后，被分配到实验组的客户的平均储蓄余额比对照组增加了81个百分点。我们得出结论，这种储蓄行为代表了储蓄习惯的持久改变，而不仅仅是对新产品的短期反应。

abstract.text: We study dating behavior using data from a Speed Dating experiment where we generate random matching of subjects and create random variation in the number of potential partners. Our design allows us to directly observe individual decisions rather than just final matches. Women put greater weight on the intelligence and the race of partner, while men respond more to physical attractiveness. Moreover, men do not value women's intelligence or ambition when it exceeds their own. Also, we find that women exhibit a preference for men who grew up in affluent neighborhoods. Finally, male selectivity is invariant to group size, while female selectivity is strongly increasing in group size.

10.1162/qjec.2006.121.2.673.abstractZh: 我们通过对Speed Dating实验的数据进行分析，研究了约会行为。该实验通过随机匹配受试者，并造成潜在伴侣数量的随机变化。我们的设计使我们能够直接观察个体的决策过程，而不仅仅是最终匹配的结果。女性更看重伴侣的智力和种族，而男性则更受外貌吸引力的影响。此外，当女性的智力或抱负超过男性时，男性并不重视这些特质。我们还发现，女性更倾向于选择成长在富裕社区中的男性。最后，男性的选择性不受群体规模的影响，而女性的选择性则随着群体规模的增加而显著增加。

abstract.text: International surveys reveal wide differences between the views held in different countries concerning the causes of wealth or poverty and the extent to which people are responsible for their own fate. At the same time, social ethnographies and experiments by psychologists demonstrate individuals' recurrent struggle with cognitive dissonance as they seek to maintain, and pass on to their children, a view of the world where effort ultimately pays off and everyone gets their just desserts. This paper offers a model that helps explain i) why most people feel such a need to believe in a “just world”; ii) why this need, and therefore the prevalence of the belief, varies considerably across countries; iii) the implications of this phenomenon for international differences in political ideology, levels of redistribution, labor supply, aggregate income, and popular perceptions of the poor. More generally, the paper develops a theory of collective beliefs and motivated cognitions, including those concerning “money” (consumption) and happiness, as well as religion.

10.1162/qjec.2006.121.2.699.abstractZh: 国际调查显示，不同国家在财富或贫困的原因以及人们对自己命运的责任感方面存在巨大差异。同时，社会民族志研究和心理学实验表明，个体在试图维持并将这种世界观传递给子女时，会反复面临认知失调的问题，即努力最终会得到回报，每个人都会得到应得的报应。本文提出了一个模型，用以解释：i) 为什么大多数人会有如此强烈的信念，认为世界是“公正的”；ii) 为什么这种需求以及这种信念的普遍性在不同国家之间存在显著差异；iii) 这种现象对国际政治意识形态、再分配水平、劳动力供应、总收入以及公众对贫困者的看法等方面的影响。更普遍地说，本文还发展了一种关于集体信念和动机性认知的理论，包括与“金钱”（消费）和幸福相关的信念，以及宗教方面的信念。

abstract.text: This study develops theory and uses a door-to-door fund-raising field experiment to explore the economics of charity. We approached nearly 5000 households, randomly divided into four experimental treatments, to shed light on key issues on the demand side of charitable fund-raising. Empirical results are in line with our theory: in gross terms, the lotteries raised more money than the voluntary contributions treatments. Interestingly, in terms of both maximizing current contributions and inducing participation, we find that a one-standard deviation increase in female solicitor physical attractiveness is similar to that ofthe lottery incentive.

10.1162/qjec.2006.121.2.747.abstractZh: 本研究通过理论推导并利用门到门募捐实地实验来探讨慈善事业的经济学现象。我们接触了近5000户家庭，将其随机分为四种实验处理组，以揭示慈善募捐需求端的关键问题。实证结果与我们的理论相符：从总体上看，彩票募捐所筹集的资金多于自愿捐款处理组。有趣的是，在最大化当前捐款数量和促进参与方面，我们发现女性募捐者外貌吸引力增加一个标准差，其效果与彩票激励相当。

abstract.text: This paper examines the properties of instrumental variables (IV) applied to models with essential heterogeneity, that is, models where responses to interventions are heterogeneous and agents adopt treatments (participate in programs) with at least partial knowledge of their idiosyncratic response. We analyze two-outcome and multiple-outcome models, including ordered and unordered choice models. We allow for transition-specific and general instruments. We generalize previous analyses by developing weights for treatment effects for general instruments. We develop a simple test for the presence of essential heterogeneity. We note the asymmetry of the model of essential heterogeneity: outcomes of choices are heterogeneous in a general way; choices are not. When both choices and outcomes are permitted to be symmetrically heterogeneous, the method of IV breaks down for estimating treatment parameters.

10.1162/rest.88.3.389.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在具有本质异质性模型中使用工具变量（IV）的性质。所谓本质异质性模型，是指干预措施的效果存在异质性，而个体在至少部分了解自身异质性反应的情况下选择参与相关项目。我们分析了双结果模型和多结果模型，包括有序选择与无序选择模型。我们允许使用特定过渡期工具和通用工具。通过为通用工具下的处理效应开发权重，我们对先前的研究进行了扩展。我们还提出了一种简单的方法来判断是否存在本质异质性。我们注意到本质异质性模型中的不对称性：选择的结果在一般意义上存在异质性，而选择本身则不存在异质性。当选择结果和选择行为都被允许具有对称性异质性时，使用工具变量法来估计处理参数就会失效。

abstract.text: The U.S. retail trade sector underwent a massive restructuring and reallocation of activity in the 1990s with accompanying technological advances. Using a data set of establishments in that sector, we quantify and explore the relationship between this restructuring and reallocation and labor productivity dynamics. We find that virtually all of the labor productivity growth in the retail trade sector is accounted for by more productive entering establishments displacing much less productive exiting establishments. The productivity gap between low-productivity exiting single-unit establishments and entering high-productivity establishments from large, national chains plays a disproportionate role in these dynamics.

10.1162/rest.88.4.748.abstractZh: 在20世纪90年代，美国零售贸易领域经历了大规模的重组和活动的重新分配，同时伴随着技术的进步。通过收集该领域的企业数据，我们量化并探讨了这种重组和重新分配与劳动生产率动态之间的关系。研究发现，零售贸易领域几乎所有的劳动生产率增长都源于更多效率高的企业进入市场，而效率较低的企业则被淘汰。在 이러한动态中，那些从低效率的单一企业转型为高效率的大型连锁企业的企业，其生产率提升的作用尤为显著。

abstract.text: Provider report cards feature prominently in ongoing efforts to improve patient quality. A well-known example is the cardiac surgery report-card program started in New York, which publicly compares hospital and surgeon performance. Public report cards have been associated with decreases in cardiac surgery mortality, but there is substantial disagreement over the source(s) of the improvement. This article develops a conceptual framework to explain how report-card-related responses could result in lower mortality and reviews the evidence. Existing research shows that report cards have not greatly changed referral patterns. How much providers increased their quality of care and altered their selection of patients remains unresolved, and alternative explanations have not been well studied. Future research should expand the number of states and years covered and exploit the variation in institutional features to improve our understanding of the relationship between report cards and outcomes.

10.1177/1077558706288831.abstractZh: 在改善患者质量的持续努力中，医疗服务提供者的报告卡发挥着重要作用。一个著名的例子是纽约开始的心脏手术报告卡项目，该项目公开比较医院和外科医生的绩效。公开报告卡与心脏手术死亡率的下降有关，但关于这种改善的来源存在很大分歧。本文提出了一个概念框架，以解释报告卡相关的措施如何导致较低的死亡率，并回顾了相关证据。现有研究表明，报告卡并没有显著改变转诊模式。医疗服务提供者究竟提高了他们的护理质量并改变了他们的患者选择方式，这一问题仍未得到解决，而替代性的解释也尚未得到充分研究。未来的研究应该扩大覆盖的州和年份范围，并利用不同机构特征的变化来加深我们对报告卡与结果之间关系的理解。

abstract.text: In our recent paper (Grossman and Lai, 2004), we studied the incentives that governments have to protect intellectual property in a trading world economy. We considered a world economy with ongoing innovation in two (or more) countries that differ in market size and in their capacity for innovation. In Section IV, we compared the strength of patent protection in an efficient world agreement with harmonized rates of protection to the strength of patent protection in a Nash equilibrium with policies chosen by two welfaremaximizing governments.
