We claimed in Proposition 5 that, as long as the elasticity of substitution between human capital and labor in the research activity is no greater than one, then efficient harmonization requires a strengthening of patent protection in both the North and the South, and that the North must gain while the South may gain or lose. Unfortunately, there was an error in our proof. It is correct that, for all elasticities of substitution no greater than one ( 0), efficient harmonization requires a strengthening of patent protection in the South and in the world as a whole. Moreover, patent protection in the North must be stronger in an efficient agreement with harmonization than in the Nash equilibrium if the elasticity of substitution between human capital and labor in R&D is equal to one ( 0). However, if the elasticity of substitution between labor and human capital is less than one, efficient harmonization may require a weakening of patent protection in the North. When MN MS, HN HS, and 0, a sufficient condition for the North to gain from efficient harmonization is HN / HS MN / MS.

10.1257/000282806776157506.abstractZh: 在我们最近的论文中（Grossman和Lai，2004年），我们研究了政府在贸易世界经济中保护知识产权的动机。我们考虑了一个包含两个或更多在市场规模和创新能力上有所不同的国家的世界经济。在第四部分中，我们比较了在高效的世界协议中，以统一的保护率为基础的专利保护强度，与在纳什均衡中由两个追求福利最大化的政府所选择的政策所带来的专利保护强度。我们在第五个命题中声称，只要研究与活动中的人力资本与劳动力之间的替代弹性不超过一，那么高效的协调就需要加强北方和南方的专利保护，并且北方必须受益，而南方可能会受益或受损。不幸的是，我们的证明中存在一个错误。实际上，对于所有替代弹性不超过一的情况（0），高效的协调确实需要加强南方以及整个世界的专利保护。此外，如果研发中的人力资本与劳动力之间的替代弹性等于一（0），那么在高效协调的协议中，北方的专利保护必须比纳什均衡中的保护更强。然而，如果劳动力与人力资本之间的替代弹性小于一，那么高效的协调可能需要削弱北方的专利保护。当MN MS、HN HS且0时，北方从高效协调中获益的充分条件是HN / HS MN / MS。

abstract.text: We decompose the beauty premium in an experimental labor market where “employers” determine wages of “workers” who perform a maze-solving task. This task requires a true skill which we show to be unaffected by physical attractiveness. We find a sizable beauty premium and can identify three transmission channels: (a) physically attractive workers are more confident and higher confidence increases wages; (b) for a given level of confidence, physically attractive workers are (wrongly) considered more able by employers; (c) controlling for worker confidence, physically attractive workers have oral skills (such as communication and social skills) that raise their wages when they interact with employers. Our methodology can be adopted to study the sources of discriminatory pay differentials in other settings.

10.1257/000282806776157515.abstractZh: 我们在一个实验性劳动力市场中分解了美貌溢价现象，该市场中“雇主”决定执行迷宫解决任务的“工人”的薪酬。这项任务需要真正的技能，我们发现美貌并不会影响这些技能的表现。我们发现美貌溢价相当显著，并且可以识别出三个传递渠道：(a) 外貌吸引人的工人更自信，而更高的自信水平会提高他们的薪酬；(b) 在一定的自信水平下，外貌吸引人的工人会被雇主错误地认为更有能力；(c) 在控制工人自信水平的情况下，外貌吸引人的工人在与雇主互动时，其口头技能（如沟通能力和社交能力）也会提升他们的薪酬。我们的研究方法可以应用于研究其他情境下歧视性薪酬差异的来源。

abstract.text: Some recent empirical studies, motivated by Grossman and Helpman's (1994) “protection-for-sale” model, suggest that very few factors (none of them labor related) determine trade protection. This paper reexamines the roles that labor issues play in the determination of trade policy. We introduce collective bargaining, differences in inter industry labor mobility, and trade union lobbying into the protection-for-sale model, and show that the equilibrium protection rate in our model depends upon these labor market variables. We test our model predictions using data from U.S. manufacturing and find that labor market considerations do seem to matter for U.S. trade policy.

10.1257/000282806776157524.abstractZh: 一些近期的实证研究，基于Grossman和Helpman在1994年提出的“保护换取销售”模型，指出几乎没有哪些因素（其中没有与劳动力相关的因素）能够决定贸易保护政策。本文重新审视了劳动力问题在贸易政策决定中的作用。我们将集体谈判、行业间劳动力流动的差异以及工会游说纳入“保护换取销售”模型，并发现模型中的均衡保护率取决于这些劳动力市场变量。我们使用美国制造业的数据对模型预测进行了检验，发现劳动力市场的因素确实对美国的贸易政策有重要影响。

abstract.text: This paper describes how wealth inequality may distort public resource allocation. A government seeks to allocate limited resources to productive sectors, but sectoral productivity is privately known by agents with vested interests in those sectors. They lobby the government for preferential treatment. The government—even if it honestly seeks to maximize economic efficiency—may be confounded by the possibility that both high wealth and true economic desirability create loud lobbies. Broadly speaking, both poorer economies and unequal economies display greater public misallocation. The paper warns against the conventional wisdom that this is so because such governments are more “corrupt.”

10.1257/000282806776157533.abstractZh: 本文探讨了财富不平等如何扭曲公共资源的分配。政府试图将有限的资源分配给生产部门，但各部门的生产效率是由那些在该部门拥有既得利益的个体所掌握的私人信息。这些个体会向政府游说，以换取优惠待遇。即使政府真诚地寻求最大化经济效率，也可能受到高财富水平与真正的经济需求这两种因素的共同影响，从而陷入混乱。总体而言，无论是较贫穷的经济体还是不平等的经济体，都表现出更严重的公共资源分配不当问题。本文警告说，这种状况的出现并非因为这样的政府更加“腐败”。

abstract.text: Are consumers sufficiently self-interested and self-reliant so that privatized markets deliver the efficiency and welfare gains they promise? Why are consumers uncomfortable in markets, and in some case sufficiently opposed to market solutions to prevent their implementation? What can be done to prepare consumers so that they function satisfactorily in markets, and understand the advantages of market-based resource allocation? This paper examines the foundations of consumer behavior and attitudes in markets, and proposes a program of scientific research to determine how consumers cope in privatized markets, and the implications for market design of the limits of self-reliance.

10.1257/000282806776157542.abstractZh: 消费者是否具备足够的自我利益意识和自立能力，使得私有化市场能够兑现其承诺的效率提升和福利改善？为什么消费者在市场中感到不适，甚至在某些情况下强烈反对市场解决方案，从而阻碍其实施？可以采取哪些措施来培养消费者的市场参与能力，使他们能够充分理解基于市场的资源配置的优势？本文探讨了消费者在市场中的行为和态度基础，并提出了科学研究计划，以了解消费者在私有化市场中的应对方式，以及自立能力的限制对市场设计的影响。

abstract.text: Recent technological advances have dramatically lowered the cost of transmitting information over large distances. In the late 1990s, the New York Times implemented a national distribution strategy, expanding delivery in over 100 cities. Using cross-sectional and longitudinal data on local newspaper circulation, Times penetration, and local newspapers characteristics, we find that as Times circulation grows in a market, local newspaper circulation declines among college-educated readers. Local newspapers reposition toward local and away from national coverage, raising circulation among individuals without a degree. Availability of national newspapers in local markets changes the relationship between local preferences and local products.

10.1257/000282806776157551.abstractZh: 近期的技术进步显著降低了信息在长距离传输上的成本。在20世纪90年代末，《纽约时报》实施了全国性的发行策略，将发行范围扩展到了100多个城市。通过关于地方报纸发行量、《纽约时报》的普及程度以及地方报纸特征的横截面和纵向数据，我们发现，在一个市场中，《纽约时报》的发行量增加时，受过大学教育读者的地方报纸发行量则会下降。地方报纸重新定位为地方性内容，减少全国性报道，从而吸引了没有学位的读者。全国性报纸在地方市场的存在改变了地方偏好与当地产品之间的关系。

abstract.text: The canonical inflation specification in sticky-price rational expectations models (the new-Keynesian Phillips curve) is often criticized for failing to account for the dependence of inflation on its own lags. In response, many studies employ a “hybrid” specification in which inflation depends on its lagged and expected future values, together with a driving variable such as the output gap. We consider some simple tests of the hybrid model that are derived from its closed form. We find that the hybrid model describes inflation dynamics poorly, and find little empirical evidence for the type of rational, forward-looking behavior that the model implies.

10.1257/000282806776157560.abstractZh: 在粘性价格理性预期模型中，传统的通胀设定方式（即新凯恩斯主义菲利普斯曲线）常常因未能考虑通胀对其自身滞后因素的依赖性而受到批评。为了应对这一问题，许多研究采用了一种“混合”设定方式，其中通胀不仅取决于其滞后值和预期未来值，还取决于诸如产出缺口等驱动因素。我们研究了从该混合模型封闭形式推导出的一些简单测试方法。研究发现，混合模型对通胀动态的描述效果不佳，并且几乎没有实证证据支持该模型所假设的那种理性、前瞻性的行为模式。

abstract.text: We propose a simple model of trooper behavior to design empirical tests for whether troopers of different races are monolithic in their search behavior, and whether they exhibit relative racial prejudice in motor vehicle searches. Our test of relative racial prejudice provides a partial solution to the well-known inframarginality and omitted-variables problems associated with outcome tests. When applied to a unique dataset from Florida, our tests soundly reject the hypothesis that troopers of different races are monolithic in their search behavior, but the tests fail to reject the hypothesis that troopers of different races do not exhibit relative racial prejudice.

10.1257/000282806776157579.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个简单的士兵行为模型，用于设计实证测试，以探讨不同种族的士兵在搜索行为上是否存在单一性，以及他们在机动车搜索中是否表现出相对的种族偏见。我们对相对种族偏见的测试为与结果测试相关的众所周知的“次边际性”和“遗漏变量”问题提供了部分解决方案。当应用于佛罗里达州的一个独特数据集时，我们的测试强烈否定了不同种族的士兵在搜索行为上具有单一性的假设，但未能否定不同种族的士兵不表现出相对种族偏见的假设。

abstract.text: Previous experiments using the minimum-effort coordination game reveal a striking regularity—large groups never coordinate efficiently. Given the frequency with which large real-world groups, such as firms, face similarly difficult coordination problems, this poses an important question: Why do we observe large, successfully coordinated groups in the real world when they are so difficult to create in the laboratory? This paper presents one reason. The experiments show that, even though efficient coordination does not occur in groups that start off large, efficiently coordinated large groups can be “grown.” By starting with small groups that find it easier to coordinate, we can add entrants—who are aware of the group's history—to create efficiently coordinated large groups. This represents the first experimental demonstration of large groups tacitly coordinated at high levels of efficiency.

10.1257/000282806776157588.abstractZh: 先前使用最小努力协调游戏进行的实验揭示了一个显著的规律性——大型群体永远无法有效协调。鉴于现实世界中许多大型群体，如企业，经常面临类似的协调难题，这就提出了一个重要问题：为什么在现实世界中我们能观察到大型且协调良好的群体，而在实验室中却很难创建这样的群体？本文提出了其中一个原因。实验表明，即使从一开始就形成的大型群体无法实现有效协调，但可以通过“培育”来形成高效协调的大型群体。从那些更容易协调的小型群体开始，我们可以引入了解该群体历史的参与者，从而创建出高效协调的大型群体。这代表了首次通过实验证明大型群体在高度协调的情况下能够保持高效运作。

abstract.text: Why are distortionary policies used when seemingly Pareto improvements exist? According to a standard textbook argument, a Pareto improvement can be obtained by eliminating the distortions, compensating the losers with a lump sum transfer, and redistributing the gains that are left over. We relax the assumption that winners know the losses suffered by the losers and show that the informationally efficient method of compensating losers may involve the use of seemingly inefficient (but informationally efficient) distortionary policies. The risk of overcompensating losers may make distortions informationally efficient, as there are points on the Pareto frontier where distortions are used.

10.1257/000282806776157605.abstractZh: 为什么在看似存在帕累托改进的情况下还会采用扭曲性政策？根据标准教科书中的论点，通过消除扭曲、用一次性资金补偿受害者，并重新分配剩余的收益，可以实现帕累托改进。我们放宽了“赢家知道受害者所遭受的损失”这一假设，并表明，在信息经济学上，补偿受害者的有效方法可能涉及看似低效的（但在信息经济学上却是有效的）扭曲性政策。过度补偿受害者的风险可能使得扭曲性政策在信息经济学上变得有效，因为在帕累托前沿点上，扭曲性政策是被使用的。

abstract.text: Using large samples of estate tax returns, we construct new series on wealth concentration in Paris and France from 1807 to 1994. Inequality increased until 1914 because industrial and financial estates grew dramatically. Then, adverse shocks, rather than a Kuznets-type process, led to a massive decline in inequality. The very high wealth concentration prior to 1914 benefited retired individuals living off capital income (rentiers) rather than entrepreneurs. The very rich were in their seventies and eighties, whereas they had been in their fifties a half century earlier and would be so again after World War II. Our results shed new light on ongoing debates about wealth inequality and growth.

10.1257/000282806776157614.abstractZh: 通过大量地产税申报数据的分析，我们构建了从1807年到1994年巴黎和法国财富集中程度的新数据系列。在1914年之前，由于工业和金融领域的资产急剧增长，不平等现象加剧。然而，随后出现的负面冲击，而非库兹涅茨式的过程，导致了不平等的显著下降。1914年之前极高的财富集中程度使得依靠资本收入生活的退休人员受益，而非企业家。那些非常富有的人大多年龄在七十多岁或八十多岁，而半个世纪前他们还处于五十多岁，二战之后这一状况仍将持续。我们的研究结果为关于财富不平等与经济增长的持续争论提供了新的视角。

abstract.text: How should benefit-cost analysis account for the value that benevolent individuals place on others' enjoyment of public goods? When adding up the benefits to be compared with costs, should we sum the private valuations, the altruistic valuations, or something else? This paper argues that private valuations are appropriate if concern for the well-being of others respects their private preferences. The discussion has implications for family decision-making, welfare economics, and the design of applied contingent valuation studies.

10.1257/000282806776157623.abstractZh: 利益成本分析应该如何考虑仁慈个体对他人享受公共产品价值的看法？在将各种利益与成本相加时，我们应该汇总私人估值、利他主义估值还是其他标准？本文认为，如果关注他人的福祉符合他们的私人偏好，那么私人估值是合适的。这一讨论对家庭决策、福利经济学以及应用条件价值评估研究的设计具有启示意义。

abstract.text: Empirical evidence suggests that most advertisements contain little direct information. Many do not mention prices. We analyze a monopoly firm's choice of advertising content and the information disclosed to consumers. The firm advertises only product information, price information, or both, and prefers to convey only limited product information if possible. It is socially harmful to force it to provide full information if it has sufficient ability to parse the information imparted, nor does it help to restrict the information voluntarily provided.

10.1257/000282806776157632.abstractZh: 实证证据表明，大多数广告中直接提供的信息很少。许多广告并不提及价格信息。我们分析了垄断企业选择广告内容以及向消费者披露的信息情况。该企业仅宣传产品信息、价格信息或两者兼有，并且如果可能的话，更倾向于只传达有限的产品信息。如果企业有足够的能力解析所传递的信息，强制其提供完整信息是不利的；同时，限制其自愿提供的信息也没有任何帮助。

abstract.text: The change to the minimum school-leaving age in the United Kingdom from 14 to 15 had a powerful and immediate effect that redirected almost half the population of 14-year-olds in the mid-twentieth century to stay in school for one more year. The magnitude of this impact provides a rare opportunity to (a) estimate local average treatment effects (LATE) of high school that come close to population average treatment effects (ATE); and (b) estimate returns to education using a regression discontinuity design instead of previous estimates that rely on difference-in-differences methodology or relatively weak instruments. Comparing LATE estimates for the United States and Canada, where very few students were affected by compulsory school laws, to the United Kingdom estimates provides a test as to whether instrumental variables (IV) returns to schooling often exceed ordinary least squares (OLS) because gains are high only for small and peculiar groups among the more general population. I find, instead, that the benefits from compulsory schooling are very large whether these laws have an impact on a majority or minority of those exposed.

10.1257/000282806776157641.abstractZh: 英国将最低离校年龄从14岁改为15岁，这一变化产生了强烈且直接的影响，使得20世纪中叶近一半14岁的儿童在学年内多待了一年。这一影响的规模为评估高中教育的平均处理效应（LATE）提供了难得的机会，这些效应与总体平均处理效应（ATE）非常接近。此外，通过回归不连续设计来估算教育回报，而非依赖差异-差异方法或相对较弱的工具变量，可以更准确地进行估算。将美国和加拿大的LATE估计结果与美国和英国的估计结果进行比较，可以发现，在这些国家，受强制教育法律影响的 학생数量非常少，因此工具变量带来的教育回报往往超过普通最小二乘法估计的结果，因为只有在特定群体中，教育的收益才非常高。相反，我发现，无论强制教育法律对大多数还是少数学生产生影响，其带来的好处都是非常巨大的。

abstract.text: The main result of Morris and Shin (2002)–restated in papers by Amato, Morris, and Shin (2002) and Amato and Shin (2003) and commented upon by the Economist (2004)–has been presentedandinterpretedasananti-transparency result: more public information can be bad. However, some scrutiny of the result shows that it is actually pro transparency: except in very special circumstances, more public information is good. Furthermore, for a conservative benchmark of equal precision in public and private information, social welfare is higher than in a situation without public information.

10.1257/000282806776157650.abstractZh: Morris和Shin在2002年提出的主要结论——该结论在Amato、Morris和Shin于2002年以及Amato和Shin于2003年的论文中得到了重申，并受到了《经济学人》在2004年的评论——被描述为反透明性结果：更多的公共信息可能有害。然而，对这一结论的仔细分析表明，实际上更多的公共信息是有益的：除非在非常特殊的情况下，否则更多的公共信息是有利的。此外，对于公共信息和私人信息具有同等精确度的保守假设，社会福祉比没有公共信息的情况更高。

abstract.text: This paper investigates how noisy evaluation of worker skills affects human capital investments and hiring. Individuals distort investments toward skills that most managers can evaluate. Dynamically, when workers become managers, managerial expertise can become increasingly skewed over time, raising investment distortions and reducing output. If firms select managerial expertise strategically, efficient investments can be retrieved when (a) identifying whether workers' skills matter more than distinguishing among skilled workers, and (b) initial investment distortions are small. Otherwise, such strategic design worsens long-run outcomes. Finally, we determine when short-run affirmative action policies are effective.

10.1257/000282806776157669.abstractZh: 本文研究了工人技能评估的噪声如何影响人力资本投资与招聘。个体会倾向于投资那些大多数管理者都能评估的技能。随着工人成为管理者，管理专业知识可能会随时间逐渐出现偏差，从而导致投资扭曲并降低产出。如果企业能够战略性地选择管理专业知识，那么当满足以下条件时，高效的投资是可以实现的：(a)能够判断工人的技能是否比区分技术工人更为重要；(b)初始的投资扭曲较小。否则，这种战略性设计会恶化长期结果。最后，我们确定了短期积极政策何时能够产生效果。

abstract.text: A multivariate regime-switching model for monetary policy is confronted with U.S. data. The best fit allows time variation in disturbance variances only. With coefficients allowed to change, the best fit is with change only in the monetary policy rule and there are three estimated regimes corresponding roughly to periods when most observers believe that monetary policy actually differed. But the differences among regimes are not large enough to account for the rise, then decline, in inflation of the 1970s and 1980s. Our estimates imply monetary targeting was central in the early 1980s, but also important sporadically in the 1970s.

10.1257/000282806776157678.abstractZh: 该模型采用多变量制度转换模型来研究货币政策，并基于美国数据进行分析。最佳拟合结果显示，干扰方差仅随时间变化。如果允许系数发生变化，则最佳拟合结果仅体现在货币政策规则上，并且存在三种估计出的制度阶段，这些阶段大致对应于大多数观察者认为货币政策实际存在差异的时期。然而，不同制度阶段之间的差异不足以解释20世纪70年代和80年代通货膨胀的上升与下降现象。我们的估计表明，在20世纪80年代初，货币政策目标设定是核心政策手段，而在20世纪70年代则偶尔也起到重要作用。

abstract.text: We find that technology's effect on employment varies greatly across manufacturing industries. Some industries exhibit a temporary reduction in employment in response to a permanent increase in TFP, whereas many more industries exhibit an employment increase in response to a permanent TFP shock. This raises serious questions about existing work that finds a labor productivity shock has a strong negative effect on employment. There are tantalizing and interesting differences between TFP and labor productivity. We argue that TFP is a more natural measure of technology because labor productivity reflects shifts in the input mix as well as in technology.

10.1257/000282806776157687.abstractZh: 我们发现，技术对就业的影响在不同制造业中差异很大。一些行业在技术效率永久性提升的情况下会出现短暂的就业减少，而更多行业则会在技术效率永久性提升的情况下出现就业增加。这引发了关于现有研究的严重质疑，这些研究认为劳动生产率冲击会对就业产生强烈的负面影响。技术效率与劳动生产率之间存在有趣且引人关注的差异。我们认为，技术效率是衡量技术的更自然的指标，因为劳动生产率不仅反映了投入结构的变动，还反映了技术的变化。

abstract.text: Trade sanctions are often criticized as ineffective because they create incentives for evasion or as harmful to the target country's population. Loan sanctions, in contrast, could be self-enforcing and could protect the population from being saddled with “odious debt” run up by looting or repressive dictators. Governments could impose loan sanctions by instituting legal changes that prevent seizure of countries' assets for nonrepayment of debt incurred after sanctions were imposed. This would reduce creditors' incentives to lend to sanctioned regimes. Restricting sanctions to cover only loans made after the sanction was imposed would help avoid time-consistency problems.

10.1257/000282806776157696.abstractZh: 贸易制裁常常被批评为无效，因为它们会促使人们逃避制裁，或者对目标国家的人口造成危害。相比之下，贷款制裁则具有自我执行的能力，能够保护民众免受因掠夺或专制独裁者造成的“可憎债务”的困扰。政府可以通过制定法律措施来实施贷款制裁，这些措施可以防止债权人因无法收回制裁实施后的债务而没收相关资产。这将减少债权人向受制裁政权提供贷款的动机。将制裁范围限制在制裁实施后的贷款上，有助于避免时间一致性问题。

abstract.text: Examination of firms in 47 countries shows a widespread overlap of controlling shareholders and top officers who are connected with national parliaments or governments, particularly in countries with higher levels of corruption, with barriers to foreign investment, and with more transparent systems. Connections are diminished when regulations set more limits on official behavior. Additionally, I show that the announcement of a new political connection results in a significant increase in value.

10.1257/000282806776157704.abstractZh: 对47个国家的企业进行调查后发现，控股股东与与国会议员或政府有联系的高层管理人员之间存在广泛的重叠关系，这种情况在腐败程度较高、对外国投资存在障碍以及制度较为透明的国家尤为明显。当法规对官员的官方行为施加更多限制时，这种联系会减弱。此外，我还发现，当宣布出现新的政治联系时，企业的价值会显著上升。

abstract.text: Using data on prices, production, and exports, we are able to identify marginal costs as well as the effectiveness of the Norwegian cement industry cartel. We find that our marginal cost estimates are very much in line with the detailed cost accounting data. We show that the cement cartel has been ineffective because the sharing rule induces “overproduction” and exporting below marginal costs. It is consumers — not firms — who benefit from the sharing rule. The ineffectiveness of the cartel was becoming so large that domestic welfare of a merger to monopoly would be positive around 1968, which is when the merger actually took place! We also show that competition would have resulted in even higher welfare gains over the entire sample.

10.1257/000282806776157713.abstractZh: 通过价格、生产和出口数据，我们能够确定边际成本以及挪威水泥行业卡特尔的成效。我们发现，我们的边际成本估算与详细的成本会计数据非常一致。研究表明，水泥卡特尔之所以无效，是因为分配规则导致了“过度生产”，并且出口价格低于边际成本。受益的其实是消费者，而非企业。到1968年卡特尔的无效性已经变得如此严重，以至于合并后实现垄断的国内福利反而会有所改善，而这一合并实际上就在这一年发生了！我们还表明，如果没有竞争，整个样本中的福利收益将会更高。

abstract.text: The property rights approach to the theory of the firm suggests that ownership structures are chosen in order to provide ex ante investment incentives, while bargaining is ex post efficient. In contrast, transaction cost economics emphasizes ex post inefficiencies. In the present paper, a party may invest and acquire private information about the default payoff that it can realize on its own. Inefficient rent seeking can overturn prominent implications of the property rights theory. In particular, ownership by party B may be optimal, even though only the indispensable party A makes an investment decision.

10.1257/000282806776157722.abstractZh: 企业理论中的产权方法认为，所有权结构的选择是为了提供事前投资激励，而事后谈判则具有效率。相比之下，交易成本经济学强调事后效率的缺失。在本文中，一方可以投资并获取关于自身可能实现的违约收益的私人信息。低效的租金获取行为可能会颠覆产权理论的重要结论。特别是，即使只有不可或缺的A方做出投资决策，B方的所有权也可能是最优的。

abstract.text: During the World War II and Korean War era, the U.S. military freely distributed cigarettes to overseas personnel and provided low-cost tobacco products on domestic military bases. In fact, even today the military continues to sell subsidized tobacco products on its bases. Using a variety of instrumental variables approaches to deal with nonrandom selection into the military and into smoking, we provide substantial evidence that cohorts with higher military participation rates subsequently suffered more premature mortality. More importantly, we show that a large fraction, 35 to 79 percent, of the excess veteran deaths due to heart disease and lung cancer are attributable to military-induced smoking.

10.1257/000282806776157731.abstractZh: 在第二次世界大战和朝鲜战争时期，美国军方向海外军人免费分发香烟，并在国内军事基地提供低成本的烟草产品。事实上，直到今天，军方仍在其基地销售补贴的烟草产品。通过多种工具变量方法分析军人选拔和吸烟行为之间的非随机关系，我们发现，军事服役时间较长的军人群体随后出现更多的过早死亡现象。更重要的是，我们发现，由于军事因素导致的吸烟，有35%到79%的退伍军人死亡案例是由心脏病和肺癌引起的。

abstract.text: We analyze the effect of economic conditions early in life on individual mortality rate later in life, using business cycle conditions early in life as an exogenous indicator. Individual records from Dutch registers of birth, marriage, and death, covering a window of unprecedented size (1912–2000) are merged with historical data on macroeconomic and health indicators. We correct for secular changes over time and other mortality determinants. We nonparametrically compare those born in a recession to those born in the preceding boom, and we estimate duration models where the individual's mortality rate depends on current conditions, conditions early in life, age individual characteristics, including individual socioeconomic indicators, and interaction terms. The results indicate a significant negative effect of economic conditions early in life on individual mortality rates at all ages.

10.1257/000282806776157740.abstractZh: 我们分析了生命早期的经济状况对后期个人死亡率的影响，将生命早期的经济周期状况作为外生指标。我们整合了荷兰出生、婚姻和死亡登记处的个人记录，这些数据涵盖了前所未有的大范围时间跨度（1912-2000年），并与宏观经济和健康指标的历史数据进行了结合分析。我们纠正了随时间推移发生的长期变化以及其他影响死亡率的因素。我们通过非参数方法比较了处于经济衰退时期出生的人与处于经济繁荣时期出生的人，并建立了持续时间模型，其中个人的死亡率取决于当前状况、生命早期的状况、年龄、个人特征（包括个人社会经济指标）以及交互项。研究结果表明，生命早期的经济状况对各个年龄段的个人死亡率有显著的负面影响。

abstract.text: We examine the role of banks in the transmission of monetary policy. In economies where banks use real demand deposits to finance their lending, fluctuations in the timing of production can force banks to scramble for real liquidity, or even fail, which can greatly affect lending and aggregate output. The adverse effect on output can be reduced if banks finance with nominal deposits. Nominal deposits also open a “financial liquidity” channel for monetary policy to affect real activity. The banking system may be better off, however, issuing real deposits (e.g., foreign exchange denominated) under some circumstances.

10.1257/000282806776157759.abstractZh: 我们研究了银行在货币政策传导中的作用。在那些银行使用实际需求存款来融资的经济体中，生产时间的波动可能会迫使银行争夺实际流动性，甚至导致银行倒闭，这会对贷款和总体产出产生重大影响。如果银行使用名义存款进行融资，对产出的负面影响就可以减轻。名义存款还为货币政策影响实际活动提供了“金融流动性”渠道。然而，在某些情况下，银行发行实际存款（例如以外汇计价的存款）可能会使其状况更好。

abstract.text: The National Treatment (NT) clause is the first-line defense in the GATT (and in most other trade agreements) against opportunistic exploitation of the inevitable incompleteness of the agreement. This paper examines the role of NT as it applies to internal taxation under the GATT. It is shown that despite severely restricting the freedom to set internal taxes, NT may improve government welfare, but it will not completely solve the incomplete contract problem it is meant to remedy. Furthermore, it requires a high degree of economic sophistication on behalf of trade negotiators in order for this beneficial effect to materialize.

10.1257/000282806776157768.abstractZh: 国民待遇条款是《关贸总协定》（以及大多数其他贸易协定）中防止机会主义利用协议不可避免的不完整性所采取的第一道防线。本文探讨了国民待遇条款在《关贸总协定》框架下对国内税收的影响。研究表明，尽管国民待遇条款严重限制了设定国内税收的自由，但它仍可能改善政府的福利，但并不能完全解决其旨在弥补的不完全契约问题。此外，为了使这一有益效果得以实现，贸易谈判者需要具备较高的经济专业素养。

abstract.text: This paper examines preferences toward particular classes of lottery pairs. We show how such concepts as prudence and temperance can be fully characterized by a preference relation over these lotteries. If preferences are defined in an expectedutility framework with differentiable utility, the direction of preference for a particular class of lottery pairs is equivalent to signing the n th derivative of the utility function. What makes our characterization appealing is its simplicity, which seems particularly amenable to experimentation.

10.1257/000282806776157777.abstractZh: 本文探讨了人们对特定类型彩票组合的偏好。我们展示了诸如谨慎和节制这样的概念如何通过一种偏好关系来完全描述。如果偏好是在具有可微效用函数的期望效用框架下定义的，那么对某一类彩票组合的偏好方向就相当于对效用函数的第n阶导数进行符号化处理。我们这种描述方式之所以具有吸引力，是因为其简单性，而且似乎特别适合用于实验研究。

abstract.text: In his recent paper in the American Economic Review, Jensen (1997) argues that delegation of monetary policy to an independent central bank, which acts as an agent for the government, does not mitigate the problem of time-inconsistency, but merely relocates it. ∗We acknowledge with thanks support for this work provided through ESRC research grant L138251003 “Imperfect Financial Markets, Business Cycles, and Growth”, which forms part of the programme on Understanding the Evolving Macroeconomy (UEM). We are grateful to participants at the Money, Macro and Finance (MMF), and UEM Conference 2002 for their helpful comments. We thank also the editors and referees of this journal for their advice and suggestions. An Appendix containing details of algebraic derivations in Section 4 of this paper can be found on the AER web site and on the authors’ site at www.econ.bbk.ac.uk/faculty/driffill 1 He examines a government that delegates monetary policy to an in-dependent central bank, and that faces costs if it interferes in the policy decisions of the bank by appointing a new central banker to obtain a preferred result. He shows that delegation makes it more dif-ficult to sustain the credibility of optimal monetary policy. We show here that this result emerges because Jensen examines a restricted range of policy actions for the government. When this restriction is lifted, the result is reversed. By means of suitable announcements of contracts for the central bank, combined with appropriate actually implemented contracts, delegated policy enables zero inflation to pre-vail in economies in which it could not do so without delegated policy. These economies are ones that have relatively low discount factors.

10.1257/000282806779468418.abstractZh: 在《美国经济评论》最近的一篇论文中，Jensen（1997）认为，将货币政策委托给一个独立的中央银行作为政府的代理人，并不能缓解时间不一致性问题，反而只是将其转移了。我们感谢ESRC研究项目L138251003“不完美的金融市场、商业周期与增长”对这项研究的支持，该项目是“理解不断演变的宏观经济”计划的一部分。我们感谢2002年举行的货币、宏观与金融会议以及“理解不断演变的宏观经济”会议的参与者提供的宝贵意见。同时，我们也感谢本期刊的编辑和审稿人提供的建议和意见。本文第4节中的代数推导细节可以在AER网站和作者的个人网站www.econ.bbk.ac.uk/faculty/driffill上找到。Jensen研究了一个政府将货币政策委托给独立中央银行的情景，如果政府通过任命新的中央银行家来干预银行的决策，就会面临成本。他表明，这种委托使得维持最优货币政策的可信度变得更加困难。我们在这里指出，这一结果之所以出现，是因为Jensen研究的是政府有限的政策选择范围。当这种限制被解除时，结果就会逆转。通过适当的中央银行合同公告，结合实际实施的适当合同，委托政策使得零通胀能够在没有委托政策的情况下无法实现的经济体中得以实现。这些经济体通常具有相对较低的贴现因子。

abstract.text: Proposition 5 in our paper dealt with the incentive equilibrium in differentiated product oligopoly. The proposition states that under linear demand and cost functions, the incentive equilibrium is such that managers are overcompensated at the margin for profits. Given the correction of equation (24) above, we need to add that this proposition holds only when A (ba)c. Note, however, that this condition has little impact on our analysis, since in our setting it is a necessary condition for having a duopolistic market in which both firms produce positive quantities while having nonnegative profits.

10.1257/000282806779468436.abstractZh: 我们论文中的第5个命题涉及差异化产品寡头垄断中的激励均衡问题。该命题指出，在线性需求和成本函数下，激励均衡使得管理者在利润边际上获得超额补偿。鉴于上述方程(24)的修正，我们需要补充一点：该命题仅当A (ba)c成立时成立。不过，需要指出的是，这一条件对我们的分析影响较小，因为在我们的设定中，它是形成双寡头市场的必要条件，而双寡头市场要求两家企业都能实现正产量，并且利润非负。

abstract.text: Yeon-Koo Che and Ian Gale (1998) studied the impact of imposing a cap on lobbying expenditures. They showed that a cap may lead to (1) greater expected aggregate expenditures and (2) a less efficient allocation of a political prize. In their comment, Todd Kaplan and David Wettstein (2005) show that if the cap is not rigid (i.e., its effect on the cost of lobbying is continuous) it has no effect.

10.1257/000282806779468490.abstractZh: Yeon-Koo Che和Ian Gale在1998年研究了对游说支出设定上限的影响。他们指出，这种上限可能会导致（1）更高的预期总支出，以及（2）政治奖励的分配效率降低。在他们的评论中，Todd Kaplan和David Wettstein在2005年指出，如果这种上限不是固定的（即其对游说成本的影响是连续的），那么这种上限就不会产生任何效果。

abstract.text: The article focuses on spending caps, and compares those used in politics with many examples in sports economics. In 1999, the party of Israeli Prime Minister Ehud Barak was fined $3.2 million for exceeding Israel's campaign finance caps. Financing caps by the National Collegiate Athletics Association did not prevent The University of Oregon from spending $3 million on their football locker room. Mathematical models are provided in order to prove that spending caps will not necessarily have their intended effect, as they increase the total expended amount by increasing the risk of being fined.

10.1257/000282806779468517.abstractZh: 本文聚焦于支出上限，并将政治领域中的支出上限与体育经济学中的案例进行了比较。1999年，以色列总理埃胡德·巴拉克的政党因超过以色列的竞选资金上限而被罚款320万美元。美国国家大学体育协会的融资上限并未阻止俄勒冈大学在足球训练室上花费300万美元。文中还提供了数学模型，以证明支出上限不一定能达到预期效果，因为它们通过增加被罚款的风险，实际上增加了总支出金额。

abstract.text: This paper shows that a large fraction of the 1973–2003 growth in residual wage inequality is due to composition effects linked to the secular increase in experience and education, two factors associated with higher within-group wage dispersion. The level and growth in residual wage inequality are also overstated in the March Current Population Survey (CPS) because, unlike the May or Outgoing Rotation Group (ORG) CPS, it does not measure directly the hourly wages of workers paid by the hour. The magnitude and timing of the growth in residual wage inequality provide little evidence of a pervasive increase in the demand for skill due to skill-biased technological change.

10.1257/aer.96.3.461.abstractZh: 本文指出，1973年至2003年间，剩余工资不平等的增长在很大程度上是由于与经验积累和教育水平提升相关的因素所导致的。这两个因素都与组内工资差异的增加有关。此外，3月当前人口调查（CPS）中对剩余工资不平等的衡量水平和增长也被高估了，因为与5月或离职轮组调查（ORG）不同，该调查并未直接衡量按小时计酬工人的时薪。剩余工资不平等的增长幅度和时间点并不能充分证明由于技能偏向性技术变革而导致的对技能需求的普遍增加。

abstract.text: We study cross-country differences in the aggregate production function when skilled and unskilled labor are imperfect substitutes. We find that there is a skill bias in cross-country technology differences. Higher-income countries use skilled labor more efficiently than lower-income countries, while they use unskilled labor relatively and, possibly, absolutely less efficiently. We also propose a simple explanation for our findings: rich countries, which are skilled-labor abundant, choose technologies that are best suited to skilled workers; poor countries, which are unskilled-labor abundant, choose technologies more appropriate to unskilled workers. We discuss alternative explanations, such as capital-skill complementarity and differences in schooling quality.

10.1257/aer.96.3.499.abstractZh: 我们研究了在熟练劳动与非熟练劳动并非完美替代品的情况下，不同国家之间总体生产函数的差异。我们发现，各国之间的技术差异存在技能偏向性。高收入国家使用熟练劳动的效率高于低收入国家，而非熟练劳动的使用效率则相对较低，甚至在某些情况下效率更低。我们还提出了一种简单的解释：富裕国家由于拥有丰富的熟练劳动资源，会选择最适合熟练工人的技术；而贫穷国家由于拥有丰富的非熟练劳动资源，会选择更适合非熟练工人的技术。我们还讨论了其他可能的解释，如资本与技能的互补性以及教育质量的差异。

abstract.text: Over the postwar period, many industrialized countries have experienced significant medium-frequency oscillations between periods of robust growth versus relative stagnation. Conventional business cycle filters, however, tend to sweep these oscillations into the trend. In this paper we explore whether they may, instead, reflect a persistent response of economic activity to the high-frequency fluctuations normally associated with the cycle. We define as the medium-term cycle the sum of the high- and medium-frequency variation in the data, and then show that these kinds of fluctuations are substantially more volatile and persistent than are the conventional measures. These fluctuations, further, feature significant procyclical movements in both embodied and disembodied technological change, and research and development (R&D), as well as the efficiency and intensity of resource utilization. We then develop a model of medium-term business cycles. A virtue of the framework is that, in addition to offering a unified approach to explaining the high- and medium-frequency variation in the data, it fully endogenizes the movements in productivity that appear central to the persistence of these fluctuations. For comparison, we also explore how well an exogenous productivity model can explain the facts.

10.1257/aer.96.3.523.abstractZh: 在战后时期，许多工业化国家经历了显著的中频波动，这些波动表现为强劲增长与相对停滞之间的交替。然而，传统的商业周期分析往往将这些波动纳入趋势之中。本文探讨这些波动是否反而反映了经济活动对通常与周期相关的高频波动的持续反应。我们将数据的高频和中频变化之和定义为中期周期，并发现这类波动比传统指标更为剧烈且持久。此外，这些波动在实体和技术变革、研究与开发活动以及资源利用的效率和强度方面表现出显著的顺周期特征。随后，我们建立了一个中期商业周期模型。该框架的优势在于，除了提供了一种统一的方法来解释数据中的高频和中频变化外，它还完全内生化了影响这些波动持续性的生产率变化。为了进行比较，我们还研究了外生生产率模型在解释这些现象方面的效果。

abstract.text: Empirical evidence shows that most exchange rate volatility at short to medium horizons is related to order flow and not to macroeconomic variables. We introduce symmetric information dispersion about future macroeconomic fundamentals in a dynamic rational expectations model in order to explain these stylized facts. Consistent with the evidence, the model implies that (a) observed fundamentals account for little of exchange rate volatility in the short to medium run, (b) over long horizons, the exchange rate is closely related to observed fundamentals, (c) exchange rate changes are a weak predictor of future fundamentals, and (d) the exchange rate is closely related to order flow.

10.1257/aer.96.3.552.abstractZh: 实证证据表明，短期到中期内的汇率波动主要与订单流有关，而非宏观经济变量。我们在动态理性预期模型中引入了关于未来宏观经济基本面的对称信息分散性，以解释这些典型现象。与研究结果一致的是，该模型表明：(a)在短期到中期范围内，观察到的宏观经济基本面对汇率波动的贡献很小；(b)在长期范围内，汇率与观察到的宏观经济基本面密切相关；(c)汇率变动对未来基本面的预测能力较弱；(d)汇率与订单流密切相关。

abstract.text: Emerging equity markets witness occasional surges in prices (frenzies) and cross-market price dispersion (herds), accompanied by abundant media coverage. An information market complementarity can explain these anomalies. Because information has high fixed costs, high volume makes it inexpensive. Low prices induce investors to buy information that others buy. Given two identical assets, investors learn about one; abundant information reduces its payoff risk and raises its price. Transitions between low-information/low-asset-price and high-information/high-asset-price equilibria resemble frenzies. Equity data and new panel data on news coverage support the model's predictions: Asset market movements generate news and news raises prices and price dispersion.

10.1257/aer.96.3.577.abstractZh: 新兴股票市场偶尔会出现价格飙升（狂热行情）和跨市场价格分散现象，这些现象往往伴随着媒体的大量报道。信息市场的互补性可以解释这些异常现象。由于信息的固定成本较高，大量信息使得获取信息变得经济实惠。低价格会促使投资者购买其他人也愿意购买的信息。对于两个相同的资产，投资者会了解其中一个资产的信息；丰富的信息可以降低其收益风险并提高其价格。低信息/低资产价格与高信息/高资产价格之间的转换类似于狂热行情。股票数据以及关于新闻报道的新面板数据支持了该模型的预测：资产市场的变动会产生新闻，而新闻又会推高价格并导致价格分散。

abstract.text: This article proposes a new dynamic design for auctioning multiple heterogeneous commodities. An auctioneer wishes to allocate K types of commodities among n bidders. The auctioneer announces a vector of current prices, bidders report quantities demanded at these prices, and the auctioneer adjusts the prices. Units are credited to bidders at the current prices as their opponents' demands decline, and the process continues until every commodity market clears. Bidders, rather than being assumed to behave as price-takers, are permitted to strategically exercise their market power. Nevertheless, the proposed auction yields Walrasian equilibrium prices and, as from a Vickrey-Clarke-Groves mechanism, an efficient allocation.

10.1257/aer.96.3.602.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种针对多种异质商品拍卖的新动态设计。拍卖师希望将K种商品分配给n名竞买人。拍卖师公布当前价格向量，竞买人报告在这些价格下的需求量，拍卖师随后调整价格。当对手的需求下降时，竞买人会在当前价格下获得相应数量的商品，这一过程持续进行，直到每种商品都完成交易。竞买人并非被假设为价格接受者，而是被允许战略性地运用其市场力量。尽管如此，所提出的拍卖机制仍能产生瓦尔拉斯均衡价格，并且如同Vickrey-Clarke-Groves机制一样，能够实现有效的资源分配。

abstract.text: We argue that some, but not all, superstitions can persist when learning is rational and players are patient, and illustrate our argument with an example inspired by the Code of Hammurabi. The code specified an “appeal by surviving in the river” as a way of deciding whether an accusation was true. According to our theory, a mechanism that uses superstitions two or more steps off the equilibrium path, such as “appeal by surviving in the river,” is more likely to persist than a superstition where the false beliefs are only one step off the equilibrium path.

10.1257/aer.96.3.630.abstractZh: 我们认为，当学习是理性的且参与者具有耐心时，某些迷信观念可能会持续存在，但并非所有迷信观念都会如此。我们通过汉谟拉比法典中的一个例子来说明我们的观点。该法典规定，“通过留在河中的幸存者来裁决”是一种判断指控是否属实的方法。根据我们的理论，一种在均衡路径之外两步以上使用迷信机制的机制，如“通过留在河中的幸存者来裁决”，比那些错误信念仅偏离均衡路径一步的迷信观念更有可能持续存在。

abstract.text: We develop a model in which firms set impersonal salary levels before matching with workers. Wages fall relative to any competitive equilibrium while profits rise almost as much, implying little inefficiency. Furthermore, the best firms gain the most from the system while wages become compressed. In light of our results, we discuss the performance of alternative institutions and the recent antitrust case against the National Resident Matching Program.

10.1257/aer.96.3.652.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个模型，在该模型中，企业在与工人匹配之前就设定了非个人化的薪资水平。与任何竞争均衡相比，工资水平有所下降，而利润则几乎同样增加，这意味着效率几乎没有下降。此外，表现最好的企业从这一体系中获益最多，而工资水平则趋于压缩。基于我们的研究结果，我们讨论了其他制度的表现，以及最近针对全国居民匹配计划的反托拉斯诉讼。

abstract.text: We study how financial incentives can be used to overcome a history of coordination failure using controlled laboratory experiments. Subjects' payoffs depend on coordinating at high effort levels. In an initial phase, the benefits of coordination are low, and play typically converges to an inefficient outcome. We then explore varying financial incentives to coordinate at a higher effort level. An increase in the benefits of coordination leads to improved coordination, but large increases have no more impact than small increases. Once subjects have coordinated on a higher effort level, reductions in the incentives to coordinate have little effect on behavior.

10.1257/aer.96.3.669.abstractZh: 我们研究了如何利用金融激励来克服历史上存在的协调失败问题，通过受控实验室实验进行研究。受试者的收益取决于在较高努力水平下的协调行为。在初始阶段，协调带来的收益较低，通常会导致效率低下的结果。随后，我们探讨了不同金融激励措施对更高努力水平下协调行为的影响。协调收益的提高确实有助于改善协调效果，但大幅度的激励提升与小幅度的提升效果并无差异。一旦受试者能够在更高努力水平下进行协调，那么减少协调激励对行为的影响就很小。

abstract.text: How do consumers choose from a menu of contracts? We analyze a novel dataset from three U.S. health clubs with information on both the contractual choice and the day-to-day attendance decisions of 7,752 members over three years. The observed consumer behavior is difficult to reconcile with standard preferences and beliefs. First, members who choose a contract with a flat monthly fee of over $70 attend on average 4.3 times per month. They pay a price per expected visit of more than $17, even though they could pay $10 per visit using a 10-visit pass. On average, these users forgo savings of $600 during their membership. Second, consumers who choose a monthly contract are 17 percent more likely to stay enrolled beyond one year than users committing for a year. This is surprising because monthly members pay higher fees for the option to cancel each month. We also document cancellation delays and attendance expectations, among other findings. Leading explanations for our findings are overconfidence about future self-control or about future efficiency. Overconfident agents overestimate attendance as well as the cancellation probability of automatically renewed contracts. Our results suggest that making inferences from observed contract choice under the rational expectation hypothesis can lead to biases in the estimation of consumer preferences.

10.1257/aer.96.3.694.abstractZh: 消费者是如何从一系列合同中选择的呢？我们分析了来自美国三家健身俱乐部的新型数据集，该数据集包含了7,752名会员在三年内的合同选择情况以及日常出勤决策的信息。观察到的消费者行为难以与标准的偏好和信念相调和。首先，那些选择每月固定费用超过70美元的会员平均每月出勤4.3次。他们每次预期的访问费用超过17美元，尽管使用10次访问的会员卡只需支付10美元。平均而言，这些用户在会员期间放弃了600美元的节省。其次，选择按月合同的消费者比那些承诺一年以上的用户更有可能在一年后继续注册。这令人惊讶，因为按月付费的会员每月都要支付更高的费用来获得取消合同的选项。我们还发现了取消延迟和出勤预期等问题。我们的研究结果表明，基于理性预期假设对观察到的合同选择进行推断可能会导致对消费者偏好的估计出现偏差。

abstract.text: It has long been recognized that the media play an essential role in government accountability. Even in the absence of censorship, however, the government may influence news content by maintaining a “cozy” relationship with the media. This paper develops a model of democratic politics in which media capture is endogenous. The model offers insights into the features of the media market that determine the ability of the government to exercise such capture and hence to influence political outcomes.

10.1257/aer.96.3.720.abstractZh: 长期以来，人们都认识到媒体在政府问责中起着至关重要的作用。然而，即使在没有审查制度的情况下，政府仍可能通过与媒体建立“亲密”关系来影响新闻内容。本文提出了一个民主政治模型，其中媒体控制是内生性的。该模型揭示了媒体市场的特征，这些特征决定了政府行使这种控制能力的能力，从而影响政治结果。

abstract.text: This paper studies an overlapping generations model with stochastic production and incomplete markets to assess whether the introduction of an unfunded social security system leads to a Pareto improvement. When returns to capital and wages are imperfectly correlated, a system that endows retired households with claims to labor income enhances the sharing of aggregate risk between generations. Our quantitative analysis shows that, abstracting from the capital crowding-out effect, the introduction of social security represents a Pareto-improving reform, even when the economy is dynamically efficient. However, the severity of the crowding-out effect in general equilibrium tends to overturn these gains.

10.1257/aer.96.3.737.abstractZh: 本文研究了一个具有随机生产和不完全市场的重叠代模型，以评估引入无资金保障的社会保障制度是否会导致帕累托改进。当资本回报与工资之间存在不完美的相关性时，一个向退休家庭提供劳动收入保障的制度能够增强代际间的总体风险分担。我们的定量分析表明，即使经济在动态上效率较高，只要忽略资本挤出效应，引入社会保障制度仍然是一种能够带来帕累托改进的改革。然而，在一般均衡状态下，资本挤出的严重程度往往会抵消这些收益。

abstract.text: We propose a framework for analyzing transformations of demand. Such transformations frequently stem from changes in the dispersion of consumers' valuations, which lead to rotations of the demand curve. In many settings, profits are a U-shaped function of dispersion. High dispersion is complemented by niche production, and low dispersion is complemented by mass-market supply. We investigate numerous applications, including product design; advertising, marketing and sales advice; and the construction of quality-differentiated product lines. We also suggest a new taxonomy of advertising, distinguishing between hype, which shifts demand, and real information, which rotates demand.

10.1257/aer.96.3.756.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个分析需求转换的框架。这种转换通常源于消费者估值分散性的变化，从而导致需求曲线的旋转。在许多情况下，利润与分散性呈U形关系。高分散性伴随着小众生产，而低分散性则伴随着大众市场的供应。我们研究了众多应用场景，包括产品设计、广告、市场营销和销售建议，以及构建具有差异化质量的产品线。我们还提出了一种新的广告分类方法，区分了能够转移需求的炒作信息与能够旋转需求的真实信息。

abstract.text: Rasmusen et al. (1991) and Segal and Whinston (2000) show that an incumbent monopolist might prevent entry of a more efficient competitor by exploiting externalities among buyers. We show that their results hold only when downstream competition among buyers is weak. Under fierce downstream competition, if entry took place, a free buyer would become more competitive and increase its output and profits at the expense of buyers that sign an exclusive deal with the incumbent. Anticipating that orders from a single buyer would trigger entry, no buyer will sign the exclusive deal and entry will occur. This result is robust across different specifications of the game.

10.1257/aer.96.3.785.abstractZh: Rasmusen等人（1991年）和Segal与Whinston（2000年）指出，在位垄断者可能会通过利用买家之间的外部性来阻止更高效竞争者的进入。我们的研究表明，这一结论仅适用于买家之间的下游竞争较弱的情况。在激烈的下游竞争环境下，如果允许新进入者进入，那么自由选择的买家将会变得更加有竞争力，并增加其产量和利润，而这与那些与在位垄断者签订独家协议的买家利益相悖。由于预期单个买家的订单会触发新进入者的进入，因此没有买家会签订独家协议，从而实现了新进入者的进入。这一结果在不同博弈模型下依然成立。

abstract.text: We use earnings forecasts from securities analysts to construct a new measure of the neoclassical fundamentals that drive investment spending. We find that investment responds significantly to our new measure of fundamentals but is insensitive to cash flow, even for firms typically thought to be liquidity constrained. These results have two key implications. First, fundamentals may be more important for investment spending than would be suggested by the results to date from investment-q models. Second, the positive cash-flow effects obtained in such models may reflect a failure to control properly for fundamentals rather than the presence of financial constraints.

10.1257/aer.96.3.796.abstractZh: 我们利用证券分析师的盈利预测来构建一个新的衡量标准，以评估驱动投资支出的新古典主义基本因素。我们发现，投资对我们的新衡量标准有显著的反应，但对现金流却不太敏感，即使对于那些通常被认为存在流动性约束的公司也是如此。这些结果有两个关键意义。首先，基本因素对投资支出的影响可能比目前投资-Q模型的结果所暗示的更为重要。其次，这些模型中获得的积极现金流效应可能反映了未能正确控制基本因素的问题，而不是金融约束的存在。

abstract.text: Human capital investments are not independent of the aggregate state of labor markets: frictions and slackness of the labor market raise the returns to specific human capital investments relative to general investments. We build a macroeconomic model with two pure strategy regimes. In the pure G-regime, workers invest in general skills. This occurs when they face high turnover labor markets and in the absence of employment protection. The pure 5-regime in which workers invest in skills specific to their job appears when employment protection is high enough. Implications for a characterization of Europe-United States differences are provided in conclusion.

10.1257/aer.96.3.811.abstractZh: 人力资本投资并非独立于劳动力市场的整体状况：劳动力市场的摩擦和松弛会提高特定人力资本投资的回报，相对于一般投资而言。我们构建了一个具有两种纯策略机制的宏观经济模型。在纯G机制下，工人投资于一般技能，这种情况发生在劳动力市场流动性较高且缺乏就业保护的情况下。而在纯5机制下，当就业保护足够高时，工人会投资于与其工作相关的特定技能。结论部分还提出了关于欧洲与美国之间差异的进一步分析。

abstract.text: This paper challenges the notion that on-the-job training investments are quantitatively important for workers' welfare and argues that on-the-job training may not increase lifetime income by more than 1 percent. I argue that it is very difficult to reconcile the slowdown in wage growth late in a worker's career with optimizing behavior unless the technology for learning on the job is such that it generates very low gains from training. The analysis is based on a nonparametric methodology for estimating the learning technology from wage profiles; the results are arrived at by comparing the lifetime income when the worker optimally invests in his human capital to the one where he does not make any investments.

10.1257/aer.96.3.832.abstractZh: 本文对“在职培训对劳动者福利具有定量上的重要性”这一观点提出了质疑，并认为在职培训可能并不会使劳动者的终身收入增加超过1%。我认为，除非在职学习的技术能够带来非常低的培训收益，否则很难将劳动者职业生涯后期工资增长的放缓与优化行为联系起来。该分析基于一种非参数方法，用于从工资数据中提取学习技术的信息；通过比较劳动者在最优情况下投资人力资本时的终身收入与不进行任何投资时的终身收入，得出了分析结果。

abstract.text: Colombia's PACES program provided over 125,000 poor children with vouchers that covered the cost of private secondary school. The vouchers were renewable annually conditional on adequate academic progress. Since many vouchers were assigned by lottery, program effects can reliably be assessed by comparing lottery winners and losers. Estimates using administrative records suggest the PACES program increases secondary school completion rates by 15 to 20 percent. Correcting for the greater percentage of lottery winners taking college admissions tests, the program increased test scores by two-tenths of a standard deviation in the distribution of potential test scores.

10.1257/aer.96.3.847.abstractZh: 哥伦比亚的PACES计划为超过125,000名贫困儿童提供了私人中学的学费补助。这些补助可以每年续签，前提是学生有稳定的学业进步。由于许多补助是通过抽签方式分配的，因此可以通过比较抽签中奖者和落选者来评估该计划的效果。根据行政记录的数据，PACES计划使中学毕业率提高了15%到20%。考虑到有更高比例的中签者参加了大学入学考试，该计划使潜在考生的考试成绩提高了0.2个标准差。

abstract.text: This paper estimates effects of increases in incarceration length on employment and earnings prospects of individuals after their release from prison. I utilize a variety of research designs including controlling for observable factors and using instrumental variables for incarceration length based on randomly assigned judges with different sentencing propensities. The results show no consistent evidence of adverse labor market consequences of longer incarceration length using any of the analytical methods in either the state system in Florida or the federal system in California.

10.1257/aer.96.3.863.abstractZh: 本文估计了监禁时间延长对囚犯出狱后就业和收入前景的影响。我采用了多种研究设计，包括控制可观测因素，并使用基于随机分配的、具有不同量刑倾向的法官所设定的监禁时间工具变量。结果表明，无论是佛罗里达州的州系统还是加利福尼亚州的联邦系统，使用任何分析方法都无法发现监禁时间延长对劳动力市场产生负面影响的证据。

abstract.text: We provide a first formal analysis of the international rules that govern the use of subsidies to domestic production. Our analysis highlights the impact of the new subsidy disciplines that were added to GATT rules with the creation of the WTO. While GATT subsidy rules were typically viewed as weak and inadequate, our results suggest that the key changes introduced by the WTO subsidy rules may ultimately do more harm than good to the multilateral trading system by undermining the ability of tariff negotiations to serve as the mechanism for expanding market access to more efficient levels.

10.1257/aer.96.3.877.abstractZh: 我们对规范补贴用于国内生产的国际规则进行了首次正式分析。我们的分析强调了随着世贸组织的成立，GATT规则中新增的补贴条款所带来的影响。虽然GATT的补贴规则通常被认为薄弱且不足，但我们的研究结果表明，世贸组织补贴规则引入的关键变化可能会对多边贸易体系造成更大的损害，因为它们削弱了关税谈判作为促进市场进入更高效水平的机制的能力。

abstract.text: Most countries are members of preferential trade agreements (PTAs). The effect of these agreements has attracted much interest and raised the question of whether PTAs promote or slow multilateral trade liberalization, i.e., whether they are a “building block” or “stumbling block” to multilateral liberalization. Despite this long-standing concern with PTAs and the lack of theoretical consensus, there is no systematic evidence on whether they are actually a stumbling block to multilateral liberalization. We use detailed data on U.S. multilateral tariffs to provide the first systematic evidence that the direct effect of PTAs was to generate a stumbling block to its MTL. We also provide evidence of reciprocity in multilateral tariff reductions.

10.1257/aer.96.3.896.abstractZh: 大多数国家都是优惠贸易协定的成员。这些协议的影响引起了广泛关注，并引发了关于优惠贸易协定是促进还是阻碍多边贸易自由化的疑问，即它们是对多边自由化的“助力”还是“阻碍”。尽管长期以来人们一直关注优惠贸易协定，并且缺乏理论上的共识，但目前还没有系统性的证据来证明它们实际上是对多边自由化的阻碍。我们利用美国多边关税的详细数据，首次系统地证明了优惠贸易协定直接起到了阻碍多边贸易自由化的作用。同时，我们还发现了多边关税减免中的互惠现象。

abstract.text: This paper analyses the compensatory behavior of smokers. Exploiting data on cotinine concentration--a metabolite of nicotine--measured in a large population of smokers over time, we show that smokers compensate for tax hikes by extracting more nicotine per cigarette. Our study makes two important contributions. First, as smoking a given cigarette more intensively is detrimental to health, our results question the usefulness of tax increases. Second, we develop a model of rational addiction where agents can also adjust their intensity of smoking, and we show that the previous empirical results suffer from estimation biases.

10.1257/aer.96.4.1013.abstractZh: 本文分析了吸烟者的补偿行为。通过利用对大量吸烟者随时间测量的可替宁浓度数据，我们发现吸烟者通过每支香烟摄入更多尼古丁来弥补税收的增加。我们的研究有两个重要贡献：首先，由于更强烈的吸烟行为对健康有害，我们的研究结果质疑了增加税收的合理性。其次，我们建立了一个理性成瘾模型，其中个体可以调整自己的吸烟强度，并表明之前的实证结果存在估计偏差。

abstract.text: In an experiment, players' ability to learn to cooperate in the repeated prisoner's dilemma was substantially diminished when the payoffs were noisy, even though players could monitor one another's past actions perfectly. In contrast, in one-time play against a succession of opponents, noisy payoffs increased cooperation, by slowing the rate at which cooperation decays. These observations are consistent with the robust observation from the psychology literature that partial reinforcement (adding randomness to the link between an action and its consequences while holding expected payoffs constant) slows learning. This effect is magnified in the repeated game: when others are slow to learn to cooperate, the benefits of cooperation are reduced, which further hampers cooperation. These results show that a small change in the payoff environment, which changes the speed of individual learning, can have a large effect on collective behavior. And they show that there may be interesting comparative dynamics that can be derived from careful attention to the fact that at least some economic behavior is learned from experience.

10.1257/aer.96.4.1029.abstractZh: 在一项实验中，当收益存在不确定性时，即使玩家能够完美地监控彼此的过往行为，他们学习合作的能力也会显著下降。相比之下，在一次性博弈中，不确定的收益反而增加了合作行为，因为它减缓了合作行为衰减的速度。这些观察结果与心理学文献中的结论一致：部分强化（在保持预期收益不变的情况下，增加行为与后果之间的随机性）会减缓学习过程。在重复博弈中，这种效应更加明显：当其他玩家学习合作的速度较慢时，合作的好处就会减少，从而进一步阻碍合作行为。这些结果表明，对收益环境进行微小的改变，能够改变个体学习的速度，从而对集体行为产生重大影响。此外，这些结果还表明，从经验中学习至少某些经济行为，可能会带来有趣的比较动态。

abstract.text: The directed cognition model assumes that agents use partially myopic option-value calculations to select their next cognitive operation. The current paper tests this model by studying information acquisition in two experiments. In the first experiment, information acquisition has an explicit financial cost. In the second experiment, information acquisition is costly because time is scarce. The directed cognition model successfully predicts aggregate information acquisition patterns in these experiments. When the directed cognition model and the fully rational model make demonstrably different predictions, the directed cognition model better matches the laboratory evidence.

10.1257/aer.96.4.1043.abstractZh: 定向认知模型假设代理人使用部分近视的期权价值计算方法来选择下一个认知操作。本文通过两个实验来测试这一模型。在第一个实验中，信息获取存在明确的财务成本。在第二个实验中，信息获取的成本较高，因为时间有限。定向认知模型能够成功预测这些实验中的总体信息获取模式。当定向认知模型和完全理性模型得出明显不同的预测时，定向认知模型更能符合实验室的实证结果。

abstract.text: We argue that “narrow framing,” whereby an agent who is offered a new gamble evaluates that gamble in isolation, may be a more important feature of decision-making than previously realized. Our starting point is the evidence that people are often averse to a small, independent gamble, even when the gamble is actuarially favorable. We find that a surprisingly wide range of utility functions, including many nonexpected utility specifications, have trouble explaining this evidence, but that this difficulty can be overcome by allowing for narrow framing. Our analysis makes predictions as to what kinds of preferences can most easily address the stock market participation puzzle.

10.1257/aer.96.4.1069.abstractZh: 我们认为，“狭义框架”这一行为模式——即当一个人面临新的赌博机会时，会单独评估该赌博的利弊——可能是决策过程中一个比以往认为更重要的特征。我们的研究基于这样的观察：人们通常对小型、独立的赌博持反感态度，即使这种赌博在精算上是有利的。我们发现，包括许多非预期效用模型在内的多种效用函数都无法解释这一现象，但可以通过引入“狭义框架”来克服这一困难。我们的分析还预测了哪些偏好类型最能够解决关于股市参与的问题。

abstract.text: Owners of intellectual property or mere sponsors of an idea (e.g., authors, security issuers, sponsors of standards) resort to more or less independent certifiers to persuade potential users (buyers or adopters) of the worth of their property or idea. We analyze the sponsor's choices of certifier and design, social preferences regarding these choices, and the impacts thereon of multiple categories of users, of a downstream presence of the sponsor, and of certifier market power. Finally, we study strategic forum shopping by sponsors of competing ideas.

10.1257/aer.96.4.1091.abstractZh: 知识产权所有者或仅仅是某个想法的赞助者（例如，作者、标准制定者等）会借助或多或少独立的认证机构来说服潜在用户（购买者或采纳者）认可其财产或想法的价值。我们分析了赞助者对认证机构的选择，以及社会对这些选择的偏好，同时探讨了多种类型用户、赞助者下游存在的影响，以及认证机构市场力量的作用。最后，我们研究了不同想法之间的赞助者进行战略性选择论坛的行为。

abstract.text: By taking sets of utility functions as primitive, we define an ordering over assumptions on utility functions that gauges their measurement requirements. Cardinal and ordinal assumptions constitute two levels of measurability, but other assumptions lie between these extremes. We apply the ordering to explanations of why preferences should be convex. The assumption that utility is concave qualifies as a compromise between cardinality and ordinality, while the Arrow-Koopmans explanation, supposedly an ordinal theory, relies on utilities in the cardinal measurement class. In social choice theory, a concavity compromise between ordinality and cardinality is also possible and rationalizes the core utilitarian policies.

10.1257/aer.96.4.1114.abstractZh: 以效用函数集合为原始基础，我们定义了效用函数假设的一种排序方式，以此来衡量它们的测量需求。基数假设和序数假设构成了两种可测量性层次，而其他假设则介于这两者之间。我们将这种排序方法应用于解释为何偏好应该是凸的。认为效用是凹的假设，实际上是一种在基数和序数之间的折中方案；而Arrow-Koopmans解释虽然被认为是一种序数理论，但实际上依赖于基数测量类中的效用函数。在社会选择理论中，序数性和基数性之间的凹性折中也是可能的，并且可以解释核心的功利主义政策。

abstract.text: Some international organizations are governed by unanimity rule, others by (simple or qualified) majority rules. Standard voting models, which assume that the decisions made by voting are perfectly enforceable, have a hard time explaining the observed variation in governance mode, and in particular the widespread occurrence of the unanimity system. We present a model whose main departure from standard voting models is that the organization cannot rely on external enforcement mechanisms: each country is sovereign and cannot be forced to comply with the collective decision or, in other words, the voting system must be self-enforcing. The model identifies conditions under which the organization adopts the unanimity rule, and yields rich comparative-statics predictions on the determinants of the mode of governance.

10.1257/aer.96.4.1137.abstractZh: 一些国际组织遵循一致通过原则进行治理，而另一些则采用简单或多数规则。传统的投票模型假设通过投票做出的决策是完全可执行的，但这些模型难以解释治理模式上的差异，尤其是一致通过制度的广泛存在。我们提出了一个模型，其主要区别在于该模型认为组织无法依赖外部执行机制：每个国家都是主权国家，不能被迫遵守集体决策，换句话说，投票系统必须是自我执行的。该模型还指出了组织采用一致通过原则的条件，并对治理模式的决定因素提出了丰富的比较统计预测。

abstract.text: We propose a framework for understanding episodes of vigorous economic expansion and extreme asset valuations. We interpret this phenomenon as a high-valuation equilibrium with a low cost of capital based on optimism about future funding. The key ingredient for such equilibrium is feedback from increased growth to a decline in the long-run cost of capital. This feedback arises when an expansion comes with technological progress in the capital sector, when fiscal rules generate procyclical fiscal surpluses, when the rest of the world has lower expansion potential or high saving needs, and when financial constraints are relaxed by the expansion itself.

10.1257/aer.96.4.1159.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个框架，用于理解经济快速扩张和资产估值极度上升的时期。我们将这一现象解释为一种高估值均衡状态，其基础是对未来融资的乐观预期，同时资本成本较低。这种均衡的关键要素是，随着经济增长的加剧，长期资本成本会下降。这种反馈效应出现在资本领域出现技术进步、财政规则导致顺周期性财政盈余、全球其他地区的扩张潜力较低或储蓄需求较高，以及经济扩张本身缓解了金融约束的情况下。

abstract.text: We use a Bayesian Markov Chain Monte Carlo algorithm to estimate the parameters of a “true” data-generating mechanism and those of a sequence of approximating models that a monetary authority uses to guide its decisions. Gaps between a true expectational Phillips curve and the monetary authority's approximating nonexpectational Phillips curve models unleash inflation that a monetary authority that knows the true model would avoid. A sequence of dynamic programming problems implies that the monetary authority's inflation target evolves as its estimated Phillips curve moves. Our estimates attribute the rise and fall of post-WWII inflation in the United States to an intricate interaction between the monetary authority's beliefs and economic shocks. Shocks in the 1970s made the monetary authority perceive a tradeoff between inflation and unemployment which ignited big inflation. The monetary authority's beliefs about the Phillips curve changed in ways that account for former Federal Reserve Chairman Paul Volcker's conquest of U.S. inflation.

10.1257/aer.96.4.1193.abstractZh: 我们采用贝叶斯马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛算法来估计“真实”数据生成机制的参数，以及货币当局用于指导决策的近似模型参数。真实预期菲利普斯曲线与货币当局近似的非预期菲利普斯曲线模型之间的差距导致了货币当局明知应避免的通胀。一系列动态规划问题表明，货币当局的通胀目标会随着其估计的菲利普斯曲线的变化而演变。我们的估计结果显示，二战后美国通胀的上升和下降是由货币当局的信念与经济冲击之间的复杂互动造成的。20世纪70年代的冲击使得货币当局认为通胀与失业之间存在权衡，从而引发了大规模通胀。货币当局对菲利普斯曲线的看法发生了改变，这些变化解释了前美联储主席保罗·沃尔克是如何成功控制美国通胀的。

abstract.text: This paper addresses the question of how traditional institutions interact with the forces of globalization to shape the economic mobility and welfare of particular groups of individuals in the new economy. We explore the role of one such traditional institution—the caste system—in shaping career choices by gender in Bombay using new survey data on school enrollment and income over the past 20 years. We find that male working-class—lower-caste—networks continue to channel boys into local language schools that lead to the traditional occupation, despite the fact that returns to nontraditional white-collar occupations rose substantially in the 1990s, suggesting the possibility of a dynamic inefficiency. In contrast, lower-caste girls, who historically had low labor market participation rates and so did not benefit from the network, are taking full advantage of the opportunities that became available in the new economy by switching rapidly to English schools.

10.1257/aer.96.4.1225.abstractZh: 本文探讨了传统制度如何与全球化力量相互作用，从而影响特定群体在新经济中的经济流动性和福利状况。我们利用过去20年关于学校入学率和收入的新调查数据，研究了种姓制度这一传统制度在塑造孟买性别职业选择中的作用。研究发现，尽管20世纪90年代非传统白领职业的回报显著上升，但低种姓的男性工人阶级网络仍然将男孩引导至当地语言学校，从而进入传统职业。相比之下，历史上劳动市场参与度较低的低种姓女孩则充分利用了新经济带来的机会，迅速转向英语学校。

abstract.text: Automobile manufacturers frequently use promotions involving cash incentives. While payments are nominally directed to either customers or dealers, the ultimate beneficiary of the promotion depends on the outcome of price negotiation. We use program evaluation methods to compare the incidence of these two types of promotions. Customers obtain 70 to 90 percent of a customer rebate, but only 30 to 40 percent of a dealer discount promotion, a $500 difference for a typical promotion. Our leading hypothesis is that pass-through rates differ because of information asymmetries: customer rebates are well-publicized to customers, while dealer discount promotions are not.

10.1257/aer.96.4.1253.abstractZh: 汽车制造商经常采用包含现金激励的促销活动。虽然这些支付名义上是对客户或经销商的，但促销活动的实际受益者取决于价格谈判的结果。我们使用项目评估方法来比较这两种促销活动的发生率。客户可以获得70%到90%的返利，而经销商折扣促销只能获得30%到40%的优惠，典型的促销活动差价可达500美元。我们的主要假设是，由于信息不对称，这两种促销活动的传递率有所不同：客户返利信息容易向客户公开，而经销商折扣促销活动则不会如此。

abstract.text: We analyze a model of participation in elections in which voting is costly and no vote is pivotal. Ethical agents are motivated to participate when they determine that agents of their type are obligated to do so. Unlike previous duty-based models of participation, in our model an ethical agent's obligation to vote is determined endogenously as a function of the behavior of other agents. Our model predicts high turnout and comparative statics that are consistent with strategic behavior.

10.1257/aer.96.4.1271.abstractZh: 我们分析了一个选举参与模型，其中投票是有成本的，且没有任何投票是至关重要的。当伦理代理人意识到他们同类的其他代理人有义务参与时，他们就会受到激励去参与。与之前的基于义务的参与模型不同，我们的模型中，伦理代理人是否有义务投票是由其他代理人的行为内生决定的。我们的模型预测了较高的投票率，并且其相关统计结果与战略行为是一致的。

abstract.text: We illustrate problems of measuring discrimination using elections to AEA offices. With a new econometric technique, we find female candidates have a much better than random chance of victory. This advantage is either reverse discrimination or reflects beliefs that women are more productive. The former interpretation could be explained by an unchanging median voter whose preferences were not satisfied by suppliers of candidates; but there was a structural change in voting behavior in the mid-1970s. The results suggest it is generally impossible to claim differences in rewards, for different groups measure the extent of discrimination or even its direction.

10.1257/aer.96.4.1283.abstractZh: 我们通过选举亚利桑那州众议员职位来说明衡量歧视问题的情况。利用一种新的计量经济学技术，我们发现女性候选人获胜的概率远高于随机水平。这种优势要么是逆向歧视，要么反映了人们认为女性更具生产力的观念。前一种解释可以归因于中位选民的偏好并未得到满足，但20世纪70年代中期，投票行为发生了结构性变化。结果表明，通常无法声称不同群体在奖励方面存在差异，因为不同群体衡量的是歧视的程度甚至方向。

abstract.text: We show that the joint behavior of stock prices and TFP favors a view of business cycles driven largely by a shock that does not affect productivity in the short run – and therefore does not look like a standard technology shock – but affects productivity with substantial delay – and therefore does not look like a monetary shock. One structural interpretation for this shock is that it represents news about future technological opportunities which is first captured in stock prices. This shock causes a boom in consumption, investment, and hours worked that precedes productivity growth by a few years, and explains about 50 percent of business cycle fluctuations.

10.1257/aer.96.4.1293.abstractZh: 我们指出，股票价格和全要素生产率之间的联动行为，更倾向于将商业周期归因于一种冲击，这种冲击在短期内并不会直接影响生产率——因此并不像标准的技术冲击那样表现——而是会在相当长的时间后才对生产率产生影响——因此也不像是货币冲击。对这种冲击的一种结构性解释是，它代表了关于未来技术机会的消息，这些信息首先反映在股票价格上。这种冲击会导致消费、投资和工作时间出现增长，并且这种增长会在生产率增长之前几年出现，约占商业周期波动的50%。

abstract.text: Researchers in a variety of important economic literatures have assumed that current income variables as proxies for lifetime income variables follow the textbook errors-in-variables model. In our analysis of Social Security records containing nearly career-long earnings histories for the Health and Retirement Study sample, we find that the relationship between current and lifetime earnings departs substantially from the textbook model in ways that vary systematically over the life cycle. Our results can enable more appropriate analysis of, and correction for, errors-in-variables bias in any research that uses current earnings to proxy for lifetime earnings.

10.1257/aer.96.4.1308.abstractZh: 许多重要的经济学研究都假设，作为终身收入代理变量的当前收入变量遵循教科书中的误差变量模型。在我们对健康与退休研究样本的社会保障记录进行分析时，这些记录包含了近整个职业生涯的收入历史。我们发现，当前收入与终身收入之间的关系与教科书模型有很大差异，这种差异在生命周期中呈现出系统性变化。我们的研究结果有助于更准确地分析和使用当前收入来替代终身收入，从而纠正误差变量偏差。

abstract.text: The phenomenon of choice shifts in group decision-making has received attention in the social psychology literature. Faced with a risky group decision, individuals appear to support more extreme choices relative to those they would make on their own. This paper demonstrates that from a decision-theoretic perspective, choice shifts are intimately connected to failures of expected utility theory. In the model studied here, the Allais paradox is equivalent to a well-studied configuration of choice shifts. Thus, our results marry two well-known behavioral regularities, one in individual decision theory and another in the social psychology of groups.

10.1257/aer.96.4.1321.abstractZh: 在群体决策中，选择倾向的变化现象在社会心理学文献中受到了关注。面对有风险的群体决策时，个体似乎更倾向于选择更为极端的方案，而不是单独决策时可能做出的选择。本文指出，从决策理论的角度来看，选择倾向的变化与期望效用理论的失效密切相关。在本文研究的模型中，Allais悖论等同于一种已被广泛研究的选择倾向变化模式。因此，我们的研究结果结合了两种众所周知的行为规律：一种属于个体决策理论，另一种则属于群体社会心理学领域。

abstract.text: In a multicommunity model, high-income families cluster together in any equilibrium, and cluster near effective schools if effectiveness is an important component of community desirability. Governmental fragmentation facilitates this residential sorting. Thus, if parents prefer effective schools, income correlates with effectiveness in high-choice-market equilibrium. I examine the distribution of student background and test scores across schools within metropolitan areas that differ in the structure of educational governance. I find little indication of the “effectiveness sorting” that is predicted if parents choose neighborhoods for the efficacy of the local schools. This suggests caution about the productivity implications of school choice policies.

10.1257/aer.96.4.1333.abstractZh: 在多社区模型中，高收入家庭在任何均衡状态下都会聚集在一起，如果有效性是社区吸引力的重要组成部分，这些家庭还会聚集在优质学校附近。政府的碎片化现象有助于这种居住选择的形成。因此，如果家长更倾向于优质学校，那么在选择多样化的市场均衡中，收入与学校的有效性之间存在相关性。我研究了不同教育治理结构的大都市区域内学校的学生背景和考试成绩分布。我发现，如果家长根据当地学校的有效性来选择社区，那么“有效性排序”的现象几乎不存在。这提示我们，在评估学校选择政策对生产力的影响时需要谨慎。

abstract.text: We demonstrate the existence of multiple dimensions of private information in the long-term care insurance market. Two types of people purchase insurance: individuals with private information that they are high risk and individuals with private information that they have strong taste for insurance. Ex post, the former are higher risk than insurance companies expect, while the latter are lower risk. In aggregate, those with more insurance are not higher risk. Our results demonstrate that insurance markets may suffer from asymmetric information even absent a positive correlation between insurance coverage and risk occurrence. The results also suggest a general test for asymmetric information.

10.1257/aer.96.4.938.abstractZh: 我们证明了在长期护理保险市场中，私人信息存在多个维度。有两种类型的人购买保险：一类是拥有高风险私人信息的人，另一类是拥有强烈保险需求的人。事后来看，前者的风险确实高于保险公司预期，而后者的风险则较低。总体而言，拥有更多保险的人风险并不更高。我们的研究结果表明，即使保险覆盖与风险发生之间没有正相关关系，保险市场仍可能受到信息不对称的影响。研究结果还提出了一个检测信息不对称的一般性方法。

abstract.text: Exploiting differences across U.S. states, this paper demonstrates that there is a tight link between higher education policies, past enrollment rates, and recent changes in the college wage premium among labor market entrants. The analysis reveals, however, that this relationship is much weaker in states with high private enrollment rates, high levels of interstate mobility, or interstate trade. The within-state estimates of the own-cohort relative supply effect shed some light on the extent to which the U.S. labor market can be characterized as a single national market or a collection of state-specific labor markets.

10.1257/aer.96.4.959.abstractZh: 本文通过对比美国各州的情况，发现高等教育政策、过去的学生入学率以及大学工资溢价的变化之间存在密切关联。然而，分析表明，在私人入学率较高、跨州流动性较强或跨州贸易活跃的州，这种关系相对较弱。对州内同辈相对供给效应的分析有助于了解美国劳动力市场究竟是作为一个单一的国家市场，还是由多个具有州特定特征的劳动力市场构成的。

abstract.text: Labor supply theory predicts systematic heterogeneity in the impact of recent welfare reforms on earnings, transfers, and income. Yet most welfare reform research focuses on mean impacts. We investigate the importance of heterogeneity using random-assignment data from Connecticut's Jobs First waiver, which features key elements of post-1996 welfare programs. Estimated quantile treatment effects exhibit the substantial heterogeneity predicted by labor supply theory. Thus mean impacts miss a great deal. Looking separately at samples of dropouts and other women does not improve the performance of mean impacts. We conclude that welfare reform's effects are likely both more varied and more extensive than has been recognized.

10.1257/aer.96.4.988.abstractZh: 劳动力供给理论预测，最近的福利改革对收入、转移支付和收益的影响存在系统性差异。然而，大多数福利改革研究主要关注平均影响。我们利用康涅狄格州“就业优先”豁免计划中的随机分配数据来研究差异的重要性，该计划包含了1996年后福利计划的关键要素。估计的分位数处理效应显示出劳动力供给理论所预测的显著差异。因此，平均影响存在很大的遗漏。分别观察退出计划的其他女性样本并不能改善平均影响的准确性。我们得出结论，福利改革的效果可能比目前所认识到的更为多样化和广泛。

abstract.text: I am delighted to be able to present this lecture before so many people. I’m also very happy when I get to work with models inhabited by many people. That is the key to the framework for which Ed Prescott and I were cited by the Nobel Committee: Individuals are introduced explicitly in the models. Their decision problems are fully dynamic—they are forward looking. That is one of the prerequisites for what we ultimately seek, which is a framework we can use to evaluate economic policy. The eminent researcher and 1995 Nobel laureate in economics, Bob Lucas, from whom I have learned a great deal, wrote: “One of the functions of theoretical economics is to provide fully articulated, artificial economic systems that can serve as laboratories in which policies that would be prohibitively expensive to experiment with in actual economies can be tested out at much lower cost ... (Lucas, 1980, p. 696). Our task, as I see it ... is to write a FORTRAN program that will accept specific economic policy rules as ‘input’ and will generate as ‘output’ statistics describing the operating characteristics of time series we care about, which are predicted to result from these policies” (pp. 709–10). The desired environments to which Lucas refers would make use of information on “individual responses [that] can be documented relatively cheaply ... by means of ... censuses, panels [and] other surveys ...” (p. 710). Lucas seems to suggest that economic researchers place people in desired model environments and record how they behave under alternative policy rules. In practice, that is easier said than done. The key tool macroeconomists use is the computational experiment. With its help, the researcher performs exactly what I just described—places the model’s people in the desired environment and records their behavior. But the purpose of the computational experiment is broader than only to evaluate policy rules. The computational experiment is useful for answering a host of quantitative questions, that is, those for which we seek numerical answers. When evaluating government policy, the policy is stated in the form of a rule that specifies how the government will behave—what action to take under various contingencies—today and in the indefinite future. That is one reason it would be so difficult and prohibitively expensive to perform the alternative Lucas mentions, namely, to test the policies in actual economies.

10.1257/aer.96.5.1373.abstractZh: 我很高兴能够在这么多人面前进行这次演讲。当我能够与那些包含许多人的模型一起工作时，我也会感到非常愉快。这正是Ed Prescott和我所提出的框架的关键所在：模型中明确引入了个体。他们的决策问题是完全动态的——它们是向前看的。这是我们最终所追求的框架的一个前提条件，我们可以利用这个框架来评估经济政策。著名的经济学家、1995年诺贝尔经济学奖得主Bob Lucas曾写道：“理论经济学的功能之一是提供完全明确、可模拟的经济系统，这些系统可以作为实验室，在其中可以以更低的成本测试那些在实际经济中实验成本极高的政策……（Lucas, 1980, p. 696）。在我看来，我们的任务……是编写一个FORTRAN程序，该程序接受具体的经济政策规则作为‘输入’，并生成描述我们关心的时间序列运行特性的统计数据，这些统计数据预计是由这些政策所导致的。”（pp. 709–10）。Lucas所提到的理想环境需要使用“可以相对便宜地记录个体反应的信息……通过……人口普查、面板数据和其他调查……”来实现。（p. 710）Lucas似乎认为，经济研究人员将人们置于理想的模型环境中，并记录他们在不同政策规则下的行为。但实际上，说起来容易做起来难。宏观经济学家使用的关键工具是计算实验。借助这一工具，研究人员可以精确地执行我刚才描述的步骤——将模型中的人们置于理想环境中，并记录他们的行为。但计算实验的目的不仅仅是为了评估政策规则。该实验有助于回答许多定量问题，即那些我们需要数值答案的问题。在评估政府政策时，政策是以规则的形式表述的，这些规则规定了政府在各种情况下的行为方式——即在当前以及不确定的未来应采取何种行动。这也是为什么执行卢卡斯提到的另一种方法——即在实际经济中测试政策——会如此困难且成本高昂的原因之一。

abstract.text: This paper uses data from a randomized social experiment in Mexico to estimate and validate a dynamic behavioral model of parental decisions about fertility and child schooling, to evaluate the effects of the PROGRESA school subsidy program, and to perform a variety of counterfactual experiments of policy alternatives. Our method of validation estimates the model without using post-program data and then compares the model’s predictions about program impacts to the experimental impact estimates. The results show that the model’s predicted program impacts track the experimental results. Our analysis of counterfactual policies reveals an alternative subsidy schedule that would induce a greater impact on average school attainment at similar cost to the existing program.

10.1257/aer.96.5.1384.abstractZh: 本文利用墨西哥一项随机社会实验的数据，来估计和验证一个关于父母在生育和子女教育方面的决策的动态行为模型。同时，本文还评估了PROGRESA学校补贴计划的效果，并进行了多种政策替代方案的对比实验。我们的验证方法是在不使用项目后数据的情况下估计模型，然后将模型对计划影响的预测结果与实验影响估计值进行比较。结果表明，模型预测的计划影响与实验结果一致。我们对替代政策的分析表明，采用另一种补贴方案可以在不增加成本的情况下，对平均学校教育水平产生更大的影响。

abstract.text: Yes. We construct a measure of aggregate technology change, controlling for aggregation effects, varying utilization of capital and labor, nonconstant returns, and imperfect competition. On impact, when technology improves, input use and nonresidential investment fall sharply. Output changes little. With a lag of several years, inputs and investment return to normal and output rises strongly. The standard one-sector real-business-cycle model is not consistent with this evidence. The evidence is consistent, however, with simple sticky-price models, which predict the results we find: when technology improves, inputs and investment generally fall in the short run, and output itself may also fall.

10.1257/aer.96.5.1418.abstractZh: 是的。我们构建了一个衡量总体技术变化的指标，同时控制了聚合效应、资本和劳动力的不同利用方式、非恒定回报以及不完全竞争等因素。从影响来看，当技术得到改进时，投入的使用和非住宅投资会显著下降。产出变化不大。经过数年的滞后后，投入和投资会恢复正常，产出则会显著上升。标准的单部门实际商业周期模型与这一证据并不一致。然而，这一证据与简单的粘性价格模型是一致的，后者也预测了我们所发现的结果：当技术得到改进时，短期内投入和投资通常会下降，产出本身也可能下降。

abstract.text: We propose that a simple "dual-self" model gives a unified explanation for several empirical regularities, including the apparent time inconsistency that has motivated models of quasi-hyperbolic discounting and Rabin’s paradox of risk aversion in the large and small. The model also implies that self-control costs imply excess delay, as in the O'Donoghue and Rabin models of quasi-hyperbolic utility, and it explains experimental evidence that increased cognitive load makes temptations harder to resist. The base version of our model is consistent with the Gul-Pesendorfer axioms, but we argue that these axioms must be relaxed to account for the effect of cognitive load.

10.1257/aer.96.5.1449.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个简单的“双重自我”模型，该模型能够统一解释多种经验规律，包括那些促使人们采用准超bolic折扣模型的风险不一致性现象，以及Rabin关于风险厌恶的悖论。该模型还表明，自我控制成本会导致额外的延迟，这与O'Donoghue和Rabin提出的准超bolic效用模型一致。此外，该模型还解释了实验证据，即认知负荷的增加使得诱惑更难抵抗。我们模型的基版本与Gul-Pesendorfer公理一致，但我们认为，为了解释认知负荷的影响，必须对这些公理进行放宽。

abstract.text: Under the Agreement on Trade-Related Intellectual Property Rights, the World Trade Organization members are required to enforce product patents for pharmaceuticals. In this paper we empirically investigate the welfare effects of this requirement on developing countries using data for the fluoroquinolones subsegment of the systemic anti-bacterials segment of the Indian pharmaceuticals market. Our results suggest that concerns about the potential adverse welfare effects of TRIPS may have some basis. We estimate that the withdrawal of all domestic products in this subsegment is associated with substantial welfare losses to the Indian economy, even in the presence of price regulation. The overwhelming portion of this welfare loss derives from the loss of consumer welfare.

10.1257/aer.96.5.1477.abstractZh: 根据《与贸易有关的知识产权协定》，世界贸易组织成员国被要求实施药品产品的专利保护。本文利用印度药品市场中的氟喹诺酮类药物子领域的数据，实证研究了这一要求对发展中国家的福利影响。研究结果表明，关于TRIPS协议可能带来的负面福利影响的担忧有一定的依据。我们估计，即使存在价格管制，从这一子领域中撤出所有国内产品，仍会导致印度经济出现显著的福利损失。这种福利损失的大部分来源于消费者福利的减少。

abstract.text: In recent decades, U.S. foreign trade grew much faster than GDP, but there is no consensus why. Notably lacking is an understanding of the role of multinational corporations (MNCs), which mediate over half of world trade. We use Bureau of Economic Analysis data on U.S. MNCs to study the rapid growth of MNC-based trade from 1983 to 1996. Using a model of U.S. MNCs and Canadian affiliates, we decompose this growth by source. Tariff reductions can largely explain increases in arms-length MNC-based trade. But intra-firm trade growth is attributed mostly to “technical change.” We present additional evidence suggesting just-in-time production facilitated intra-firm trade. (JEL F13, F14, F23)
