10.1257/aer.96.5.1515.abstractZh: 近几十年来，美国的对外贸易增长速度远远超过了GDP的增长速度，但关于这一现象的原因尚未达成共识。目前对于跨国企业（MNCs）在促进世界贸易中的作用缺乏了解，而跨国企业实际上承担了超过一半的世界贸易。我们利用美国经济分析局关于美国跨国企业的数据，研究了1983年至1996年间基于跨国企业的贸易的快速增长。通过构建美国跨国企业与加拿大子公司之间的模型，我们将这种增长按来源进行了分解。关税的降低在很大程度上可以解释基于跨国企业的贸易的增长。而企业内部的贸易增长则主要归因于“技术变革”。我们还提供了额外的证据，表明准时制生产方式促进了企业内部的贸易往来。（JEL F13, F14, F23）

abstract.text: I use data from chief executive officer (CEO) successions to examine the impact of inherited control on firms' performance. I find that firms where incoming CEOs are related to the departing CEO, to a founder, or to a large shareholder by either blood or marriage underperform in terms of operating profitability and market-to-book ratios, relative to firms that promote unrelated CEOs. Consistent with wasteful nepotism, lower performance is prominent in firms that appoint family CEOs who did not attend “selective” undergraduate institutions. Overall, the evidence indicates that nepotism hurts performance by limiting the scope of labor market competition.

10.1257/aer.96.5.1559.abstractZh: 我利用首席执行官继任的数据来研究继承性控制对公司绩效的影响。我发现，那些新任首席执行官与离任首席执行官有亲属关系、与创始人有亲属关系或与被大股东有血缘或婚姻关系的公司，其运营盈利能力和市净率均低于那些提拔无亲属关系的首席执行官的公司。与浪费性的裙带关系一致，那些任命未就读于“选择性”本科院校的家庭CEO的公司，其绩效表现更差。总体而言，这些证据表明，裙带关系通过限制劳动力市场的竞争范围而损害公司绩效。

abstract.text: Using questions expressly added to the Consumer Expenditure Survey, we estimate the change in consumption expenditures caused by the 2001 federal income tax rebates and test the permanent income hypothesis. We exploit the unique, randomized timing of rebate receipt across households. Households spent 20 to 40 percent of their rebates on nondurable goods during the three-month period in which their rebates arrived, and roughly two-thirds of their rebates cumulatively during this period and the subsequent three-month period. The implied effects on aggregate consumption demand are substantial. Consistent with liquidity constraints, responses are larger for households with low liquid wealth or low income.

10.1257/aer.96.5.1589.abstractZh: 通过专门在消费者支出调查中添加的问题，我们估计了2001年联邦所得税退税对消费支出变化的影响，并检验了永久收入假说。我们利用了退税发放时间在不同家庭间具有随机性的特点。在退税发放的三个月期间，家庭将其退税的20%到40%用于非耐用品消费，而大约三分之二的退税在这两个时期累积使用。这些影响对整体消费需求产生了显著作用。与流动性约束一致，拥有较低流动资产或较低收入的家庭对退税的响应更为强烈。

abstract.text: We analyze the consequences of control on motivation in an experimental principal-agent game, where the principal can control the agent by implementing a minimum performance requirement before the agent chooses a productive activity. Our results show that control entails hidden costs since most agents reduce their performance as a response to the principal's controlling decision. Overall, the effect of control on the principal's payoff is nonmonotonic. When asked for their emotional perception of control, most agents who react negatively say that they perceive the controlling decision as a signal of distrust and a limitation of their choice autonomy.

10.1257/aer.96.5.1611.abstractZh: 我们在一个实验性的主-代理游戏中分析了控制对动机的影响。在这个游戏中，主方可以通过在代理选择生产活动之前设定最低绩效要求来控制代理的行为。我们的研究结果表明，控制带来了隐性成本，因为大多数代理为了应对主方的控制决策而降低了自己的绩效。总体而言，控制对主方收益的影响是非单调的。当被询问他们对控制的情感感知时，大多数反应消极的代理表示，他们认为控制决策是一种不信任的信号，也限制了他们的选择自主权。

abstract.text: We analyze the effects of financial and trade globalization on the likelihood of financial crashes in emerging markets. While trade globalization always makes crashes less likely, financial globalization may make them more likely, especially when trade costs are high. Pessimistic expectations can be self-fulfilling and lead to a collapse in demand for goods and assets. Such a crash comes with a current account reversal and drops in income and investment. Lower-income countries are more prone to such demand-based financial crises. A quantitative evaluation shows our model is consistent with the main stylized facts of financial crashes in emerging markets.

10.1257/aer.96.5.1631.abstractZh: 我们分析了金融和贸易全球化对新兴市场金融崩溃可能性的影响。虽然贸易全球化总是降低金融崩溃的可能性，但金融全球化可能会增加这种可能性，尤其是在贸易成本较高的情况下。悲观预期可能会自我实现，导致对商品和资产的需求崩溃。这种崩溃伴随着经常账户逆差以及收入和投资的下降。低收入国家更容易遭受这种基于需求的金融危机。定量评估表明，我们的模型与新兴市场金融崩溃的主要典型特征一致。

abstract.text: We develop a theory of prosocial behavior that combines heterogeneity in individual altruism and greed with concerns for social reputation or self-respect. Rewards or punishments (whether material or image-related) create doubt about the true motive for which good deeds are performed, and this “overjustification effect” can induce a partial or even net crowding out of prosocial behavior by extrinsic incentives. We also identify the settings that are conducive to multiple social norms and, more generally, those that make individual actions complements or substitutes, which we show depends on whether stigma or honor is (endogenously) the dominant reputational concern. Finally, we analyze the socially optimal level of incentives and how monopolistic or competitive sponsors depart from it. Sponsor competition is shown to potentially reduce social welfare.

10.1257/aer.96.5.1652.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种关于亲社会行为的理论，该理论将个体利他行为与贪婪的异质性与对社会声誉或自我尊重的考量相结合。奖励或惩罚（无论是物质上的还是与形象相关的）都会引发对善行动机真实性的怀疑，这种“过度正当化效应”可能会通过外部激励部分甚至完全抑制亲社会行为。我们还确定了有利于多种社会规范的环境，以及那些使个体行为成为互补或替代关系的环境，我们发现这些关系取决于污名还是荣誉是（内源性地）主导的声誉考量。最后，我们分析了激励措施的社会最优水平，以及垄断性或竞争性赞助者如何偏离这一水平。研究表明，赞助者的竞争可能会降低社会福祉。

abstract.text: We examine administrative data on young German workers and their employers to study the long-term effects of an early career job loss. To account for nonrandom sorting of workers into firms with different turnover rates and for selective job mobility, we use changes over time in firm- and age-specific labor demand as an instrument for displacement. We find that wage losses of young job losers are initially 15 percent, but drop to zero within five years. Only workers leaving very large establishments suffer persistent losses. A comparison of estimators implies that initial sorting, negative selection, and voluntary job mobility biases ordinary least squares estimates toward finding permanent negative effects of early displacements.

10.1257/aer.96.5.1679.abstractZh: 我们研究了德国年轻工人及其雇主的行政数据，以研究早期职业失败的长期影响。为了考虑工人被随机分配到不同周转率的企业中，以及选择性职业流动的情况，我们使用随时间变化的特定企业和年龄的劳动力需求变化作为替代变量。我们发现，年轻失业者的工资损失最初为15%，但在五年内降至零。只有离开大型企业的工人才会遭受持续的工资损失。通过比较不同估计方法，我们发现初始的排序、负面选择以及自愿的职业流动等因素，使得普通最小二乘法估计倾向于发现早期职业失败的永久性负面影响。

abstract.text: We study dynamic monopoly pricing of storable goods in an environment where demand changes over time. The literature on durables has focused on incentives to delay purchases. Our analysis focuses on a different intertemporal demand incentive. The key force on the consumer side is advance purchases or stockpiling. In the case of storable goods, the stockpiling motive has recently been documented empirically. We show that, in this environment, if the monopolist cannot commit, then prices are higher in all periods, and social welfare is lower, than in the case in which the monopolist can commit. This is in contrast with the analysis in the literature on the Coase conjecture.

10.1257/aer.96.5.1706.abstractZh: 我们研究了在需求随时间变化的环境下，可储存商品的动态垄断定价问题。关于耐用品的文献主要关注延迟购买的激励因素。我们的分析聚焦于另一种跨期需求激励因素。消费者方面的关键动机是提前购买或囤积。对于可储存商品而言，囤积动机最近已有实证记录。我们指出，在这种环境下，如果垄断者无法做出承诺，那么所有时期的价格都会更高，社会福利也会更低，这与关于科斯猜想的文献分析结果相反。

abstract.text: Crises are volatile times when endogenous sources of information are closely monitored. We study the role of information in crises by introducing a financial market in a coordination game with imperfect information. The asset price aggregates dispersed private information acting as a public noisy signal. In contrast to the case with exogenous information, our main result is that uniqueness may not obtain as a perturbation from perfect information: multiplicity is ensured with small noise. In addition, we show that: (a) multiplicity may emerge in the financial price itself; (b) less noise may contribute toward nonfundamental volatility even when the equilibrium is unique; and (c) similar results obtain for a model where individuals observe one another's actions, highlighting the importance of endogenous information more generally.

10.1257/aer.96.5.1720.abstractZh: 危机是信息来源不稳定的时期，此时需要密切监控内源性信息。我们通过在一个存在信息不完美的协调博弈中引入金融市场，来研究信息在危机中的作用。资产价格汇总了分散的私人信息，这些信息起到了公共噪声信号的作用。与外部信息的情况不同，我们的主要结论是：从完美信息的扰动来看，唯一性可能不再成立；即使均衡是唯一的，多重性也是可以实现的，且噪声越小，多重性越有保障。此外，我们还发现：(a)在金融价格本身中也可能出现多重性；(b)即使均衡是唯一的，较少的噪声也可能有助于减少非基本波动性；(c)对于个体观察彼此行为的模型，也获得了类似的结果，这进一步凸显了内源性信息的重要性。

abstract.text: This paper reports an experiment that elicits subjects' initial responses to 16 dominance-solvable two-person guessing games. The structure is publicly announced except for varying payoff parameters, to which subjects are given free access. Varying the parameters allows very strong separation of the behavior implied by leading decision rules. Subjects' decisions and searches show that most subjects understood the games and sought to maximize payoffs, but many had simplified models of others' decisions that led to systematic deviations from equilibrium. The predictable component of their deviations is well explained by a structural nonequilibrium model of initial responses based on level-k thinking.

10.1257/aer.96.5.1737.abstractZh: 本文报道了一项实验，旨在引发受试者对16种可解决支配关系的两人猜谜游戏的初始反应。实验的结构是公开的，只是支付参数有所不同，受试者可以自由访问这些参数。通过改变参数，可以非常明显地分离出由主导决策规则所暗示的行为模式。受试者的决策和搜索行为表明，大多数受试者理解这些游戏并试图最大化收益，但许多受试者对他人的决策有简化的模型，这导致他们系统性地偏离了均衡状态。他们偏离行为的可预测性可以通过基于k级思维结构的非均衡模型来很好地解释。

abstract.text: We develop a model of currency crises, in which traders are heterogeneously informed, and interest rates are endogenously determined in a noisy rational expectations equilibrium. In our model, multiple equilibria result from distinct roles an interest rate plays in determining domestic asset market allocations and the devaluation outcome. Except for special cases, this finding is not affected by the introduction of noisy private signals. We conclude that the global games results on equilibrium uniqueness do not apply to market-based models of currency crises.

10.1257/aer.96.5.1769.abstractZh: 我们建立了一个货币危机模型，在该模型中，交易者具有异质性的信息，而利率则在噪声理性预期均衡中内生地确定。在我们的模型中，多个均衡状态源于利率在决定国内资产市场配置和货币贬值结果中的不同作用。除了特殊情况外，这一发现不会受到噪声私人信号引入的影响。我们得出结论，关于均衡唯一性的全局博弈结果并不适用于基于市场的货币危机模型。

abstract.text: This paper exploits the variation in the legal minimum working age across states in 1920 America in order to identify households' labor supply responses to exogenous changes in children's labor force participation. Using micro data on urban households from the U.S. Census, I find evidence that as a child moves to the labor market his siblings are less likely to work and more likely to attend school. I find no significant effect on parents' labor supply.

10.1257/aer.96.5.1788.abstractZh: 本文研究了1920年美国各州法定最低工作年龄的差异，以探讨家庭劳动力供给对子女劳动力参与率变化的外生影响的响应。通过美国人口普查中城市家庭微观数据的研究，我发现随着儿童进入劳动力市场，其兄弟姐妹从事工作的可能性降低，上学的可能性增加。然而，这一变化对父母的劳动力供给并未产生显著影响。

abstract.text: Applying the Coase Theorem to marital bargaining suggests that shifting from consent to unilateral divorce laws will not affect divorce rates. I show that existing evidence suggesting large effects of divorce laws on divorce rates reflect a failure to explicitly model the dynamic response of divorce rates to a shock to the legal regime. When accounting for these dynamics, I find that unilateral divorce spiked following the adoption of unilateral divorce laws, but that this rise largely reversed itself within a decade. Overall, these changes in family law explain very little of the rise in divorce over the past half-century.

10.1257/aer.96.5.1802.abstractZh: 将科斯定理应用于婚姻谈判表明，从同意制转向单方面离婚法律并不会影响离婚率。我指出，现有证据表明离婚法律对离婚率有显著影响，这反映了未能明确模拟离婚率对法律制度的动态反应。在考虑这些动态因素后，我发现单方面离婚率在采用单方面离婚法律后急剧上升，但这种上升在十年内基本逆转。总体而言，这些家庭法律的变化对过去半个世纪离婚率的上升解释力度非常有限。

abstract.text: I show existing evidence on labor supply behavior places an upper bound on risk aversion in the expected utility model. I derive a formula for the coefficient of relative risk aversion (γ) in terms of the ratio of the income elasticity of labor supply to wage elasticity and degree of complementarity between consumption and labor. I bound the degree of complementarity using data on consumption choices when labor supply varies across states. Using labor supply elasticity estimates, I find a mean estimate of [Formula: see text], then show generating γ > 2 requires that wage increases cause sharper labor supply reductions.

10.1257/aer.96.5.1821.abstractZh: 我展示了现有关于劳动力供给行为的证据，这些证据表明在期望效用模型中，风险厌恶存在一个上限。我推导出了一个相对风险厌恶系数γ的公式，该公式取决于劳动力供给的收入弹性与工资弹性之比，以及消费与劳动力之间的互补程度。我利用不同状态下消费选择的数据来界定互补程度。通过劳动力供给弹性的估计，我发现γ的平均估计值为[公式：见正文]，然后我表明，要使γ大于2，工资增长必须导致更显著的劳动力供给减少。

abstract.text: This paper uses a dynamic general equilibrium model to analyze and quantify the aggregate effects of the timing of tax rate changes enacted in 2001 (which called for successive rate reductions through 2006) and 2003 (which made immediate tax rate cuts scheduled for 2004 and 2006). The phased-in nature contributed to the slow recovery from the 2001 recession, while the elimination of the phase-in helped explain the increase in economic activity in 2003. The simulations suggest while the tax policy was a drag on the economy in 2001 and 2002, it increased economic growth in 2003, once phase-ins were eliminated.

10.1257/aer.96.5.1835.abstractZh: 本文采用动态一般均衡模型来分析和量化2001年实施的税率调整政策（该政策要求到2006年逐步降低税率）以及2003年实施的立即减税政策（计划于2004年和2006年实施）的综合影响。逐步实施的税率调整政策导致2001年经济衰退后的恢复进程较为缓慢，而取消逐步实施政策则有助于解释2003年经济活动的增加。模拟结果显示，虽然2001年和2002年的税收政策对经济增长产生了抑制作用，但一旦取消逐步实施政策，这些税收政策在2003年反而促进了经济增长。

abstract.text: Despite much work, economists have not been able to quantitatively account for the differences in the Japanese and U.S. saving rates after World War II. In this paper, we show that the use of actual Japanese total factor productivity growth rates in a standard growth model generates saving rates that are reasonably similar to the Japanese data between 1956 and 2000.

10.1257/aer.96.5.1850.abstractZh: 尽管进行了大量研究，经济学家仍未能定量解释二战后日本与美国储蓄率之间的差异。本文指出，在标准的增长模型中，使用实际的日本全要素生产率增长率所得到的储蓄率与1956年至2000年的日本数据相当接近。

abstract.text: We examine the “technology sourcing” hypothesis that foreign research labs located in the U.S. tap into U.S. R&D spillovers and improve home country productivity. We show that U.K. firms that established a high proportion of inventors based in the U.S. by 1990 benefited disproportionately from the growth of U.S. R&D stock over the next ten years. We estimate that U.S. R&D during the 1990s was associated with 5 percent higher Total Factor Productivity for U.K. manufacturing firms in 2000 (about $13 billion), with the majority of benefits accruing to firms with an innovative presence in the U.S.

10.1257/aer.96.5.1859.abstractZh: 我们探讨了“技术获取”假说，即位于美国的国外研究实验室能够利用美国的研发溢出效应，从而提高母国的生产力。我们发现，到1990年时，英国企业中拥有大量美国籍发明人的企业，在接下来的十年里从美国研发的增长中获得了不成比例的收益。我们的估计显示，在1990年代，美国的研发活动使英国制造企业的全要素生产率提高了5%，这一提升带来的经济影响约为130亿美元。其中，大部分收益都归给了那些在美有创新能力的企业。

abstract.text: Dramatic changes in the volatility of output occurred in the U.S. auto industry in the early 1980s. Namely, output volatility declined, the covariance of inventory investment and sales grew more negative, and adjustments to production schedules, which in earlier decades stemmed primarily from plants hiring and laying off workers, were more often accomplished with changes in average hours per worker after the mid-1980s. Using a linear quadratic inventory model with intensive and extensive labor adjustments, we show how all of these changes could have stemmed from one underlying factor—a decline in the persistence of motor vehicle sales.

10.1257/aer.96.5.1876.abstractZh: 在20世纪80年代初，美国汽车行业的产出波动性发生了显著变化。具体来说，产出的波动性下降，库存投资与销售之间的协方差变得更加负值，而生产计划的调整——在之前几十年中主要依赖于工厂的招聘和裁员——在20世纪80年代中期之后，更多地通过改变每个工人的平均工作时间来实现。利用一个包含劳动密集型与劳动粗放型调整的线性二次库存模型，我们展示了所有这些变化可能都源于一个潜在因素——汽车销售的持续性下降。

abstract.text: Mixing across racial and ethnic lines could spur understanding or inflame tensions between groups. We find that white students at a large state university randomly assigned African American roommates in their first year were more likely to endorse affirmative action and view a diverse student body as essential for a high-quality education. They were also more likely to say they have more personal contact with, and interact more comfortably with, members of minority groups. Although sample sizes are too small to provide definitive evidence, these results suggest students become more empathetic with the social groups to which their roommates belong.

10.1257/aer.96.5.1890.abstractZh: 跨种族和族裔的融合可能会促进理解，也可能加剧群体间的紧张关系。我们发现，在大型州立大学中，第一年被分配与非洲裔室友同住的白人学生，更有可能支持平权行动，并认为多元化的学生群体对高质量的教育至关重要。他们也更有可能表示自己与少数族裔成员有更多的个人接触，并且与他们相处得更自在。尽管样本规模太小，无法提供明确的证据，但这些结果表明，学生对其室友所属的社会群体会表现出更多的同理心。

abstract.text: A major puzzle in the literature on social preferences is that a large majority of subjects behaves as if completely self-interested in some circumstances, such as in competitive experimental markets with standardized goods or in the final rounds of public goods experiments; while in other circumstances a large majority behaves as if strongly motivated by fairness concerns, e.g., in competitive markets with incomplete contracts or in public goods experiments with punishment opportunities. Recently developed models of inequity aversion (Fehr and Schmidt, 1999; Gary E Bolton and Axel Ockenfels, 2000) can explain this puzzle by assuming a heterogeneous population of selfish and inequity-averse subjects. Dirk Engelmann and Martin Strobel (2004, henceforth E&S) question the relevance of inequity aversion in simple dictator game experiments, claiming that a combination of a preference for efficiency 1 and a Rawlsian motive for helping the least

10.1257/aer.96.5.1912.abstractZh: 在关于社会偏好的文献中，一个主要的谜题是：在某些情况下，大多数受试者表现得好像完全以自身利益为出发点，例如在具有标准化商品的竞争性实验市场或公共物品实验的最后阶段；而在其他情况下，大多数受试者则表现出强烈的公平意识，例如在具有不完全契约的竞争市场或带有惩罚机会的公共物品实验中。最近提出的不公平厌恶模型（Fehr和Schmidt，1999年；Gary E. Bolton和Axel Ockenfels，2000年）可以通过假设一个由自私者和不公平的厌恶者组成的异质群体来解释这一谜题。Dirk Engelmann和Martin Strobel（2004年）在简单的独裁者博弈实验中质疑了不公平厌恶的相关性，他们声称，效率偏好与罗尔斯式的帮助最弱者的动机相结合，可以解释这一现象。

abstract.text: OBJECTIVES: A basic tenet of effective performance management is that decision makers should be held responsible only for aspects of performance over which they have control. We examine the degree to which variations in the performance of health care organizations are explained by a range of factors that are subject to differing degrees of managerial control. METHODS: We use multiple regression methods and data on 304 National Health Service (NHS) Primary Care Trusts (PCTs) in England for 2002/03 to analyse the relationship between their performance, as measured by 'star ratings' and nine key performance targets, and a large number of explanatory variables. We classify the explanatory variables into five groups along a spectrum from 'no managerial control' to 'total managerial control'. We also analyse the relationship between PCTs that are service purchasers and their main providers to assess the degree to which their performance is linked. RESULTS: For all of the key performance targets, most of the variation in performance is unexplained, although variables in groups 1, 2 and 3 (less managerial control) explain the largest proportion of variation. We find some evidence that socioeconomic and geographic factors have an impact on performance. We also find a positive relationship between the performances of purchaser and provider organizations. CONCLUSIONS: The star ratings did not allow for the different environmental circumstances within which PCTs operate and which affect their performance. Policy-makers should exercise caution in using such performance indicators to regulate health care organizations.

10.1258/135581906778476517.abstractZh: 目标：有效的绩效管理的基本原则是，决策者仅应对他们能够控制的绩效方面负责。我们研究了医疗组织绩效差异在多大程度上可以由受不同程度管理控制影响的多种因素来解释。方法：我们使用多元回归方法，以2002/03年度的英格兰304个国家卫生服务初级保健信托机构的数据为基础，分析其绩效（通过“星级评分”和九个关键绩效指标衡量）与大量解释变量的关系。我们将这些解释变量分为五个类别，从“无管理控制”到“完全管理控制”。我们还分析了作为服务购买方的信托机构与其主要提供者之间的关系，以评估其绩效之间的关联程度。结果：对于所有关键绩效指标，大部分绩效差异无法解释，尽管第1、2和3组变量（管理控制较少）解释了最大比例的差异。我们发现一些证据表明社会经济和地理因素对绩效有影响。我们还发现购买方和提供者组织的绩效之间存在正相关关系。结论：星级评分未能考虑到信托机构运营中的不同环境状况，而这些状况会影响其绩效。政策制定者在使用此类绩效指标来监管医疗组织时应谨慎行事。

abstract.text: In many settings, firms rely on independent contractors, or freelancers, for the provision of certain services. The benefits of such relationships for both firms and workers are often understood in terms of increased flexibility. Less understood is the impact of freelancing on individual performance. While it is often presumed that the performance of freelancers is largely portable across organizations, it is also possible that a given worker’s performance may vary across organizations if he or she develops firm-specific skills and knowledge over time. We examine this issue empirically by considering the performance of cardiac surgeons, many of whom perform operations at multiple hospitals within narrow periods of time. Using patient mortality as an outcome measure, we find that the quality of a surgeon’s performance at a given hospital improves significantly with increases in his or her recent procedure volume at that hospital but does not significantly improve with increases in his or her volume at other hospitals. Our findings suggest that surgeon performance is not fully portable across hospitals (i.e., some portion of performance is firm specific). Further, we provide preliminary evidence suggesting that this result may be driven by the familiarity that a surgeon develops with the assets of a given organization.

10.1287/mnsc.1050.0464.abstractZh: 在许多情况下，企业依赖独立承包商或自由职业者来提供某些服务。这种关系对企业和员工的好处通常被认为可以提高灵活性。然而，自由职业者对个人表现的影响却鲜为人知。虽然人们通常认为自由职业者的表现在不同组织之间具有可转移性，但实际上，如果一名员工随着时间发展出特定于该企业的技能和知识，其表现可能会在不同组织间发生变化。我们通过研究心脏外科医生的表现来探讨这个问题，这些医生在较短的时间内需要在多家医院进行手术。以患者死亡率作为衡量标准，我们发现，外科医生在某一医院的表现质量会随着其在该医院最近手术量的增加而显著提高，但在其他医院的表现则不会随着手术量的增加而显著改善。我们的研究结果表明，外科医生的表现在不同医院之间并非完全可转移（即，部分表现是特定于企业的）。此外，我们提供了初步证据，表明这一结果可能源于外科医生对特定组织资源的熟悉程度。

abstract.text: We examine Medicare costs and survival gains for acute myocardial infarction (AMI) during 1986-2002. As David Cutler and Mark McClellan did in earlier work, we find that overall gains in post-AMI survival more than justified the increases in costs during this period. Since 1996, however, survival gains have stagnated, while spending has continued to increase. We also consider changes in spending and outcomes at the regional level. Regions experiencing the largest spending gains were not those realizing the greatest improvements in survival. Factors yielding the greatest benefits to health were not the factors that drove up costs, and vice versa.

10.1377/hlthaff.25.w34.abstractZh: 我们研究了1986年至2002年间急性心肌梗死患者医疗保险费用与生存改善之间的关系。正如David Cutler和Mark McClellan在之前的研究中所指出的，这一时期生存改善带来的总体收益超过了费用的增加。然而，自1996年以来，生存改善的成效逐渐停滞，而医疗费用却持续上升。我们还研究了区域层面的支出和生存状况变化。那些支出增长最大的地区，其生存改善的成效并不最为显著。对健康产生最大益处的因素，并不一定是导致费用上升的因素，反之亦然。

abstract.text: Most studies of competition in health care focus on prices and costs, but concerns about quality play a central role in policy debates. If demand is inelastic to quality, then competition may reduce patient welfare. This study uses a dataset of patient registrations for kidney transplantation in conjunction with a mixed logit model to gauge consumers' responsiveness to quality when choosing hospitals. Results indicate that at the hospital level, a one-standard deviation increase in the graft-failure rate is associated with a 6% decline in patient registrations. Privately-insured patients are more responsive to quality than Medicare patients, suggesting that insurers consider quality when contracting with providers.

10.1515/1538-0653.1349.abstractZh: 大多数关于医疗保健竞争的研究都集中在价格和成本上，但质量问题在政策讨论中起着核心作用。如果需求对质量缺乏弹性，那么竞争可能会降低患者的福利。本研究使用肾脏移植患者的注册数据，并结合混合逻辑模型，来评估消费者在选择医院时对质量的反应。研究结果表明，在医院层面，移植失败率增加一个标准差，会导致患者注册数量下降6%。与Medicare患者相比，私人保险患者对质量的反应更为敏感，这表明保险公司在与医疗服务提供者签约时会考虑质量因素。

abstract.text: On almost all measures of physical health, Scots fare worse than residents of any other region of the UK and often worse than the rest of Europe. Deaths from chronic liver disease and lung cancer are particularly prevalent in Scotland. The self-assessed wellbeing of Scots is lower than that of the English or Welsh, even after taking into account any differences in characteristics. Scots also suffer from higher levels of self-assessed depression or phobia, accidental death and suicide than those in other parts of Great Britain. This result is particularly driven by outcomes in Strathclyde and is consistent with the high scores for other measures of social deprivation in this area. On average, indicators of social capital in Scotland are no worse than in England or Wales. Detailed analysis within Scotland, however, shows that social capital indicators for the Strathclyde area are relatively low. We argue that these problems seem unlikely to be fixed by indirect policies aimed at raising economic growth.

10.3386/w11911.abstractZh: 在几乎所有身体健康指标上，苏格兰人的状况都比其他英国地区的居民更差，甚至比欧洲其他地区的居民还要糟糕。慢性肝病和肺癌的死亡率在苏格兰尤为突出。即使考虑到各种特征上的差异，苏格兰人的自我幸福感仍然低于英格兰或威尔士人。此外，苏格兰人在自我评估中表现出更高的抑郁、恐惧、意外死亡和自杀率。这一结果尤其体现在斯特拉斯克莱德地区，这与该地区在其他社会剥夺指标上的高分一致。总体而言，苏格兰的社会资本指标并不比英格兰或威尔士差。然而，对苏格兰内部的详细分析表明，斯特拉斯克莱德地区的社会资本指标相对较低。我们认为，这些问题不太可能通过旨在促进经济增长的间接政策得到解决。

abstract.text: Traditional economic analysis has proposed well known remedies to deal with consumption externalities and inefficient technological change in isolation, but lacks a general framework for addressing them jointly. We argue that the joint determination of R&D and consumption externalities is central to health care industries around the world generally, and for the pharmaceutical industry in particular. This is because technological change drives the expansion of the health care sector and altruism seems to motivate many public subsidies such as Medicaid in the US. We stress that standard remedies to the two problems in isolation are inefficient -- Pigouvian corrections to consumption externalities are inefficient under technological change and standard R&D stimuli are inefficient because they focus only on consumer and producer surplus, not the altruistic surplus accruing to non-consumers. We provide illustrative calculations of the dynamic inefficiency in the level of US R&D spending due to the inability of innovators to appropriate the altruistic surplus. We find that altruistic gains amount to about a quarter of consumer surplus in the baseline scenario. Our analysis implies that total R&D could be under-provided by as much as 60 percent.

10.3386/w11930.abstractZh: 传统的经济分析提出了一些众所周知的解决方案，以单独处理消费外部性和技术变革的无效性，但缺乏一个能够共同解决这些问题的总体框架。我们认为，共同确定研发与消费外部性问题是全球医疗保健行业，尤其是制药行业的核心问题。这是因为技术变革推动了医疗保健领域的扩张，而利他主义似乎也是美国医疗补助等公共补贴的动机之一。我们强调，单独解决这两个问题的标准方法效率低下——在技术变革背景下，针对消费外部性的庇古修正效率低下；而标准的研发激励措施效率低下，因为它们只关注消费者和生产者剩余，而忽略了非消费者所获得的利他剩余。我们通过计算实例说明了由于创新者无法获取利他剩余而导致的美国研发支出水平的动态低效。我们发现，在基准情景下，利他收益大约相当于消费者剩余的四分之一。我们的分析表明，总研发投入可能不足60%。

abstract.text: This paper provides a systematic review of the economic analysis of health, safety, and environmental regulations. Although the market failures that give rise to a rationale for intervention are well known, not all market failures imply that market risk levels are too great. Hazard warnings policies often can address informational failures. Some market failures may be exacerbated by government policies, particularly those embodying conservative risk assessment practices. Labor market estimates of the value of statistical life provide a useful reference point for the efficient risk tradeoffs for government regulation. Guided by restrictive legislative mandates, regulatory policies often strike a quite different balance with an inordinately high cost per life saved. The risk-risk analysis methodology enables analysts to assess the net safety implications of policy efforts. Inadequate regulatory enforcement and behavioral responses to regulation may limit their effectiveness, while rising societal wealth will continue to generate greater levels of health and safety.

10.3386/w11934.abstractZh: 本文系统回顾了健康、安全和环境法规的经济分析。虽然导致需要干预的市场失灵现象早已为人所知，但并非所有市场失灵都意味着市场风险水平过高。危险警示政策通常能够解决信息不足的问题。某些市场失灵可能因政府政策而加剧，尤其是那些采用保守风险评估做法的政策。对统计生命价值的估算为政府监管中有效的风险权衡提供了有用的参考依据。在限制性立法要求的指导下，监管政策往往寻求一种成本过高的平衡。风险-风险分析方法使分析师能够评估政策努力对安全的净影响。不充分的监管执行以及对法规的行为反应可能会限制其有效性，而不断上升的社会财富将继续带来更高水平的健康和安全保障。

abstract.text: This article examines revealed rates of time preference for public goods, using environmental quality as the case study. A nationally representative panel-based sample of 2,914 respondents considered a series of 5 conjoint policy choices, yielding 14,570 decisions. Both the conditional fixed effect logit estimates of the random utility model and mixed logit estimates implied that the rate of time preference is very high for immediate improvements and drops off substantially thereafter, which is inconsistent with exponential discounting but consistent with hyperbolic discounting. The implied marginal rate of time preference declines and then rises. Estimates of the quasi-hyperbolic discounting parameter range from 0.48 to 0.61. People who are older are especially likely to have a high disutility from delays in improving water quality.

10.3386/w11935.abstractZh: 本文以环境质量为案例研究，探讨了公共物品的时间偏好显性比率。一项基于全国代表性样本的调查研究，涉及2,914名受访者，他们面临5种联合政策选择，最终形成了14,570种决策结果。随机效用模型的条件下固定效应Logit估计和混合Logit估计均表明，对于即时改善而言，时间偏好率非常高，之后则显著下降。这一结果与指数型折现不符，但与双曲型折现一致。时间偏好的边际率呈现先下降后上升的趋势。准双曲型折现参数的估计值介于0.48至0.61之间。年龄较大的人尤其可能对水质改善的延迟感到不满。

abstract.text: To shed new light on the role private profit incentives play in promoting public health, in this paper we conduct an empirical study of the impact of pharmaceutical industry advertising on smoking cessation decisions. We link survey data on individual smokers with an archive of magazine advertisements. The rich survey data allow us to measure smokers' exposure to smoking cessation advertisements based on their magazine-reading habits. Because we observe the same information about the consumers that the advertisers observe, we can control for the potential endogeneity of advertising due to firms' targeting decisions. We find that when smokers are exposed to more advertising, they are more likely to attempt to quit and are more likely to have successfully quit. While some of the increased quitting behavior involves purchases of smoking cessation products, our results indicate that advertisements for smoking cessation products also increase the probability of quitting without the use of any product. Thus, the public health returns to smoking cessation product advertisements exceed the private returns to the manufacturers. Because advertising of a wide range of consumer products may have important and under-studied spillover effects on various non-market behaviors, our results have broad implications for the economics of advertising.

10.3386/w11938.abstractZh: 为了进一步探讨私人利润激励在促进公共健康方面的作用，本文对制药行业广告对戒烟决策的影响进行了实证研究。我们将关于个体吸烟者的调查数据与杂志广告档案相结合。丰富的调查数据使我们能够根据读者的杂志阅读习惯来衡量吸烟者接触戒烟广告的情况。由于我们获取消费者的信息与广告商相同，因此可以控制广告因企业目标定位而产生的潜在内生性。研究发现，当吸烟者接触到更多戒烟广告时，他们更有可能尝试戒烟，并且更有可能成功戒烟。虽然部分增加的戒烟行为涉及购买戒烟产品，但我们的结果表明，戒烟产品的广告也能增加不使用任何产品的情况下戒烟的概率。因此，戒烟产品广告对公共健康的贡献超过了其对制造商的私人收益。由于各种消费品广告可能对各种非市场行为产生重要且尚未充分研究的溢出效应，我们的研究结果对广告经济学具有广泛的意义。

abstract.text: The introduction of Medicare in 1965 was the single largest change in health insurance coverage in U.S. history. Many economists and commentators have conjectured that the introduction of Medicare may have also been an important impetus for the development of new drugs that are now commonly used by the elderly and have substantially extended their life expectancy. In this paper, we investigate whether Medicare induced pharmaceutical innovations directed towards the elderly. Medicare could have played such a role only if two conditions were met. First, Medicare would have to increase drug spending by the elderly. Second, the pharmaceutical companies would have to respond to the change in market size for drugs caused by Medicare by changing the direction of their research. Our empirical work finds no evidence of a "first-stage" effect of Medicare on prescription drug expenditure by the elderly. Correspondingly, we also find no evidence of a shift in pharmaceutical innovation towards therapeutic categories most used by the elderly. On the whole, therefore, our evidence does not provide support for the hypothesis that Medicare had a major effect on the direction of pharmaceutical innovation.

10.3386/w11949.abstractZh: 1965年医疗保险制度的引入是美国历史上健康保险覆盖范围的最大变革。许多经济学家和评论家推测，医疗保险制度的引入可能也是推动新药物开发的重要动力，这些新药物如今被老年人广泛使用，并显著延长了他们的预期寿命。在本文中，我们探讨了医疗保险制度是否促进了针对老年人的药物创新。只有当满足两个条件时，医疗保险制度才可能发挥这样的作用。首先，医疗保险制度必须增加老年人的药物支出。其次，制药公司必须根据医疗保险制度导致的市场规模变化，调整其研究方向。我们的实证研究并未发现医疗保险制度对老年人处方药支出有“第一阶段效应”的证据。相应地，我们也没有发现药物创新方向向老年人最常用的治疗类别转变的证据。因此，总体而言，我们的研究结果并不支持医疗保险制度对药物创新方向产生重大影响的假设。

abstract.text: This study examines the effect of price on the demand for health insurance by early retirees between the ages of 55 and 64. The analysis is based on administrative data from a medium sized employer and takes advantage of a natural experiment created by the firm's health insurance contribution policy. The amount the firm contributes toward retiree health insurance coverage depends on when a person retired and her years of service at that date. As a result of this policy, there is considerable variation in out-of-pocket premiums faced by individuals in the data, but this variation is independent of the non-price attributes of the health insurance plans offered, and plausibly exogenous to individual characteristics that are likely to affect the demand for insurance. We find that price has a statistically significant but small effect on the decision to take up coverage. The implied elasticities are very similar to results found in previous studies using very different data.

10.3386/w11951.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了价格对55至64岁提前退休者健康保险需求的影响。分析基于一家中等规模雇主的行政数据，并利用了该雇主健康保险缴费政策所创造的自然实验。企业为退休人员提供的健康保险覆盖金额取决于个人退休的时间及其在该时间段的服务年限。由于这一政策，数据中的个体所承担的自付保费存在显著差异，但这种差异与所提供的健康保险计划的非价格属性无关，且很可能是独立于可能影响保险需求的个人特征之外的因素。我们发现，价格对选择购买保险的决定具有统计上显著但较小的影响。这些隐含的弹性与之前使用不同数据得出的研究结果非常相似。

abstract.text: The Nutrition Labeling and Education Act (NLEA) imposed significant changes in the information about calories and nutrients that manufacturers of packaged foods must provide to consumers. This paper tests whether the release of this information impacted body weight and obesity among American adults. We estimate the effect of the new label using a difference-in-differences method. We compare the change before and after the implementation of NLEA in body weight among those who use labels when food shopping to that among those who do not use labels. In National Health Interview Survey data we find, among non-Hispanic white women, that the implementation of the new labels was associated with a decrease in body weight and the probability of obesity. Using NLEA regulatory impact analysis benchmarks, we estimate that the total monetary benefit of this decrease in body weight was $63 to $166 billion over a 20-year period, far in excess of the costs of the NLEA.

10.3386/w11956.abstractZh: 《营养标签与教育法案》对包装食品制造商向消费者提供的卡路里和营养成分信息提出了重大修改。本文旨在探讨这些信息的发布是否对美国成年人的体重和肥胖状况产生了影响。我们采用差异-差异方法估算新标签实施后的效果，并比较了使用标签与不使用标签的人在食品购买时体重的变化情况。根据全国健康访谈调查的数据，我们发现，在非西班牙裔白人女性中，新标签的实施与体重下降及肥胖概率的降低有关。根据《营养标签与教育法案》的监管影响分析基准，我们估计，在20年期间，体重下降带来的总经济效益为630亿至1660亿美元，远远超过了该法案的成本。

abstract.text: The escalating rate of obesity in the US highlights the importance of understanding the causes for this rise. In this paper I employ the First, Second, and Third National Health and Nutrition Examination Surveys to estimate a structural model of the determinants of adult obesity. To control for the potential endogeneity of some explanatory variables, such as caloric intake (adjusted for activity level) and smoking, a set of reduced form equations for these outcomes is estimated simultaneously with the obesity equation. To identify each equation, I use an array of state-level characteristics as instrumental variables. Trends in these variables shed light on the sources of the rapid increase in obesity since 1980.

10.3386/w11957.abstractZh: 美国肥胖率的不断上升凸显了理解这一增长原因的重要性。在本文中，我利用第一次、第二次和第三次全国健康与营养调查的数据，建立了一个结构模型来估计影响成人肥胖的因素。为了控制一些解释变量的潜在内生性，例如热量摄入（经过活动水平调整后的数据）和吸烟情况，我同时估计了这些变量的简化方程。为了识别每个方程，我使用了一系列州级特征作为工具变量。这些变量的变化趋势有助于揭示自1980年以来肥胖率迅速增加的来源。

abstract.text: Mortality rates have fallen dramatically over time, starting in a few countries in the 18th century, and continuing to fall today. In just the past century, life expectancy has increased by over 30 years. At the same time, mortality rates remain much higher in poor countries, with a difference in life expectancy between rich and poor countries of also about 30 years. This difference persists despite the remarkable progress in health improvement in the last half century, at least until the HIV/AIDS pandemic. In both the time-series and the cross-section data, there is a strong correlation between income per capita and mortality rates, a correlation that also exists within countries, where richer, better-educated people live longer. We review the determinants of these patterns: over history, over countries, and across groups within countries. While there is no consensus about the causal mechanisms, we tentatively identify the application of scientific advance and technical progress (some of which is induced by income and facilitated by education) as the ultimate determinant of health. Such an explanation allows a consistent interpretation of the historical, cross-country, and within-country evidence. We downplay direct causal mechanisms running from income to health.

10.3386/w11963.abstractZh: 随着时间的推移，死亡率显著下降，这一趋势始于18世纪的少数国家，并持续至今。仅在过去的一个世纪里，预期寿命增加了30多年。与此同时，贫困国家的死亡率仍然要高得多，富裕国家与贫困国家之间的预期寿命差距也约为30年。尽管在过去半个世纪中，健康状况取得了显著改善，但这种差异仍然存在，至少直到HIV/AIDS大流行之前都是如此。无论是时间序列数据还是横截面数据，人均收入与死亡率之间存在强烈的相关性，这种相关性在国家内部也存在，即收入更高、受教育程度更高的人寿命更长。我们回顾了这些模式的决定因素：从历史角度、国家层面以及国家内部的不同群体来看。虽然对于因果机制没有共识，但我们初步认为科学进步和技术进步（其中一些是由收入驱动的，而另一些则通过教育得到促进）是健康的最终决定因素。这样的解释能够一致地解释历史、跨国和国内层面的证据。我们淡化了从收入到健康的直接因果机制。

abstract.text: Estimates of labor market inequality usually focus only on wages, even though fringes account for almost one-third of total compensation. Using data from the Current Population Survey, I analyze coverage by own-employer health insurance coverage among full-time workers for women versus men, blacks versus whites and Hispanics versus whites. I find significant gaps in coverage for each of these groups. About two-thirds of the gap for blacks or Hispanics is explained by differences in observable characteristics (primarily education and occupation). The gap for women is not explained by controlling for observables. Looking over the 20 year period from 1980 to 2000, I find that the adjusted gap in own-employer coverage for women has been relatively flat over this period and is consistently much smaller than the male/female wage gap (about half as large), so that measuring inequality in wages plus health insurance would result in a smaller estimate of male/female compensation inequality than measuring wages alone. The same is generally true for blacks although their health insurance gap is much closer in magnitude to their wage gap. For Hispanics, the health insurance gap is nearly identical to the wage gap and both are increasing over time.

10.3386/w11975.abstractZh: 关于劳动力市场不平等的估计通常只关注工资水平，尽管边缘群体几乎占总薪酬的三分之一。利用当前人口调查的数据，我分析了全职女性与男性、黑人与白人以及西班牙裔与白人在自有雇主健康保险覆盖方面的差异。我发现这些群体在保险覆盖方面存在显著差距。黑人或西班牙裔的差距约有三分之二可以通过可观察到的特征（主要是教育和职业）来解释。而女性的差距则无法通过控制可观察因素来解释。在1980年至2000年的20年间，我发现女性自有雇主健康保险覆盖的差距在这一时期相对平稳，并且始终小于男女工资差距（约为后者的一半），因此，通过衡量工资加上健康保险的不平等，得到的男女薪酬不平等估计值会比单独衡量工资时更小。对于黑人来说，情况也大致相同，尽管他们的健康保险差距与工资差距的幅度更为接近。对于西班牙裔来说，健康保险差距与工资差距几乎相同，并且两者都在随时间增加。

abstract.text: There is an extensive literature on the extent to which public health insurance coverage through Medicaid induces less private health insurance coverage. However, little is known about the effect of other components of the health care safety net in crowding out private coverage. We examine the effect of Medicaid and uncompensated care provided by clinics and hospitals on insurance coverage. We construct a long panel of metropolitan area and state-level data on hospital uncompensated care and free and reduced price care offered by Federally Qualified Health Centers. We match this information to individual level data on coverage from the Current Population Survey for two distinct groups: children aged 14 and under and single, childless adults aged 18 to 64. Our results provide mixed evidence on the extent of crowd-out. Hospital uncompensated care does not appear to crowd-out health insurance coverage and health center uncompensated care appears to crowd-out private coverage for adults and, in some specifications, children.

10.3386/w11977.abstractZh: 关于公共健康保险通过医疗补助计划对私人健康保险覆盖的影响，已有大量文献研究。然而，对于医疗安全网络的其他组成部分在排挤私人保险覆盖方面的作用，目前了解甚少。我们研究了医疗补助计划以及诊所和医院提供的无补偿护理对保险覆盖的影响。我们构建了一个长期的数据面板，包含大都市区域和州级层面的医院无补偿护理数据，以及联邦合格健康中心提供的免费和低价护理数据。我们将这些信息与当前人口调查中的个人层面数据进行了匹配，针对两个不同群体：14岁及以下的儿童，以及18至64岁无子女的单身成年人。我们的研究结果对于排挤程度提供了混合性的证据。医院无补偿护理似乎并不会排挤健康保险覆盖，而健康中心无补偿护理则似乎会排挤成年人的私人保险覆盖，在某些假设下，也会排挤儿童的私人保险覆盖。

abstract.text: This paper provides a broad and general overview of the relationship between the U.S. health care system and the labor market. The paper first describes some of the salient features of and facts about the system of health insurance coverage in the U.S., particularly the role of employers. It then summarizes the empirical evidence on how health insurance impacts labor market outcomes such as wages, labor supply (including retirement, female labor supply, part-time vs. full-time work, and formal vs. informal sector work), labor demand (including hours worked and the composition of employment across full-time, part-time and temporary workers), and job turnover. It then discusses the implications of having a fragmented system of health insurance delivery--in which employers play a central role--on the health care system and health care outcomes.

10.3386/w11980.abstractZh: 本文对美国的医疗保健系统与劳动力市场之间的关系进行了广泛的概述。首先，文章描述了美国医疗保险体系的一些显著特征和事实，特别是雇主在其中的作用。接着，文章总结了关于医疗保险如何影响劳动力市场结果的实证证据，包括工资、劳动力供应（包括退休、女性劳动力供应、兼职与全职工作以及正式与非正式部门的工作）、劳动力需求（包括工作时间和全职、兼职及临时工人的就业构成）以及就业流动情况。最后，文章讨论了以雇主为中心的分化医疗保险体系对医疗保健系统和医疗结果的影响。

abstract.text: Donohue and Levitt (2001) argue that the legalization of abortion in the United States in the 1970s played an important role in explaining the observed decline in crime approximately two decades later. Foote and Goetz (2005) challenge the results presented in one of the tables in that original paper. In this reply, we regretfully acknowledge the omission of state-year interactions in the published version of that table, but show that their inclusion does not alter the qualitative results (or their statistical significance), although it does reduce the magnitude of the estimates. When one uses a more carefully constructed measure of abortion (e.g. one that takes into account cross-state mobility, or doing a better job of matching dates of birth to abortion exposure), however, the evidence in support of the abortion-crime hypothesis is as strong or stronger than suggested in our original work.

10.3386/w11987.abstractZh: Donohue和Levitt（2001）认为，20世纪70年代美国堕胎合法化政策在大约二十年后犯罪率下降现象中起到了重要作用。Foote和Goetz（2005）对这一原始论文中某张表格的结果提出了质疑。在此回应中，我们遗憾地承认该表格的出版版本中忽略了州与年份之间的交互作用，但指出即使包含这些交互作用，也不会改变定性结果（或其统计显著性），尽管这确实会减小估计值的幅度。然而，当使用更精细构建的堕胎衡量指标时（例如，考虑跨州流动情况，或更好地匹配出生日期与堕胎暴露时间），支持堕胎与犯罪关系假说的证据仍然与我们的原始研究所提出的证据一样强，甚至更强。

abstract.text: We analyze data from the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth 1979 to explore the relationships between high school completion and the two leading preventable causes of death - smoking and obesity. We focus on three issues that have received a great deal of attention in research on the pecuniary returns to schooling. First, we investigate whether GED recipients differ from other high school graduates in their smoking and obesity behaviors. Second, we explore the extent to which the relationships between schooling and these health-related behaviors are sensitive to controlling for family background measures and cognitive ability. Third, we estimate instrumental variables (IV) models of the impact of schooling on smoking and obesity. Although our IV estimates are imprecise, both the OLS and IV results tend to suggest that the returns to high school completion include a reduction in smoking. We find little evidence that high school completion is associated with a lower probability of being overweight or obese for either men or women. The results also suggest that the health returns to GED receipt are much smaller than the returns to high school completion.

10.3386/w11990.abstractZh: 我们分析了1979年青年纵向调查的数据，以探讨高中毕业与两个主要的可预防死亡原因——吸烟和肥胖之间的关系。我们重点关注了在关于教育经济回报的研究中备受关注的三个问题。首先，我们调查了获得普通教育文凭的人与其他高中毕业生在吸烟和肥胖行为上的差异。其次，我们探讨了在控制家庭背景和认知能力因素后，教育程度与这些健康相关行为之间的关系。第三，我们建立了工具变量模型，以估计教育程度对吸烟和肥胖的影响。尽管我们的工具变量估计结果不够精确，但OLS估计和工具变量估计都表明，高中毕业所带来的回报包括减少吸烟行为。我们发现，高中毕业与男性或女性超重或肥胖的概率降低之间几乎没有关联。结果还表明，获得普通教育文凭所带来的健康回报远低于高中毕业所带来的回报。

abstract.text: We use administrative data on a sample of births between 1978 and 1985 to investigate the short, medium and long-term consequences of poor infant health. Our findings offer several advances to the existing literature on the effects of early infant health on subsequent health, education, and labor force attachment. First, we use a large sample of both siblings and twins, second we use a variety of measures of infant health, and finally we track children through their schooling years and into the labor force. Our findings suggest that poor infant health is a strong predictor of educational and labor force outcomes. In particular, infant health is found to predict both high school completion and social assistance (welfare) take-up and length.

10.3386/w11998.abstractZh: 我们利用1978年至1985年间出生的样本数据，研究婴儿健康状况不佳对短期、中期和长期影响的后果。我们的研究结果对现有文献中关于婴儿早期健康状况对其后续健康、教育以及劳动力参与的影响提供了一些新的见解。首先，我们采用了大量兄弟姐妹和双胞胎的样本；其次，我们使用了多种婴儿健康指标；最后，我们追踪了儿童在求学阶段及进入劳动力市场的经历。我们的研究结果表明，婴儿健康状况不佳是教育和劳动力成果的重要预测因素。具体而言，婴儿健康状况能够预测高中毕业率、社会援助的接受程度以及持续时间。

abstract.text: In this paper we investigate how direct-to-consumer (DTC) advertising of pharmaceutical products in affected by regulations of the Food and Drug Administration and by market conditions. We focus on a relatively under-studied segment of the pharmaceutical market -- the market for smoking cessation products. Because of their proven effectiveness, these products could be the key to meeting public health goals to reduce smoking. However, in many ways, smoking cessation products have been more heavily regulated than cigarettes. Our empirical analysis uses data on advertising expenditures and data from an archive of print advertisements. The archive includes all smoking cessation product advertisements that appeared in over 13,000 issues of 28 magazines between January 1985 and May 2002. Our study period begins shortly atfer the first nicotine replacement product was introduced, and covers the evolution of the market as new products are introduced while some of the older products move from prescription to over-the-counter (OTC) status. OTC status eases the disclosure requirements imposed on advertisements of prescription pharmaceuticals, substantially reducing the costs of a print advertisement. Our results suggest that OTC status is associated with an increase in advertising expenditures and the number and pages of magazine advertisements. A current proposal to reduce disclosure requirements on all DTC advertisements of prescription drugs could have similar effects. Our results also suggest that advertising increase with the introduction of new products and with market competition.

10.3386/w12001.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们研究了直接面向消费者（DTC）的药品广告如何受到美国食品药品监督管理局的法规和市场条件的影响。我们重点关注药品市场中一个相对研究较少的细分领域——戒烟产品市场。由于这些产品已被证明具有有效性，它们可能是实现减少吸烟这一公共卫生目标的关键。然而，在许多方面，戒烟产品的监管比香烟更为严格。我们的实证分析使用了广告支出数据以及一份印刷广告档案中的数据。该档案包含了1985年1月至2002年5月期间，28种杂志中超过13,000期出现的所有戒烟产品广告。我们的研究时间始于第一种尼古丁替代产品问世之后，并涵盖了随着新产品推出以及部分旧产品从处方药转为非处方药状态而发生的市场演变。非处方状态降低了处方药广告的披露要求，从而大幅降低了印刷广告的成本。我们的研究结果表明，非处方状态与广告支出的增加以及杂志广告的数量和篇幅有关。目前提出的减少所有处方药DTC广告披露要求的提议可能会产生类似的效果。我们的研究还表明，广告数量会随着新产品的推出以及市场竞争的加剧而增加。

abstract.text: We examine the extent to which infant health production functions are sensitive to model specification and measurement error. We focus on the importance of typically unobserved but theoretically important variables (TUVs), other non-standard covariates (NSCs), input reporting, and characterization of infant health. The TUVs represent wantedness, taste for risky behavior, and maternal health endowment. The NSCs include father and family structure characteristics. We estimate effects of prenatal drug use, prenatal cigarette smoking, and first trimester prenatal care on birth weight, low birth weight, and a measure of abnormal infant health conditions. We compare estimates using self-reported inputs versus input measures that combine information from medical records and self-reports. We find that TUVs and NSCs are significantly associated with both inputs and outcomes, but that excluding them from infant health production functions does not appreciably affect the input estimates. However, using self-reported inputs leads to overestimated effects of inputs, particularly prenatal care, on outcomes, and using a direct measure of infant health does not always yield input estimates similar to those when using birth weight outcomes. The findings have implications for research, data collection, and public health policy.

10.3386/w12004.abstractZh: 我们研究了婴儿健康生产函数对模型设定和测量误差的敏感性。我们重点关注那些通常未被观察到但在理论上具有重要意义的变量（TUVs）、其他非标准协变量（NSCs）、输入数据的报告方式以及婴儿健康的特征描述。TUVs包括需求、对风险行为的偏好以及母亲的健康状况。NSCs则包括父亲和家庭结构特征。我们估计了产前药物使用、产前吸烟以及孕早期产前护理对出生体重、低出生体重以及婴儿健康异常状况的影响。我们比较了使用自我报告的数据与结合医疗记录和自我报告的数据得出的估计结果。我们发现，TUVs和NSCs与输入数据和结果都有显著关联，但将它们排除在婴儿健康生产函数之外并不会显著影响输入数据的估计结果。然而，使用自我报告的数据会导致对输入数据（尤其是产前护理）的影响估计过高，而使用直接的婴儿健康指标并不总是能得到与使用出生体重指标相似的输入数据估计结果。这些发现对研究、数据收集以及公共卫生政策具有启示意义。

abstract.text: We analyze some of the perverse incentives that may arise under the current Medicare prescription drug benefit design. In particular, risk adjustment for a stand-alone prescription drug benefit creates perverse incentives for prescription drug plans' coverage decisions and/or pharmaceutical companies' pricing decisions. This problem is new in that it does not arise with risk adjustment for other types of health care coverage. For this and other reasons, Medicare's drug benefit requires especially close regulatory oversight, now and in the future. We also consider a relatively minor change in how the benefit is financed that could lead to significant changes in how it functions. In particular, if all plans were required to charge the same premium, there would be less diversity in quality but also less budgetary uncertainty and less upward pressure on drug prices.

10.3386/w12008.abstractZh: 我们分析了当前Medicare处方药福利设计下可能出现的一些反常激励因素。特别是，独立处方药福利的风险调整机制，会为处方药计划的覆盖决策和制药公司的定价决策带来反常的激励。这个问题之所以新颖，是因为其他类型的医疗保健覆盖机制中不会出现类似的问题。基于这些原因，Medicare的药品福利需要特别严格的监管，无论是现在还是将来。我们还考虑到了一种对福利融资方式相对较小的改变，这种改变可能会导致福利功能的重大变化。具体来说，如果所有计划都被要求收取相同的保费，那么质量上的多样性将会减少，预算的不确定性也会降低，药品价格的上涨压力也会减弱。

abstract.text: Given the rapid growth in health care spending that is often attributed to technological change, many private and public institutions are grappling with how to best assess and adopt new health care technologies. The leading technology adoption criteria proposed in theory and used in practice involve so called "cost-effectiveness" measures. However, little is known about the dynamic efficiency implications of such criteria, in particular how they influence the R&D investments that make technologies available in the first place. We argue that such criteria implicitly concern maximizing consumer surplus, which many times is consistent with maximizing static efficiency after an innovation has been developed. Dynamic efficiency, however, concerns aligning the social costs and benefits of R&D and is therefore determined by how much of the social surplus from the new technology is appropriated as producer surplus. We analyze the relationship between cost-effectiveness measures and the degree of surplus appropriation by innovators driving dynamic efficiency. We illustrate how to estimate the two for the new HIV/AIDS therapies that entered the market after the late 1980's and find that only 5% of the social surplus is appropriated by innovators. We show how this finding can be generalized to other existing cost-effectiveness estimates by deriving how those estimates identify innovator appropriation for a set of studies of over 200 drugs. We find that these studies implicitly support a low degree of appropriation as well. Despite the high annual cost of drugs to patients, very low shares of social surplus may go to innovators, which may imply that cost-effectiveness is too high in a dynamic efficiency sense.

10.3386/w12016.abstractZh: 鉴于医疗保健支出的快速增长，这一增长通常归因于技术变革，许多私营和公共机构都在努力评估并采用新的医疗保健技术。理论上提出的、并在实践中使用的领先技术采纳标准涉及所谓的“成本效益”指标。然而，关于这些标准对动态效率的影响知之甚少，特别是它们如何影响使技术得以普及的研发投资。我们认为，这些标准隐含着最大化消费者剩余，而这在许多情况下与在创新开发后最大化静态效率是一致的。然而，动态效率关注的是将研发的社会成本与收益进行协调，因此取决于新技术带来的社会剩余中有多少被作为生产者剩余分配。我们分析了成本效益指标与创新者对剩余分配程度之间的关系，以评估动态效率。我们举例说明了如何估算1980年代末之后进入市场的新型HIV/AIDS疗法的成本效益指标，发现只有5%的社会剩余被创新者所获取。我们还展示了如何通过推导200多种药物研究中的创新者剩余分配情况，将这一发现推广到其他现有的成本效益估计。我们发现，这些研究也隐含着较低的剩余分配程度。尽管药物对患者每年的成本很高，但分配给创新者的社会剩余比例却非常低，这可能意味着从动态效率的角度来看，成本效益指标过高。

abstract.text: Using data from three waves of Add Health we find that being very attractive reduces a young adult's (ages 18-26) propensity for criminal activity and being unattractive increases it for a number of crimes, ranging from burglary to selling drugs. A variety of tests demonstrate that this result is not because beauty is acting as a proxy for socio-economic status. Being very attractive is also positively associated adult vocabulary test scores, which suggests the possibility that beauty may have an impact on human capital formation. We demonstrate that, especially for females, holding constant current beauty, high school beauty (pre-labor market beauty) has a separate impact on crime, and that high school beauty is correlated with variables that gauge various aspects of high school experience, such as GPA, suspension or having being expelled from school, and problems with teachers. These results suggest two handicaps faced by unattractive individuals. First, a labor market penalty provides a direct incentive for unattractive individuals toward criminal activity. Second, the level of beauty in high school has an effect on criminal propensity 7-8 years later, which seems to be due to the impact of the level of beauty in high school on human capital formation, although this second avenue seems to be effective for females only.

10.3386/w12019.abstractZh: 通过Add Health项目的三次数据调查我们发现，非常具有吸引力会降低年轻成年人（18-26岁）从事犯罪活动的倾向，而不具有吸引力则会增加多种犯罪行为的倾向，包括入室盗窃和贩卖毒品等。多项测试表明，这一结果并非因为美貌可以替代社会经济地位。此外，非常具有吸引力还与成年词汇测试成绩呈正相关，这表明美貌可能对人力资本的形成产生影响。研究还发现，对于女性而言，在保持当前美貌不变的情况下，高中时期的美貌（劳动市场前的美貌）对犯罪倾向有独立的影响，而高中时期的美貌与多个高中经历相关的变量存在关联，如平均绩点、是否被停学或开除，以及与教师的关系等问题。这些结果表明，不具吸引力的个体面临两个障碍：首先，劳动市场的劣势直接促使不具吸引力的个体倾向于从事犯罪活动；其次，高中时期的美貌水平在7-8年后对犯罪倾向产生影响，这似乎是由于高中时期的美貌水平对人力资本形成的影响，不过这一机制似乎仅对女性有效。

abstract.text: We present PublicationHarvester, an open-source software tool for gathering publication information on individual life scientists. The software interfaces with MEDLINE, and allows the end-user to specify up to four MEDLINE-formatted names for each researcher. Using these names along with a user-specified search query, PublicationHarvester generates yearly publication counts, optionally weighted by Journal Impact Factors. These counts are further broken-down by order on the authorship list (first, last, second, next-to-last, middle) and by publication type (clinical trials, regular journal articles, reviews, letters/editorials, etc.) The software also generates a keywords report at the scientist-year level, using the Medical Subject Headings (MeSH) assigned by the National Library of Medicine to each publication indexed by Medline. The software, source code, and user manual can be downloaded at http://www.stellman-greene.com/PublicationHarvester/

10.3386/w12039.abstractZh: 我们介绍了PublicationHarvester，这是一个开源软件工具，用于收集单个生命科学家的出版物信息。该软件与MEDLINE接口，允许最终用户为每位研究人员指定最多四个符合MEDLINE格式的姓名。利用这些姓名以及用户指定的搜索查询，PublicationHarvester能够生成每年的出版物数量统计，并可选地进行按期刊影响因子加权处理。这些统计数据还按作者顺序（首位、末位、第二、倒数第二、中间）和出版物类型（临床试验、常规期刊文章、综述、信件/评论等）进一步细分。该软件还能生成以科学家-年份为单位的关键词报告，使用美国国家医学图书馆为每个在MEDLINE中索引的出版物分配的医学主题词。该软件、源代码和用户手册可访问http://www.stellman-greene.com/PublicationHarvester/下载。

abstract.text: There is a pronounced gradient in disability across socioeconomic groups, with better educated and higher income groups reporting substantially less disability. In this paper, we consider why that is the case, focusing on impairments in basic physical and cognitive aspects of living for the elderly. Our empirical work has two parts. First, we consider how much of this gradient in disability is a result of underlying differences in functioning versus the ability to cope with impairments. We show differences in functioning are the major part of the difference in disability, but both are important. Second, we consider how the better educated elderly cope with disability. Better educated people use substantially more assistive technology than the less educated and are more likely to use paid help. But use of these services is not the primary reason that the better educated are better able to cope. We conclude with thoughts about other potential factors that may explain differential coping.

10.3386/w12040.abstractZh: 不同社会经济群体之间的残疾状况存在明显的差异，受教育程度较高且收入较高的群体报告的残疾情况明显较少。在本文中，我们探讨了这一现象的原因，重点关注老年人基本身体和认知方面的障碍。我们的实证研究分为两部分。首先，我们探讨了这种残疾差异中，功能性差异与应对障碍能力的差异分别占多大比例。我们发现，功能性差异是残疾差异的主要部分，但两者都很重要。其次，我们探讨了受教育程度较高的老年人如何应对残疾问题。受教育程度较高的人使用的辅助技术明显多于受教育程度较低的群体，并且更有可能寻求有偿帮助。然而，使用这些服务并不是受教育程度较高的人能够更好地应对残疾问题的主要原因。最后，我们提出了其他可能解释这种差异的因素。

abstract.text: In August, September and October of 2005, the Monthly Surveys of Consumers fielded by the University of Michigan included questions about the happiness of a nationally representative sample of U.S. adults. The date of each interview is known. Looking at the data week by week, reported happiness dipped significantly in the first week of September, after the seriousness of the damage done by Katrina became clear. The impulse response of happiness is especially strong in the South Central region, closest to the devastation of Katrina. The dip in happiness lasted two or three weeks in the South Central region; in the rest of the country, reported happiness returned to normal after one or two weeks. In addition to the reaction to Katrina, happiness dipped significantly after the October 2005 earthquake in Pakistan. These results illustrate the potential of high-frequency happiness data to yield information about preferences over regional, national and international conditions by indicating the magnitude of the good or bad news conveyed by events.

10.3386/w12062.abstractZh: 在2005年8月、9月和10月，密歇根大学进行的月度消费者调查包含了关于美国全国代表性成年人群体幸福感的问题。每次访谈的日期都是已知的。逐周观察数据发现，在9月的第一周，随着卡特里娜飓风造成的破坏影响变得明显，人们的幸福感显著下降。在最接近卡特里娜飓风受灾地区的南中部地区，幸福感的反应尤为强烈。南中部地区的幸福感下降持续了两到三周；而在国家的其他地区，报告的幸福感在一到两周后便恢复正常。除了对卡特里娜飓风的反应外，2005年10月巴基斯坦地震后，人们的幸福感也显著下降。这些结果表明，高频幸福感数据具有潜力，可以通过反映事件带来的好消息或坏消息的严重程度，来揭示人们对地区、国家乃至国际状况的偏好。

abstract.text: This paper studies the interactions between health insurance and the incentives for innovation. Although we focus on pharmaceutical innovation, our discussion applies to other industries producing novel technologies for sale in markets with subsidized demand. Standard results in the growth and productivity literatures suggest that firms in many industries may possess inadequate incentives to innovate. Standard results in the health literature suggest that health insurance leads to the overutilization of health care. Our study of innovation in the pharmaceutical industry emphasizes the interaction of these incentives. Because of the large subsidies to demand from health insurance, limits on the lifetime of patents and possibly limits on monopoly pricing may be necessary to ensure that pharmaceutical companies do not possess excess incentives for innovation.

10.3386/w12080.abstractZh: 本文研究了健康保险与创新激励之间的相互作用。虽然我们关注的是制药行业的创新，但我们的讨论同样适用于其他在需求被补贴的市场中生产新型技术的行业。关于增长和生产力研究的标准结果表明，许多行业的企业可能缺乏足够的创新激励。健康领域的标准研究则表明，健康保险会导致医疗服务的过度使用。我们对制药行业创新的研究重点在于这些激励因素之间的相互作用。由于健康保险对需求的巨大补贴，可能需要限制专利的寿命，甚至限制垄断定价，以确保制药公司不会拥有过多的创新激励。

abstract.text: Estimating the value of medical innovation is a continual challenge. In this research, we quantify the impact of antihypertensive therapy on U.S. blood pressures, risk and number of heart attacks, strokes, and deaths. We also consider the potential for further improvements. We estimate the value of innovation using equations relating blood pressure to adverse outcomes from the Framingham Heart Study. Our results show that without antihypertensive therapy, 1999-2000 average blood pressure for the U.S. population age 40 plus would have been 10-13 percent higher. 86,000 excess premature deaths from cardiovascular disease (2001), and 833,000 hospital discharges for stroke and heart attacks (2002) would have occurred. Life expectancy would be 0.5 (men) and 0.4 (women) years lower. At guideline care, there would have been 89,000 fewer premature deaths (2001) and 420,000 fewer hospital discharges for stroke and heart attack (2002) than observed. Our analysis suggests that antihypertensive therapy has had a significant impact on cardiovascular health outcomes but that mortality gains would have been approximately twice as high if guideline care had been achieved for all.

10.3386/w12096.abstractZh: 估算医疗创新的价值一直是一个持续的挑战。在这项研究中，我们量化了抗高血压疗法对美国血压、心脏病发作风险及数量、中风和死亡人数的影响。我们还考虑了进一步改进的潜力。我们通过将血压与弗雷明汉心脏研究中的不良结果相关联的方程来估算创新的价值。我们的结果显示，如果没有抗高血压疗法，1999-2000年间40岁以上美国人口的平均血压将高出10-13%。这将导致86,000例因心血管疾病而过早死亡（2001年），以及833,000例因中风和心脏病发作而住院的情况（2002年）。预期寿命将分别降低0.5年（男性）和0.4年（女性）。如果遵循指南进行护理，过早死亡的数量将减少89,000例（2001年），中风和心脏病发作的住院人数将减少420,000例（2002年）。我们的分析表明，抗高血压疗法对心血管健康结果产生了显著的影响，但如果所有人都遵循指南进行护理，死亡率的改善幅度将大约是现在的两倍。

abstract.text: Panel data econometric methods are used to investigate how the risk of death from acute myocardial infarction (AMI) varies with macroeconomic conditions after controlling for demographic factors, fixed state characteristics, general time effects and state-specific time trends. The sample includes residents of the 20 largest states over the 1979 to 1998 period. A one percentage point reduction in unemployment is predicted to raise AMI mortality by 1.3 percent, with a larger increase in relative risk for 20-44 year olds than older adults, particularly if the economic upturn is sustained. Nevertheless, the much higher absolute AMI fatality rate of senior citizens implies that they account for most of the additional deaths. This suggests the importance of factors like air pollution and traffic congestion that increase with economic activity, are linked to coronary heart disease and may have particularly strong effects on vulnerable segments of the population, such as the frail elderly. AMI mortality risk quickly rises when the economy strengthens and increases further if the favorable economic conditions persist. This is consistent with strong effects of other short-term factors on heart attack risk and with health being a durable capital stock that is affected by flows of lifestyle behaviors and environmental conditions whose effects accumulate over time.

10.3386/w12102.abstractZh: 本研究采用面板数据计量经济学方法，在控制人口因素、固定状态特征、一般时间效应和特定状态时间趋势后，探讨急性心肌梗死（AMI）死亡风险如何随宏观经济状况变化。样本涵盖了1979至1998年期间20个最大州的居民。研究发现，失业率每降低一个百分点，AMI死亡率将增加1.3%。对于20-44岁的年轻人来说，相对风险的增加更为显著，尤其是在经济好转持续的情况下。然而，老年人较高的AMI死亡率表明，他们承担了大部分额外死亡负担。这提示我们，像空气污染和交通拥堵这样的因素随着经济活动的增加而增加，与冠心病有关，并且可能对脆弱人群，如体弱老年人，产生特别强烈的影响。当经济状况改善时，AMI死亡风险迅速上升，如果经济条件持续良好，这一风险还会进一步增加。这与其他短期因素对心脏病发作风险的强烈影响相一致，同时也表明健康是一种持久的资产，其受到生活方式行为和环境条件的影响，这些影响会随时间累积。

abstract.text: Of the ten million uninsured children in 1996, nearly half were eligible for Medicaid, the public health insurance program for poor families, but not enrolled. In response, policy efforts to improve coverage have shifted to increasing Medicaid take-up among those already eligible rather than expanding eligibility. However, little is known about the reasons poor families fail to use public programs or the consequences of failing to enroll. The latter is of particular relevance to Medicaid given that children are typically enrolled when they become sufficiently sick as to require hospitalization. Using new data on Medicaid outreach, enrollment and child hospitalizations in California, I find that information and administrative costs are important barriers to program enrollment, with the latter particularly true for Hispanic and Asian families. In addition, enrolling children in Medicaid before they get sick promotes the use of preventative care, reduces the need for hospitalization and improves health.

10.3386/w12105.abstractZh: 在1996年，有千万名未投保的儿童，其中近一半有资格享受为贫困家庭提供的公共健康保险计划——Medicaid，但他们并未注册。为此，政策努力转向提高已有资格人群对Medicaid的注册率，而非扩大资格范围。然而，关于贫困家庭为何不使用公共计划以及未注册所带来的后果，我们知之甚少。对于Medicaid而言，后者尤为重要，因为儿童通常在病情严重到需要住院治疗时才会被注册。利用加州关于Medicaid推广、注册和儿童住院的新数据，我发现信息和行政成本是阻碍项目注册的重要障碍，尤其是针对西班牙裔和亚裔家庭而言。此外，在儿童生病之前就将其注册为Medicaid用户，有助于促进预防性护理的使用，减少住院需求，并改善健康状况。

abstract.text: This paper explores how early life exposure to poverty and want adversely affects later life health outcomes. In particular, it examines how exposure to crowded housing conditions and impure drinking water undermines long-term health prospects and increases the risk of age-related pathologies such as cancer, heart disease, kidney disease, and stroke. Exploiting city-level data from early-twentieth century America, evidence is presented that cities with unusually high rates of typhoid fever in 1900 had elevated rates of heart and kidney disease fifteen years later; also cities with unusually high rates of tuberculosis in 1900 had elevated rates of cancer and stroke fifteen years later. The estimated coefficients suggest that eradicating typhoid fever (through water purification) and tuberculosis (through improved housing and nutrition) would have reduced later death rates from heart disease, cancer, stroke, and kidney disease by 23 to 35 percent.

10.3386/w12111.abstractZh: 本文探讨了早期生活中遭遇贫困和匮乏对后期健康结果的影响。具体而言，文章研究了拥挤的居住环境和不纯净的饮用水如何破坏长期健康前景，并增加患癌症、心脏病、肾脏疾病和中风等老年疾病的风险。通过利用20世纪初美国的城市级数据，研究发现：在1900年伤寒发病率异常高的城市，15年后心脏病和肾脏疾病的发病率也较高；而在1900年结核病发病率异常高的城市，15年后癌症和中风的发病率也较高。估计的系数表明，通过净化水源和改善住房及营养条件来消除伤寒和结核病，可以将心脏病、癌症、中风和肾脏疾病导致的死亡率降低23%至35%。

abstract.text: In this study, we examined the association between girls' participation in high school sports and the physical activity, weight, body mass and body composition of adolescent females during the 1970s when girls' sports participation was dramatically increasing as a result of Title IX. We found that increases in girls' participation in high school sports, a proxy for expanded athletic opportunities for adolescent females, were associated with an increase in physical activity and an improvement in weight and body mass among girls. In contrast, adolescent boys experienced a decline in physical activity and an increase in weight and body mass during the period when girls' athletic opportunities were expanding. Taken together, these results strongly suggest that Title IX and the increase in athletic opportunities among adolescent females it engendered had a beneficial effect on the health of adolescent girls.

10.3386/w12113.abstractZh: 在本研究中，我们探讨了20世纪70年代女孩参与高中体育活动与青少年女性身体活动、体重、体质指数及身体成分之间的关联。当时，由于《第九条修正案》的实施，女孩的体育参与率显著上升。研究发现，女孩参与高中体育活动的增加，作为青少年女性体育机会扩大的标志，与身体活动的增加以及体重和体质指数的改善有关。相反，在女孩体育机会扩大的时期，男孩的身体活动量却有所下降，体重和体质指数也有所增加。综合这些结果可以看出，《第九条修正案》以及由此带来的青少年女性体育机会的扩大，对女孩的健康产生了积极影响。

abstract.text: This study examines the effect of the introduction of new laboratory procedures and other medical goods and services on the health of Americans during the period 1990-2003. We hypothesize that, the more medical innovation there is related to a medical condition, the greater the improvement in the average health of people with that condition. To test this hypothesis, we estimate models of health outcomes using longitudinal disease-level data. We measure innovation in five types of medical procedures or products: pathology & laboratory procedures, outpatient prescription drugs, inpatient prescription drugs, surgical procedures, and diagnostic radiology procedures. We examine two kinds of (inverse) indicators of health: mortality and disability. The mortality indicator we analyze is the mean age at death of people whose underlying cause of death is medical condition i. The disability measures we analyze are the fraction of people with medical condition i who (1) missed work, or (2) spent one or more days in bed, due to that condition. Our estimates indicate that conditions with higher rates of lab and outpatient drug innovation had larger increases in mean age at death, controlling for other medical innovation rates and initial mean age at death. The 1990-1998 increase in mean age at death attributable to use of new lab procedures is estimated to be about 6 months. This is 42% of the total increase in mean age at death (1.18 years) in our sample of diseases. New laboratory procedures introduced during 1990-1998 are estimated to have saved 1.13 million life-years in 1998. Expenditure per life-year gained from new lab procedures is estimated to be $6093. Treatments that cost this amount are generally considered to be quite cost-effective. In the analysis of disability, when we don't control for the initial level of disability, we find that conditions with higher rates of lab and outpatient innovation had greater declines in the probability of missing work during 1996-2003. This suggests that the use of new laboratory procedures reduced the number of work-loss days in 2003 by 42 million. When we control for initial disability, the inverse relationship between lab innovation and disability changes disappears. This is because there is a significant inverse relationship between initial health and the extent of laboratory innovation. But due to errors in measuring initial health, controlling for this variable may cause the impact of innovation on health to be underestimated.

10.3386/w12120.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了1990至2003年间，新的实验室程序及其他医疗产品和服务引入对美国人健康的影响。我们假设，与某种医疗状况相关的医疗创新越多，该状况患者的平均健康状况改善幅度就越大。为了验证这一假设，我们使用纵向疾病数据来估算健康结果的模型。我们测量了五种类型的医疗程序或产品的创新：病理与实验室程序、门诊处方药、住院处方药、外科手术以及诊断放射学程序。我们同时考察了两种健康指标：死亡率和残疾率。我们分析的死亡率指标是那些以医疗状况为死因的人的平均死亡年龄。我们分析的残疾率指标则是患有某种医疗状况的人中，因该状况而（1）缺勤或（2）卧床超过一天的比例。我们的估算结果显示，在控制其他医疗创新率和初始平均死亡年龄的情况下，实验室和门诊药物创新率较高的状况，其平均死亡年龄的增长幅度更大。1990至1998年间，由于使用新的实验室程序导致的平均死亡年龄增长约为6个月，这占我们样本中所有疾病平均死亡年龄增长（1.18年）的42%。在1990至1998年间引入的新实验室程序，估计在1998年挽救了113万人的生命年。从新实验室程序中获得的生命年所带来的成本估计为6093美元。这种成本的治疗通常被认为是非常具有成本效益的。在残疾分析中，如果我们不控制残疾的初始水平，会发现实验室和门诊创新程度较高的地区，在1996-2003年间缺勤概率的下降幅度更大。这表明，使用新的实验室程序使得2003年的工作损失天数减少了4200万天。当控制初始残疾水平后，实验室创新与残疾变化之间的反向关系消失了。这是因为初始健康状况与实验室创新程度之间存在显著的负相关关系。但由于测量初始健康状况存在误差，控制这一变量可能会导致对创新对健康影响的认识被低估。

abstract.text: While numerous studies have examined how health affects retirement behavior, few have analyzed the impact of retirement on subsequent health outcomes. This study estimates the effects of retirement on health status as measured by indicators of physical and functional limitations, illness conditions, and depression. The empirics are based on seven longitudinal waves of the Health and Retirement Study, spanning 1992 through 2005. To account for biases due to unobserved selection and endogeneity, panel data methodologies are used. These are augmented by counterfactual and specification checks to gauge the robustness and plausibility of the estimates. Results indicate that complete retirement leads to a 5-16 percent increase in difficulties associated with mobility and daily activities, a 5-6 percent increase in illness conditions, and 6-9 percent decline in mental health, over an average post-retirement period of six years. Models indicate that the effects tend to operate through lifestyle changes including declines in physical activity and social interactions. The adverse health effects are mitigated if the individual is married and has social support, continues to engage in physical activity post-retirement, or continues to work part-time upon retirement. Some evidence also suggests that the adverse effects of retirement on health may be larger in the event of involuntary retirement. With an aging population choosing to retire at earlier ages, both Social Security and Medicare face considerable shortfalls. Eliminating the embedded incentives in public and private pension plans, which discourage work beyond some point, and enacting policies that prolong the retirement age may be desirable, ceteris paribus. Retiring at a later age may lessen or postpone poor health outcomes for older adults, raise well-being, and reduce the utilization of health care services, particularly acute care.

10.3386/w12123.abstractZh: 虽然许多研究探讨了健康对退休行为的影响，但很少有研究分析退休对后续健康结果的影响。本研究通过身体和功能限制、疾病状况以及抑郁等指标，估算了退休对健康状况的影响。研究基于《健康与退休研究》的七次纵向调查数据，时间跨度从1992年到2005年。为了消除因未观测选择和内生性导致的偏差，采用了面板数据方法。此外，还通过反事实分析和规范检验来评估估计结果的稳健性和合理性。研究结果表明，完全退休会导致与移动性和日常活动相关的困难增加5-16%，疾病状况增加5-6%，心理健康下降6-9%，平均退休后持续时间为六年。模型显示，这些影响主要通过生活方式的改变来体现，包括体力活动和社交互动的减少。如果个体已婚并有社会支持，继续从事体力活动或在退休后继续从事兼职工作，这些负面健康影响可以得到缓解。一些证据表明，非自愿退休可能对健康的负面影响更大。随着人口老龄化，人们选择更早退休，社会保障和医疗保险都面临着相当大的挑战。消除公共和私人养老金计划中的内在激励因素，这些激励因素会阻碍人们继续工作，并制定延长退休年龄的政策可能是必要的。在较晚的年龄退休可能会减少或推迟老年人的不良健康结果，提高他们的幸福感，并降低对医疗服务的需求，尤其是急性医疗服务的需求。

abstract.text: While Americans are less healthy than Europeans along some dimensions (like obesity), Americans are significantly less likely to smoke than their European counterparts. This difference emerged in the 1970s and it is biggest among the most educated. The puzzle becomes larger once we account for cigarette prices and anti-smoking regulations, which are both higher in Europe. There is a nonmonotonic relationship between smoking and income; among richer countries and people, higher incomes are associated with less smoking. This can account for about one-fifth of the U.S./Europe difference. Almost one-half of the smoking difference appears to be the result of differences in beliefs about the health effects of smoking; Europeans are generally less likely to think that cigarette smoking is harmful.

10.3386/w12124.abstractZh: 虽然美国在某些方面（如肥胖问题）的健康状况不如欧洲人，但美国人吸烟的可能性明显低于欧洲人。这种差异在20世纪70年代就已经出现，并且在受教育程度较高的人群中最为明显。如果我们考虑到欧洲更高的香烟价格和禁烟法规，这一差异变得更加复杂。吸烟与收入之间存在着非单调关系；在富裕国家和人群中，较高的收入与较少的吸烟行为相关。这可以解释美国与欧洲之间约五分之一的差异。几乎一半的吸烟差异似乎是由于人们对吸烟健康影响的看法不同造成的；欧洲人通常认为吸烟并不有害。

abstract.text: Despite the conceptual differences between for-profit and non-profit firms stressed in conventional economic analyses of the non-profit sector, U.S. antitrust law generally does not distinguish between these two organizational forms. This paper argues that the same incentives to restrain trade exist in the non-profit sector as in the for-profit sector. Altruistic firms benefit from exploiting market power, just as non-altruistic ones do, even when they would price below cost without regard to competition. Therefore, promoting competition is socially valuable regardless of the particular objectives of producers, and the fact that antitrust law does not distinguish between the two sectors is efficient.

10.3386/w12132.abstractZh: 尽管传统经济分析强调营利性企业与非营利性企业之间的概念差异，但美国反垄断法通常并不区分这两种组织形式。本文认为，非营利部门与营利部门一样，都存在抑制竞争的激励。无论是利他性企业还是非利他性企业，都能从利用市场力量中获益，即使它们可以在不考虑竞争的情况下以低于成本的价格定价。因此，无论生产者的具体目标如何，促进竞争都具有社会价值，而反垄断法不区分这两个部门的事实也是高效的。

abstract.text: The goal of this paper is to analyze consumer demand in markets with large price uncertainty. We develop a demand model for goods that are subject to habit formation. We show that consumption plans of forward looking individuals depend not only on preferences and current period prices, but also on individual beliefs about the evolution of future prices. Moreover, a mean preserving spread in the price distribution and, hence, an increase in price uncertainty reduces consumption along the optimal path. With smoking as our application, we test the predictions of our model. We use a unique data set of prices for cigarettes collected by the Bureau of Labor Statistics to characterize price uncertainty and price expectations of individuals. We have also obtained access to the restricted use version of the National Education Longitudinal Study, which provides detailed information on smoking behavior of teenagers in the U.S. Our estimation results suggest that teenagers who live in metropolitan areas with a large amount of cigarette price volatility have, on average, significantly lower levels of cigarette consumption. Moreover, these individuals are less likely to start consuming cigarettes. Our results also provide evidence that young individuals are forward looking. Myopic individuals would not respond to an increase in uncertainty about future prices by reducing consumption.

10.3386/w12156.abstractZh: 本文旨在分析价格不确定性较大的市场中的消费者需求。我们为受习惯形成影响的商品开发了一个需求模型。研究表明，具有前瞻性思维的个体的消费计划不仅取决于偏好和当前时期的价格，还取决于他们对未来价格走势的个人预期。此外，价格分布的均值保持差异，即价格不确定性的增加，会沿着最优路径降低消费。以吸烟为例，我们验证了模型中的预测结果。我们使用了劳工统计局收集的独特香烟价格数据集来表征价格不确定性和个体价格预期。我们还获得了《国家教育纵向研究》的受限使用版本的数据，该数据提供了美国青少年吸烟行为的详细信息。我们的估计结果表明，生活在香烟价格波动较大的都市地区的青少年，其香烟消费水平普遍较低。此外，这些个体开始吸烟的可能性也较低。我们的研究结果还表明，年轻个体具有前瞻性思维。目光短浅的个体不会因未来价格不确定性的增加而减少消费。

abstract.text: Using country- and region-level data, I investigate the effect of HIV/AIDS on fertility in Africa during 1985-2000. Results differ depending on the variation used and the estimation method. Between estimates that exploit cross-sectional variation suggest a positive significant effect of HIV/AIDS on fertility, whereas within estimates that are identified of off time-series variation show both positive and negative results depending on the HIV/AIDS variable used. These within estimates are insignificant in most of the specifications.

10.3386/w12181.abstractZh: 利用国家和地区层面的数据，我研究了1985年至2000年间HIV/AIDS对非洲生育率的影响。研究结果因所使用的变量和估计方法而异。在利用横截面数据的估计中，HIV/AIDS对生育率有显著的积极影响；而在处理时间序列变异的估计中，结果则取决于所使用的HIV/AIDS变量，既有积极的影响，也有消极的影响。在大多数情况下，这些内部估计结果并不显著。

abstract.text: There is little empirical evidence to explain why disability declined among the elderly over the past 20 years. In this paper, we explore the role of improved medical care for cardiovascular disease on health status improvements over time. We show that the incidence of cardiovascular disease hospitalizations remained relatively constant between 1984 and 1999 at the same time that post-event survival improved and disability declined. We find that use of appropriate therapies, including pharmaceuticals such as beta-blockers, aspirin, and ace-inhibitors, and invasive procedures, explains up to 50% and 70% of the reductions in disability and death over time, respectively. Elderly patients living in regions with high use of appropriate medical therapies had better health outcomes than patients living in low-use areas. Finally, we estimate that preventing disability after an acute event can add as much as 3.7 years of quality-adjusted life expectancy, or $316,000 of value.

10.3386/w12184.abstractZh: 目前，几乎没有实证证据可以解释过去20年间老年人中残疾率下降的原因。在本文中，我们探讨了心血管疾病医疗护理改善对健康状况随时间改善的作用。我们发现，在1984年至1999年期间，心血管疾病的住院率保持相对稳定，与此同时，患者的生存率和残疾率均有所下降。研究发现，使用适当的疗法，包括β受体阻滞剂、阿司匹林和ACE抑制剂等药物以及侵入性手术，分别可以解释50%和70%的残疾率和死亡率下降。在那些使用适当医疗疗法的地区，老年患者的健康状况优于那些使用较少医疗疗法的地区。最后，我们估计，在急性事件后预防残疾可以延长多达3.7年的质量调整预期寿命，或带来316,000美元的价值。

abstract.text: We use data from the Fragile Families and Child Wellbeing study to estimate the effects of poor infant health, pre-pregnancy health conditions of the mother, and the father's health status on health insurance status of urban, mostly unmarried, mothers and their one-year-old children. Virtually all births were covered by health insurance, but one year later about one third of mothers and over 10 percent of children were uninsured. We separately examine births that were covered by public insurance and those that were covered by private insurance. The child's health status had no effect, for the most part, on whether the mother or child became uninsured. For publicly insured births, a maternal physical health condition made it less likely that both the mother and child became uninsured, while maternal mental illness made it more likely that both the mother and child lost insurance coverage.
