10.3386/w12577.abstractZh: 专利保护通过提高研究的回报来促进创新，但通常在创新被发现后会导致不太理想的分配结果。实际上，专利奖励的是拥有低效垄断权力的发明家。然而，以往对知识产权的分析仅关注专利通过限制价格竞争所带来的成本。我们分析了竞争在价格以外的维度上可能发挥的重要但被忽视的作用。与专利垄断相比，竞争性的企业可能会在非价格竞争方面采取低效的行动——例如市场营销——而这些活动对竞争对手也有好处。因此，专利垄断可能以较低的效率定价，但比竞争性企业更高效地运作市场。我们使用1990年至2003年美国制药行业的专利到期数据来衡量这一问题的实际重要性。与单纯的价格竞争预测相反，我们发现专利到期实际上在第一年对产量产生了负面影响。这是由于市场营销努力的减少，抵消了价格的降低。短期内，每款药物的产量损失使消费者每月损失至少40万美元。然而，从长期来看，专利到期确实提高了产量，但专利到期对消费者的价值比仅考虑价格竞争而不考虑市场营销努力的模型预测的要低约15%。非价格竞争带来的非标准效应改变了我们对专利福利效应的分析。

abstract.text: Medicare's Part D offers heavily subsidized new drug coverage to 22.5 million seniors to date, of whom 16.5 million are in stand-alone drug plans (Department of Health and Human Services, 2006). The government delegated the delivery of the benefit to private insurance companies arguing that market incentives would lead them to provide coverage at the lowest price possible. The massive entry of plans and the large variety of actuarial designs and formularies offered make it complicated to assess how insurers set premiums during this first year of the program. This paper presents the first econometric evidence on whether premiums in the stand-alone drug plan markets are driven by the relevant factors predicted by insurance theory. Using data gathered from the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services, we measure a plan's generosity as the simulated out of pocket payments for different sets of drugs. We also identify the listed full drug prices by each insurer and merge these with other plan and geographical characteristics to test predictions about how insurers set premiums. We find evidence that a) the number of insurers in a market is big enough such that it does not appear to influence premiums, b) the full drug prices listed appear to be reflected to some degree in the premiums charged c) plan characteristics such as the provision of extra coverage are reflected in higher premiums, but overall there is a weak relationship between premiums and simulated out of pocket payments for different sets of drugs d) the institutional setting and regional market characteristics affect the firms' bidding behavior and their resulting premiums. Insurers appear to have responded strongly to program incentives such as the automatic enrollment of dual Medicaid-Medicare beneficiaries into low cost plans. As data for 2007 are made available, it will be important to see if plans follow similar pricing strategies in subsequent years of this program.

10.3386/w12595.abstractZh: Medicare的Part D计划为至今已有2250万老年人提供了大幅补贴的新药覆盖服务，其中1650万人使用的是独立药品计划（卫生与公共服务部，2006年）。政府将提供这种福利的职责委托给私人保险公司，认为市场激励机制会促使他们以最低的价格提供保险服务。由于计划数量众多，且各保险公司的精算设计和药品清单各不相同，因此很难评估保险公司在这一计划实施的第一年是如何设定保费的。本文首次提供了计量经济学证据，以验证独立药品计划市场的保费是否由保险理论所预测的相关因素驱动。通过从Medicare和Medicaid服务中心收集的数据，我们衡量了一个计划的慷慨程度，即不同药品组合下的模拟自付费用。我们还列出了各保险公司的完整药品价格，并将其与其他计划和地理特征相结合，以验证关于保险公司如何设定保费的预测。我们发现：a) 市场中的保险公司数量足够多，因此似乎不会影响保费水平；b) 列出的完整药品价格在一定程度上反映在收取的保费中；c) 计划特性，如额外覆盖服务的提供，会导致更高的保费，但总体而言，保费与不同药品组合下的模拟自付费用之间关系较弱；d) 制度环境和区域市场特征会影响公司的投标行为及其最终保费水平。保险公司似乎对计划激励措施如自动将同时享受Medicaid和Medicare的受益人纳入低成本计划做出了积极反应。随着2007年的数据可供使用，将有必要观察该计划的后续年份中是否采用了类似的定价策略。

abstract.text: Beginning around 1880, public health issues and engineering advances spurred the installation of city water and sewer systems. As part of this growth, many cities chose to use lead service pipes to connect residences to city water systems. This choice had negative consequences for child mortality, although the consequences were often hard to observe amid the overall falling death rates. This paper uses national data from the public use sample of the 1900 Census of Population and data on city use of lead pipes in 1897 to estimate the effect of lead pipes on child mortality. In 1900, 29 percent of the married women in the United States who had given birth to at least one child and were age forty-five or younger lived in locations where lead service pipes were used to deliver water. Because the effect of lead pipes depended on the acidity and hardness of the water, much of the negative effect was concentrated on the densely populated eastern seaboard. In the full sample, women who lived on the eastern seaboard in cities with lead pipes experienced increased child mortality of 9.3 percent relative to the sample average. These estimates suggest that the number of child deaths attributable to the use of lead pipes numbered in the tens of thousands. Many surviving children may have experienced substantial IQ impairment as a result of lead exposure. The tragedy is that lead problems were avoidable, particularly once data became available on the toxicity of lead. These findings have implications for current policy and events.

10.3386/w12603.abstractZh: 大约在1880年左右，公共卫生问题和工程技术的进步促使城市开始安装供水和污水系统。作为这一发展的组成部分，许多城市选择使用铅制管道将住宅与城市供水系统连接起来。尽管这种选择对儿童死亡率产生了负面影响，但由于整体死亡率的下降，这种影响往往难以被察觉。本文利用1900年人口普查的公开数据以及1897年城市使用铅制管道的数据，来估算铅制管道对儿童死亡率的影响。在1900年，美国有29%的已婚女性，年龄在45岁及以下，且至少生育过一个孩子，她们居住的地方使用了铅制管道供水。由于铅制管道对水质的酸碱度和硬度有依赖性，因此大部分负面影响集中在人口密集的东海岸地区。在全部样本中，居住在东海岸、使用铅制管道的城市中的女性，其儿童死亡率比样本平均值高出9.3%。这些估计表明，因使用铅制管道而导致的儿童死亡人数可能达到数万。许多幸存儿童可能因铅暴露而出现严重的智商下降。令人遗憾的是，这些问题是可以避免的，尤其是在有关铅的毒性数据变得可用之后。这些发现对当前政策和相关事件具有启示意义。

abstract.text: The association between legalized abortion and crime remains a contentious finding with major implications for social policy. In this paper, I replicate analyses of Donohue and Levitt (2001, 2004, 2006) in which they regress age-specific arrests and homicides on cohort-specific abortion rates. I find that the coefficient on the abortion rate in a regression of age-specific homicide or arrest rates has either the wrong sign or is small in magnitude and statistically insignificant when adjusted for serial correlation. Efforts to instrument for measurement error are flawed and attempts to identify cohort from selection effects are mis-specified. Nor are their findings robust to alternative identification strategies. A convincing test of abortion and crime should be based on an exogenous change in abortion that had a demonstrable effect on fertility. Thus, I analyze changes in abortion rates before and after Roe to identify changes in unwanted fertility. I use within-state comparison groups to net out hard to measure period effects. I also follow Donohue and Levitt (2004) and average the effects of abortion on crime over 15 to 20 years of the life of a cohort to lessen the impact of the crack epidemic. I find little support for a credible association between legalized abortion and crime.

10.3386/w12607.abstractZh: 合法化堕胎与犯罪之间的关联仍然是一个有争议的研究结果，对社会政策有着重要的影响。在本文中，我重新分析了Donohue和Levitt（2001、2004、2006）的研究，他们通过群体特定的堕胎率来回归分析特定年龄段的逮捕和凶杀事件。我发现，在调整序列相关性后，堕胎率对特定年龄段的凶杀或逮捕率的回归系数要么符号错误，要么数值很小，且在统计上不显著。试图用工具变量来消除测量误差的方法存在缺陷，而试图通过选择效应来识别群体的方法也出现了错误。他们的研究结果也无法通过其他识别策略得到验证。一个有效的测试堕胎与犯罪之间关系的标准应该是，存在一个能够显著影响生育率的外部因素导致的堕胎变化。因此，我分析了罗伊案前后堕胎率的变化，以识别不想要的生育率变化。我使用州内比较组来抵消难以测量的时期效应。此外，我遵循Donohue和Levitt（2004）的方法，将堕胎对犯罪的影响平均到15到20年的群体生命周期内，以减少“ crack 流行病”的影响。我发现，合法化堕胎与犯罪之间并不存在可信的关联。

abstract.text: The number of states that require parental involvement in a minor's decision to terminate a pregnancy has more than doubled since 1988. Congress is currently considering legislation that would further limit access to abortion for minors who reside in states that enforce parental involvement laws. So far, the academic literature has not reached a consensus as to the impact of such abortion restrictions, mainly due to methodological limitations caused by the inability to measure cross-state travel and misclassification of exposure. Using detailed data on abortions and births from Texas, we demonstrate that these limitations led researchers to overestimate the decline in minors' abortion rate, underestimate the increase in their birth rate, and to miss an important behavioral response to the law, which is the tendency to delay the abortion among a group of older minors. Correction of these methodological problems is important given the controversy surrounding abortion and the need of voters and policymakers to accurately assess the likely impact of these laws.

10.3386/w12608.abstractZh: 自1988年以来，要求父母参与未成年者终止妊娠决定的州数量增加了一倍多。目前，国会正在考虑一项立法，以进一步限制居住在实施父母参与法律州的未成年人的堕胎权利。迄今为止，学术文献尚未就此类堕胎限制的影响达成共识，主要是由于无法测量跨州旅行和暴露分类的错误导致的方法学局限性。利用德克萨斯州的详细堕胎和出生数据，我们发现这些局限性导致研究人员高估了未成年人堕胎率的下降，低估了出生率的增加，并忽略了法律对行为的重要影响，即一群年龄较大的未成年人倾向于推迟堕胎。鉴于围绕堕胎的争议以及选民和政策制定者需要准确评估这些法律可能的影响，纠正这些方法学问题非常重要。

abstract.text: This study examines the relationship between time discounting, other sources of time preference, and intertemporal choices about smoking. Using a survey fielded for our analysis, we elicit rates of time discount from choices in financial and health domains. We also examine the relationship between other determinants of time preference and smoking status. We find very high rates of time discount in the financial realm for a horizon of one year, irrespective of smoking status. In the health domain, the implied rates of time discount decline with the length of the time delay (hyperbolic discounting) and the sign of the payoff (the "sign effect"). We use a series of questions about the willingness to undergo a colonoscopy to elicit short- and long-run rates of discount in a quasi-hyperbolic discounting framework, finding no evidence that short-run and long-run rates of discount differ by smoking status. Using more general measures of time preference, i.e., impulsivity and length of financial planning horizon, smokers are more impatient. However, neither of these measures is significantly correlated with the measures of time discounting. Our results indicate that subjective rates of time discount revealed through committed choice scenarios are not related to differences in smoking behavior. Rather, a combination of more general measures of time preference and self-control, i.e., impulsivity and financial planning, are more closely related to the smoking decision.

10.3386/w12615.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了时间折扣、其他时间偏好来源以及关于吸烟的跨时选择之间的关系。通过一项调查收集数据，我们从金融和健康领域的选择中获取时间折扣率。我们还研究了其他时间偏好因素与吸烟状态之间的关系。研究发现，在一年的时间范围内，金融领域的時間折扣率非常高，且不受吸烟状态的影响。在健康领域，时间折扣率随着时间延迟的长度（超线性折扣）和收益的符号（“符号效应”）而变化。我们通过一系列关于接受结肠镜检查意愿的问题，在准超线性折扣框架下获取短期和长期折扣率，未发现短期和长期折扣率因吸烟状态而异。使用更一般的时间偏好指标，即冲动性和金融规划的时间范围，发现吸烟者更加急躁。然而，这些指标与時間折扣指标之间没有显著相关性。我们的结果表明，通过承诺选择情景揭示的主观时间折扣率与吸烟行为的差异无关。相反，更一般的时间偏好指标以及自我控制能力，即冲动性和金融规划，与吸烟决策更为相关。

abstract.text: This paper examines the effect of antidepressant use on the likelihood of being employed among HIV-positive women receiving highly active antiretroviral therapy (HAART) in the United States from 1994 to 2004. We use instrumental variables to predict antidepressant use independently of outcomes; thus, addressing potential sources of bias -- more depressed women are more likely to receive antidepressant treatment, but they are also more likely to be unemployed. The results show that antidepressant use has a positive effect on the employment probability of women living with HIV. The proposed instrumental variables can be used to identify antidepressant use in the WIHS population. Among women receiving HAART, and controlling for individual and local area labor market characteristics, the use of antidepressants is associated with a higher probability of being employed.

10.3386/w12619.abstractZh: 本文研究了抗抑郁药物的使用对1994年至2004年间在美国接受高效抗逆转录病毒疗法治疗的HIV阳性女性就业可能性的影响。我们采用工具变量法来预测抗抑郁药物的使用情况，从而排除潜在偏差因素——抑郁情绪较重的女性更有可能接受抗抑郁治疗，但同时也更有可能处于失业状态。研究结果表明，抗抑郁药物的使用对HIV感染女性的就业可能性有积极影响。所提出的工具变量法可用于识别WIHS人群中抗抑郁药物的使用情况。在控制个体和当地劳动力市场特征的情况下，抗抑郁药物的使用与更高的就业可能性相关。

abstract.text: What are the important tradeoffs in consulting a single expert for both diagnosis and treatment? On one hand, an integrated diagnostician may have the incentive to recommend treatments that are not in the buyer's best interests. On the other hand, joint production of diagnosis and treatment by an integrated diagnostician may be more efficient. We examine an important special case of this problem: the costs and health outcomes of elderly Medicare beneficiaries with coronary artery disease. We compare the empirical consequences of diagnosis by an "integrated" cardiologist -- one who can provide surgical treatment -- to the consequences of diagnosis by a non-integrated cardiologist. Diagnosis by an integrated cardiologist leads, on net, to higher health spending but similar health outcomes. The net effect contains three components: reduced spending and improved outcomes from better allocation of patients to surgical treatment options; increased spending conditional on treatment option; and worse outcomes from poorer provision of non-surgical care. We conclude that accounting more completely for doctors' incentives to refer patients in setting reimbursements, or in the alternative, allowing doctors more freedom to make and receive payments for referrals, could reduce spending and improve quality.

10.3386/w12623.abstractZh: 在咨询单一专家进行诊断和治疗时，存在哪些重要的权衡？一方面，综合诊断医生可能有动机推荐对买家不利的治疗方案。另一方面，由综合诊断医生共同进行诊断和治疗可能更为高效。我们研究了一个重要的特殊情况：患有冠状动脉疾病的老年医疗保险受益人的成本和健康结果。我们比较了由“综合”心脏病专家进行诊断与非综合心脏病专家进行诊断的实证后果。由综合心脏病专家进行诊断，总体上会导致更高的健康支出，但健康结果相似。净效应包含三个组成部分：减少支出并通过更好地分配患者到手术治疗选项来提高结果；在采用手术治疗选项的情况下增加支出；以及由于非手术治疗的提供质量较差而导致的结果恶化。我们得出结论，在设定报销机制时，更全面地考虑医生推荐患者的动机，或者让医生在推荐和接受报酬方面拥有更多自由，可能会减少支出并提高质量。

abstract.text: Although decades of empirical research has demonstrated that criminal behavior responds to incentives, non-economists frequently express the belief that human beings are not rational enough to make calculated decisions about the costs and benefits of engaging in crime and therefore, a priori drawing the conclusion that criminal activity cannot be altered by incentives. However, scientific research should not be driven by personal beliefs. Whether or not economic conditions matter or deterrence measures such police, arrests, prison deaths, executions, and commutations provide signals to people is an empirical question, which should be guided by a solid theoretical framework. In this paper we extend the analysis of Mocan and Gittings (2003). We alter the original model in a number of directions to make the relationship between homicide rates and death penalty related outcomes (executions, commutations and removals) disappear. We deliberately deviate from the theoretically consistent measurement of the risk variables originally employed by Mocan and Gittings (2003) in a variety of ways. We also investigate the sensitivity of the results to changes in the estimation sample (removing high executing states for example) and weighting. The basic results are insensitive to these and a variety of other specification tests performed in the paper. The results are often strong enough to even hold up under theoretically meaningless measurements of the risk variables. In summary, the original findings of Mocan and Gittings (2003) are robust, providing evidence that people indeed react to incentives induced by capital punishment. Research findings about the deterrent effect of the death penalty evoke strong feelings, which could be due to political, ideological, religious, or other personal beliefs. Yet, such findings do not mean that capital punishment is good or bad, nor does it provide any judgment about whether capital punishment should be implemented or abolished. It is simply a scientific finding which demonstrates that people react to incentives. Therefore, there is no need to be afraid of this result.

10.3386/w12631.abstractZh: 尽管数十年的实证研究表明，犯罪行为会对激励作出反应，但非经济学家们常常认为，人类并不够理性，无法对犯罪行为的成本和收益进行精算决策，因此，他们先验地认为，激励措施无法改变犯罪活动。然而，科学研究不应由个人信念驱动。经济条件是否重要，以及诸如警察、逮捕、监狱死亡、处决和减刑等威慑措施是否能向人们传递信号，这些都是需要实证研究的课题，而研究应基于坚实的理论框架。在本文中，我们扩展了Mocan和Gittings（2003）的分析。我们对原始模型进行了多项修改，使得杀人率与死刑相关的结果（如处决、减刑和死刑缓期执行）之间的关系消失。我们故意偏离了Mocan和Gittings（2003）最初使用的、在理论上一致的风险变量测量方法。我们还研究了结果对估计样本变化（例如移除高处决率的国家）和权重变化的敏感性。基本结果对这些以及其他多种规格测试都不敏感。这些结果通常足够稳健，即使在理论上无意义的风险变量测量下也能成立。总之，Mocan和Gittings（2003）的原始发现是稳健的，它们提供了证据，表明人们确实会对死刑引发的激励作出反应。关于死刑威慑效果的研究结果会引发强烈的情感反应，这可能是由于政治、意识形态、宗教或其他个人信念所致。然而，这样的研究结果并不意味着死刑是好的还是坏的，也不对死刑是否应该实施或废除做出任何判断。这仅仅是一个科学发现，表明人们会对激励因素做出反应。因此，不必害怕这一结果。

abstract.text: Autism is currently estimated to affect approximately one in every 166 children, yet the cause or causes of the condition are not well understood. One of the current theories concerning the condition is that among a set of children vulnerable to developing the condition because of their underlying genetics, the condition manifests itself when such a child is exposed to a (currently unknown) environmental trigger. In this paper we empirically investigate the hypothesis that early childhood television viewing serves as such a trigger. Using the Bureau of Labor Statistics' American Time Use Survey, we first establish that the amount of television a young child watches is positively related to the amount of precipitation in the child's community. This suggests that, if television is a trigger for autism, then autism should be more prevalent in communities that receive substantial precipitation. We then look at county-level autism data for three states -- California, Oregon, and Washington -- characterized by high precipitation variability. Employing a variety of tests, we show that in each of the three states (and across all three states when pooled) there is substantial evidence that county autism rates are indeed positively related to county-wide levels of precipitation. In our final set of tests we use California and Pennsylvania data on children born between 1972 and 1989 to show, again consistent with the television as trigger hypothesis, that county autism rates are also positively related to the percentage of households that subscribe to cable television. Our precipitation tests indicate that just under forty percent of autism diagnoses in the three states studied is the result of television watching due to precipitation, while our cable tests indicate that approximately seventeen percent of the growth in autism in California and Pennsylvania during the 1970s and 1980s is due to the growth of cable television. These findings are consistent with early childhood television viewing being an important trigger for autism. We also discuss further tests that can be conducted to explore the hypothesis more directly.

10.3386/w12632.abstractZh: 目前估计，大约每166名儿童中就有1名患有自闭症，但导致这种疾病的确切原因尚不清楚。目前关于该疾病的理论之一认为，在那些因遗传因素而易患自闭症的儿童中，当这些儿童接触到某种（目前尚不清楚的）环境诱因时，疾病就会显现出来。在本文中，我们实证研究了幼儿看电视时间是否可以作为这种诱因的假设。通过美国劳工统计局的《美国时间使用调查》，我们首先发现，幼儿观看电视的时间与其所在社区的降水量呈正相关。这表明，如果电视确实是自闭症的诱因，那么降水量较大的社区中自闭症的发病率应该更高。接着，我们分析了加利福尼亚州、俄勒冈州和华盛顿州这三个降水量变化较大的州的自闭症数据。通过多种测试，我们发现这三个州的自闭症发病率确实与降水量呈正相关。最后，我们利用加利福尼亚州和宾夕法尼亚州1972年至1989年间出生的儿童数据，再次证实了与电视诱因假设一致的结果：自闭症发病率也与订阅有线电视的家庭比例呈正相关。我们的降水测试表明，在研究的三个州中，大约40%的自闭症诊断是由于观看电视导致的，而我们的有线电视测试则显示，在1970年代和1980年代，加利福尼亚州和宾夕法尼亚州的自闭症病例增加约17%的原因在于有线电视的普及。这些发现与早期儿童时期观看电视与自闭症之间的关联一致。我们还讨论了可以进一步进行的测试，以更直接地验证这一假设。

abstract.text: To better understand the potential economic repercussions of a bioterrorist attack, this paper explores the effects of several catastrophic epidemics that struck American cities between 1690 and 1880. The epidemics considered here killed between 10 and 25 percent of the urban population studied. A particular emphasis is placed on smallpox and yellow fever, both of which have been identified as potential bioterrorist agents. The central findings of the paper are threefold. First, severe localized epidemics did not disrupt, in any permanent way, the population level or long-term growth trajectory of those cities. Non-localized epidemics (i.e., those that struck more than one major city) do appear to have had some negative effect on population levels and long-term growth. There is also modest evidence that ill-advised responses to epidemics on the part of government officials might have had lasting and negative effects in a few cities. Second, severe localized epidemics did not disrupt trade flows; non-localized epidemics had adverse, though fleeting, effects on trade. Third, while severe epidemics probably imposed some modest costs on local and regional economies, these costs were very small relative to the national economy.

10.3386/w12636.abstractZh: 为了更好地理解生物恐怖袭击可能带来的经济影响，本文探讨了1690年至1880年间袭击美国城市的几次灾难性流行病的影响。这些流行病导致被研究的城市人口中有10%到25%丧生。文章特别强调了天花和黄热病，这两种疾病都被认为是潜在的生物恐怖袭击源。本文的主要发现有三点。首先，严重的局部性流行病并没有永久性地破坏这些城市的居民水平或长期增长轨迹。而非局部性流行病（即袭击多个主要城市的流行病）确实对居民水平和长期增长产生了一些负面影响。此外，有证据表明，政府官员对流行病的不当应对可能在一些城市产生了长期且负面的影响。其次，严重的局部性流行病并没有扰乱贸易流动；而非局部性流行病则对贸易产生了短暂的不利影响。第三，虽然严重的流行病可能对当地和区域经济造成了一些成本，但这些成本相对于整个国民经济来说非常微不足道。

abstract.text: The stated goals of welfare reform are to increase work, reduce dependency on welfare, reduce births outside marriage, and to increase the formation of two parent families. However, welfare reform may also have indirect impacts on health. We provide a comprehensive review of the literature on the impacts of welfare reform on health. We illustrate the main findings from the literature by presenting estimates of the impact of reform on health insurance, health utilization, and health status using data from five state waiver experiments. The most consistent finding is that welfare reform led to a reduction in health insurance coverage. The impacts on health care utilization and health status tend to be more mixed and fewer are statistically significant. While the results are not conclusive, they suggest that welfare-to-work programs need not have large negative health effects.

10.3386/w12642.abstractZh: 福利改革的目标包括增加工作机会、减少对福利的依赖、降低婚外生育现象，以及促进双亲家庭的形成。然而，福利改革也可能对健康产生间接影响。我们对福利改革对健康影响的文献进行了全面综述。通过利用五个州级福利改革实验的数据，我们展示了改革对健康保险、健康利用和健康状况的影响。最一致的结论是，福利改革导致健康保险覆盖范围减少。而对健康利用和健康状况的影响则更为复杂，且统计上显著性的结论较少。尽管这些结果并不具有决定性意义，但它们表明，将福利资源转化为工作机会的计划，可能不会对健康产生严重的负面影响。

abstract.text: Broad claims are frequently made that new medications will offset all or part of their costs by reducing other areas of Medicaid spending. In this paper we examine the net impact on spending for new drugs used to treat schizophrenia. We extend research in this area by taking a new approach to identification of spending impacts of new drugs. We specify and estimate models of spending on treatment of schizophrenia using 7 years of Florida Medicaid data. The estimates indicate that use of the new drugs result in net spending increases. This may be due to increased adherence to treatment.

10.3386/w12643.abstractZh: 人们经常声称，新药物能够通过减少医疗补助在其他领域的支出来抵消其全部或部分成本。在本文中，我们研究了用于治疗精神分裂症的新型药物对支出的净影响。我们通过采用新的方法来识别新型药物对支出的影响，从而扩展了这一领域的研究。我们使用佛罗里达州医疗补助数据中的7年数据，建立了治疗精神分裂症的相关模型，并进行了估计。估计结果显示，使用新型药物会导致支出的净增加。这可能是由于患者治疗依从性的提高所致。

abstract.text: Substantial uncertainty exists about the impact of school quality on the black-white achievement gap. Our results, based on both Texas Schools Project (TSP) administrative data and the Early Childhood Longitudinal Survey (ECLS), differ noticeably from other recent analyses of the black-white achievement gap by providing strong evidence that schools have a substantial effect on the differential. The majority of the expansion of the achievement gap with age occurs between rather than within schools, and specific school and peer factors exert a significant effect on the growth in the achievement gap. Unequal distributions of inexperienced teachers and of racial concentrations in schools can explain all of the increased achievement gap between grades 3 and 8. Moreover, non-random sample attrition for school changers and much higher rates of special education classification and grade retention for blacks appears to lead to a significant understatement of the increase in the achievement gap with age within the ECLS and other data sets.

10.3386/w12651.abstractZh: 关于学校质量对黑人与白人成绩差距的影响，目前存在相当大的不确定性。我们的研究结果基于德克萨斯州学校项目（TSP）的行政数据以及早期儿童纵向调查（ECLS）的数据，与其他关于黑人与白人成绩差距的最新分析相比，显示出明显的差异。成绩差距随年龄增长的大部分扩展发生在学校之间，而非学校内部。具体的学校和同伴因素对成绩差距的增长有着显著的影响。缺乏经验的教师分布不均以及学校中种族集中现象的存在，可以解释3年级到8年级之间成绩差距的扩大。此外，学校变更学生的非随机样本流失现象，以及黑人学生更高的特殊教育分类和留级率，似乎导致ECLS和其他数据集中的成绩差距随年龄增长的数据被显著低估。

abstract.text: Previous work shows that higher levels of education quality (as measured by international student achievement tests) increases growth rates of national income. This paper begins by confirming those findings in an analysis involving more countries over more time with additional controls. We then use the panel structure of our data to assess whether the mechanism by which education quality appears to improve per capita income levels is through shifting the level of the production function (probably not), through increasing the impact of an additional year of education (probably not), or through increasing a country's rate of technological progress (very likely). Mortality rates complement income levels as indicators of national well-being and we extend our panel models to show that improved education quality increases the rate of decline in infant mortality. Throughout the analysis, we find a stronger impact of education quality and of years of schooling in open than in closed economies.

10.3386/w12652.abstractZh: 先前的研究表明，更高的教育质量水平（以国际学生成绩测试为衡量标准）能够提升国民收入的增长率。本文通过涉及更多国家、更长时间跨度以及额外控制因素的分析，进一步证实了这些发现。随后，我们利用数据的面板结构来探讨教育质量的提升是否通过改变生产函数的水平来实现（可能性不大）；或者通过增加额外一年的教育年限来实现（可能性也不大）；或者通过提高一个国家的技术进步率来实现（可能性很大）。死亡率作为国民福祉的指标，能够补充收入水平的信息。我们进一步扩展面板模型分析，发现教育质量的提升能够降低婴儿死亡率的下降速度。在整个分析过程中，我们发现，在开放经济中，教育质量和受教育年限的影响更为显著，而在封闭经济中则未必如此。

abstract.text: Looking across many diseases, average health among mature men is much worse in America compared to England. Second, there exists a steep negative health gradient for men in both countries where men at the bottom of the economic hierarchy are in much worse health than those at the top. This health gradient exists whether education, income, or financial wealth is used as the marker of one's SES status. These conclusions are maintained even after controlling for a standard set of behavioral risk factors such as smoking, drinking, and obesity and are equally true using either biological measures of disease or individual self-reports. In contrast to these disease based measures, health of American men appears to be superior to the health of English men when self-reported general health status is used. The contradiction most likely stems instead from different thresholds used by Americans and English when evaluating health status on subjective scales. For the same "objective" health status, Americans are much more likely to say that their health is good than are the English. Finally, feedbacks from new health events to household income are one of the reasons that underlie the strength of the income gradient with health in England.

10.3386/w12674.abstractZh: 从许多疾病的角度来看，与英格兰相比，美国的成年男性平均健康状况要差得多。其次，在这两个国家中，男性的健康状况都存在明显的负面梯度，即经济地位较低的男性健康状况明显不如经济地位较高的男性。这种健康状况的梯度无论以教育水平、收入还是财务财富作为社会经济地位的标志时都存在。即使在控制了吸烟、饮酒和肥胖等常见行为风险因素后，这些结论仍然成立；使用疾病的生物学指标或个人自我报告时，结论同样成立。与基于疾病的指标相比，当使用自我报告的一般健康状况时，美国男性的健康状况似乎优于英格兰男性。这种矛盾很可能源于美国人和英格兰人在评估主观健康状况时使用的不同标准。对于相同的“客观”健康状况，美国人更有可能认为自己健康状况良好，而英格兰人则不然。最后，新的健康事件对家庭收入的影响也是英格兰健康状况与收入之间存在梯度的原因之一。

abstract.text: EU countries closely regulate pharmaceutical prices whereas the U.S. does not. This paper shows how price constraints affect the profitability, stock returns, and R&D spending of EU and U.S. firms. Compared to EU firms, U.S. firms are more profitable, earn higher stock returns, and spend more on research and development (R&D). Some differences have increased over time. In 1986, EU pharmaceutical R&D exceeded U.S. R&D by about 24 percent, but by 2004, EU R&D trailed U.S. R&D by about 15 percent. During these 19 years, U.S. R&D spending grew at a real annual compound rate of 8.8 percent, while EU R&D spending grew at a real 5.4 percent rate. Results show that EU consumers enjoyed much lower pharmaceutical price inflation, however, at a cost of 46 fewer new medicines introduced by EU firms and 1680 fewer EU research jobs.

10.3386/w12676.abstractZh: 欧盟国家对药品价格进行严格监管，而美国则没有。本文探讨了价格限制如何影响欧盟和美国企业的盈利能力、股票回报以及研发支出。与欧盟企业相比，美国企业在盈利性、股票回报以及研发支出方面表现更优。随着时间的推移，这些差异也有所扩大。1986年，欧盟的药品研发支出比美国高出约24%，但到2004年，欧盟的研发支出仅相当于美国的15%。在这19年间，美国的研发支出实际年均增长率为8.8%，而欧盟的研发支出年均增长率为5.4%。研究结果表明，尽管欧盟消费者的药品价格通胀程度较低，但代价是欧盟企业推出的新药数量减少了46种，同时欧盟的研究岗位也减少了1680个。

abstract.text: Monopolies appear throughout health care markets, as a result of patents, limits to the extent of the market, or the presence of unique inputs and skills. In the health care industry, however, the deadweight costs of monopoly may be small or even absent. Health insurance, frequently implemented as an ex ante premium coupled with an ex post co-payment per unit consumed, effectively operates as a two-part pricing contract. This allows monopolists to extract consumer surplus without inefficiently constraining quantity. This view of health insurance contracts has several implications: (1) Low ex post copayments to insured consumers substantially reduce deadweight losses from medical care monopolies -- we calculate, for instance, that the presence of health insurance lowers monopoly loss in the US pharmaceutical market by 82 percent; (2) Price regulation or break-up of health care monopolies may be inferior to laissez-faire or simple redistribution of monopoly profits; and (3) Promoting efficiency in the health insurance market can reduce static losses in the goods market while improving the dynamic efficiency of innovation.

10.3386/w12681.abstractZh: 垄断现象在医疗保健市场中普遍存在，这可能是由于专利制度、市场规模的限制，或是由于独特的投入和技能的存在。然而，在医疗保健行业中，垄断带来的无谓成本可能很小，甚至不存在。健康保险通常是以事前保费加事后按消费单位计费的模式实施的，这实际上是一种两部分定价合同。这种定价方式使得垄断者能够在不过度限制消费量的前提下获取消费者剩余。这种对健康保险合同的看法有几个重要意义：(1) 对参保消费者实施较低的事后费用，可以显著减少医疗垄断带来的无谓损失——例如，我们计算发现，健康保险的存在使美国制药市场的垄断损失降低了82%；(2) 对医疗保健垄断进行价格管制或拆分，可能不如放任自流或简单重新分配垄断利润更为有效；(3) 提高健康保险市场的效率，可以在减少商品市场的静态损失的同时，提升创新的动态效率。

abstract.text: Using a sample of households in 48 Chinese villages for the period 1986-2002, this paper studies the dynamic effects of major health shocks on household income and the role played by village elections in mitigating these effects. Our results show that in the first 15 years after a shock, a shock-hit household on average falls short of its normal income trajectory by 11.8% and its recovery would take 19 years. Based on the premise that shock-hit families impose negative externalities on richer families by borrowing from them, our political economy model predicts that the outcome of village elections would differ from that of a standard median voter model in that the elected village leaders tend to adopt pro-poor policies. Our empirical study finds that villages are more likely to establish a healthcare plan after the election is introduced. In addition, village elections reduce the probability of a household to borrow by 16.7% when one of its working adults is seriously sick. As a result, they reduce more than half of the negative effect of a health shock on household income.

10.3386/w12686.abstractZh: 本文以1986至2002年期间48个中国村庄的家庭样本为研究对象，研究了重大健康冲击对家庭收入的动态影响，以及村选举在缓解这些影响中的作用。研究结果表明，在冲击发生后的前15年内，受冲击的家庭平均收入会低于正常水平11.8%，其恢复时间长达19年。基于“受冲击的家庭通过向富裕家庭借款而对其产生负面外部性”这一假设，我们的政治经济学模型预测，村选举的结果会与标准的中位选民模型有所不同，即当选的村领导倾向于采取有利于贫困群体的政策。实证研究发现，村选举后，村庄更有可能制定医疗保健计划。此外，当家庭中的一名工作人口患病时，村选举可使家庭借款的概率降低16.7%。因此，村选举能够减少超过一半的健康冲击对家庭收入的负面影响。

abstract.text: We explore the proposition that expected longevity affects retirement decisions and accumulated wealth using micro data drawn from the Health and Retirement Study for the United States. We use data on a person's subjective probability of survival to age 75 as a proxy for their prospective lifespan. In order to control for the presence of measurement error and focal points in responses, as well as reverse causality, we instrument subjective survival probabilities using information on current age, or age at death, of the respondent's parents. Our estimates indicate that increased subjective probabilities of survival result in increased household wealth among couples, with no effect on the length of the working life. These findings are consistent with the view that retirement decisions are driven by institutional constraints and incentives and that a longer expected lifespan leads to increased wealth accumulation.

10.3386/w12688.abstractZh: 我们探讨了预期寿命对退休决策和财富积累的影响，使用了来自美国健康与退休研究的小数据。我们用一个人到75岁的主观生存概率作为其预期寿命的代理指标。为了控制测量误差、回答中的焦点问题以及反向因果关系，我们通过使用受访者父母当前的年龄或死亡年龄的信息来工具化主观生存概率。我们的估计表明，主观生存概率的增加会导致夫妻家庭财富的增加，而对工作年限没有影响。这些发现与以下观点一致：退休决策是由制度约束和激励因素驱动的，而较长的预期寿命会导致财富积累的增加。

abstract.text: The provision of life-saving antiretroviral (ARV) treatment has emerged as a key component of the global response to HIV/AIDS, but very little is known about the impact of this intervention on the welfare of children in the households of treated persons. We estimate the impact of ARV treatment on children's schooling and nutrition outcomes using longitudinal household survey data collected in collaboration with a treatment program in western Kenya. We find that children's weekly hours of school attendance increase by over 20 percent within six months after treatment is initiated for the adult household member. For boys in treatment households, these increases closely follow their reduced market labor supply. Similarly, young children's short-term nutritional status--as measured by their weight-for-height Z-score--also improves dramatically. We argue that these treatment effects will be considerably larger when compared to the counterfactual scenario of no ARV treatment. The results provide evidence on how intrahousehold resource allocation is altered in response to significant health improvements. Since the improvements in children's schooling and nutrition at these critical early ages will affect their socio-economic outcomes in adulthood, the widespread provision of ARV treatment is likely to generate significant long-run macroeconomic benefits.

10.3386/w12689.abstractZh: 提供救命的抗逆转录病毒治疗已成为全球应对艾滋病的关键措施，但关于这一干预措施对接受治疗者家庭儿童福利的影响知之甚少。我们结合肯尼亚西部的一个治疗项目，利用纵向家庭调查数据，估算了抗逆转录病毒治疗对儿童就学情况和营养状况的影响。研究发现，在成人家庭成员接受治疗后的六个月内，儿童的每周上学时间增加了20%以上。对于接受治疗家庭的男孩来说，这种增加与他们的市场劳动力供应减少情况密切相关。同样，幼儿的短期营养状况——通过体重与身高的Z分数来衡量——也显著改善。我们认为，与没有抗逆转录病毒治疗的对照情况相比，这些治疗效果将更大。这些结果揭示了在重大健康改善情况下，家庭内部资源分配是如何发生变化的。由于在这些关键早期阶段，儿童就学情况和营养状况的改善将影响其成年后的社会经济状况，因此广泛提供抗逆转录病毒治疗可能会带来显著的长期宏观经济效益。

abstract.text: This essay examines how repugnance sometimes constrains what transactions and markets we see. When my colleagues and I have helped design markets and allocation procedures, we have often found that distaste for certain kinds of transactions is a real constraint, every bit as real as the constraints imposed by technology or by the requirements of incentives and efficiency. I'll first consider a range of examples, from slavery and indentured servitude (which once were not as repugnant as they now are) to lending money for interest (which used to be widely repugnant and is now not), and from bans on eating horse meat in California to bans on dwarf tossing in France. An example of special interest will be the widespread laws against the buying and selling of organs for transplantation. The historical record suggests that while repugnance can change over time, change can be quite slow.

10.3386/w12702.abstractZh: 本文探讨了厌恶情绪如何有时会限制我们看到的交易和市场形式。当我和我的同事们帮助设计市场与分配机制时，我们发现对某些类型交易的厌恶确实是一种现实的限制，这种限制与技术因素或激励与效率的要求所带来的限制一样重要。我将首先列举一系列例子，从奴隶制和契约奴役（过去并不像现在这样令人反感）到收取利息的借贷行为（过去被广泛认为令人反感，但现在则不然），以及从加利福尼亚禁止食用马肉到法国禁止抛掷侏儒等例子。特别值得关注的是，广泛存在的禁止买卖器官用于移植的法律。历史表明，虽然厌恶情绪会随着时间而变化，但这种变化往往相当缓慢。

abstract.text: In this paper, we calculate the consequences for health spending and federal revenues of an above-the-line deduction for out-of-pocket health spending. We show how the response of spending to this expansion in the tax preference can be specified as a function of a small number of behavioral parameters that have been estimated in the existing literature. We compare our estimates to those from other researchers. And, we use our analysis to derive some implications for tax policy toward HSAs.

10.3386/w12733.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们计算了超出线扣除个人健康支出对健康支出和联邦收入的影响。我们展示了这种税收优惠扩展对支出响应的描述，该响应可以通过现有文献中估计的少数行为参数来表征。我们将我们的估计结果与其他研究者的结果进行了比较。此外，我们利用我们的分析得出了一些关于HSA税收政策的启示。

abstract.text: People in poor countries live shorter lives than people in rich countries so that, if we scale income by some index of health, there is more inequality in the world than if we consider income alone. Such international inequalities in life expectancy decreased for many years after 1945, and the strong correlation between income and life-expectancy might lead us to hope that economic growth will improve people's health as well as their material living conditions. I argue that the apparent convergence in life expectancies is not as beneficial as might appear, and that, while economic growth is the key to poverty reduction, there is no evidence that it will deliver automatic health improvements in the absence of appropriate conditions. The strong negative correlation between economic growth on the one hand and the proportionate rate of decline of infant and child mortality on the other vanishes altogether if we look at the relationship between growth and the absolute rate of decline in infant and child mortality. In effect, the correlation is between the level of infant mortality and the growth of real incomes, most likely reflecting the importance of factors such as education and the quality of institutions that affect both health and growth.

10.3386/w12735.abstractZh: 贫困国家的人民寿命比富裕国家的人民短，因此，如果我们用某种健康指标来衡量收入，那么世界上的不平等程度会比仅考虑收入时更为严重。1945年之后，这些国际间的预期寿命不平等现象在多年内有所减少，而收入与预期寿命之间的强相关性让我们希望经济增长能够改善人们的健康状况以及物质生活条件。我认为，预期寿命的明显趋同并不如看上去那么有益，虽然经济增长是减少贫困的关键，但在缺乏适当条件的情况下，并没有证据表明它会自动带来健康的改善。如果我们观察经济增长与婴儿和儿童死亡率下降比例之间的关系，就会发现经济增长与婴儿和儿童死亡率下降之间的强烈负相关关系完全消失了。实际上，这种相关性存在于婴儿死亡率水平与实际收入增长之间，这很可能反映了教育质量和制度质量等因素对健康和增长的影响。

abstract.text: Policymakers often argue that increasing access to health care is one crucial avenue for decreasing gender inequality in the developing world. Although this is generally true in the cross section, time series evidence does not always point to the same conclusion. This paper analyzes the relationship between access to child health investments and gender inequality in those health investments in India. A simple theory of gender-biased parental investment suggests that gender inequality may actually be non-monotonically related to access to health investments. At low levels of availability, investment in girls and boys is low but equal; as availability increases, boys get investments first, creating inequality. As availability increases further, girls also receive investments and equality is restored. I test this theory using data on the relationship between gender balance in vaccinations and the availability of "Health Camps" in India. I find support for a non-monotonic relationship. This result may shed light on the contrast between the cross-sectional and time-series evidence on gender and development, and may provide guidance for health policy in developing countries.

10.3386/w12743.abstractZh: 政策制定者通常认为，增加医疗保健的获取机会是减少发展中国家性别不平等的关键途径之一。虽然这一观点在总体上是正确的，但时间序列数据并不总是支持同样的结论。本文分析了印度儿童健康投资与性别不平等之间的关系。一个简单的性别偏向性父母投资理论表明，性别不平等实际上可能与医疗保健投资的获取机会并非单调相关。在资源匮乏的情况下，对女孩和男孩的投资水平相同；随着资源增加，男孩会首先获得投资，从而形成不平等现象。当资源进一步增加时，女孩也会获得投资，平等状况得以恢复。我使用印度疫苗接种中的性别平衡数据与“健康营”的可用性数据来检验这一理论，发现其确实存在非单调关系。这一结果可能有助于解释性别与发展方面的横截面数据和时间序列数据之间的差异，并为发展中国家的卫生政策提供指导。

abstract.text: Few studies in the economics literature have linked individuals' criminal behavior to changes in their personal circumstances. Life shocks, such as natural or personal disasters, could reduce or sever a person's connections to his/her family, job, or community. With fewer connections, crime may become a more attractive option. This study addresses the question of whether an exogenous shock in life circumstances affects criminal activity. Specifically, we estimate the effects of the birth of a child with a random and serious health problem (versus the birth of a healthy infant) on the likelihood that the child's father becomes or remains involved in illegal activities. Controlling for the father's pre-birth criminal activity, we find that the shock of having a child with a serious health problem increases both the father's post-birth conviction and incarceration by 1 to 8 percentage points, depending on the measure of infant health used.

10.3386/w12754.abstractZh: 在经济学文献中，很少有研究将个人的犯罪行为与其个人状况的变化联系起来。诸如自然灾害或个人灾难这样的生活冲击可能会削弱或切断一个人与家庭、工作或社区的联系。随着联系减少，犯罪可能成为一种更有吸引力的选择。本研究探讨了生活状况的外生冲击是否会影响犯罪活动。具体来说，我们估计了生育一个患有严重健康问题的孩子（与生育一个健康婴儿相比）对父亲参与或继续从事非法活动的可能性有何影响。在控制父亲出生前的犯罪活动后，我们发现，生育一个患有严重健康问题的孩子这一冲击会使父亲在出生后的定罪率和监禁率分别增加1到8个百分点，具体取决于所使用的婴儿健康状况的衡量标准。

abstract.text: Recently, many U.S. employers have adopted less generous prescription drug benefits. In addition, the U.S. began to offer prescription drug insurance to approximately 42 million Medicare beneficiaries in 2006. We use data on individual health insurance claims and benefit data from 1997-2003 to study the effects of changing consumers' co-payments for prescription drugs on the quantity demanded and expenditure on prescription drugs, inpatient care and outpatient care. We allow for effects both in the year of the co-payment change and in the year following the change. Our results show that increases in prescription drug prices reduce both the use of and spending on prescription drugs. However, consumers substitute the use of outpatient care and inpatient care for prescription drug use, and about 35% of the expenditure reductions on prescription drugs are offset by the increases in other spending.

10.3386/w12758.abstractZh: 最近，许多美国雇主采用了较为宽松的处方药福利政策。此外，美国于2006年开始为约4200万医疗保险受益人提供处方药保险。我们利用1997至2003年的个人健康保险索赔和福利数据，研究消费者在处方药上的共同支付额变化对处方药需求量和支出、住院护理及门诊护理的影响。我们的研究考虑了支付额变化当年以及变化后一年的情况。结果显示，处方药价格的上涨减少了处方药的使用和支出。然而，消费者会通过使用门诊护理和住院护理来替代处方药的使用，大约35%的处方药支出减少被其他支出的增加所抵消。

abstract.text: Baby Boomers have left a unique imprint on US culture and society in the last 60 years, and it might be anticipated that they will also put their own stamp on retirement, the last phase of the life cycle. Yet because Boomers have not all fully retired, we cannot yet judge how they will fare as retirees. Instead, we focus on how this group compares with prior groups on the verge of retirement, that is, at ages 51-56. Accordingly, this chapter evaluates the stock of health which Early Boomers bring to retirement and compare these to the circumstances of two prior cohorts at the same point in their life cycles. Using three sets of responses from the Health and Retirement Study, we find some interesting patterns. Overall, the raw evidence indicates that Boomers on the verge of retirement are in poorer health their counterparts 12 years ago. Using a summary health index designed for this study, we find that those born 1948 to 1953 share health risks with the War Baby cohort. This suggests that most of the health decline instead began before the late 1940's. A more complex set of health conclusions emerges from the specific self-reported health measures. Boomers indicate they have relatively more difficulty with a range of everyday physical tasks, but they also report having more pain, more chronic conditions, more drinking and psychiatric problems, than their HRS earlier counterparts. This trend portends poorly for the future health of Boomers as they age and incur increasing costs associated with health care and medications. Using our health index, only those at the 75th percentile or higher are likely to be characterized as having good or better health.

10.3386/w12762.abstractZh: 在过去60年里，婴儿潮一代对美国文化和社会留下了独特的印记，可以预见他们也会为退休这一生命周期的最后一个阶段留下自己的烙印。然而，由于婴儿潮一代并非全部退休，我们还无法判断他们作为退休人士会面临怎样的状况。因此，我们重点关注这一群体与那些处于退休边缘的先前群体的比较，即那些年龄在51-56岁的人。基于此，本章评估了早期婴儿潮一代在退休时的健康状况，并将其与同一生命周期阶段的两个先前群体的情况进行比较。通过《健康与退休研究》提供的三组数据，我们发现了一些有趣的趋势。总体而言，原始数据表明，即将退休的婴儿潮一代的健康状况比12年前的情况要差。使用为这项研究设计的综合健康指数，我们发现1948年至1953年出生的群体与战争婴儿群体存在相同的健康风险。这表明，大部分健康下降实际上始于20世纪40年代末之前。从具体的自我报告健康指标来看，婴儿潮一代在一系列日常身体任务上表现出相对更多的困难，但他们报告的疼痛、慢性疾病、饮酒和精神健康问题也更多。这一趋势预示着随着婴儿潮一代年龄的增长以及与医疗保健和药物相关的成本不断增加，他们的未来健康状况将会变得不容乐观。根据我们的健康指数，只有那些处于第75百分位或更高的人才可能被认为拥有良好或更好的健康状况。

abstract.text: Basic economic theory suggests that health insurance coverage may cause a reduction in prevention activities, but empirical studies have yet to provide much evidence to support this prediction. However, in other insurance contexts that involve adverse health events, evidence of ex ante moral hazard is more consistent. In this paper, we extend the analysis of the effect of health insurance on health behaviors by allowing for the possibility that health insurance has a direct (ex ante moral hazard) and indirect effect on health behaviors. The indirect effect works through changes in health promotion information and the probability of illness that may be a byproduct of insurance-induced greater contact with medical professionals. We identify these two effects and in doing so identify the pure ex ante moral hazard effect. This study exploits the plausibly exogenous variation in health insurance as a result of obtaining Medicare coverage at age 65. We find evidence that obtaining health insurance reduces prevention and increases unhealthy behaviors among elderly men. We also find evidence that physician counseling is successful in changing health behaviors.

10.3386/w12764.abstractZh: 基础经济理论表明，健康保险覆盖可能会减少预防行为，但实证研究尚未提供足够证据来支持这一预测。然而，在涉及健康不良事件的其它保险情境中，事前道德风险的证据更为一致。本文通过考虑健康保险对健康行为的直接影响（事前道德风险）和间接影响，进一步分析了健康保险对健康行为的影响。间接影响是通过健康促进信息的改变以及因保险导致与医疗专业人员接触增多而可能产生的疾病概率来实现的。我们识别出这两种影响，并从中分离出纯粹的事前道德风险影响。本研究利用了因65岁时获得医疗保险而产生的健康保险变化这一可能的外生变量。我们发现，获得健康保险会减少老年人的预防行为，并增加不健康行为。此外，我们还发现，医生咨询在改变健康行为方面是有效的。

abstract.text: Comparing the safety of prescription drugs over time is difficult due to the paucity of reliable quantitative measures of drug safety. Both the academic literature and popular press have focused on drug withdrawals as a proxy for breakdowns in the drug safety system. This metric, however, is problematic because withdrawals are rare events, and they may be influenced by factors beyond a drug's safety profile. In the current paper, we propose a new measure: the incidence and timing of Black Box Warnings (BBWs). BBWs are warnings placed on prescription drug labels when a drug is determined to carry a significant risk of a serious or life-threatening adverse event. Using a unique data set, one that includes all new molecular entities (NMEs) submitted to the FDA between May 1981 and February 2006, and subsequently approved and marketed, we analyze the timing and incidence of BBWs. Our analyses also use data on several drug characteristics likely to affect the probability a new drug will receive a BBW. We draw several conclusions from our analyses. For example, drugs receiving priority FDA review are more likely to have BBWs at the time of approval than NMEs receiving standard review. We also find that early prescription volume and orphan drug status are associated with an increased likelihood of receiving a BBW. We do not, however, find a significant difference in the rate of BBWs across time cohorts. A comparison of NMEs approved before and after the 1992 Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA), which authorized the payment of user fees from drug manufacturers to the FDA in an effort to expedite new drug application (NDAs) review times, did not reveal a statistically significant difference in the rate of BBWs. Critics of PDUFA maintain that reduced FDA-approval times under PDUFA have compromised drug safety. We do not find empirical support for this contention.

10.3386/w12803.abstractZh: 由于缺乏可靠的定量衡量标准来评估药品的安全性，因此很难随时间比较处方药的安全性。学术文献和大众媒体都关注药品撤出情况，以此作为药品安全体系失效的替代指标。然而，这一指标存在问题，因为药品撤出是罕见事件，而且它们可能受到药物安全性之外的因素的影响。在本文中，我们提出了一种新的衡量标准：黑盒警告的发生率和时间。黑盒警告是当药品被认定存在严重或危及生命的不良事件风险时，会标注在处方药标签上的警告。我们使用了一个独特的数据集，该数据集包括1981年5月至2006年2月期间提交给FDA的所有新分子实体，并随后获得批准并上市。我们分析了黑盒警告的发生时间和频率。我们的分析还使用了一些可能影响新药品获得黑盒警告概率的药品特征数据。我们从分析中得出了几个结论。例如，获得FDA优先审查的药品在批准时更有可能出现黑盒警告，而获得标准审查的新分子实体则不太可能出现这种情况。我们还发现，早期处方数量和孤儿药状态与获得黑盒警告的可能性增加有关。然而，我们并没有发现不同时间段的黑盒警告发生率存在显著差异。对1992年《处方药用户费用法案》实施前后批准的新分子实体进行比较后，发现黑盒警告的发生率并没有统计学上的显著差异。批评PDUFA法案的人认为，PDUFA法案带来的FDA审批时间缩短已经损害了药品的安全性。我们没有找到实证支持这一论点。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: Research has documented dramatic differences in health care utilization and spending across U.S. regions with similar levels of patient illness. Although patient outcomes and quality of care have been found to be no better in regions of high health care intensity, it is unknown whether physicians in these regions feel more capable of providing good patient care than those in low-intensity regions. OBJECTIVE: To determine whether physicians in high-intensity regions feel better able to care for patients than physicians in low-intensity regions. DESIGN: Physician telephone survey. SETTING: 51 metropolitan and 9 nonmetropolitan areas of the United States and a supplemental national sample. PARTICIPANTS: 10,577 physicians who provided care to adults in 1998 or 1999 were surveyed for the Community Tracking Study (response rate, 61%). MEASUREMENTS: The End-of-Life Expenditure Index, a measure of spending that reflects differences in the overall quantity of medical services provided rather than differences in illness or price, was used to determine health care intensity in the physicians' community. Outcomes included physicians' perceived availability of clinical services, ability to provide high-quality care to patients, and career satisfaction. RESULTS: Although the highest-intensity regions have substantially more hospital beds and specialists per capita, physicians in these regions reported more difficulty obtaining needed services for their patients. The proportion of physicians who felt able to obtain elective hospital admissions ranged from 50% in high-intensity regions to 64% in the lowest-intensity region (P < 0.001 for the relationship between intensity and perceived ability to obtain hospital admissions); the proportion of physicians who felt able to obtain high-quality specialist referrals ranged from 64% in high-intensity regions to 79% in low-intensity regions (P < 0.001). Compared with low-intensity regions, fewer physicians in high-intensity regions felt able to maintain good ongoing patient relationships (range, 62% to 70%; P < 0.001) or able to provide high-quality care (range, 72% to 77%; P = 0.009). In most cases, differences persisted but were attenuated in magnitude after adjustment for physician attributes, practice characteristics, and local market factors (for example, managed care penetration); the difference in perceived ability to provide high-quality care was no longer statistically significant (P = 0.099). LIMITATIONS: The cross-sectional design prevented demonstration of a causal relationship between intensity and physician perceptions of quality. CONCLUSION: Despite more resources, physicians in regions of high health care intensity did not report greater ease in obtaining needed services or greater ability to provide high-quality care.

10.7326/0003-4819-144-9-200605020-00007.abstractZh: 背景：研究记录了美国不同地区在患者疾病程度相似的情况下，医疗利用和支出存在显著差异。尽管在医疗强度较高的地区，患者的治疗效果和护理质量并未有所改善，但尚不清楚这些地区的医生是否认为自己有能力提供比低强度地区更好的患者护理。目的：确定高强度地区的医生是否认为自己有能力比低强度地区的医生更好地为患者提供护理。设计：医生电话调查。地点：美国的51个大都市地区和9个非大都市地区，以及一个补充性全国样本。参与者：1998年或1999年曾为成人提供护理的10,577名医生，他们参与了社区跟踪研究（回复率为61%）。测量方法：使用临终支出指数作为衡量医疗强度的指标，该指数反映了医疗服务总量的差异，而非疾病或价格的差异。结果：尽管高强度地区的医院床位和专家人数明显更多，但这些地区的医生报告称，获取患者所需服务存在更多困难。在高强度地区，有50%的医生认为能够获得选择性住院服务，而在最低强度地区这一比例达到了64%（强度与获得住院服务的感知能力之间的关系具有统计学意义，P < 0.001）。在高质量专科转诊方面，高强度地区的医生比例从64%上升到低强度地区的79%（P < 0.001）。与低强度地区相比，高强度地区的医生中，能够维持良好的患者关系的比例较低（范围在62%到70%之间；P < 0.001），能够提供高质量护理的比例也较低（范围在72%到77%之间；P = 0.009）。在大多数情况下，这些差异仍然存在，但在调整了医生属性、执业特点以及当地市场因素（例如，管理式医疗的普及程度）后，这些差异的幅度有所减小。在提供高质量护理方面的感知能力差异不再具有统计学意义（P = 0.099）。局限性：横断面设计无法证明强度与医生对服务质量感知之间的因果关系。结论：尽管资源更多，但在高医疗强度地区的医生并未报告更容易获得所需服务或能够提供更高质量护理的情况。

abstract.text: During the 1990s, the hospital industry was transformed by mergers and acquisitions. This synthesis looks at why this rapid consolidation occurred and what impact it had on the price and quality for patients, and the cost of care for hospitals. Key findings include: Managed care was not a main driver of consolidation, but fear of managed care may have played a part. Other factors, including technological advances that reduced inpatient demand, and an antitrust environment that was receptive to consolidation contributed to consolidation. Research suggests hospital prices increased by 5 percent or more as a result of consolidation. When two hospitals merge, not only does the surviving hospital raise prices but so do its competitors. Evidence of the impact of consolidation on quality of care is limited and mixed, but the strongest studies show a reduction in quality. Hospital consolidation does modestly reduce the cost to hospitals of providing care.

https://openalex.org/W1602843455.abstractZh: 在1990年代，医院行业因并购而发生了变革。本文探讨了这种快速整合现象发生的原因，以及它对患者价格和医疗质量的影响，以及医院运营成本的变动。主要发现包括：医疗管理并非推动整合的主要因素，但人们对医疗管理的担忧可能起到了一定作用。其他因素，如技术进步导致住院需求减少，以及反垄断环境对整合的接纳，也促进了整合的进程。研究表明，由于整合，医院价格上升了5%或更多。当两家医院合并时，存活下来的医院不仅会提高价格，其竞争对手也会如此。关于整合对医疗质量影响的证据有限且存在争议，但最有力的研究结果显示，医疗质量有所下降。医院整合确实在一定程度上降低了医院提供服务的成本。

abstract.text: This paper undertakes an analysis of the decision to utilize public or private providers for the local provision of emergency medical services (EMS) in cities. We provide a historical overview of the EMS industry from the mid-1860s to the present day. EMS services are commonly broken into two components: first response and transport. While first response is generally kept within the purview of local fire departments, transport is maintained in-house by public agencies, contracted out to private providers, or provided by some combination of the two. The decision to employ public or private providers for EMS transport services involves a fundamental trade-off between incentives for innovation/flexibility among private providers and infrastructural advantages posed by maintaining in-house transport services. The degree to which cities value the competing advantages of each method of provision is a result of a number of city-level factors, including population, urban density, population age, health status, the likelihood of major emergency events, crime levels, the location of fire departments and trauma centers, and the strength of labor unions. This paper poses a number of hypotheses regarding how each of the above factors is likely to affect incentives to utilize public or private EMS providers. Some of these interactions are examined empirically using data on EMS contracting decisions in the 200 largest US cities. We conclude by discussing the strongest relationships between city-specific characteristics and the method of EMS provision, and identify avenues for future research in this arena.

https://openalex.org/W2262207732.abstractZh: 本文对在城市中决定利用公共或私人供应商来提供紧急医疗服务进行了分析。我们提供了从19世纪60年代中期至今的紧急医疗服务行业的历史概述。紧急医疗服务通常分为两个组成部分：第一响应和运输。第一响应通常由当地消防部门负责，而运输则由公共机构内部处理、外包给私人供应商，或者由两者结合的方式提供。决定使用公共或私人供应商来提供运输服务，涉及一个基本的权衡：私人供应商在创新/灵活性方面的激励与内部运输服务带来的基础设施优势之间的权衡。城市对每种提供方式所具备的竞争优势的重视程度，取决于多个城市层面的因素，包括人口数量、城市密度、人口年龄结构、健康状况、重大突发事件的可能性、犯罪水平、消防部门和创伤中心的位置，以及工会的力量。本文提出了一些假设，探讨上述因素如何影响使用公共或私人紧急医疗服务提供商的激励。其中一些互动关系通过美国200个最大城市的紧急医疗服务合同决策数据进行了实证分析。最后，本文讨论了城市特定特征与紧急医疗服务提供方式之间最强的关联，并指出了该领域未来研究的方向。
